title: A Portable and Versatile Limited-Memory BFGS Implementation in PETSc/TAO
summary: The limited-memory BFGS (L-BFGS) Hessian update scheme is the critical kernel in many quasi-Newton optimization algorithms. The most common approach to implementing L-BFGS uses $2m$ sequential rank-1 updates as part of solving a linear system when there are $m$ history steps. The performance of this approach suffers when the latency of synchronization is significant, and its poor temporal locality increases the memory traffic when vectors do not fit in cache. The compact dense representation of L-BFGS results in an approach that has minimal synchronization latency and better temporal locality, but it requires an additional pass over the basis vectors and an additional basis that must be recomputed when the $B_0$ matrix changes as in variable-metric methods. In the Portable Extensible Toolkit for Scientific Computation and the Toolkit for Advanced Optimization (PETSc/TAO), we have implemented an intermediate dense formulation of BFGS that retains most of the good characteristics of both the recursive and compact dense approaches. We report single-node performance tests of these implementations on the U.S. Department of Energy's Polaris and Frontier machines, testing both GPU-based and CPU-based computations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种中间密集型L-BFGS实现方法，在PETSc/TAO框架中实现了兼具递归方法和紧凑密集方法优点的方案，在GPU和CPU平台上验证了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 传统L-BFGS实现中，2m次顺序rank-1更新在同步延迟显著时性能下降，且时间局部性差导致缓存未命中时内存流量增加；紧凑密集表示虽减少了同步延迟和改善了时间局部性，但需要额外遍历基向量，且在变度量方法中B_0矩阵变化时需重新计算额外基。
AI.method: 在PETSc/TAO框架中实现了一种中间密集型BFGS公式，该方法保留了递归方法和紧凑密集方法的大部分优良特性，兼具低同步延迟、良好的时间局部性，同时避免了紧凑密集方法的额外计算开销。
AI.result: 在美国能源部的Polaris和Frontier超级计算机上进行了单节点性能测试，验证了基于GPU和CPU计算的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 提出的中间密集型L-BFGS实现方法成功平衡了递归方法和紧凑密集方法的优缺点，为高性能优化算法提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Design and Implementation of Schwarz Information Criterion-Aided Intelligent Decentralized Resource Allocation in Dynamic LoRa Networks
summary: This paper proposes a lightweight distributed learning method for selecting transmission parameters in Long-Range (LoRa) networks that adapts to dynamically changing communication environments. In the proposed method, the Thompson Sampling (TS) is adopted for transmission parameter selection, whereas the Schwarz Information Criterion (SIC) is employed for environmental change detection. TS is a reinforcement learning approach that effectively balances exploration and exploitation by updating parameters based on probability distributions. Additionally, it demonstrates stable performance even with a small number of trials, thereby making it well-suited for LoRa end devices (EDs) with limited memory capacity and computational resources. Furthermore, to address the issue that TS-based methods strongly depend on past learning histories and therefore adapt slowly to abrupt changes in communication environments, a statistical change detection mechanism based on the SIC is integrated into our proposed method. SIC is adopted because it can detect environmental changes with low computational cost and is suitable for implementation on resource-constrained LoRa EDs. When a change in the communication environment is detected by SIC, the learning history of TS is reset, thereby enabling rapid re-learning under new environmental conditions. Moreover, to achieve fully distributed communication parameter selection while enhancing transmission reliability and energy efficiency, the proposed method relies solely on Acknowledgment (ACK) feedback and the selected transmission parameters. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves the transmission success rate from 64.0% to 71.1% and increases energy efficiency from 293.9 bit/J to 328.3 bit/J compared with the conventional Upper Confidence Bound (UCB)1-tuned scheme under high-density dynamic LoRa networks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种适用于LoRa网络的轻量级分布式学习方法，结合Thompson Sampling和Schwarz Information Criterion，在动态环境中显著提升了传输成功率和能量效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于Thompson Sampling的方法在通信环境发生突变时依赖历史学习数据，导致适应性缓慢；同时，LoRa终端设备资源受限，需要低计算复杂度的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用Thompson Sampling进行传输参数选择，平衡探索与利用，适合资源受限设备；引入Schwarz Information Criterion进行环境变化检测，计算成本低，适合LoRa终端；当检测到环境变化时重置学习历史以实现快速重新学习；仅依赖ACK反馈和选定参数实现完全分布式通信参数选择。
AI.result: 在高密度动态LoRa网络中，传输成功率从64.0%提升至71.1%，能量效率从293.9 bit/J提升至328.3 bit/J，相比传统的UCB1-tuned方案有显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了轻量级、分布式的传输参数选择，在动态变化的通信环境中表现出更强的适应性和更好的性能指标，为资源受限的LoRa网络提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Cache-Consistent Dynamic Load Balancing for Kubernetes Controllers
summary: As Kubernetes clusters grow, the scalability of controllers can become a bottleneck for the performance of the system. Distributing the load dynamically across multiple controller instances, however, raises the following two problems, and a controller can therefore be run only as a single instance today. The first problem is the cost of reassignment. A controller retrieves objects on the basis of the Labels attached to them, so in a naive design in which the assigned instance is recorded in a Label on every object, the Labels must be rewritten in proportion to the total number of objects whenever instances are added or removed. The second problem is cache consistency. A controller consults only its own cache when it reads an object and never refers to the actual data, so the cache has to be updated explicitly at the time of a reassignment. Furthermore, a controller manages a cache independently for each kind of object, so cache updates have to be synchronized across the kinds of objects. We propose a method for scaling Kubernetes controllers horizontally that combines lightweight load balancing with cache synchronization. A two-level Hash maps objects to Virtual Nodes, records their identifiers in Labels, and assigns Virtual Nodes to instances by Consistent Hashing. Whenever instances are added or removed, it therefore suffices to update the Label value specified when objects are retrieved, and no Label on an object has to be rewritten. The cache is also locked until the reassignment has completed, which prevents any reference to a stale cache. The version identifier of the data store is used to synchronize the kinds of objects with one another. We implemented the proposed method on Kubernetes and evaluated it: the processing throughput rises with the number of instances, and the time required for reassignment remains within an acceptable range.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种Kubernetes控制器水平扩展方法，通过两级哈希和一致性哈希实现轻量级负载均衡，结合缓存同步机制，解决了标签重写开销和缓存一致性问题，实现了控制器性能随实例数量线性增长。
AI.motivation: 随着Kubernetes集群规模增长，单实例控制器成为系统性能瓶颈。现有方案无法实现控制器的水平扩展，主要面临两大挑战：一是负载重分配带来的标签重写开销，需按对象总数比例修改标签；二是缓存一致性问题，控制器仅读取本地缓存且按对象类型独立管理缓存，重分配时需同步更新多类型缓存。
AI.method: 提出基于两级哈希和缓存同步的控制器水平扩展方案。首先，采用两级哈希机制：对象通过哈希映射到虚拟节点，虚拟节点通过一致性哈希分配给控制器实例，将虚拟节点标识符而非实例标识符写入对象标签，避免实例增减时的标签重写。其次，引入缓存同步机制：在重分配期间锁定缓存防止访问过期数据，利用数据存储版本标识符实现不同对象类型间的缓存同步。
AI.result: 在Kubernetes上实现了该方法并进行评估，结果表明：处理吞吐量随控制器实例数量增加而提升，验证了水平扩展的有效性；重分配所需时间保持在可接受范围内，证明了轻量级负载均衡机制的低开销特性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功解决了Kubernetes控制器水平扩展中的核心挑战，在保证系统正确性的前提下实现了性能线性扩展，为大规模Kubernetes集群的控制器性能优化提供了可行的解决方案。

title: AReaL-DTE: Sparse Policy-Weight Transfer for Online Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Online agentic reinforcement learning implemented with micro-services separates policy training from rollout generation, improving scalability and modularity while potentially making frequent policy-weight synchronization a critical systems overhead. Shared storage naturally connects these services across clusters, but vanilla dense policy weight synchronization could incur model-scale construction, transfer, and application costs. Sparse synchronization reduces transferred data, yet checkpoint-oriented approaches can still retain a previous model and materialize complete intermediates to bridge heterogeneous training and inference layouts. We present AReaL-DTE, a snapshot-free Delta Transfer Engine that translates inference-visible weight sparsity into end-to-end system efficiency. Across our evaluated workloads, fewer than 2% of BF16 weight elements change between consecutive policy versions. AReaL-DTE reconstructs overwritten weights on demand by inverting AdamW updates, streams reconstructed and current parameters through converter-aligned BF16 change detection, and remaps changed elements directly into receiver-local coordinates. AReaL-DTE supports manifest-committed sparse transfer through shared storage across clusters and a deadlock-safe two-round protocol within a cluster, followed by direct application to inference shards. We evaluate AReaL-DTE on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B across four online RL workloads. AReaL-DTE achieves speedups of up to 19.9x over ByteCheckpoint and 3.2x over PULSE across clusters, and up to 7.6x and 7.4x, respectively, within a cluster. In the same-cluster Qwen3-30B-A3B experiments, it reduces peak GPU memory by approximately 41% and peak CPU memory by at least 87%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AReaL-DTE，一种无需快照的增量传输引擎，通过利用策略权重的稀疏变化（BF16权重元素变化率低于2%）显著降低了在线智能体强化学习系统中跨服务策略权重同步的开销，在跨集群和集群内场景分别实现了相比现有系统最高19.9x和7.6x的加速，并大幅降低了峰值内存占用。
AI.motivation: 在线智能体强化学习采用微服务架构分离策略训练与推演生成，提升了可扩展性和模块化，但频繁的策略权重同步成为关键系统开销。共享存储虽能连接跨集群服务，但传统密集同步涉及模型规模的构建、传输和应用成本；而稀疏同步方法（如检查点导向方法）仍需保留旧模型或物化完整中间态以桥接异构的训练与推理布局，效率受限。
AI.method: 提出AReaL-DTE，一种无需快照的增量传输引擎：(1) 通过逆向AdamW更新按需重建被覆盖的权重；(2) 将重建参数与当前参数流经对齐的BF16变化检测，识别变化元素；(3) 将变化元素直接重映射到接收端本地坐标；(4) 支持通过共享存储的manifest提交式稀疏跨集群传输，以及集群内无死锁的两轮协议；(5) 直接将变化应用于推理分片，无需完整模型物化。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-30B-A3B模型、四个在线RL工作负载上的评估表明：(1) 跨集群场景：相比ByteCheckpoint加速高达19.9x，相比PULSE加速高达3.2x；(2) 集群内场景：分别加速高达7.6x和7.4x；(3) Qwen3-30B-A3B集群内实验中，峰值GPU内存降低约41%，峰值CPU内存降低至少87%。
AI.conclusion: AReaL-DTE成功将推理可见的权重稀疏性转化为端到端系统效率，显著降低了在线智能体RL系统中的策略同步开销，为大规模分布式RL训练提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: Benchmarking LLMs on File System Design and Implementation: The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are fundamentally transforming computer system research and development. As we employ LLMs in file system (fs) development, it is essential to understand their capabilities, limitations, and operational efficiency for domain-specific tasks. We present φ-Bench, an LLM benchmarking framework for fs-specific tasks. To facilitate benchmarking, we develop six types of tasks in φ-Bench: basic understanding, basic implementation, performance modeling, debugging, optimization, and new feature development. Each type emphasizes different LLM capabilities: instruction following, knowledge recall, reasoning, or coding. To create high-quality tasks while achieving broad coverage with minimal human effort, we develop a new AI-assisted task generation pipeline in addition to expert-written and textbook-adapted tasks. With 505 tasks in φ-Bench, we conduct an empirical study with both open source (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.1, and MiniMax-M2.7) and proprietary (Claude-Opus-4.7, GPT-5.2, and Gemini-3.1-Pro) LLMs. Our study discloses the model efficiency for different tasks, causes of failed fs tasks, and techniques for mitigating LLM failures. We will open source φ-Bench to facilitate public research on using LLMs for fs development.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了φ-Bench，一个针对文件系统开发任务的LLM基准测试框架，包含6类共505个任务，通过对开源和专有LLM的实证研究，揭示了模型在文件系统特定任务中的效率、失败原因及缓解技术。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正在根本性地改变计算机系统的研发方式。在将LLM应用于文件系统开发时，理解其在领域特定任务上的能力、局限性和操作效率至关重要。然而，目前缺乏针对文件系统开发任务的系统性LLM评估基准。
AI.method: 开发了φ-Bench基准测试框架，包含六类任务：基础理解、基础实现、性能建模、调试、优化和新功能开发，分别测试指令遵循、知识回忆、推理和编码能力。采用AI辅助任务生成流程，结合专家编写和教材改编任务，以最小人工成本创建高质量任务并实现广泛覆盖。
AI.result: 构建了包含505个任务的φ-Bench基准。对开源模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.1、MiniMax-M2.7）和专有模型（Claude-Opus-4.7、GPT-5.2、Gemini-3.1-Pro）进行了实证研究，揭示了不同任务的模型效率、文件系统任务失败的原因，以及缓解LLM失败的技术方案。
AI.conclusion: φ-Bench为LLM在文件系统开发中的应用研究提供了系统性的评估工具。研究公开了模型在领域特定任务中的表现差异和失败模式，为未来改进LLM在系统开发中的应用提供了重要参考，并将开源以促进公共研究。

title: HSRAI: Permutation-Preserving Address Interleaving with Hierarchical Balance Metrics
summary:
Address interleaving balances bandwidth across caches, DRAM, and GPU partitions. In a multi-level interconnect topology, the mapping must be a one-to-one, invertible correspondence between logical and encoded addresses and, under typical access patterns, keep traffic uniform at every level's egress ports, not only at terminal slave nodes.
  Using random access as the stimulus and terminal uniformity as the acceptance criterion is insufficient for cascaded interconnects; this paper partitions workloads by access-pattern priority and requires a global bijection with no slave node left unvisited for extended periods. Per-level coefficient of variation (CV), consecutive same-port run length, and sliding-window peak occupancy evaluate traffic at each level's egress.
  HSRAI preserves high-order and intra-line low-order address bits and applies a W-bit bijection only to the intermediate index segment. Full-domain topologies use offline GF(2) affine search with matrix and salt parameters selected via priority-ranked access patterns and per-level admissibility hard constraints; pruned topologies combine the Chinese Remainder Theorem with remapping.
  Evaluation uses a reproducible C++ benchmark covering linear streams, matrix tiling, and 2D arithmetic lattices. On the 128-node full-domain topology, the proposed affine map satisfies bijection, terminal balance, design-time admissibility thresholds, and zero long-window starvation on the high-priority acceptance set; fixed XOR and folding/table baselines expose intermediate-level hotspots or extended zero-access periods. For pruned topologies, the CRT variant significantly improves per-level metrics on linear and tiling accesses. Artifact: https://github.com/xiaotongyuan/hsrai_address_hash (tag paper-v11).

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSRAI方法，通过地址交错技术解决多级互连拓扑中的带宽平衡问题，在保证全局双射和终端均匀性的同时，避免中间层热点和长期零访问问题。
AI.motivation: 在多级互连拓扑中，传统的随机访问测试和终端均匀性准则不足以评估级联互连性能。现有方法（如固定XOR、折叠/表查找）会导致中间级热点或长期零访问期，无法保证流量在各层出口端口的均匀分布。
AI.method: HSRAI保留高阶和行内低阶地址位，仅对中间索引段应用W位双射。对于全域拓扑，使用离线GF(2)仿射搜索，通过优先级排序的访问模式和各级可接受性硬约束选择矩阵和盐参数；对于剪枝拓扑，结合中国剩余定理（CRT）与重映射技术。采用逐级变异系数（CV）、连续同端口运行长度和滑动窗口峰值占用率作为评价指标。
AI.result: 在128节点全域拓扑上，提出的仿射映射满足双射、终端平衡、设计时可接受性阈值，且在优先级接受集上实现零长窗口饥饿；基线方法则暴露中间级热点或扩展零访问期。在剪枝拓扑上，CRT变体显著改善了线性和分块访问的逐级指标。
AI.conclusion: HSRAI通过优先级排序的访问模式和全局双射约束，有效解决了多级互连拓扑中的地址映射问题，避免了中间级热点和长期零访问，显著优于传统固定XOR和折叠/表查找方法。

title: Width, Memory, and Delay: A Resource Accounting for the Limits of Flat Multi-Agent Systems
summary: A recurring question in the design of scalable multi-agent systems -- from robot swarms to collectives of large-language-model (LLM) agents -- is whether adding more agents can, on its own, overcome performance limits, or whether a qualitatively \emph{deeper} organization is required. A recent preprint argues that flat, homogeneous multi-agent systems face an irreducible, population-independent ``causal floor'' on achievable error, removable only by hierarchical (nested-loop) organization. Using a controlled disturbance-rejection testbed with an exactly computable optimum, we show this conclusion is too strong and replace it with a quantitative resource model built on three resources: population \emph{width} $N$, per-agent internal-model \emph{memory} $d$, and prediction across the observation \emph{delay} $τ$. We establish three claims. (i) The achievable floor is governed not by architectural hierarchy but by per-agent internal-model content: a flat, homogeneous swarm whose agents carry a matched internal model of the disturbance matches or beats a designed two-loop hierarchy at equal per-agent memory -- so temporal depth can be dynamical (recurrent memory), not architectural (nesting). (ii) The three resources are \emph{not mutually interchangeable}; we chart the exchange rates and the hard non-exchange boundaries on an explicit width$\times$memory map, including a strict equal-total-state-budget comparison. (iii) A residual floor is set by the observation delay and the environment's unpredictability over that horizon, which we verify against the optimal controller. We quantify the price of replacing oracle knowledge of the disturbance spectrum with online learning, provide a preliminary robustness check against a mild bounded nonlinearity and a spatially-extended plant, and distill four design rules for practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"扁平同构多智能体系统存在不可约误差下限"的观点，证明通过合理配置智能体内部模型记忆，扁平系统可达到与层级结构相当的性能，并提出了基于人口宽度N、内部模型记忆d和观测延迟τ的定量资源模型。
AI.motivation: 在可扩展多智能体系统设计中（从机器人群体到大语言模型智能体群体），一个核心问题是：单纯增加智能体数量是否能突破性能限制，还是需要更深层次的组织结构？近期有预印本认为扁平同构系统存在无法通过增加智能体数量消除的"因果下限"，必须通过层级嵌套结构才能解决。本文旨在验证并修正这一结论。
AI.method: 使用可控扰动抑制测试平台（具有可精确计算的最优解）进行实验。提出基于三种资源的定量模型：人口宽度N（智能体数量）、单智能体内部模型记忆d、观测延迟τ。通过对比扁平同构群体与设计的双环层级结构，在相同单智能体记忆条件下测试性能。绘制宽度×记忆资源交换图，分析资源间的不可互换边界。
AI.result: (1)可达到的误差下限取决于单智能体内部模型内容而非架构层级：携带匹配扰动内部模型的扁平同构群体在相同单智能体记忆下可匹敌甚至超越双环层级结构——时序深度可通过动态递归记忆而非架构嵌套实现；(2)三种资源不可相互完全替代，明确了硬性非交换边界；(3)残余误差下限由观测延迟和环境在该时间窗口内的不可预测性决定，与最优控制器验证一致。量化了用在线学习替代扰动频谱先验知识的代价。
AI.conclusion: 层级结构并非解决多智能体系统性能下限的唯一途径。通过合理设计智能体内部模型记忆，扁平系统同样可以突破性能限制。为实践者提炼出四条设计规则，并为无先验知识情况下的在线学习提供了性能代价的量化分析。

title: LightCal: Lightweight Optical-Pulse Bootstrap Calibration for Crystal-Free BLE Radios
comment: 6 pages,to be published in IEEE Globecom 2026
summary: Crystal-free Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) radios remove the off-chip high-frequency crystal oscillator and can therefore reduce the cost, size, and integration complexity of Internet of Things (IoT) nodes. However, they face a fundamental bootstrap problem: before a node can communicate over RF, it must first obtain a sufficiently accurate carrier-frequency reference. Existing approaches typically rely on RF beacons, already-connected nodes, or search-based channel acquisition, which can incur long startup latency and provide limited feedback when the initial carrier offset is large. This paper presents LightCal, a lightweight bootstrap calibration method that uses periodic optical pulses as an external timing reference for crystal-free BLE radios. LightCal is designed for highly resource-constrained platforms and requires only simple optical pulse reception. We implement LightCal on scum, a crystal-free IoT platform and use a commercial HTC Lighthouse V1 base station as an unmodified off-the-shelf optical pulse source. Experimental results show that pulse accumulation substantially improves the effective timing stability of Lighthouse sync pulses on SC$μ$M and enables practical BLE bootstrap calibration. In the current scum prototype, optical calibration brings the RF carrier into a bounded residual-error range, and the remaining offset is resolved by a narrow transmit-time fine sweep. The results demonstrate that optical pulse references can provide a practical pre-RF bootstrap calibration path for crystal-free and highly integrated IoT platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LightCal，一种利用光学脉冲作为外部时序参考的无晶振BLE引导校准方法，成功解决了启动延迟长和大频偏下反馈有限的问题。
AI.motivation: 无晶振BLE无线电虽能降低物联网节点的成本、尺寸和集成复杂度，但在通信前面临引导校准问题：必须获得足够精确的载波频率参考。现有基于RF信标或搜索的方法存在启动延迟长、初始频偏大时反馈有限等局限。
AI.method: 提出LightCal方法，利用周期性光学脉冲作为外部时序参考。该方法面向资源受限平台，仅需简单的光脉冲接收功能。在SCμM无晶振平台上实现，使用商用HTC Lighthouse V1基站作为未修改的光脉冲源，通过脉冲累积提高时序稳定性，并将剩余频偏通过窄发射时间精细扫描解决。
AI.result: 实验表明，脉冲累积显著提高了SCμM上Lighthouse同步脉冲的有效时序稳定性。光学校准将RF载波引入有界残差范围，结合精细扫描可实现实用的BLE引导校准。
AI.conclusion: 光学脉冲参考可为无晶振及高集成度物联网平台提供实用的预RF引导校准路径，有效解决无晶振BLE的引导校准难题。

title: Revisiting Classic Thought Experiments to Measure Consciousness for Artificial Intelligence Safety
summary: This research note revisits Leibniz's mill, Turing's imitation game, and Searle's Chinese Room through the Conservation-Congruent Encoding (CCE) framework. It formalises a toy symbolic setting in which successful behaviour is measured by task performance ($W_{causal,T}$), while the efficiency with which preserved internal structure supports that behaviour is measured by operational consciousness ($κ_T$). Within this setup, an uncompressed lookup system and a compact generative system can in principle achieve comparable behavioural success, yet diverge sharply in $κ_T$: the former relies on an expanding standing store of unreused mappings, whereas the latter reuses compact internal structure. The note therefore reframes classic disputes about understanding by separating outward performance from the organisation that sustains it, and motivates why this distinction may matter for later AI-safety analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文基于守恒-一致性编码（CCE）框架重新审视经典哲学问题，提出通过任务表现（$W_{causal,T}$）和运作意识（$κ_T$）区分外在行为与内部组织效率，证明查找系统与生成系统虽行为相似但运作意识差异显著，为AI安全分析提供新视角。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在重新审视Leibniz之磨、图灵模仿游戏和塞尔中文房间等经典哲学问题，通过形式化框架区分外在行为成功与内部组织效率，为理解的本质及AI安全分析提供理论基础。
AI.method: 构建玩具符号设定，采用守恒-一致性编码（CCE）框架，定义任务表现$W_{causal,T}$衡量行为成功，运作意识$κ_T$衡量内部结构支持行为的效率，对比未压缩查找系统与紧凑生成系统。
AI.result: 未压缩查找系统与紧凑生成系统可实现相当的行为成功，但$κ_T$差异显著：前者依赖不断扩展的未重用映射存储，后者重用紧凑内部结构，证明行为表现与内部组织效率可分离。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分外在表现与支持其的组织结构，重新界定关于理解的经典争论，指出此区别对后续AI安全分析具有重要意义。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Simulation-Based Inference for Operations Research with Large Language Models
summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for operations research (OR) tasks remains challenging because correctness depends on a coherent modeling process, not merely a correct final answer. Standard autoregressive generation operates on a myopic policy, which sometimes fails to anticipate whether a partial formulation can be validly extended into a globally consistent optimization model. Consequently, locally plausible steps may propagate into catastrophic downstream formulation or solver code errors. To address this, we propose an uncertainty-aware, training-free inference framework for OR mathematical modeling. Without updating model parameters, our method evaluates intermediate candidate steps using short lookahead simulations to quantify downstream predictive uncertainty or probability concentration. Candidates that demonstrate a higher likelihood of yielding coherent mathematical formulations are then dynamically selected via importance resampling. Empirical evaluations across multiple OR benchmarks (including NL4OPT, MAMO, and IndustryOR) demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms both standard and low-temperature baselines, establishing an efficient, training-free paradigm for reliable OR formulation generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练、不确定性感知的推理框架，用于解决大语言模型在运筹学任务中的生成一致性问题，通过前瞻模拟和重要性重采样提升模型可靠性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在运筹学任务中的部署面临核心挑战：正确性取决于连贯的建模过程，而非仅靠正确答案。标准自回归生成采用短视策略，无法预判部分公式化能否有效扩展为全局一致的优化模型，导致局部看似合理的步骤可能引发灾难性的下游公式化或求解器代码错误。
AI.method: 提出一种无需训练、不确定性感知的推理框架：1）不更新模型参数，通过短程前瞻模拟评估中间候选步骤；2）量化下游预测不确定性或概率集中度；3）通过重要性重采样动态选择更可能产生连贯数学公式的候选步骤。
AI.result: 在多个运筹学基准测试（NL4OPT、MAMO、IndustryOR）上的实证评估表明，该框架持续优于标准和低温度基线方法，证明了其在生成可靠运筹学公式化方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一种高效、无需训练的范式，用于可靠的运筹学公式化生成，为解决大语言模型在需要连贯推理过程的专业领域任务中的应用难题提供了新思路。

title: Collaborative Orbital Edge Intelligence: A Decentralized Paradigm for Energy-Efficient Computing in Space
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for publication in IEEE Network
summary: In recent years, Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites have been increasingly deployed to enable connectivity in remote and disaster-prone areas. Researchers have proposed Orbital Edge Computing, which adds computational intelligence to LEO satellites to process data on orbit, providing edge intelligence close to space data sources. Existing work on Orbital Edge Computing typically assumes centralized control without collaboration among satellites from different providers, leading to limited connectivity, higher latency, and increased satellite battery depletion. They have not fully explored decentralized inter-satellite collaboration for energy-efficient intelligence under heterogeneous LEO constellations. This paper introduces a novel paradigm, Collaborative Orbital Edge Intelligence (COEI), that leverages decentralized collaboration among LEO satellites to enable energy-efficient on-orbit processing of space data. We describe the overall system architecture of COEI, including the issues related to networking, computing, and power management. COEI can help create a multi-party, multi-orbit megaconstellation of satellites that delivers better service quality by providing benefits, including global resilient connectivity, real-time intelligence, and energy-efficient services. To demonstrate the COEI benefits, we conduct a case study on decentralized energy-aware satellite task offloading to maximize the task success rate while minimizing the sum of the maximum battery depth-of-discharge across all satellites. Finally, we outline future directions for COEI that offer opportunities for further investigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为COEI的新型卫星边缘计算范式，通过去中心化的卫星间协作实现高效的星上数据处理，以解决现有集中式控制方案的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有的轨道边缘计算研究通常假设集中式控制，缺乏不同提供商卫星间的协作，导致连接性受限、延迟较高以及卫星电池损耗加剧。在异构LEO星座场景下，尚未充分探索去中心化的星间协作以实现能效优化。
AI.method: 提出协作轨道边缘智能（COEI）新范式，利用LEO卫星间的去中心化协作实现高效的星上数据处理。详细描述了COEI的系统架构，涵盖网络、计算和电源管理等相关问题。通过案例研究——去中心化能耗感知卫星任务卸载，展示了COEI的实施方式。
AI.result: COEI能够构建多方、多轨道的巨型卫星星座，提供全球弹性连接、实时智能和节能服务。案例研究表明，COEI可以在最大化任务成功率的同时，最小化所有卫星的最大电池放电深度总和。
AI.conclusion: COEI为解决现有轨道边缘计算的局限性提供了新思路，能够提升服务质量和能效。论文最后指出了COEI的未来研究方向，为进一步研究提供了机会。

title: Themis: A Filesystem Model Checker That Owns the Machine
summary:
Filesystem model checkers explore an unmodified in-kernel filesystem's state space to find bugs that escape unit tests. The state of the art, Metis, runs inside the OS: it drives syscalls, and, lacking a cheap way to snapshot in-kernel state from user space, it hand-codes a reference filesystem (RefFS) as its differential oracle and sets time aside as noise. Where a checker sits shapes what it can see.
  I present Themis, a filesystem model checker built beneath an unmodified in-kernel filesystem on a bare-metal Type-1 AMD-V hypervisor. Themis owns the machine: the virtual block device and the virtual clock under a stock Linux/ext2 guest. Ownership buys four things. (1) A machine-layer epsilon-copy fork whose restore cost is proportional to dirtied pages, not filesystem image size, so every unmodified filesystem becomes its own differential reference and no hand-coded reference is required. (2) Below-filesystem observation and byte-level whole-disk diffs with nuisance-field normalization. (3) Control of the clock, turning time into an explored search dimension. (4) The same fork, made re-armable, doubling as a checkpoint for bit-exact deterministic replay.
  Over a campaign of 40+ hardware runs on an AMD Zen5 9800X3D, the mechanism is proven end-to-end: a real ext2 write is served inside a fork window and fully reverted (DRAM, disk, and device state) in 9 microseconds for the dirtied set. The principal result is the clock: Themis drives real ext2 across a clock sweep and witnesses a real Y2038 defect, a 128-byte-inode clamp that a time-excluded fingerprint cannot register. A real ext2 workload replays whole-DRAM and whole-disk bit-exact across nine passes, and a timing-flaky outcome (nine distinct hashes raw) becomes reproducible when the clock is served (nine identical).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Themis，一个基于Type-1裸机hypervisor的文件系统模型检查器，通过控制虚拟块设备和虚拟时钟，实现了机器层epsilon-copy fork、全盘字节级diff、时钟作为搜索维度以及确定性重放，成功发现了ext2文件系统中真实存在的Y2038缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有文件系统模型检查器（如Metis）运行在OS内部，缺乏从用户空间快照内核状态的廉价方法，因此需要手工编写参考文件系统（RefFS）作为差异oracle，并将时间视为噪声。检查器所在的位置决定了它能看到什么，这限制了现有方法的能力。
AI.method: Themis构建在未修改的内核文件系统之下的裸机Type-1 AMD-V hypervisor上，控制虚拟块设备和虚拟时钟。这种方法带来了四个优势：（1）机器层epsilon-copy fork，其恢复成本与脏页成正比而非文件系统镜像大小，使每个未修改的文件系统都成为自己的差分参考；（2）文件系统之下的观察和字节级全盘diff；（3）时钟控制，将时间转化为探索的搜索维度；（4）可重入的fork作为位精确确定性重放的检查点。
AI.result: 在AMD Zen5 9800X3D上进行了40+次硬件运行，证明了机制的端到端有效性：真实的ext2写入在fork窗口内服务，并在9微秒内完全恢复（DRAM、磁盘和设备状态）。关键结果是时钟控制：Themis驱动真实ext2进行时钟扫描，发现了一个真实的Y2038缺陷，这是一个时间排除指纹无法检测到的128字节inode限制。真实ext2工作负载在九次传递中重放全DRAM和全盘位精确，原本时序不稳定的结果（九个不同的原始哈希）在时钟控制下变得可复现（九个相同）。
AI.conclusion: Themis证明了将模型检查器置于hypervisor层的价值：通过拥有机器的所有权（虚拟块设备和时钟），可以消除对手工参考实现的依赖，实现更强大的观察和恢复能力，并通过控制时钟将时序不确定性转化为可探索的搜索空间，从而发现传统方法无法检测到的真实缺陷。

title: Themis: Software-Defined Hardware Prefetching
summary:
Data cache misses represent a significant portion of stall cycles in datacenter workloads. Hardware prefetchers that reduce such stalls by fetching data ahead of time have become increasingly sophisticated. However, to achieve high coverage, they have to prefetch aggressively, generating many inaccurate accesses that waste memory bandwidth. This is problematic in datacenter environments where memory bandwidth is a limited resource due to high multi-tenancy.
  We observe that for datacenter workloads, inaccurate prefetches can be effectively filtered on a data page granularity, without sacrificing prefetch coverage. However, storing per-page metadata about prefetch usefulness in hardware is costly, so we propose a novel hardware-software interface for data prefetching: The software directs the hardware on where to prefetch, and the hardware identifies and issues prefetches in the regions of interest.
  We propose Themis, a profile-guided hardware prefetching solution that implements this new interface. Themis utilizes page-level hints stored in page-table entries to disable the prefetcher for certain data pages at runtime. Themis requires no binary or ISA changes and can be used to optimize processes without disrupting their execution. Themis is also orthogonal to existing works on prefetching and can be applied to optimize any hardware prefetcher. Our results show that Themis is able to achieve around 40% reduction in useless prefetch requests, resulting in speedup for all the evaluated prefetchers for datacenter workloads, including 4.1% for BOP, 3.1% for SPP+PPF, and 1.4% for Pythia.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Themis，一种基于硬件-软件协作的预取优化方案，通过页表项中的页级提示禁用特定数据页的预取，在数据中心工作负载中将无用预取请求减少约40%，同时提升多种预取器的性能。
AI.motivation: 在数据中心工作负载中，数据缓存缺失是导致停顿周期的主要原因。现有硬件预取器为提高覆盖率而采用激进策略，产生大量无效访问，浪费宝贵的内存带宽资源。这在多租户环境下尤为严重，因为内存带宽本就受限。观察发现，可以按数据页粒度有效过滤无效预取，而无需牺牲预取覆盖率，但在硬件中存储页级元数据的成本过高。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的硬件-软件接口用于数据预取：软件通过存储在页表项中的页级提示来引导硬件预取位置，硬件在感兴趣的区域内识别并发起预取。Themis利用这些页级提示在运行时禁用特定数据页的预取器。该方案无需二进制或指令集架构修改，可在不中断进程执行的情况下进行优化，且与现有预取方法正交，可应用于优化任何硬件预取器。
AI.result: Themis能够实现约40%的无用预取请求减少，为所有评估的预取器在数据中心工作负载中带来性能提升：BOP提升4.1%，SPP+PPF提升3.1%，Pythia提升1.4%。
AI.conclusion: Themis成功实现了软硬件协作的预取优化，通过页级粒度的预取控制有效平衡了预取覆盖率与内存带宽消耗，为数据中心环境下的内存带宽受限问题提供了一种低开销、易部署的解决方案。

title: MAPLE-Guard: Memory-Aware Link Enforcement Against Memory-Link Poisoning in Multi-Agent Systems
comment: 27 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Includes examples that may be misleading or harmful. Code: https://github.com/xiong-wenjun/MAPLE-Guard
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) increasingly rely on persistent private and shared memories for long-horizon coordination. This memory layer improves continuity, but it also gives attackers a durable channel: a poisoned memory can be written once, continuously retrieved in later tasks, promoted into shared memory, and reused by other agents. A single poisoned write can therefore steer many later decisions and contaminate agents that never saw the original attack, all while no malicious message crosses a visible communication edge at the moment of harm. Further, because existing safeguards mainly inspect prompts, actions, or communication edges, they can miss attacks whose content appears benign at write time but becomes harmful after retrieval. We introduce Memory-Aware Propagation and Link Enforcement Guard, MAPLE-Guard, a memory-link guard for memory-enabled MAS. MAPLE-Guard monitors the memory lifecycle and places gates at write, retrieval, promotion, and cross-agent reuse, so risky memories can be quarantined, unsafe retrievals filtered, and poisoned private memories blocked before they enter shared memory. In the main evaluation, MAPLE-Guard lowers attack success rate (ASR) from 38.2% to 0.9% on LongMemEval and from 34.7% to 0.2% on AppWorld; it also raises multi-agent defense success rate (MDSR) from 54.0% to 74.3% and from 42.5% to 99.8% on the same benchmarks. These results suggest that memory-aware link enforcement covers a gap left by prompt-level and topology-level defenses. Code is available at the link: https://github.com/xiong-wenjun/MAPLE-Guard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAPLE-Guard，一种针对LLM多智能体系统记忆层的防御机制，通过在记忆生命周期的关键节点设置门控，有效防御记忆投毒攻击，将攻击成功率降至接近0。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统(MAS)依赖持久化记忆实现长期协调，但这引入了新的攻击面：攻击者可向记忆层写入中毒内容，该内容会在后续任务中被反复检索、传播到共享记忆并被其他智能体重用。单一的中毒写入可影响大量后续决策并污染从未见过原始攻击的智能体。现有防御机制主要检测提示、动作或通信边，无法捕获写入时看似良性但检索后变为有害的攻击。
AI.method: 提出Memory-Aware Propagation and Link Enforcement Guard (MAPLE-Guard)，一种记忆链接防御机制。该方法监控记忆生命周期，在写入、检索、提升和跨智能体重用四个关键阶段设置门控，实现风险记忆隔离、不安全检索过滤、以及阻止中毒的私有记忆进入共享记忆层。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval基准上，攻击成功率(ASR)从38.2%降至0.9%，在AppWorld上从34.7%降至0.2%；多智能体防御成功率(MDSR)在LongMemEval上从54.0%提升至74.3%，在AppWorld上从42.5%提升至99.8%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，记忆感知的链接执行机制有效填补了提示级和拓扑级防御留下的安全漏洞，为记忆使能的MAS提供了关键安全防护。代码已开源。

title: HCCL: Collective Communication for Meta Training and Inference Accelerators
comment: 12 pages, 17 figures, to be published in the proceedings of "SC '26: Proceedings of the International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage and Analysis"
summary: We present HCCL, a collective communication library co-designed with Meta's MTIA 300 accelerator, the first Meta chip to integrate backend networking directly on chip package. MTIA 300 includes dedicated message engines (MEs) with near-memory compute (NMC) that fully offload collective execution from the compute grid, enabling large overlap between computation and communication. HCCL uses a compiled communication model in which the host generates a complete description of each collective including dependencies. We describe the control and data path architecture, topology-aware algorithm selection across MTIA 300's asymmetric scale-up and scale-out network, and optimizations for both training and inference workloads. For training, HCCL achieves up to 940 GB/s on intra-rack collectives while introducing less than 0.5% degradation to concurrent compute throughput. For inference, we leverage one-sided communication primitives that bypass the scheduling path to minimize collective latency and describe collective designs that improve compute-communication pipelining for latency-sensitive workloads.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了HCCL，这是一个与Meta首款集成后端网络的MTIA 300加速器协同设计的集合通信库，通过近内存计算单元完全卸载通信任务，在训练和推理场景下实现了高带宽、低延迟和高计算通信重叠率。
AI.motivation: Meta的MTIA 300加速器首次在芯片封装内集成了后端网络，配备了具有近内存计算能力的专用消息引擎（MEs），这为设计一个能充分利用硬件特性、实现计算与通信高度重叠、并针对训练和推理不同负载优化的集合通信库提供了动机。
AI.method: HCCL采用编译式通信模型，由主机生成包含依赖关系的集合操作完整描述。在数据与控制路径上进行了架构设计，实现了拓扑感知的算法选择以适应非对称的scale-up和scale-out网络。针对训练负载，优化了并发计算与通信；针对推理负载，利用单边通信原语绕过调度路径以降低延迟，并设计了改善计算-通信流水线的方案。
AI.result: 在训练场景下，HCCL在机架内集合通信上实现了高达940 GB/s的带宽，同时对并发计算吞吐量的影响小于0.5%。在推理场景下，通过单边通信原语和优化的集合设计，显著降低了延迟并改善了计算与通信的流水线效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过与MTIA 300硬件的紧密协同设计，HCCL成功利用了片上网络和近内存计算单元的优势，在保持计算效率的同时大幅提升了集合通信性能，为大规模AI训练和低延迟推理提供了一个高效的解决方案。

title: AutoFOAM: The Self-Refining Autonomous OpenFOAM Agent
summary: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) plays an important role in modern engineering, but using open-source solvers such as OpenFOAM requires considerable knowledge and skills, as well as time-consuming configuration file setup. To reduce this burden, we propose AutoFOAM - a self-evolving large language model (LLM) agent that creates, evaluates, runs, and evolves its own OpenFOAM simulations based solely on natural-language instructions. Our model is pre-trained on the Qwen-coder 2.5-14B, which is then fine-tuned on 252 text prompts targeting 7 OpenFOAM solvers, 13 parametrized mesh templates, and a y plus-aware numerical policy. The crucial element of the algorithm is a sophisticated evolution loop composed of 7 stages. To prevent model degeneration under repeated self-training, the agent employs three complementary anti-collapse streams: RAG-augmented retry context, surgical dictionary-level patching, and prompt-diversity paraphrasing. By bridging generative artificial intelligence with rigorous fluid simulations, AutoFOAM accelerates rapid prototyping and democratizes advanced CFD workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoFOAM，一个基于Qwen-coder 2.5-14B的自进化大语言模型智能体，能根据自然语言指令自动创建、运行和演化OpenFOAM仿真，通过7阶段演化循环和三种防崩溃机制实现CFD工作流的自动化与普及化。
AI.motivation: 开源CFD求解器（如OpenFOAM）在现代工程中至关重要，但其使用门槛高、需要大量专业知识，且配置文件设置耗时繁琐，限制了高级CFD工作流的普及与应用。
AI.method: 基于Qwen-coder 2.5-14B进行预训练，并在252个文本提示上微调，覆盖7种OpenFOAM求解器、13个参数化网格模板和y+感知数值策略。核心算法为包含7个阶段的演化循环，并采用三种互补的防崩溃机制：RAG增强重试上下文、精确字典级补丁、提示多样性改写，以防止模型在自训练中退化。
AI.result: 成功构建了能够仅凭自然语言指令自动创建、评估、运行并演化OpenFOAM仿真的智能体系统，有效防止了重复自训练下的模型退化问题。
AI.conclusion: AutoFOAM将生成式人工智能与严格的流体仿真相结合，加速了快速原型设计，并使高级CFD工作流更加民主化，降低了使用门槛。

title: Learning Compositional Meta-Routing for Agentic Workflows: An Executable Benchmark
summary: Agentic systems must decide not only what answer to produce, but which reasoning and execution operations should precede it. A controller may answer directly, decompose a request, retrieve evidence, execute code, delegate to a specialist, or verify an intermediate result. Existing routing work largely selects model endpoints, retrieval depth, or tools in isolation. We introduce an executable benchmark and a budget-aware meta-router that composes heterogeneous operations from raw task text. The benchmark contains 216 training, 72 development, 108 held-out test, and 108 locked lexical-shift challenge tasks across data analysis, frozen-corpus research, and document processing. Outcomes are machine checked after operations execute. Independent regularized logistic heads predict operation probabilities from word and character features, are temperature-scaled on development data, and are greedily composed under route-cost and action-count budgets. On the held-out test, the learned policy achieves 100% success versus 93.5% for strong static and fixed workflows, with 43% lower cost than the static policy; a matched learned one-shot router reaches 56.5%. On the untouched challenge split, learned success falls to 75.9% and trails static routing at 93.5%, while remaining 49% cheaper and exceeding one-shot routing by 34.3 points. The gap identifies lexical generalization, rather than route execution, as the principal limitation. These results establish a reproducible testbed and a bounded proof of concept, not evidence of live-LLM performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个可执行的基准测试和一个预算感知的元路由器，用于组合异构操作。在保持测试集上，学习策略实现100%成功率，成本比静态策略低43%；但在未触及挑战集上，成功率降至75.9%，主要受限于词汇泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的路由工作主要孤立地选择模型端点、检索深度或工具，而代理系统需要决定采用哪些推理和执行操作（如直接回答、分解请求、检索证据、执行代码、委托专家或验证中间结果），缺乏一个能组合这些异构操作的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出一个包含216个训练、72个开发、108个保持测试和108个锁定词汇偏移挑战任务的基准测试，涵盖数据分析、冻结语料研究和文档处理。采用独立的正则化逻辑回归头，基于词和字符特征预测操作概率，在开发数据上进行温度缩放，并在路由成本和操作计数预算约束下进行贪婪组合。
AI.result: 在保持测试集上，学习策略达到100%成功率（对比静态/固定工作流的93.5%），成本降低43%；匹配的一-shot路由器达到56.5%。在未触及挑战集上，学习策略成功率为75.9%，低于静态路由的93.5%，但成本降低49%，比一-shot路由高34.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验确定了词汇泛化（而非路由执行）是主要限制因素。研究结果建立了一个可复现的测试平台和受限的概念验证，而非实时LLM性能的证据，为未来代理系统的路由研究提供了基准。

title: Multi-tenant Kubernetes Use Cases for AI, Secure Computing and Data Services, and More
summary: Kubernetes, as a container orchestration engine, has been widely used in cloud-native ecosystems for several years. In supercomputing ecosystems, especially where bare-metal performance for compute and network devices are considered, the adoption is somewhat limited. However, with the increasing diversity of use cases such as AI, secure and confidential computing for sensitive data, and mixed workload orchestration, a traditional, single-tenant batch computing system does not offer the flexibility and reproducibility to which public cloud users are accustomed. Note that Kubernetes is not considered a replacement for batch scheduling systems, which have powerful features for large-scale MPI jobs with thousands of network end points. Rather, it is a complementary service provided as part of a national AI Research Resource. We evaluate Kubernetes deployment on a Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Cray EX supercomputerwith HPE Slingshot interconnect, called Isambard-AI, with co-design use cases. One is a Trusted Research Environment used for medical and health sciences. The other combines KubeRay, Ray, and vLLM to provide a distributed, sandboxed, persistent AI model hosting service targeting multi-tenant confidential computing. We discuss challenges and lessons learned, and where further development is needed to offer a production Kubernetes-as-a-Service on HPE Cray EX (and later) platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了在HPE Cray EX超级计算机（Isambard-AI）上部署Kubernetes的可行性与实践，通过医疗可信研究环境和多租户机密计算AI模型托管服务两个协同设计用例，探讨了在超算环境中提供Kubernetes服务的挑战与经验。
AI.motivation: 随着AI、安全机密计算和混合工作负载编排等用例日益多样化，传统的单租户批处理计算系统缺乏公有云用户习惯的灵活性和可复现性。尽管Kubernetes在高性能计算生态系统中采用有限，但它可以作为国家AI研究资源的补充服务，提供所需的灵活性。
AI.method: 在配备HPE Slingshot互连的HPE Cray EX超级计算机Isambard-AI上部署和评估Kubernetes。通过两个协同设计用例进行验证：一是用于医学和健康科学的可信研究环境；二是结合KubeRay、Ray和vLLM提供分布式、沙箱化、持久的AI模型托管服务，面向多租户机密计算场景。
AI.result: 成功在HPE Cray EX超算平台上部署了Kubernetes，并验证了两个实际用例的可行性。识别了在超算环境（特别是裸金属性能和网络设备）中运行Kubernetes所面临的挑战，总结了实践经验。
AI.conclusion: Kubernetes并非要替代批处理调度系统，而是作为超算平台的补充服务。要在HPE Cray EX及后续平台上提供生产级的Kubernetes-as-a-Service，仍需进一步开发和完善。本文为未来超算环境中的Kubernetes部署提供了宝贵的经验教训。

title: Analyzing RV32/RV64 Trade-offs for FreeRTOS Latency on 8-Stage RISC-V Soft Processors
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for presentation at APCCAS 2026; to be presented on October 26, 2026
summary: Although many commercial RISC-V platforms provide real-time operating system support, practical examples that explain how to enable a preemptive RTOS on a custom bare-metal RISC-V soft processor remain limited, leaving the interaction between processor microarchitecture, interrupt handling, and RTOS context switching difficult to understand from simple hardware implementation examples. This paper presents the design and evaluation of FreeRTOS on custom 8-stage RV32/RV64 RISC-V soft processors with machine-mode CSRs, a CLINT timer, trap and exception control logic, and the required context-switch path. Using this platform, we compare RV32 and RV64 under the same microarchitectural organization and firmware structure using two Rhealstone-derived latency microbenchmarks, task switching and task preemption, measured with the mcycle counter. RV64 requires 36.6% and 17.7% more cycles for task switching and preemption, respectively. Instruction-level analysis attributes this overhead to the doubled RV64 trap frame, wider pointer-based kernel data structures, and 64-bit scheduler priority handling. The RTL, firmware, and benchmark code are released as open source.

AI.tldr: 本文在定制RISC‑V软核上移植并评估FreeRTOS，量化对比RV32与RV64的任务切换与抢占延迟，揭示RV64在上下文切换帧、内核指针与优先级处理上的额外开销。
AI.motivation: 商业RISC‑V平台虽有RTOS支持，但在定制裸机软核上使能抢占式RTOS的实践示例稀缺，导致处理器微架构、中断处理与RTOS上下文切换的交互难以从简单硬件实现示例中理解。
AI.method: 设计并实现具有机器态CSR、CLINT定时器、陷入与异常控制逻辑及所需上下文切换路径的8级RV32/RV64 RISC‑V软核，并在其上移植FreeRTOS。采用两类源自Rhealstone的延迟微基准——任务切换与任务抢占，利用mcycle计数器进行测量，并在相同微架构组织与固件结构下比较RV32与RV64。
AI.result: 在相同微架构与固件条件下，RV64的任务切换和抢占分别比RV32多消耗36.6%与17.7%的周期。指令级分析将该开销归因于RV64的陷入帧翻倍、基于指针的内核数据结构更宽以及64位调度器优先级处理。RTL、固件与基准测试代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 在定制RISC‑V软核上使能抢占式RTOS是可行且可分析的；然而，从RV32迁移到RV64会引入显著的上下文切换与抢占周期开销，主要来源于更宽的陷入帧与内核数据结构。这些发现为在资源受限的软核上选择ISA宽度与优化RTOS实现提供了量化依据。

title: BANDMAS: Causality-Inspired Semantic Packet Scheduling for Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems make decisions based on the aggregated information via exchanging messages across specialized agents. Forwarding every generated message among agents increases application-layer traffic. Yet, it introduces tremendous input tokens for agent processing, potentially raising inference latency and computational overhead. Existing approaches attempt to address the above issues by pruning agents or discarding redundant messages. Nevertheless, such agent-level or message-level optimization results in insufficient evidence supporting for final decisions or still containing redundant message transmissions. To address these challenges, we propose BANDMAS, a multi-agent collaboration framework that models inter-agent communications as task-oriented traffic, which enables efficient transmission via causality-inspired replay valuation. Specifically, we decompose messages into several data packets by analyzing their semantic features such as evidence and requests. The system only transmits these packets if their predicted replay-derived contribution exceeds their resource cost. Consequently, BANDMAS is able to adaptively schedule communication packets while adhering to bandwidth, latency, deadline, and receiver context constraints. On frozen Qwen3-4B traffic across SciFact, HotpotQA, and FanOutQA, our framework reduces application-layer bytes by 53.2\% to 77.3\% at selected caps and attains the highest mean task metric among constrained methods on all three workloads.

AI.tldr: 提出了BANDMAS多智能体协作框架，通过因果启发的回放价值评估对智能体间通信进行细粒度数据包调度，在任务性能最优的情况下显著降低了应用层流量。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统在智能体间转发所有生成消息会导致应用层流量大增和推理延迟升高；现有方法通过剪枝智能体或丢弃冗余消息进行优化，但会导致决策证据不足或仍存在冗余传输。
AI.method: 提出BANDMAS框架，将消息按语义特征（如证据和请求）分解为数据包，仅当预测的回放贡献超过资源成本时才传输该数据包，从而在带宽、延迟、截止时间和接收者上下文约束下自适应调度通信数据包。
AI.result: 在SciFact、HotpotQA和FanOutQA三个任务上，基于冻结的Qwen3-4B模型，BANDMAS在选定约束下减少了53.2%至77.3%的应用层字节数，并在所有三个工作负载上取得了受限方法中最高的平均任务指标。
AI.conclusion: BANDMAS通过任务导向的流量建模和因果启发的回放价值评估，有效平衡了通信效率与任务性能，为LLM多智能体系统的高效协作提供了新思路。

title: TrimMoE A communication aware and adaptive depth framework for distributed edge inference
summary: Serving Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models across distributed edge servers is bottlenecked by the cross-server expert transmission. The existing approaches mainly focus on how to reach a remote expert faster. However, in this paper, we instead consider whether a given layer, and the layers after it, need to be executed at all. To this end, a communication-aware adaptive-depth framework is proposed in this paper, termed TrimMoE, which couples layer skipping and confidence-based early exit with substitute execution and server-expert selection under a unified quality budget. Specifically, in the offline stage, TrimMoE freezes the backbone, trains the lightweight per-layer exit heads, calibrates the per-layer importance thresholds, and allocates the expert replicas by a skip/exit-aware redundancy benefit. In the online stage, a transition-aware look-ahead anticipates the token movement, so that the depth reduction targets the costliest transmissions, and besides, two feedback rules adapt the delay-quality weights and the exit threshold. Moreover, we prove that the substitution-and-skipping proxy degradation never exceeds the configured budget, and that the early exit is admitted only under a calibrated confidence gate. On a heterogeneous 10-server testbed with Switch-Base-8E, Qwen-MoE-A2.7B, and Mixtral-8x7B, TrimMoE reduces the average latency by up to 62.8%, lowers the cross-server traffic and the remote-execution ratio, and sustains high throughput under load, while keeping the task-quality degradation within a 2% bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrimMoE框架，通过层次跳过和置信度早退机制减少分布式边缘服务器上MoE大模型的跨服务器专家传输开销，在保证任务质量下降不超过2%的前提下，将平均延迟降低高达62.8%。
AI.motivation: 在分布式边缘服务器上部署混合专家（MoE）大语言模型时，跨服务器专家传输成为主要瓶颈。现有方法主要关注如何更快地访问远程专家，而本文从不同角度出发，探究是否真的需要执行某些层及其后续层，从而从根本上减少不必要的通信开销。
AI.method: 提出TrimMoE通信感知自适应深度框架，统一结合层次跳过和置信度早退机制。离线阶段：冻结骨干网络，训练轻量级逐层退出头，校准逐层重要性阈值，基于跳过/退出感知的冗余收益分配专家副本。在线阶段：采用转换感知前瞻机制预测token移动，使深度削减针对最昂贵的传输；设计两条反馈规则自适应调整延迟-质量权重和退出阈值。同时提供了理论保证，确保替代-跳过代理退化不超过配置预算，且早退仅在校准的置信门控下被允许。
AI.result: 在包含Switch-Base-8E、Qwen-MoE-A2.7B和Mixtral-8x7B的异构10服务器测试平台上，TrimMoE将平均延迟降低高达62.8%，显著降低跨服务器流量和远程执行比例，在高负载下保持高吞吐量，同时将任务质量退化控制在2%界限内。
AI.conclusion: TrimMoE通过自适应深度优化成功解决了分布式MoE服务中的通信瓶颈问题，在保证任务质量的前提下实现了显著的延迟降低和流量减少，为边缘服务器上的MoE模型部署提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Enhancing LLMs with Context-Specific Knowledge for Mitigating Misinformation in SMEs: A RAG-based Modeling and Analysis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), a part of artificial intelligence (AI), are increasingly being adopted by Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) to enhance question-answering capabilities and support business decision-making processes. However, hallucinations in LLM-generated outputs can serve as a source of misinformation, reducing user confidence in their reliability and trustworthiness within SMEs. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising approach to address this challenge by incorporating external knowledge sources into the modeling process. In this paper, we present VectorRAG and GraphRAG modeling approaches to mitigate hallucinations and misinformation risks and evaluate their effectiveness in SME environments. Our experimental evaluation is conducted on multiple state-of-the-art LLMs, including LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen, to assess performance in terms of useful response generation, risk of hallucination, contextual relevance, as well as human-interpretation. The results demonstrate that RAG-enhanced LLMs can significantly improve response quality by reducing hallucinations and misinformation, thereby supporting more reliable, trustworthy, and context-aware decision-making in SME environments.

title: MetaRoute-Bench: Evaluating Meta-Decision Policies for Agentic Workflow Routing
summary: Agentic systems must repeatedly decide whether to answer directly, decompose a task, invoke a tool, execute code, delegate to a specialist, verify an intermediate result, or recover from failure. These meta-decisions affect not only task success but also operating cost and latency, yet they are often embedded inside an orchestration framework and evaluated only through aggregate task accuracy. We present MetaRoute-Bench, an open, inspectable framework for comparing meta-decision policies under a shared execution model. The initial benchmark contains 180 synthetic task profiles spanning data analysis, research, and document processing, eight routing policies, and 30 paired random seeds. Across 43,200 traces, a task-aware compositional policy achieves 79.4% success compared with 76.7% for a strong workload-specific static policy, 67.4% for one-shot task routing, and 52.9% for direct answering. Relative to the static policy, this is a 2.7 percentage-point improvement with paired 95% CI of plus or minus 2.0 points, at 4.7% higher mean cost and 6.4% higher latency. Ablations show the largest losses when route composition is restricted to one operation and when verification is removed. These results are generated by a seeded offline execution model rather than a live deployment; accordingly, the primary contribution is a reproducible evaluation method and an analysis of routing-policy tradeoffs, not evidence of production effectiveness. We release task generation, policies, traces, tests, and analysis artifacts to support live-system validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MetaRoute-Bench，一个用于比较智能体系统元决策策略的开源可检测框架。在180个合成任务上的实验表明，任务感知的组合策略成功率可达79.4%，显著优于静态策略(76.7%)、一次性路由(67.4%)和直接回答(52.9%)，但成本和延迟略有增加。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统需要反复做出元决策（如直接回答、任务分解、工具调用、代码执行、委托专家、验证中间结果、故障恢复等），这些决策影响任务成功率、运营成本和延迟。然而现有研究往往将元决策嵌入编排框架中，仅通过整体任务准确率进行评估，缺乏对元决策策略本身的系统性比较和分析框架。
AI.method: 提出MetaRoute-Bench框架：1) 开源可检测的元决策策略比较平台；2) 包含180个涵盖数据分析、研究和文档处理的合成任务；3) 对比8种路由策略；4) 使用30个配对随机种子；5) 采用离线执行模型而非实时部署，确保可复现性；6) 发布任务生成、策略、轨迹、测试和分析工具。
AI.result: 在43,200条执行轨迹上：任务感知组合策略成功率达79.4%，显著高于强静态策略(76.7%)、单次路由(67.4%)和直接回答(52.9%)。相对静态策略提升2.7个百分点(配对95% CI: ±2.0)，成本增加4.7%，延迟增加6.4%。消融实验表明，限制路由组合为单一操作和移除验证步骤会导致最大性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了可复现的元决策策略评估方法和策略权衡分析，填补了该领域的评估空白。虽然结果基于离线执行模型而非生产环境，但通过公开发布完整的任务生成、策略和轨迹数据，支持后续的实时系统验证研究。

title: NUNA: Characterizing and Mitigating Non-Uniform Network Access in Multi-Die GPU Scale-Up Systems
comment: 15 pages total, 11 pages body, 15 figures, 2 tables, 1 algorithm
summary: Graphics processing unit (GPU) architectures are growing in size to meet the increasing compute and memory requirements. As GPU sizes increase, intra-socket wire transfer delay increases significantly. While previous research has optimized for compute and memory locality within a socket, the spatial impact on inter-GPU communication has not been well-studied. We introduce the term non-uniform network access (NUNA) to describe this emerging optimization dimension in multi-GPU systems. We specifically focus on latency-sensitive collective communication, common in machine learning inference. First, we highlight the need for NUNA-aware routing (NAR), choosing optimized, spatially-aware inter-GPU paths in large scale-up network topologies. Second, we introduce NUNA-aware placement (NAP), placing threadblocks and data near I/O to optimize the inter-GPU traffic. We demonstrate that the NAP optimizations alone offer up to 1.5x collective speedups over a locality-unaware baseline. Combining NAP with NAR yields up to 1.8x faster collectives over the locality-unaware baseline. This leads to 7% mean (28% max) time per output token speedup in machine learning inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NUNA（非均匀网络访问）概念，通过NAR路由优化和NAP放置优化，在多GPU系统中实现最高1.8倍集合通信加速和28%的ML推理速度提升。
AI.motivation: 随着GPU规模增长，socket内部线传输延迟显著增加，而现有研究主要关注socket内的计算和内存局部性，对多GPU系统中空间因素对跨GPU通信的影响研究不足。
AI.method: 提出两项优化技术：1）NUNA感知路由（NAR）：在大规模扩展网络拓扑中选择优化的空间感知跨GPU路径；2）NUNA感知放置（NAP）：将线程块和数据放置在I/O附近以优化跨GPU流量。
AI.result: NAP单独优化实现最高1.5倍集合通信加速；NAP与NAR结合实现最高1.8倍集合通信加速；机器学习推理中平均7%（最高28%）的每输出token时间加速。
AI.conclusion: 非均匀网络访问是多GPU系统中的重要优化维度，NUNA感知的路径选择和数据放置策略能显著提升集合通信性能和机器学习推理效率。

title: Source-Bounded Exact Recovery over Docker's Logs API
summary: Docker can retain records that a collector misses before attachment or during downtime. A persisted read position does not by itself ensure recovery after lifecycle changes. We study what exact recovery contract is achievable through Docker's supported Logs API. We define source-bounded exactness: every retained, distinguishable source record eventually appears exactly once in durable collector output. Our method uses a generation-aware multiset oracle that separates source truncation from collector omission and exposes simultaneous loss and replay. Applied to LogDeck, it uncovered a start-to-attachment race; a one-record attachment overlap, finite Docker-API reconciliation, and exact insertion closed the tested boundary. We compare the fixed revision with unmodified Grafana Alloy 1.18.0, which uses the same API and persists read positions; across 120 collector-runs, LogDeck was exact in 60/60 and Alloy in 20/60. Alloy succeeded at guarded startup and process pause but omitted retained history when recovery required discovering an exited or restarted source. In a causal control, a 5,000-record source exited before collection: stock discovery was exact in 0/20 trials and acquired nothing, while the same reader given the container ID recovered all records exactly in 20/20. This reproduced on OrbStack and independent Ubuntu hosts with Docker 29.4.0 and 24.0.9; both collectors recovered daemon restart, while neither recovered records after source removal. Exactness assumes distinct tuples of physical generation, timestamp, stream, and bytes; 200,000 byte-identical records across two drivers produced no observed collisions. Our results show that lifecycle reacquisition, not a persisted position alone, determines exact recovery within the retained-source horizon. This is a bounded interface claim, not a universal collector ranking or proof of collision freedom.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于Docker日志API的日志收集器的精确恢复问题，发现仅有持久化的读取位置不足以保证生命周期变更后的恢复，关键在于生命周期重新获取能力。提出的LogDeck方法在测试中实现了60/60的完全精确恢复，显著优于Grafana Alloy的20/60。
AI.motivation: Docker可以保留收集器在附着前或停机期间遗漏的记录，但持久化的读取位置本身并不能确保生命周期变更后的恢复。现有方法缺乏对Docker Logs API所能实现的确切恢复契约的清晰定义和验证，特别是在处理源容器退出或重启时的历史记录恢复方面存在不足。
AI.method: 定义了"源界精确性"(source-bounded exactness)概念：每个保留的、可区分的源记录最终在持久化收集器输出中精确出现一次。采用生成感知的多集合预言机(generation-aware multiset oracle)来分离源截断与收集器遗漏，并暴露同时发生的丢失和重放。通过LogDeck系统实现，解决了启动到附着的竞态条件、单记录附着重叠、有限Docker API协调和精确插入等问题。
AI.result: 在120次收集器运行测试中，LogDeck实现了60/60的完全精确恢复，而Grafana Alloy 1.18.0仅为20/60。Alloy在受保护的启动和进程暂停时成功，但在需要发现已退出或重启源的恢复时遗漏了保留的历史。因果控制实验显示：5000记录的源在收集前退出时，标准发现在0/20次试验中精确恢复且未获取任何内容，而给定容器ID的读取器在20/20次中精确恢复了所有记录。该结果在OrbStack和独立Ubuntu主机上使用Docker 29.4.0和24.0.9复现。
AI.conclusion: 生命周期重新获取能力（而非仅持久化位置）决定了保留源界范围内的精确恢复。这是一个有界接口声明，而非通用的收集器排名或碰撞自由的证明。精确性假设物理生成、时间戳、流和字节的独特元组；跨两个驱动程序的200,000个字节相同记录未观察到碰撞。研究揭示了现有收集器在处理容器生命周期事件时的根本局限性。

title: C2P-Cache: Scalable GPU L1 Cache Sharing via Concurrent Candidate Pruning
comment: Accepted at the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026)
summary:
Modern GPUs rely on private per-SM L1 caches and a shared L2 cache, but this organization obscures cross-SM reuse: an L1 miss is typically forwarded to L2 even when the requested line already resides in a peer L1 cache, leading to redundant L2 access. Prior GPU L1-sharing designs attempt to recover such reuse through exact or broad remote-hit searches, which become increasingly difficult to scale and can interfere with the critical L1 miss path under high concurrency. %miss handling as more caches participate and more misses arrive concurrently. We observe that eliminating redundant L2 accesses does not require exact, chip-wide knowledge of private L1 contents. Instead, it requires only sufficient visibility to sharply narrow down a small set of candidate caches, leaving exact confirmation to a much smaller number of L1s.
  Based on this insight, we propose C2P-Cache, a scalable GPU L1-sharing mechanism that transforms remote-hit discovery from a chip-wide exact search problem into a lightweight filtering-and-confirmation process. C2P-Cache maintains compact Bloom-filter-based snapshots of private L1 tags, performs parallel chip-wide candidate filtering, and selectively probes only a small number of likely peer caches. To sustain high concurrency, C2P-Cache organizes filtering as bit-sliced matching over a banked and replicated snapshot matrix, enabling efficient, parallel processing of many concurrent misses without interfering with normal L1 accesses. Across a wide range of GPU workloads, C2P-Cache improves instructions per cycle (IPC) by up to 49.7\% and by 23.5\% on average for applications with high remote-L1 reuse and strong sensitivity to L2 latency, demonstrating that lightweight, scalable filtering can effectively unlock cross-SM reuse with modest overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出C2P-Cache，一种基于布隆过滤器的可扩展GPU L1共享机制，通过轻量级过滤-确认过程消除冗余L2访问，平均IPC提升23.5%。
AI.motivation: 现代GPU采用私有L1缓存和共享L2缓存的层次结构，当L1未命中时即使请求的数据行已存在于其他L1缓存中，仍会转发至L2造成冗余访问。现有GPU L1共享设计通过精确或广泛搜索来发现远程命中，但随着缓存数量和并发未命中请求增加，这些方法难以扩展且会干扰关键的L1未命中处理路径。
AI.method: 提出C2P-Cache机制，将远程命中发现问题从全芯片精确搜索转化为轻量级过滤-确认过程。核心方法包括：(1)维护基于布隆过滤器的L1标签紧凑快照；(2)执行并行全芯片候选过滤；(3)选择性探测少量可能的对等缓存。为实现高并发，C2P-Cache将过滤组织为对分片复制快照矩阵的位切片匹配，在不干扰正常L1访问的前提下高效并行处理大量并发未命中请求。
AI.result: 在广泛的GPU工作负载上评估，C2P-Cache对具有高远程L1重用和强L2延迟敏感性的应用程序，IPC提升最高达49.7%，平均提升23.5%。实验证明了轻量级、可扩展的过滤机制能够以适度开销有效释放跨SM重用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 消除冗余L2访问不需要对私有L1内容的精确全芯片知识，仅需足够的可见性将候选缓存缩小至小范围集合。C2P-Cache证明了通过布隆过滤器快照和位切片匹配实现的轻量级过滤机制，可以在保持高并发性的同时有效解决GPU跨SM数据重用问题，为GPU缓存共享设计提供了新的可扩展解决方案。

title: MDGAM-Based Cooperative Task Scheduling for Communication-Constrained Distributed Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Cooperative task scheduling in communication-constrained distributed multi-agent systems is challenging because each agent must make decisions from partial and dynamic observations while satisfying complex practical constraints. Existing heuristics rely on handcrafted bidding rules and repeated consensus, whereas many learning-based methods assume global observations and lack explicit communication-based coordination. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a neural scheduling framework for distributed multi-robot task allocation (MRTA), consisting of a multi-decoder graph attention model (MDGAM) policy model and a critic-free group relative multi-agent policy gradient (GRMAPG) training algorithm. MDGAM uses an extended graph attention mechanism to jointly update node and edge features, and employs multiple decoders to generate task-selection decisions and communication messages. GRMAPG constructs group-relative advantages from equivalent task-planning instances to replace the critic network used in conventional MARL algorithms, thereby reducing training difficulty and improving convergence performance. Experiments under different problem scales and communication ranges show that the proposed method improves task-completion performance over existing heuristic and learning-based methods, while ablation, complexity, and generalization tests further validate the proposed innovations.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于通信受限分布式多机器人任务分配的神经调度框架，包括多解码器图注意力模型和无评论家群体相对策略梯度算法，在任务完成性能上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在通信受限的分布式多智能体系统中进行协同任务调度具有挑战性，因为每个智能体需要基于局部和动态观测做出决策并满足复杂约束。现有启发式方法依赖手工设计的竞价规则和重复共识，而学习型方法假设全局观测且缺乏显式的基于通信的协调机制。
AI.method: 提出了一个由两部分组成的神经调度框架：1）多解码器图注意力模型（MDGAM），使用扩展图注意力机制联合更新节点和边特征，并通过多个解码器生成任务选择决策和通信消息；2）无评论家群体相对多智能体策略梯度（GRMAPG）训练算法，从等效任务规划实例构建群体相对优势，替代传统MARL算法中的评论家网络。
AI.result: 在不同问题规模和通信范围的实验中，该方法在任务完成性能上优于现有的启发式和学习型方法。消融实验、复杂度分析和泛化测试进一步验证了所提创新的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的神经调度框架有效解决了通信受限分布式多机器人任务分配问题，通过MDGAM和GRMAPG的结合，既实现了显式通信协调，又降低了训练难度并提高了收敛性能，为实际多智能体系统提供了一种可行的解决方案。

title: HetRoute Heterogeneous and Cost-aware Collaborative Routing Framework for Distributed Edge MoE Inference
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a dominant architecture for large-scale AI services, yet deploying them over geo-distributed heterogeneous edge servers remains challenging. When the Top-k activated experts of a token are spread across multiple servers, the optimal routing depends jointly on cross-server link bandwidth, heterogeneous GPU computing capability, GPU-CPU expert loading delay, instantaneous queueing backlog, and replica-level quantization quality loss. Existing distributed inference and MoE serving methods address these factors separately and do not provide a unified framework for online multi-server collaborative routing. In this paper, we propose HetRoute, a heterogeneous-cost-aware collaborative routing framework for distributed edge MoE inference. HetRoute introduces a unified per-assignment cost model that explicitly captures four cost components: cross-server transmission, GPU-CPU offloading, GPU computation with queueing, and quantization-induced quality penalty. Guided by this model, the offline stage determines expert server placement, GPU-CPU residency, and replica precision through a routing-cost-coupled deployment algorithm, while the online stage routes the Top-k activated expert set as a whole by minimizing the bottleneck layer cost via exact enumeration or beam search. Theoretical analysis establishes fallback feasibility, a bound on the number of participating servers, per-layer optimality for small candidate domains, and online computational complexity. Trace-driven evaluation on three MoE models over a heterogeneous 10-server edge testbed shows that HetRoute reduces average inference latency by up to 59.0% and P99 latency by up to 58.0%, cuts cross-server traffic by up to 72.1%, and achieves 2.13x throughput improvement compared with representative baselines, while keeping quality degradation within the configured budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HetRoute，一种面向异构边缘服务器的混合专家模型协同路由框架，通过统一成本建模和两阶段优化，在保证模型质量的前提下显著降低推理延迟和跨服务器流量。
AI.motivation: 混合专家模型已成为大规模AI服务的主流架构，但在地理分布的异构边缘服务器上部署面临挑战。当token的Top-k激活专家分布在不同服务器时，最优路由取决于跨服务器带宽、异构GPU计算能力、GPU-CPU专家加载延迟、瞬时队列积压和副本级量化质量损失等多重因素。现有方法分别处理这些因素，缺乏统一的在线多服务器协同路由框架。
AI.method: HetRoute引入统一的单次分配成本模型，显式捕获四个成本组件：跨服务器传输、GPU-CPU卸载、含排队的GPU计算、以及量化引起的质量损失。离线阶段通过路由成本耦合的部署算法确定专家服务器放置、GPU-CPU驻留和副本精度；在线阶段将Top-k激活专家集作为整体路由，通过精确枚举或束搜索最小化瓶颈层成本。
AI.result: 在异构10服务器边缘测试平台上对三个MoE模型的跟踪驱动评估表明：HetRoute将平均推理延迟降低59.0%，P99延迟降低58.0%，跨服务器流量减少72.1%，吞吐量提升2.13倍，同时将质量退化控制在配置预算内。
AI.conclusion: HetRoute成功为分布式边缘MoE推理提供了异构成本感知的协同路由解决方案，在保证模型质量的同时显著提升了系统性能，为异构边缘环境下的MoE部署提供了有效框架。

title: Energy Efficiency of Locally Deployed LLMs: A Preliminary Quantitative GPU Power Benchmark on Consumer Hardware
summary: The local deployment of large language models (LLMs) is gaining traction due to privacy concerns and the desire for on-premise inference. However, the energy costs on consumer hardware remain poorly characterized, as most benchmarks focus solely on accuracy. This paper presents a reproducible, hardware-level energy benchmark of nine open-source LLMs (1B to 7B parameters) executed on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4060Ti 16GB). Using the Ollama inference engine, GPU power draw was sampled at 2Hz via nvidia-smi across a fixed prompt set. We evaluate mean/peak power, total energy per prompt (J/prompt), energy per output token (J/token), and throughput (tok/s). Our findings suggest that factors beyond raw parameter count, including model architecture and quantization strategy, drive energy efficiency. Specifically, gemma3:1b and llama3.2:1b achieve the lowest energy cost (0.56 J/token and 0.65 J/token) and the highest throughput (>170 tok/s). In contrast, the 7B-Mistral model consumes up to 4.4x more energy per token than the most efficient model. Notably, qwen3.5:2b exhibits anomalously high per-prompt energy due to extended internal reasoning, highlighting the need to distinguish between token generation modes in efficiency metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文在消费级GPU（RTX 4060Ti）上对9个开源LLM进行了硬件级能耗基准测试，发现模型架构和量化策略比参数量更能影响能效，Gemma和Llama的1B模型能效最高，而7B-Mistral能耗高出4.4倍，并指出需区分不同的token生成模式。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的本地部署因隐私保护和本地推理需求而日益普及，但现有基准测试主要关注模型准确性，对消费级硬件上的能耗成本缺乏系统性研究，亟需对本地推理的实际能源效率进行准确表征。
AI.method: 在单张消费级GPU（RTX 4060Ti 16GB）上使用Ollama推理引擎运行9个开源LLM（参数规模1B至7B），通过nvidia-smi以2Hz频率采样GPU功耗，系统测量平均/峰值功率、每提示词能耗（J/prompt）、每输出token能耗（J/token）以及吞吐量（tok/s）。
AI.result: 影响能效的关键因素包括模型架构和量化策略，而非仅取决于参数量。gemma3:1b和llama3.2:1b能效最优（分别为0.56 J/token和0.65 J/token），吞吐量超170 tok/s；7B-Mistral每token能耗比最优模型高4.4倍；qwen3.5:2b因内部推理导致异常高的单提示词能耗，凸显需区分token生成模式。
AI.conclusion: 模型架构设计与量化策略对本地部署的能耗效率影响显著优于单纯的参数规模因素，未来在评估LLM效率时应将token生成模式纳入能耗指标的考量范围。

title: Progressive$^2$: A Teacher-Student Progressive Co-Evolving Knowledge Distillation Method for Substantial Model Compression
comment: Manuscript under review at IEEE Transactions on Services Computing
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a widely utilized technique for transferring knowledge from a large model (the teacher) to a smaller model (the student). Owing to its flexibility and broad applicability, KD has been extensively applied in the compression of server-side models to meet the Quality of Service (QoS) requirements of client users. Despite significant advancements, the performance of distillation is substantially compromised when a large disparity exists between the capabilities of the server and the requirements of the client. To alleviate this problem, we propose a novel distillation approach, named Progressive$^2$, which operates through the combination of a progressively stronger teacher and a progressively smaller student. On the side of the teacher, rather than involving all layers simultaneously, we progressively select additional layers for distillation following a raw-to-rich semantic progression, establishing a systematic learning curriculum. Furthermore, we design a teacher-side multi-feature fusion adapter for the teacher to improve training stability, which is theoretically supported by the framework of Lipschitz continuity. On the side of the student, rather than directly training a tiny model, we gradually reduce the size of the network to facilitate an iterative co-evolution with the teacher. Progressive$^2$ serves as a flexible framework; the progressive strategy of the teacher can be deployed independently to achieve an optimal balance between accuracy and training efficiency, while the joint integration of the teacher and the student yields further improvements in overall performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Progressive²渐进式知识蒸馏框架，通过渐进增强的教师和渐进缩小的学生来缓解服务器与客户端能力差距大的问题，提升蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏在服务器模型压缩中被广泛应用，但当服务器能力与客户端需求差距较大时，蒸馏性能显著下降。现有方法难以有效处理这种大跨度能力差异，需要新的解决方案来改善跨平台模型压缩效果。
AI.method: 提出Progressive²方法，包含两个渐进策略：教师侧按"从原始到丰富"的语义渐进顺序逐步选择更多层进行蒸馏，建立系统化学习课程，并设计多特征融合适配器提升训练稳定性；学生侧采用渐进缩小网络规模的方式，与教师协同进化。理论框架基于Lipschitz连续性。该方法可独立部署教师侧策略或联合集成教师与学生策略。
AI.result: Progressive²框架有效缓解了服务器与客户端能力差距大的问题。教师侧渐进策略可独立部署实现精度与训练效率的最佳平衡，教师与学生的联合集成进一步提升整体性能。多特征融合适配器理论上有Lipschitz连续性支撑，提升了训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: Progressive²提供了一种灵活有效的知识蒸馏解决方案，通过双向渐进策略实现了服务器模型向客户端模型的高效压缩，为跨平台模型部署提供了新的技术途径。

title: From Cloud to Crowd: Democratizing LLM Service with Decentralized Edge Collaboration for RAG
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has increased demand for scalable and cost-effective deployment, especially for mobile and edge devices. Cloud-hosted LLMs are powerful but expensive and difficult to scale due to vendor lock-in and high resource needs, resulting in high expenses and unstable performance under load. Recent efforts focus on deploying small language models (SLMs), distilled or pruned from LLMs, on resource-constrained edge devices to reduce costs and improve scalability. However, edge-based SLMs face limited knowledge coverage and notable accuracy gap compared to cloud-based LLMs. To address this, we present DEFRAG, a decentralized edge collaboration system for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that optimizes both retrieval and generation across heterogeneous edge devices. For retrieval, DEFRAG compresses and shares knowledge graphs, using hybrid retrieval to expand knowledge coverage. For generation, DEFRAG introduces an optimizer that adaptively selects SLMs and RAG parameters per query, balancing accuracy and cost. We implement DEFRAG on a heterogeneous edge testbed and evaluate it on benchmark QA datasets. We also test it under mobile route stress, non-uniform data placement, and a domain-specific QA workload. The results show that DEFRAG maintains stable service quality and cost efficiency under these broader settings. Results show that DEFRAG narrows the SLM-LLM accuracy gap, while reducing cost by up to 98.4% and increasing peak throughput by up to 97.8% over centralized services. These findings demonstrate the potential of DEFRAG for democratized LLM services at the edge.

AI.tldr: 提出了DEFRAG系统，通过去中心化边缘协作和检索增强生成技术，显著缩小了小型语言模型与大型语言模型的精度差距，同时大幅降低了成本并提高了吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型(LLMs)云端部署成本高、可扩展性差、存在供应商锁定问题；而边缘设备上的小型语言模型(SLMs)虽然成本较低，但知识覆盖有限，与云端LLMs存在显著精度差距。需要一种解决方案来平衡成本效益和模型性能。
AI.method: 提出DEFRAG去中心化边缘协作系统，采用检索增强生成(RAG)技术。在检索方面：压缩和共享知识图谱，采用混合检索策略扩展知识覆盖；在生成方面：引入优化器，针对每个查询自适应选择SLMs和RAG参数，平衡精度和成本。在异构边缘测试平台上实现并评估。
AI.result: 在基准QA数据集上评估，并在移动路由压力、非均匀数据放置和领域特定QA工作负载下测试。DEFRAG缩小了SLM-LLM精度差距，相比集中式服务，成本降低高达98.4%，峰值吞吐量提高高达97.8%，在各种场景下保持稳定的服务质量和成本效率。
AI.conclusion: DEFRAG证明了边缘端去中心化协作RAG系统的可行性，为边缘设备上民主化的LLM服务提供了有效解决方案，在保持服务质量的同时实现了显著的成本效益和性能提升。

title: AtumAI: A Principled Framework for Agentic Generation of Datacenter Control-Plane Policies
summary: The efficiency of a datacenter rests on its control plane policies. Designing these policies is increasingly hard: the hardware-software stack grows fast, the design space is vast and interdependent, and prototyping a single policy takes months. Agentic AI promises to automate this search. Off the shelf, however, it falls short on three fronts. It is not formal: with no structured, searchable statement of the problem, the search has little structure to exploit and hard constraints are not guaranteed. It is not transferable: each task is solved from scratch, so nothing learned on one task carries to the next. Finally, it is not systematic: relying on the LLM as the sole source of candidates, it explores a narrow slice of the design space and settles into local optima. We introduce AtumAI, a framework that generates datacenter control-plane policies with agentic AI, making the process formal, transferable, and systematic. From a goal stated in plain language, AtumAI autonomously proposes, tests, and refines candidate policies until one satisfies the request. It does so through two components. The Datacenter Task Compiler automates problem formulation: it compiles the request into a formal, machine-checkable, and searchable specification of the task's objectives, constraints, decision variables, and evaluation methodology. The Evolutionary Design Discovery Loop then searches this specification, expanding the search beyond the LLM itself via a diffusion model, an evolutionary algorithm, and a surrogate model. Together, they reduce onboarding a new task from months of engineering to writing its description. We evaluate AtumAI on three control-plane tasks with distinct problem scopes, design spaces, and trade-offs: workload placement, resource scaling, and power management. Across all tasks, the policies generated by AtumAI consistently outperform expert-engineered baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AtumAI框架，通过数据中心任务编译器和演化设计发现循环，自动化生成数据中心控制平面策略，解决了现有智能体AI缺乏形式化、可迁移性和系统性的问题。
AI.motivation: 数据中心控制平面策略设计面临硬件-软件栈快速增长、设计空间庞大且相互依赖、原型设计耗时数月等挑战。现有的智能体AI在自动化策略搜索时存在三个不足：缺乏形式化（无法保证硬约束）、缺乏可迁移性（每个任务从头开始）、缺乏系统性（仅依赖LLM导致搜索空间狭窄且陷入局部最优）。
AI.method: AtumAI框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 数据中心任务编译器，将自然语言请求编译为形式化、机器可检查且可搜索的任务规范，包括目标、约束、决策变量和评估方法；(2) 演化设计发现循环，通过扩散模型、演化算法和代理模型扩展搜索空间，超越LLM自身的局限。该框架能够自主提出、测试和精化候选策略直至满足需求。
AI.result: 在三个控制平面任务（工作负载放置、资源扩缩容、功率管理）上评估，这些任务具有不同的问题范围、设计空间和权衡。AtumAI生成的策略在所有任务中均持续优于专家工程基准。
AI.conclusion: AtumAI成功将新任务的上线时间从数月的工程工作缩短为仅需编写任务描述，实现了数据中心控制平面策略设计的形式化、可迁移和系统化的自动化，生成的策略性能优于人工设计。

title: A Journey in Shared Memory Land
summary: I have greatly enjoyed spending many years in studying parallel computing. My journey goes thorough MP-C, PLURAL, Async Plural, HAL, RC64 and more. As a PhD student at Princeton I studied a combination of shared memory and message passing, motivated by algorithms and the ease of programming. While at the Technion, a brilliant MSc student figured out a better way for shared memory machines that further simplified parallel programming. He later founded Plurality and we developed the HAL machine. At Ramon Chips we reinvented RC64 and managed to make programming much easier. Theoretical computing models, especially PRAM, have constituted the foundation for my work. Fortunately, I spent many years learning the theory and practice of asynchronous logic, and applied some of these concepts towards improving, namely simplifying, parallel machines. Over the years I became disillusioned of inventive hardware designers and their innovative machines. That perspective helped crystalize this process. Still, much more remains to be done.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇回顾性文章，作者总结了其在并行计算领域数十年的研究历程，涵盖从理论模型（PRAM）到实际系统（MP-C、PLURAL、HAL、RC64）的演进，核心主题是简化并行编程。
AI.motivation: 作者受算法需求和编程易用性的驱动，致力于简化并行编程；同时，基于对异步逻辑理论与实践的积累，以及对创新硬件设计局限性的反思，试图弥合理论模型与工程实现之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 采用理论驱动与实践迭代相结合的方法：以PRAM等理论计算模型为基础，结合异步逻辑设计理念，逐步提出并改进多种并行机器架构（如共享内存与消息传递的结合、HAL机器、RC64），持续优化编程模型。
AI.result: 成功开发出一系列逐步简化的并行计算系统（包括PLURAL、Async Plural、HAL、RC64），显著降低了并行编程的复杂度，并验证了异步逻辑概念在简化并行机器设计中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管已取得显著进展，但简化并行编程仍任重道远；理论模型与实践经验的结合、对硬件创新局限性的清醒认识，为未来工作提供了重要指引，该领域仍有大量工作待完成。

title: HIERA: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Relevance Assessment for Content Discovery Systems
summary: Content discovery systems depend on relevance judgment for search quality evaluation, but human annotation faces inter-annotator disagreement and scaling costs. While Large Language Models show promise as automated assessors, current approaches rely on flat aggregation strategies: single-step prompting, voting ensembles, or uncoordinated multi-agent pipelines that aggregate independent outputs without integration. We propose HIERA, a hierarchical multi-agent relevance assessment framework with four specialized agents: a Relevance Judge, Query Analyzer, Item Analyzer, and Relation Analyzer. The Judge determines when specialist analysis is needed; the Relation Analyzer then coordinates query and item analyses with external knowledge to establish relevance relationships for final judgment. Ablation studies show that the same agents and external knowledge without hierarchical coordination degrade performance, confirming that the coordination structure itself accounts for the improvement. Evaluation across five datasets (EVS, MSRD, ESCI, WANDS, Home Depot) shows improvements over 11 baselines: 10.2\% on Home Depot, 4.8\% on ESCI, and up to 38\% on EVS ($p < 0.05$). Hierarchical coordination yields 12.7\% improvement over uncoordinated collaboration using identical agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了HIERA，一个分层多智能体相关性评估框架。通过四个专门化智能体的层级协调，在五个数据集上相比11个基线方法取得显著提升（最高38%），证明了层级协调结构优于无协调的简单聚合策略。
AI.motivation: 内容发现系统依赖相关性判断进行搜索质量评估，但人工标注面临标注者分歧和扩展成本问题。虽然大语言模型作为自动评估器展现出潜力，但现有方法依赖扁平聚合策略（单步提示、投票集成或无协调的多智能体流程），缺乏有效的整合机制。
AI.method: 提出HIERA框架，包含四个专门化智能体：相关性判断器、查询分析器、项目分析器和关系分析器。判断器决定何时需要专家分析；关系分析器协调查询和项目分析，结合外部知识建立相关性关系，最终完成判断。采用层级协调结构而非简单的输出聚合。
AI.result: 在五个数据集（EVS、MSRD、ESCI、WANDS、Home Depot）上评估，相比11个基线方法取得显著改进：Home Depot提升10.2%，ESCI提升4.8%，EVS最高提升38%（p<0.05）。层级协调相比使用相同智能体的无协调协作提升12.7%。消融研究证实协调结构本身是性能提升的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 分层协调的多智能体框架显著优于现有的扁平聚合策略，证明了智能体间协调结构的重要性。相同智能体和外部知识在没有层级协调时会降低性能，表明改进来自于协调结构本身而非其他因素。

title: LLM-Assisted Coalition Formation for Cooperative Perception in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM 2026), Cognitive Radio and AI-Enabled Networks Symposium
summary: Cooperative perception (CP) enables connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) to share complementary observations for safer navigation, but practical deployment is limited by bandwidth constraints, unreliable links, and redundant information exchange. Existing CP methods often assume predefined participants and merely focus on collective perception. Likewise, recent LLM-based cooperative driving frameworks facilitate multi-vehicle reasoning but do not regulate participation criteria to select more beneficial vehicles. To bridge this gap, we propose an LLM-assisted coalition formation framework that selects the most informative helper vehicles before LLM reasoning. The approach jointly optimizes perceptual diversity using a determinantal point process (DPP) over multimodal vehicle embeddings and communication-aware reliability. This leads to a joint coalition selection and power allocation problem, which we solve efficiently via a relaxed convex reformulation and an ADMM-based optimization strategy that decouples diversity-aware selection from network-aware resource allocation. The selected coalition is then summarized and provided with an LLM reasoning module for efficient and less redundant multi-vehicle decision support. Experimental results show that our approach outperforms other baselines in overall coalition value, while maintaining high diversity and improved networking efficiency. The framework achieves a better balance between task performance and safety across OPV2V and V2V4Real datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness for cooperative autonomous driving with communication constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种LLM辅助的联盟形成框架，通过联合优化感知多样性和通信可靠性来选择最有价值的协作车辆，从而解决协作感知中的带宽限制和冗余信息问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的协作感知方法假设参与者预先确定，仅关注集体感知，而基于LLM的协作驾驶框架缺乏参与者选择机制。实际部署受限于带宽约束、不可靠链路和冗余信息交换，亟需一种能够智能选择更有价值协作车辆的方法。
AI.method: 提出LLM辅助的联盟形成框架，在LLM推理前选择最有信息量的辅助车辆。方法联合优化基于多模态车辆嵌入的行列式点过程(DPP)感知多样性以及通信感知可靠性。将联盟选择和功率分配问题建模为联合优化问题，通过松弛凸重构和ADMM优化策略求解，将多样性选择与网络资源分配解耦。
AI.result: 在OPV2V和V2V4Real数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在整体联盟价值上优于其他基线方法，同时保持高多样性和改进的网络效率。框架在任务性能和安全性之间实现了更好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过智能选择协作车辆联盟，有效平衡了协作自动驾驶中的任务性能、安全性和通信约束，证明了在带宽受限场景下进行高效多车协作决策的可行性。

title: CoT-Core: Accelerating LLM Evaluation via CoT-Aware Coreset Selection
summary: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational overhead during continuous development processes. While coreset selection accelerates evaluation, existing methods either suffer from a severe ``cold start'' bottleneck requiring massive historical logs (e.g., Item Response Theory) or exhibit a surface lexical bias that misses the underlying reasoning manifold of tasks. We propose CoT-Core, a novel training-free core question selection framework. Recognizing that lexically disparate questions can share equivalent underlying logic, CoT-Core prompts LLMs to unroll zero-shot Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Projecting these paths into a latent space effectively clusters questions by intrinsic logical equivalence rather than superficial text similarity. Extensive experiments on GSM8K, MMLU, MMLU-Pro, and GPQA demonstrate that CoT-Core drastically reduces evaluation costs while maintaining high-fidelity score estimation, and delineate the boundary conditions of reasoning-aware pruning, revealing that its efficacy is intrinsically gated by task complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出了CoT-Core框架，利用零样本思维链推理在潜在空间中对问题进行逻辑等价聚类，在大幅降低大模型评估成本的同时保持高保真分数估计。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型评估方法存在显著缺陷：基于项目反应理论的方法需要大量历史数据导致“冷启动”瓶颈；基于表面词法的_coreset选择方法会忽略任务的底层推理结构，导致评估偏差。
AI.method: 提出CoT-Core框架：1) 利用零样本Chain-of-Thought提示LLM展开推理轨迹；2) 将推理路径投影到潜在空间；3) 在潜在空间中基于内在逻辑等价性而非表面文本相似性对问题进行聚类，实现核心问题选择。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MMLU、MMLU-Pro和GPQA数据集上的实验表明，CoT-Core在保持高保真分数估计的同时大幅降低了评估成本，并揭示了推理感知剪枝的有效性内在受限于任务复杂度的边界条件。
