AI.conclusion: CoT-Core通过推理感知的核心问题选择有效解决了现有方法的冷启动和表面偏差问题，为大语言模型的高效评估提供了新范式，同时明确了该方法在不同任务复杂度下的适用边界。

title: Rethinking Pretraining for Specialized Design Data: Evidence from the JONES-19 Cultural Design Dataset
summary: Design and architectural archives encode expert human knowledge in graphical formats, providing a critical testbed for design-inspired Machine Learning (ML) challenges absent with typical computer vision benchmarks. Building on JONES-19, a small-size image dataset based on The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1857), we evaluate the discriminative performance of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in two model training strategies: (a) ImageNet pretraining for domain-general "visual common sense," and (b) learning from scratch on the design data in JONES-19. We find that while domain-general priors improve discriminative performance, learning from scratch augmented with repeated local sampling (multi-crop) effectively recovers these gains. For highly structured design data, local design-driven representations provide sufficient foundation for learning, challenging a reliance on massive general-purpose pretraining. These findings suggest that in specialized design domains, careful curation of smaller high-quality datasets that capture empirical and formal design principles may prove more effective and informative on the nature of a particular design domain than prioritizing large-scale data collection.

AI.tldr: 本文针对设计领域图像数据集JONES-19，比较了ImageNet预训练与从头训练两种CNN策略，发现通过多裁剪增强的从头训练能有效恢复预训练带来的性能提升，证明在高度结构化的设计数据中，精良的小规模数据集可能比大规模通用预训练更有效。
AI.motivation: 设计与建筑档案以图形格式编码了专家级人类知识，为设计启发的机器学习挑战提供了关键的测试平台，这是典型的计算机视觉基准测试所缺乏的。研究者希望评估卷积神经网络在设计领域的判别性能，探究领域通用预训练与从头训练的差异。
AI.method: 基于JONES-19（一个基于《装饰语法》（1856年伦敦版）的小型图像数据集），研究团队评估了两种CNN模型训练策略：（a）使用ImageNet预训练获得领域通用的"视觉常识"；（b）在设计数据上从头训练，并结合重复局部采样（多裁剪）技术进行增强。
AI.result: 研究发现虽然领域通用先验能提升判别性能，但结合多裁剪增强的从头训练能有效恢复这些增益。对于高度结构化的设计数据，局部设计驱动的表征为学习提供了充分基础，这挑战了对大规模通用预训练的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，在专门的设计领域中，精心策划能够捕捉实证和形式设计原理的小型高质量数据集，可能比优先收集大规模数据更有效，也能更好地揭示特定设计领域的本质特征。

title: TIDE-MC: Two-Sided Interpolative Decomposition for Billion-Scale GPU Matrix Completion
summary:
Matrix completion supports large-scale recommendation and scientific computing, yet existing GPU solvers commonly assume that the observed matrix or its dense factors fit in device memory. On real workloads, this assumption leads to out-of-memory failures or severe PCIe overhead under naive paging.
  We present TIDE-MC, a bounded-memory GPU framework built on Two-Sided Interpolative Decomposition (TSID). TSID uses a sampled template submatrix as an anchor for reconstructing the full low-rank matrix, allowing computation and storage to scale with the template and active data chunks rather than the complete matrix. TIDE-MC realizes this formulation through two execution stages. First, a conflict-free synchronization engine recovers the template using parallel factorization and hierarchical gradient aggregation. Second, a chunked reconstruction pipeline extends the recovered template to the remaining matrix while overlapping PCIe transfers with GPU computation. An asymmetric gradient-clipping scheme stabilizes mixed-precision Tensor Core execution.
  Across 15 benchmarks, TIDE-MC completes workloads that cause existing GPU solvers to run out of memory. Compared with the evaluated state-of-the-art baselines, it achieves up to 11,647x speedup, reduces peak memory usage by up to 8.5x, and lowers reconstruction error by up to 99.7%. These results show that template-anchored decomposition and stage-specific GPU execution can scale matrix completion beyond device-memory capacity.

AI.tldr: 提出了TIDE-MC，一种基于双边插值分解(TSID)的有界内存GPU矩阵补全框架，通过模板锚定和分块处理突破显存限制，相比现有方法实现显著性能提升和内存优化。
AI.motivation: 现有GPU矩阵补全求解器通常假设观测矩阵或其稠密因子能完全载入设备内存，在实际大规模工作负载下会导致内存溢出失败或在简单分页机制下产生严重的PCIe开销。
AI.method: 基于双边插值分解(TSID)设计模板锚定机制，将计算和存储规模与模板及活跃数据块而非完整矩阵挂钩。采用两阶段执行：(1)无冲突同步引擎通过并行分解和层次梯度聚合恢复模板；(2)分块重建流水线将恢复的模板扩展至剩余矩阵，实现PCIe传输与GPU计算重叠。引入非对称梯度裁剪方案稳定混合精度Tensor Core执行。
AI.result: 在15个基准测试中，TIDE-MC成功完成导致现有GPU求解器内存溢出的工作负载。与评估的最先进基线相比，实现最高11,647倍加速，峰值内存使用降低最高8.5倍，重建误差降低最高99.7%。
AI.conclusion: 模板锚定分解与阶段特定的GPU执行策略能够有效扩展矩阵补全任务超越设备内存容量限制，为大规模推荐系统和科学计算提供了可行的GPU加速方案。

title: A Time-Multiplexed Spiking Neural Network Accelerator with Pipelined Readout for FPGA Inference
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) provide a power-efficient neuromorphic alternative to traditional artificial neural networks by processing information through discrete temporal events. This paper presents the design and Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) implementation of an inference-only SNN accelerator optimized for MNIST digit classification. To address the physical routing constraints and timing bottlenecks inherent in low-cost devices, we propose an optimized hardware microarchitecture featuring a time-multiplexed 1-bit spike-feeding mechanism governed by a finite state machine (FSM), localized distributed memory for weight storage, and an integer-based Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neuron model with register widths selected to prevent overflow. In addition, a multi-cycle pipelined argmax and tie-breaker readout module eliminates the dominant combinational critical path. Implemented on an entry-level AMD Artix-7 FPGA (XC7A200T) using a 784-64-10 network topology, the proposed pipelined architecture increases the maximum operating frequency (Fmax) from 13.3 MHz to 167 MHz. Hardware evaluation demonstrates a sequential processing latency of 82 μs per image, enabling a 1,000-sample VHDL simulation batch to be completed in 0.082 s. Vivado post-implementation vector-based power analysis estimates the total on-chip power consumption at 0.336 W and the energy efficiency at approximately 36,300 samples per joule. These results demonstrate that the proposed microarchitecture provides a resource-efficient solution for real-time neuromorphic edge inference, provided that the network size remains within the practical limits of time-multiplexed execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向FPGA的SNN推理加速器，通过优化的微架构设计（时分复用、流水线argmax等）将工作频率从13.3 MHz提升至167 MHz，实现了高效的MNIST分类（36,300 samples/J）。
AI.motivation: SNN作为传统神经网络的能效替代方案，在低成本FPGA设备上部署时面临物理布线约束和时序瓶颈问题，需要优化硬件微架构以实现高效的边缘推理。
AI.method: 提出优化的硬件微架构：1) FSM控制的时分复用1-bit脉冲传输机制；2) 本地分布式权重存储；3) 防溢出的整数LIF神经元模型；4) 多周期流水线argmax和决胜模块以消除组合逻辑关键路径。
AI.result: 在AMD Artix-7 FPGA上实现784-64-10网络：Fmax从13.3 MHz提升至167 MHz（12.5倍）；单图延迟82 μs；功耗0.336 W；能效36,300 samples/J。
AI.conclusion: 所提微架构为实时神经形态边缘推理提供了资源高效的解决方案，验证了时分复用在受限网络规模下的实用性。

title: Stress-Relief Annealing: Polynomial-Time Simulation-Free Layout Optimization for Automated Warehouses
summary:
We study the problem of optimizing physical layouts for automated warehouses, where hundreds to thousands of robots are coordinated to transport packages. Previous works have shown that optimizing the warehouse layout (e.g., the physical location of the storage shelves) significantly improves throughput. However, state-of-the-art layout optimization approaches are based on evolutionary optimization methods, which treat the entire warehouse as a black box and rely on random mutation to search for high-quality layouts. While the optimization outcomes are promising, these methods require a massive number of simulations to evaluate candidate solutions, making them sample-inefficient. In this paper, we present Stress-Relief Annealing (SRA), a polynomial-time simulation-free layout optimization algorithm. SRA turns the task demand into a per-vertex \emph{stress field} that predicts where traffic will concentrate in the warehouse; the field's peak provably caps the throughput.
  Our experimental results show that (1) SRA improves both the throughput and the scalability of a human-designed warehouse, roughly doubling the number of robots it can sustain, (2) it matches or exceeds the throughput of the evolutionary baselines while taking only $19$ minutes on one CPU core, against their $25{,}000$ simulations and $25$ hours on a $64$-core machine, and (3) the gain generalizes across different Multi-Agent Path Finding algorithms, non-uniform task demands, and a warehouse with doubled dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需仿真的多项式时间仓库布局优化算法SRA，通过应力场预测交通拥堵，在大幅降低计算成本的同时提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化仓库布局优化方法主要基于进化算法，将整个仓库视为黑盒并通过随机变异搜索，需要大量仿真评估候选方案，样本效率低且计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出Stress-Relief Annealing (SRA)算法，将任务需求转化为每个顶点的应力场来预测仓库中的交通集中区域，该应力场的峰值理论上限定了吞吐量上限，从而无需仿真即可进行布局优化。
AI.result: SRA提升了人工设计仓库的吞吐量和可扩展性，使可支撑的机器人数量翻倍；在19分钟单核CPU上达到或超越进化算法基线的吞吐量性能，而后者需要25000次仿真和64核机器上25小时；优化效果在不同MAPF算法、非均匀任务需求及尺寸翻倍的仓库中均有效。
AI.conclusion: SRA算法通过应力场理论指导，实现了高效且可扩展的仓库布局优化，在大幅降低计算资源需求的同时保持或提升了系统性能。

title: Execution Timing Control for Deterministic Task Offloading in the IoT-Edge-Cloud Continuum
summary: Latency-critical IoT applications, such as autonomous mobility and industrial automation, require deterministic guarantees to ensure that tasks are completed within strict deadlines. The 6G-enabled IoT-edge-cloud continuum can support such requirements by leveraging communication, computation and intelligence resources across devices, edge, and cloud infrastructures. However, existing task offloading strategies mainly focus on selecting where tasks are executed and typically assume immediate processing upon task arrival. This leads to transient congestion when multiple tasks coincide in time and results in inefficient resource utilization under dynamic workloads. This paper addresses these limitations by introducing an execution timing control strategy for deterministic task offloading that jointly determines where tasks are executed and when their execution starts, while guaranteeing deadline compliance. The key idea is to exploit the latency budget of tasks to control their execution timing, enabling a more balanced distribution of workload over time and reducing peak congestion across the continuum. Evaluation results show that, compared to existing benchmarks, the proposed approach achieves up to 70% higher satisfaction ratio, reduces the communication resources usage by 40%, lowers peak computing resource utilization by 15%, and decreases average execution time by up to 77%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向确定性任务卸载的执行时机控制策略，通过联合决策任务执行位置和开始时间，显著提高了任务满足率并降低了资源使用峰值。
AI.motivation: 现有的任务卸载策略主要关注任务执行位置的选择，并假设任务到达后立即处理。当多个任务在时间上重叠时会导致瞬时拥塞，在动态工作负载下造成资源利用率低下，无法满足延迟敏感型物联网应用（如自动驾驶、工业自动化）对确定性保证的严格要求。
AI.method: 提出了一种面向确定性任务卸载的执行时机控制策略，联合确定任务的执行位置（where）和执行开始时间（when）。核心思想是利用任务的延迟预算来控制其执行时机，实现工作负载在时间上的均衡分布，从而降低跨设备-边缘-云连续体的峰值拥塞。
AI.result: 与现有基准方法相比，所提方法实现了：任务满足率提高高达70%；通信资源使用减少40%；峰值计算资源利用率降低15%；平均执行时间减少高达77%。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入执行时机控制，该策略有效解决了现有卸载方法中的瞬时拥塞和资源利用效率问题，能够在保证任务截止时间合规的同时，显著提升6G使能的物联网-边缘-云连续体的性能表现。

title: Optimization and Constraint Modeling using LLMs with a Retrieval Augmented Generation Process
summary: Both optimization modeling and constraint modeling are non-trivial problems requiring deep domain expertise and proficiency in modeling formalism languages. Despite their importance across logistics, healthcare, and supply chain management, current large language models regularly produce structurally inconsistent or incomplete optimization formulations, particularly in combinatorial settings. This paper evaluates whether a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline built on a curated synthetic dataset can meaningfully improve LLM optimization modeling performance. A total of 500 optimization problems were synthesized using seed descriptions from the Text2Zinc dataset and professional personas created using an LLM, specified in JSON and associated with validated Python solver scripts. These problems were encoded in a Chroma vector database. For each inference problem, semantically similar problems were retrieved and used as contextual guidance for a LangChain LLM agent. Three benchmark testbeds were used to evaluate the proposed pipeline under the Qwen 3 30B Instruct model. Accuracy rose from 40% to 72% on NL4OPT, 40% to 56% on MAMO Easy, and 32% to 56% on MAMO Complex. The use of semantically validated synthetic examples greatly improves both solution accuracy and structure. The combination of synthetic dataset generation with retrieval augmentation provides an effective alternative to fine-tuning, suggesting that domain-specific synthetic corpora paired with retrieval augmentation can serve as a practical pathway for deploying LLM-based optimization tools in real-world decision-support contexts without costly model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于合成数据集的检索增强生成(RAG)方法来提升大语言模型的优化建模能力，在三个基准测试上准确率显著提升（NL4OPT从40%升至72%），证明了无需昂贵的微调即可有效部署LLM优化工具。
AI.motivation: 优化建模和约束建模需要深厚的领域专业知识和建模语言熟练度，在物流、医疗和供应链管理等领域至关重要。然而当前大语言模型经常产生结构不一致或不完整的优化公式，特别是在组合优化场景中，这限制了LLM在实际决策支持中的应用。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于合成数据集的检索增强生成(RAG)流程：从Text2Zinc数据集提取种子描述，使用LLM创建专业角色，合成500个优化问题，以JSON格式指定并关联验证过的Python求解器脚本，存储在Chroma向量数据库中。推理时检索语义相似问题作为LangChain LLM代理的上下文指导。使用Qwen 3 30B Instruct模型在三个基准测试平台上评估。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试上均取得显著性能提升：NL4OPT准确率从40%提升至72%，MAMO Easy从40%提升至56%，MAMO Complex从32%提升至56%。语义验证的合成示例大幅提升了解决方案准确性和结构质量。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据集生成与检索增强的结合为微调提供了有效替代方案，表明领域特定的合成语料库配合检索增强可以作为在实际决策支持场景中部署基于LLM优化工具的实用路径，无需昂贵的模型重新训练。

title: Leak It: A Probabilistic Approach to Training-Data Extraction from Black-Box Language Models
summary: Membership inference (MIA) on language models is usually summarised by an aggregate ROC-AUC, but such evaluations are confounded: model-free blind baselines separate members from non-members from surface text alone. We study black-box, sampling-based training-data leakage through a probabilistic lens, treating N samples from p(.|x) as an estimate of the output distribution and casting leakage signals as functionals of it. We extend the blind-baseline critique into the sampling regime: on WikiMIA a blind bag-of-words classifier reaches AUC 0.97 (TPR 0.90 at 5% FPR) and sampling adds nothing, while on an IID Pile split (MIMIR) neither self-concentration nor gold-continuation recovery significantly beats a blind baseline (incremental AUC 95% CI includes zero). Aggregate metrics hide the real harm. The same sampling verbatim-extracts training data for a tail of documents no blind attack can reach. On Pythia-6.9B, 83 of 500 Pile documents bearing a real identifier (16.6%; 21.3% of those bearing an email address) have that exact identifier reproduced AND not reproduced under a mismatched-prefix control, so each leak is attributable to that document, not to a globally common string. This per-document disclosure is invisible to aggregate AUC and grows with capacity (5.6% to 16.6% from 410M to 6.9B). The risk is uneven: identifier leakage is ~3x stronger in code than prose, though prose stays clearly positive and also grows with capacity (4.0% to 12.1%), while recovery of arbitrary held-out continuations is confined to code (+0.44 member gap on GitHub vs at most +0.014 on prose). Temperature and nucleus sampling matter little, a 16-token prefix suffices, and we detect no reduction from corpus deduplication. Privacy audits should report per-document extraction, decomposed by domain, not a single AUC. We release leakit, a black-box extraction-audit tool.

AI.tldr: 研究指出语言模型成员推理(MIA)评估中常用的ROC-AUC指标存在缺陷，模型无关的盲基线就能达到高AUC。研究发现了传统聚合指标无法反映的逐文档训练数据泄露风险，并发布了黑盒提取审计工具leakit。
AI.motivation: 现有成员推理(MIA)评估存在混淆因素：模型无关的盲基线仅通过表面文本就能区分成员与非成员，聚合的ROC-AUC指标掩盖了真实危害。需要从概率视角重新审视黑盒采样式的训练数据泄露问题。
AI.method: 采用概率框架，将从p(.|x)采样的N个样本视为输出分布的估计，将泄露信号建模为其泛函。在WikiMIA和MIMIR数据集上测试盲基线与采样方法，分析逐文档的具体泄露情况而非聚合指标。
AI.result: 在WikiMIA上盲词袋分类器达到AUC 0.97，采样无增益；在Pythia-6.9B上，500个Pile文档中有83个(16.6%)泄露真实标识符，代码中泄露比散文强约3倍，泄露比例随模型规模从410M增至6.9B从5.6%升至16.6%。
AI.conclusion: 聚合AUC指标隐藏了真实的隐私风险，隐私审计应报告逐文档提取结果并按领域分解，而非单一AUC值。发布了黑盒提取审计工具leakit，温度和核采样影响甚微，语料去重未检测到风险降低。

title: Zellige: Moldable Sequence Placement for Mixed Image-Video DiT Training
summary: High-quality video generation requires training Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) jointly on image and video data, posing a mixed-length sequence training problem across GPUs. Existing systems rely on data parallelism (DP), context parallelism (CP), or their combination; we model these designs as disjoint-group placement and prove that they face a fundamental tradeoff between inter-group load imbalance and intra-group communication redundancy. We present Zellige, a moldable sequence placement system that jointly selects each sequence's parallelism configuration and participating ranks. Zellige consists of three components: a hardware profiler that estimates the execution time and memory consumption of candidate placements, a two-stage planner that balances compute-heavy anchor sequences and packs lighter filler sequences into the remaining capacity, and a coalesced attention engine that efficiently executes whole sequences alongside distributed-attention shards. Across 21 plans, the hardware profile predicts step makespan and peak allocated memory with mean absolute percentage errors of $3.4%$ and $1.5%$, respectively. The two-stage planner solves each batch in 33--119 ms, significantly faster than a joint-placement reference that optimizes all sequences together, while their modeled makespans differ by at most $0.32%$. In end-to-end evaluations, Zellige outperforms KnapFormer by $1.12$--$1.48\times$ on 16 A800 GPUs and $1.27$--$1.54\times$ on 32 A6000 GPUs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Zellige系统，通过可变形序列放置策略解决分布式视频生成中的混合长度序列训练问题，在多GPU环境下实现了1.12-1.54倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 高质量视频生成需要在多GPU上联合训练图像和视频数据，这产生了混合长度序列训练问题。现有系统依赖数据并行(DP)或上下文并行(CP)等分离组放置策略，面临组间负载不均衡和组内通信冗余之间的根本性权衡问题。
AI.method: Zellige系统包含三个核心组件：(1)硬件性能分析器，预测候选放置的执行时间和内存消耗；(2)两阶段规划器，平衡计算密集型锚点序列并将较轻的填充序列打包到剩余容量中；(3)合并注意力引擎，高效执行完整序列和分布式注意力分片。该方法联合选择每个序列的并行配置和参与节点。
AI.result: 在21个规划方案中，硬件分析器预测步骤完成时间和峰值内存分配的平均绝对百分比误差分别为3.4%和1.5%；两阶段规划器在33-119ms内求解每个批次；端到端评估中，Zellige在16块A800 GPU上相比KnapFormer提升1.12-1.48倍，在32块A6000 GPU上提升1.27-1.54倍。
AI.conclusion: Zellige通过可变形序列放置策略有效解决了混合长度序列训练中的负载均衡问题，在预测精度、求解速度和端到端性能方面均表现优异，为分布式视频生成训练提供了高效解决方案。

title: CascadeLUT: Information-Ordered Streaming Inference for Bandwidth-Constrained FPGAs
comment: To appear in the proceedings of the 36th International Conference on Field-Programmable Logic and Applications (FPL 2026). 6 pages, 2 figures
summary: Mapping neural networks to FPGAs enables low-latency, energy-efficient inference, particularly for lookup table (LUT)-based models that eliminate multipliers and map directly to reconfigurable fabric. While prior work achieves high compute efficiency, it typically assumes full-sample availability, causing pipeline stalls in bandwidth-limited streaming scenarios. Here, the bottleneck shifts from computation to data movement, as large input transfers limit throughput and energy efficiency. We present CascadeLUT, an information-structured inference framework organized around bandwidth constraints. Instead of buffering the full input, features are partitioned into ordered subsets and predictions are progressively refined as subsets arrive. The cascade statically controls which layers consume incoming features, enabling deterministic streaming inference without runtime branching. By co-designing feature scheduling with hardware dataflow, CascadeLUT reduces data movement while maintaining accuracy. Across datasets, it achieves 4.0 to 12.5 times lower latency, 3.0 to 5.0 times higher throughput and up to 13.8 times lower energy/sample than prior LUT baselines, using 1.2 to 4.4 times the LUTs of the smallest DWN baseline per task. We also demonstrate on-device input quantization integrated with LUT-based inference and present end-to-end FPGA results on real-world workloads, with 5 times reductions in quantization overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出CascadeLUT框架，通过级联结构解决带宽受限场景下的数据移动瓶颈，实现低延迟、高吞吐和低能耗的FPGA神经网络推理。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LUT的神经网络FPGA映射方法假设输入样本完全可用，在带宽受限的流式场景中会导致流水线停顿，瓶颈从计算转移到数据移动，限制了吞吐量和能效。
AI.method: 提出CascadeLUT信息结构化推理框架：1)将特征划分为有序子集，随子集到达逐步细化预测；2)级联静态控制各层对新到达特征的消费，实现确定性流式推理；3)特征调度与硬件数据流协同设计，减少数据移动同时保持精度；4)集成设备端输入量化与LUT推理。
AI.result: 相比现有LUT基线，延迟降低4.0-12.5倍，吞吐提升3.0-5.0倍，单样本能耗降低达13.8倍，每任务LUT使用量为最小DWN基线的1.2-4.4倍；量化开销降低5倍。
AI.conclusion: CascadeLUT通过带宽约束驱动的信息结构化设计，有效解决了流式场景下的数据移动瓶颈，在保持精度的同时显著提升了延迟、吞吐和能效，为带宽受限的边缘推理提供了有效解决方案。

title: When Collaboration Becomes a Trigger: Collective Evidence-Threshold Backdoors in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) extend LLM capabilities through iterative communication and shared contexts. However, this collaboration introduces a vulnerability: backdoor behavior can be activated when peer evidence reaches a hidden threshold, rather than being determined by any single message. We introduce a collective evidence-threshold backdoor paradigm for MAS and Boundary-Conditioned Backdoor Injection (BCBI), which constructs counterfactual boundary pairs to separate benign behavior before the threshold from the adversarial objective after it, and learns latent progression aligned with evidence. To mitigate this threat, we propose LAtent Transition Test-time Evaluation (LATTE), a clean-only latent-transition defense that learns benign communication dynamics and quarantines anomalous agent updates before their responses propagate. Across several benchmarks, BCBI yields selective activation with little premature activation; without knowing the attack target or trigger, LATTE limits propagation with minimal disruption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MAS中一种新的集体证据阈值后门攻击范式BCBI，以及对应的防御方法LATTE。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统通过迭代通信和共享上下文扩展了大语言模型的能力，但这种协作机制引入了新的安全漏洞：后门行为可以在同伴证据达到隐藏阈值时被激活，而非由单条消息触发。
AI.method: 攻击方面，提出Boundary-Conditioned Backdoor Injection (BCBI)，通过构建反事实边界对来区分阈值前的良性行为和阈值后的对抗目标，并学习与证据对齐的潜在进展。防御方面，提出LAtent Transition Test-time Evaluation (LATTE)，一种仅使用干净数据的潜在转移防御方法，学习良性通信动态并在异常智能体更新传播前进行隔离。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，BCBI实现了选择性激活，几乎没有过早激活；LATTE在不知道攻击目标或触发器的情况下，能够以最小的干扰限制后门传播。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了MAS中集体证据阈值后门攻击的新威胁范式，并证明了BCBI攻击的有效性和LATTE防御方法的可行性，为MAS安全提供了新的攻防视角。

title: Shiftfly: Scaling the Accelerator Interconnect Past the Pod with a Shift-Routed Optical Tier
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Simulator, proofs and reproduction artefacts: https://github.com/EylonKrause/shiftfly
summary:
Google's TPU interconnect spent nine generations as a $k$-ary $n$-cube, whose diameter grows as $Θ(N^{1/n})$, before TPU 8i replaced it with Boardfly: a three-tier hierarchy in which every tier is a complete graph, giving pod diameter 7 over 1,152 chips. Boardfly suits a single inference pod but does not extend, because a complete global tier needs $G-1$ optical ports to reach $G$ groups. A 400,000-chip machine would need 12,499 per group against the 40 available, so another hierarchy level must be stacked, and each level costs four chip hops.
  We propose Shiftfly, which keeps Boardfly's building block and group verbatim and replaces only the global tier with a generalized Kautz digraph, installed as a fixed permutation on the optical circuit switch the fabric already owns. At an identical 40 ports per group, Shiftfly is flat, has guaranteed diameter $\lceil \log_d G \rceil$, routes without tables by a shift register, and addresses content natively.
  The evaluation is deliberately two-sided. Shiftfly loses at one-pod scale, where Boardfly achieves chip-level diameter 7 against Shiftfly's 11, and wins beyond it, cutting worst-case distance from 23 to 19 hops at 400,000 chips with roughly 2.7x better spectral expansion at equal cost. The redundancy argument that motivated the design does not survive its own evaluation: locality-aware placement supplies most of the achievable saving on shared content, leaving the shift algebra a 2.9% residual, and we report the metric inversion that conceals this.
  We also measure operability. Replacing a failed group costs the same 40 optical circuits in both designs; deriving the global wiring costs 28 bits of control-plane state against 550,000. Slice allocation is the one regression: an arbitrary induced subset of a shift graph is disconnected, so slices must be instantiated rather than carved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Shiftfly互连架构，通过Kautz有向图替代Boardfly的全局层，在相同成本下为大规模AI集群提供更优的网络性能，但在单pod规模上存在直径劣势，且切片分配功能有所退化。
AI.motivation: Google TPU互连网络经历了九代k-ary n-cube结构后，TPU 8i引入了Boardfly三层全连接层次结构。然而Boardfly无法扩展到大规模系统：400,000芯片的机器需要每组12,499个光端口来构建全局全连接层，而实际只有40个端口可用，必须增加层次结构，每增加一层就增加4个芯片跳数的开销。需要一种既能保持Boardfly优势又能有效扩展的新型互连架构。
AI.method: 提出Shiftfly架构：保留Boardfly的构建块和分组结构不变，仅将全局层替换为广义Kautz有向图。该方案将Kautz图作为固定置换安装在光路交换机上，利用系统已有的交换设备。Shiftfly使用移位寄存器进行无表路由，原生支持内容寻址，在每组40端口约束下实现扁平化拓扑，保证直径为⌈log_d G⌉。
AI.result: Shiftfly呈现双重性能特征：在单pod规模下，Shiftfly芯片级直径为11，劣于Boardfly的7；但在400,000芯片规模下，最坏情况距离从23跳降至19跳，谱扩展提升约2.7倍（等成本条件下）。冗余性设计动机未能通过评估：局部感知放置已提供了共享内容的大部分可节省收益，移位代数仅贡献2.9%的残余收益。运维方面，故障组替换需要相同的40条光路，控制面状态从550,000位降至28位；但切片分配存在退化，移位图的任意诱导子集不连通，切片必须实例化而非雕刻。
AI.conclusion: Shiftfly成功解决了Boardfly的扩展性瓶颈，为大规模AI集群提供了更优的互连解决方案。虽然在小规模场景存在直径劣势，切片分配功能有所退化，但在大规模部署中展现出显著的网络性能和运维优势，谱扩展性能提升显著，控制面开销大幅降低。该架构为未来超大规模AI基础设施提供了可行的互连技术路径。

title: Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents
summary: Self-improving LLM agents increasingly learn from experience without updating any weights. Each episode is stored in an external memory, scored, and retrieved for similar future tasks to shape later behavior. Viewed through a reward lens, the stored score is a proxy reward for an implicit, non-parametric policy. Each retrieved episode then becomes a policy-improvement step whose reliability hinges on how that score is produced. In deployment, ground-truth labels are unavailable, so the stored reward is at best an LLM assessment. This substitution creates a failure mode, the *Echo Gap*, across the memory-based self-improving agents and model families studied. Incorrect episodes receive inflated rewards; thus, the agent preferentially reuses the very mistakes it has most confident in. Because the error compounds through memory rather than averaging out and the confirming judge's errors remain correlated with the original self-grading bias, so it cannot identify which memories are overvalued. The missing property is formalized as the *Error-Independence Assumption* (EIA), which we prove is a *necessary* condition for correcting the inflation, not merely a description of a good verifier: a usable signal must track truth *and* decorrelate its error from the memory bias, and the recoverable payoff is a closed-form function of exactly those two quantities. We further show the inflation compounds not only when retrieval ranks by the stored score but also under plain similarity retrieval which is the regime the deployed agent uses. Finally, the answer-free de-inflation algorithm LUCID delivers a consistent end-to-end gain on the BIRD text-to-SQL benchmark. It raises execution accuracy to $56.9\%$, above both a Memento-style self-graded agent ($54.0\%$, a $+2.9$-point mean gain across seeds) and a memory-less agent of identical architecture ($52.4\%$).

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了记忆型自改进LLM智能体存在"回声差距"问题：错误的推理过程被模型自身过高评分，导致智能体重复这些错误。作者提出错误独立性假设（EIA）作为纠正奖励膨胀的必要条件，并设计了LUCID算法在BIRD基准测试上将执行准确率提升至56.9%。
AI.motivation: 自改进LLM智能体通过外部记忆存储推理过程并评分来引导未来行为，但在部署场景下缺乏真实标签，只能依赖LLM自身评估作为代理奖励。这引发了一个核心问题：当评估存在系统性偏差时，记忆型自改进机制是否会放大而非纠正错误？本文旨在揭示并解决这一潜在的失败模式。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：形式化定义回声差距问题，证明错误独立性假设（EIA）是纠正奖励膨胀的必要条件，推导可恢复收益的闭式函数；2. 实验验证：跨多个模型家族和记忆型智能体验证问题普遍性，测试基于存储分数排序和相似性检索两种场景；3. 算法设计：提出无答案的去膨胀算法LUCID，在BIRD文本转SQL基准测试上进行端到端评估。
AI.result: LUCID在BIRD基准测试上达到56.9%的执行准确率，相比Memento风格的自评分智能体（54.0%）提升2.9个百分点，相比同架构无记忆基线（52.4%）提升4.5个百分点。证明了回声差距问题在基于分数排序和相似性检索两种机制下均会发生。
AI.conclusion: 记忆型自改进LLM智能体存在固有的奖励膨胀风险，错误独立性假设是纠正该问题的必要理论条件。通过引入能追踪真值且与记忆偏差解耦的信号，LUCID算法成功缓解了这一问题，为构建可靠的自改进智能体提供了理论基础和实践方案。

title: Response Magnitude as a Dominant Signal for Held-Out CRISPRi Perturbation Effect Prediction
summary: Predicting the magnitude of a CRISPRi perturbation's transcriptomic effect on held-out target genes is an important open problem in single-cell biology. Recent work has documented that simple baselines often match or exceed deep perturbation predictors on related protocols. We study this phenomenon on the Virtual Cell Challenge (VCC) benchmark under a strict held-out target-gene split, identify the specific low-dimensional signal that drives the gap, and characterize how it transfers across cell types. The target is the log Anderson-Darling distance from non-targeting controls, which is strongly predictable from four deterministic scalar functions of the 2,000-dimensional input. A deep MLP encoder with direct access to the full input collapses toward the marginal training mean, and standard remedies do not close the gap. A linear regression on the four magnitude scalars alone exceeds the strongest x-only classical model, while a Random Forest on the input plus the four scalars substantially outperforms our deep proof-of-concept encoder. Two pre-specified controls attribute the magnitude gain to per-row alignment rather than added dimensionality. Under zero-shot transfer to two external CRISPRi screens evaluated against a target-gene endpoint rebuilt from single-cell data, magnitude-only predictors transfer positively whereas expression-only predictors are negative or unresolved. Exposing magnitude to the deep encoder improves transfer over its expression-only counterpart, yet the encoder does not outperform a four-scalar linear regression on the same features. We also find that the Anderson-Darling column distributed with these screens measures transcriptome-wide response breadth rather than target-gene effect strength, so evaluating transfer against it scores a different outcome.

AI.tldr: 在CRISPRi扰动预测中，简单的基线模型往往优于深度学习模型。研究发现仅使用四个标量特征的线性回归就能超越复杂的深度模型，揭示了低维信号在预测中的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 在单细胞生物学中，预测CRISPRi扰动对保留目标基因的转录组效应强度是一个重要的开放性问题。近期研究表明，在相关协议上，简单基线方法往往能够匹配甚至超越深度预测器，研究者希望深入理解这一现象的原因。
AI.method: 研究者在Virtual Cell Challenge (VCC)基准数据集上，采用严格的目标基因保留划分方式进行实验。识别出驱动性能差距的低维信号，使用四个确定性标量函数（从2000维输入中提取）作为特征，比较深度MLP编码器、线性回归和随机森林等不同模型的预测性能。
AI.result: 1) 具有完整输入访问权限的深度MLP编码器倾向于收敛到边际训练均值；2) 仅使用四个幅度标量的线性回归超过了最强的经典模型；3) 在输入加标量特征上的随机森林显著优于深度编码器；4) 在零样本迁移到两个外部CRISPRi筛选实验中，仅幅度预测器实现正向迁移，而仅表达预测器为负向或未解决；5) 深度编码器未能优于四标量线性回归。
AI.conclusion: 低维幅度信号在CRISPRi扰动效应预测中起关键作用，简单的线性模型在目标基因预测和跨细胞类型迁移任务中可以超越深度学习方法。研究还发现评估指标的选择（Anderson-Darling距离）可能测量的是转录组全局响应广度而非目标基因效应强度，这影响了对迁移性能的解读。

title: NIXT: A NCCL Inspector Exporter Tool for Observability of Collective Communication in Large Model Training
summary: As machine learning workloads scale, it is increasingly important to gain more observability into the performance of collective communication to easily identify performance vari- ations and accelerate root cause identification. Towards this goal, the Nvidia Collective Communication Library (NCCL) introduced NCCL Inspector, a profiler plugin that provides lightweight and continuous reporting of NCCL communication performance statistics. However, the large volume of data collected by NCCL Inspector can be difficult to assess and to extract actionable insights from. This paper presents NIXT, a NCCL Inspector Exporter Tool that improves the observability of collective communication by providing readily accessible analysis and actionable insights from NCCL Inspector profiling. To highlight the benefits of our Exporter Tool, we present a case study of Nemotron-4 LLM pretraining on an Nvidia H100 GPU cluster with up to 2,048 GPUs, demonstrate observability into how communication phases change with ML parallelism and GPU scale, and perform attribution of performance variation and root cause analysis of stragglers.

AI.tldr: 提出了NIXT工具，用于分析NCCL Inspector产生的大规模通信性能数据，在大规模LLM预训练场景下实现了对集合通信性能变化的可观测性和根因分析。
AI.motivation: 随着机器学习工作负载规模扩展，需要更好的集合通信性能可观测性来识别性能变化并加速根因分析。NCCL Inspector虽能提供持续的性能统计报告，但其产生的大量数据难以评估和提取有效信息。
AI.method: 开发了NIXT（NCCL Inspector Exporter Tool），这是一个分析工具，能够从NCCL Inspector的profiling数据中提供易于访问的分析和可操作的洞察。在Nvidia H100 GPU集群（最多2048个GPU）上以Nemotron-4 LLM预训练为案例进行验证。
AI.result: 成功展示了通信阶段随ML并行度和GPU规模的变化情况，实现了性能变化的归因分析以及对落后节点（stragglers）的根因分析，提升了集合通信的可观测性。
AI.conclusion: NIXT工具能够有效提升大规模GPU集群中集合通信的可观测性，帮助用户从NCCL Inspector的大量数据中获取有价值的洞察，为性能优化和问题诊断提供支持。

title: Rethinking Agentic Kernel Generation for Emerging Accelerators
summary:
Emerging accelerators often lack mature compiler backends, motivating neural agents that generate and repair kernels from architectural documentation and simulator feedback. This approach repeatedly reconstructs workload-invariant machine semantics--including instruction behavior, legality constraints, synchronization rules, and memory protocols--for every workload. We argue that these semantics should be compiled once into a persistent symbolic artifact, while neural reasoning should focus on workload-dependent mapping decisions.
  We present Zomboss, a compiler-mediated agentic framework for kernel generation that places neural search within a verified compiler boundary. Zomboss compiles machine semantics and legality constraints into a reusable mapping interface, then uses a neural agent to optimize workload-dependent decisions within the validated mapping space. Across 20 Gemmini and 36 PLENA workload instances, Zomboss returns a correct verified kernel on all 56 instances. Relative to the compiler default, Zomboss achieves geometric-mean speedups of $3.34\times$ on Gemmini and $1.10\times$ on PLENA. Relative to direct agentic generation, it reduces inference tokens by 71.2% on Gemmini and 54.2% on PLENA.
  These results show that a compiler-defined symbolic interface turns native kernel synthesis into verified design-space exploration: compiler infrastructure preserves legality and correctness, while neural guidance improves workload-specific performance with lower search cost and complete coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Zomboss框架，通过将机器语义编译为可复用的符号接口，将神经智能体的搜索限制在验证过的编译器边界内，在所有56个测试实例上均生成正确的验证内核，相比编译器默认实现获得显著加速并大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于神经智能体的内核生成方法需要为每个工作负载重复重建工作量无关的机器语义（包括指令行为、合法性约束、同步规则和内存协议），这种重复构建效率低下且缺乏正确性保证。作者认为这些语义应该被一次性编译为持久的符号工件，而神经推理应专注于工作量相关的映射决策。
AI.method: 提出Zomboss，一个编译器中介的智能体框架，将神经搜索置于验证过的编译器边界内。该方法首先将机器语义和合法性约束编译为可复用的映射接口，然后使用神经智能体在验证过的映射空间内优化工作量相关的决策，从而将编译器基础设施的正确性保证与神经引导的性能优化相结合。
AI.result: 在20个Gemmini和36个PLENA工作量实例上，Zomboss在全部56个实例上均返回正确的验证内核。相比编译器默认实现，在Gemmini上获得3.34×几何平均加速，在PLENA上获得1.10×加速。相比直接智能体生成方法，在Gemmini上减少71.2%的推理token，在PLENA上减少54.2%。
AI.conclusion: 编译器定义的符号接口将原生内核合成转变为验证过的设计空间探索：编译器基础设施保证合法性和正确性，而神经引导以更低的搜索成本和完全覆盖提升工作量特定的性能，实现了符号推理与神经优化的有效结合。

title: Asking Questions the Right Way: A Multi-Agent Conversational System for Prompt Formulation in Complex Task Resolution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are integral to complex intellectual tasks, yet output quality remains constrained by user-provided prompts. Iterative multi-turn prompting often leads to context degradation and diminishing cognitive returns. We present PAWNI (Prompt Architecture Wizard using Neural Intelligence), an agentic conversational interface of eight agents that transforms unstructured queries into structured prompts through guided question-and-answer dialogue informed by a self-evolving knowledge base. Rather than optimizing the models response, PAWNI optimizes the question itself by front-loading intent clarification. We also propose a three-tier framework of 18 prompt elements across Essential, Enhancement, and Elevation categories.To evaluate system behavior and validate a measurement protocol, we conducted an exploratory within-subjects study (N=4) across four complex tasks, integrating 32-channel EEG, NASA-TLX workload, and behavioral metrics. Participants produced more structurally complete prompts with PAWNI (42% to 91% of assessed elements), rated LLM outputs higher across all quality dimensions, and reported lower workload (39.6 vs. 21.7 NASA-TLX). Every participant reached satisfactory output in a single turn, compared to 1-12 turns unaided. While effect sizes are unstable due to sample size, direction consistency supports the hypothesis that optimizing prompt formulation front-end is a critical lever for human-AI collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了PAWNI系统，通过8个智能体将非结构化查询转化为结构化提示词，小规模实验表明该系统可提升提示词完整性、降低用户认知负荷并显著减少交互轮数。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的输出质量受限于用户提供的提示词质量，迭代多轮提示常导致上下文退化和认知回报递减，因此需要一种在前端优化问题本身的系统方法。
AI.method: 提出PAWNI系统，包含8个智能体的对话式界面，通过引导式问答对话将非结构化查询转化为结构化提示词；同时提出包含必要、增强、提升三个层次的18个提示词元素框架；采用被试内设计实验（N=4），结合32通道EEG、NASA-TLX负荷量表和行为指标进行评估。
AI.result: 参与者使用PAWNI生成的提示词结构更完整（42%-91%的评估元素），对LLM输出的质量评分在所有维度上更高，工作负荷更低（NASA-TLX从39.6降至21.7），且每位参与者均能在单轮交互中获得满意输出（对照为1-12轮）。
AI.conclusion: 尽管样本量较小导致效应量不稳定，但方向一致性支持假设：前端优化提示词构建是人机协作的关键杠杆。

title: Learning Not to Optimize: Physics-Informed Action-Space Reshaping for Intent-Based Network Control
summary: Modern network policy control maps intent to sequential placement-control decisions. Bellman-style policy optimization primarily asks which action to optimize, while constraints are commonly handled through penalty, barrier, or Lagrangian mechanisms. We observe that before a value function can certify the best deployment, intermediate signals may already identify many candidates that should be excluded from further optimization. This motivates a complementary direction: \emph{Learning Not to Optimize}. Before a value function is accurate enough to select the best placement-control decision, intermediate signals may already show that candidates are equivalent under state--intent relabeling (quotienting), lead to a uniformly worse future state (dominance), or violate executable network laws (residual screening). \LNOQRD{} uses these computed or learned signals as a shadow process to reshape the domain on which primal policy optimization is performed, thereby reducing the action space. We prove lossless quotienting and dominance under explicit equivariance and monotonicity conditions, bound frontier size and ranking cost, and quantify losses from approximate certificates and primal estimates. Experiments show that \LNOQRD{} reduces small-instance candidates by $75.9\%$ while retaining $90.8\%$ near-oracle coverage and, on large instances, achieves the highest utility and intent satisfaction, the lowest hard-law violation and post-generation latency, and a $73.0\%$ average reduction among candidate-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了“Learning Not to Optimize”（LNOQRD）方法，通过状态-意图重标定、支配性和约束违反等中间信号，提前剔除不优候选，缩小策略优化动作空间，显著提升大规模网络策略控制的效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 传统Bellman式策略优化主要关注“选哪个动作最优”，约束处理依赖惩罚、障碍或拉格朗日方法，计算开销大。作者观察到，在价值函数足以准确甄别最优部署之前，中间信号已经可以排除大量不可行或劣质候选，因此提出一种互补思路：先学会“不优化”某些候选，以减少后续优化负担。
AI.method: 将等价性剔除、支配性判定、约束违反检测作为影子过程，重塑主策略优化的动作域，从而缩小搜索空间；在显式等变性与单调性条件下实现无损重标定与支配；引入近似证书与主估计的误差分析，并对候选前沿规模与排序成本进行理论界界定。
AI.result: 实验表明，LNOQRD在小实例上平均剔除75.9%候选，同时保持90.8%的近最优覆盖；在大实例上，获得最高的效用与意图满足度、最低的硬约束违反率与后生成延迟，相对候选类基线平均候选量减少73.0%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在主策略优化前利用中间信号进行候选剔除，LNOQRD能显著降低动作空间规模，提升网络策略控制的效率与质量，为后续策略优化提供了有益的前置过滤机制。

title: Request-Level Energy Attribution for Batched LLM Serving
summary: Batched LLM serving improves throughput but complicates energy accounting. GPU power telemetry is aggregate, whereas sustainability reporting, chargeback, and workload analysis often require request-level energy charges. Existing inference-energy benchmarks report model-, phase-, or token-level energy, and recent carbon-accounting work motivates Shapley fairness conceptually. Neither provides measured request-level ground truth, so how far the accounting rules used in practice deviate from a fair allocation has remained unknown. We present JouleShare, an attribution framework with two components. An offline harness establishes this ground truth by replaying request subsets under vLLM with a reproducible protocol, integrating GPU power telemetry, and computing exact Shapley energy for each request. A lightweight calibration model, JCalib, then learns to predict Shapley shares from cheap request features for use at serving time. Across 16 model/workload runs, token-proportional attribution differs from exact Shapley by 0.440 normalized L1 on average under static batching and by 0.458 under continuous batching, a gap that reproduces across three data-center GPUs. JCalib reduces this error to 0.116 under static batching and 0.177 under continuous batching, below even a standalone-measurement baseline that is unavailable online, while preserving exact batch-energy efficiency. Sampled Shapley extends the measured reference to larger group sizes, where the gap persists and a single offline calibration remains the most accurate deployable rule. The results show that token attribution is not a reliable proxy for marginal energy under batched execution, and that measured Shapley ground truth can calibrate low-cost request features toward fairer attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JouleShare框架，通过实测Shapley值建立请求级能耗归因基准，揭示token比例归因在批处理场景下存在显著偏差（平均归一化L1误差约0.44-0.46），并提出轻量级校准模型JCalib将误差降至0.12-0.18，实现更公平的能耗归因。
AI.motivation: 批量LLM服务提高了吞吐量但使能耗核算复杂化。GPU功耗遥测是聚合的，而可持续性报告、费用分摊和工作负载分析通常需要请求级能耗数据。现有推理能耗基准报告模型级、阶段级或token级能耗，近期碳核算工作概念上提出Shapley公平性概念，但都无法提供实测的请求级基准数据，导致实践中使用的归因规则与公平分配的偏差程度长期未知。
AI.method: 提出JouleShare归因框架，包含两个组件：(1)离线测试工具：通过在vLLM下以可复现协议回放请求子集，集成GPU功耗遥测，计算每个请求的精确Shapley能耗，建立实测基准；(2)轻量级校准模型JCalib：从低成本请求特征学习预测Shapley份额，用于在线服务时预测。此外还采用采样Shapley方法将实测参考扩展到更大规模组。
AI.result: 在16个模型/工作负载运行中，token比例归因与精确Shapley的偏差：静态批处理下平均归一化L1误差为0.440，连续批处理下为0.458，该差距在三种数据中心GPU上复现。JCalib将误差降至静态批处理下0.116、连续批处理下0.177，甚至低于在线不可用的独立测量基准，同时保持精确批能耗效率。在更大组规模下差距持续存在，单一离线校准仍是最准确的部署规则。
AI.conclusion: Token归因不是批处理执行下边际能耗的可靠代理；实测Shapley基准真相可以校准低成本请求特征以实现更公平的归因。这为LLM服务的公平能耗核算和可持续性报告提供了可行方案。

title: Inference-Time Policy Alignment for Fair Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC) 2026. 13 pages main + appendix, 5 figures, 6 tables
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents achieve strong performance by optimizing scalar reward functions. However, once deployed, the policies of these RL agents are often rigid and costly to adapt to new performance criteria. For instance, an agent trained to maximize expected cumulative reward may not accommodate previously unknown stakeholder preferences. Existing approaches to achieve fairness, a type of preference, in RL typically assume that such preferences are known a priori and require complete retraining of the policy under a fairness-oriented metric. Inspired by inference-time alignment in large language models, we investigate the problem of steering a pretrained RL policy toward welfare-based fairness objectives at inference time without updating the base policy's parameters. We formalize inference-time fairness alignment as a policy shaping problem and propose a multiplicative policy shaping framework that adjusts action probabilities using action-dependent welfare scores, thus requiring no modification to the base policy. Our framework is general and compatible with any deep RL agent. Through extensive experiments across multiple domains, we demonstrate that inference-time policy shaping substantially improves welfare-based fairness objectives while preserving core task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了推理时策略塑形框架，无需重新训练即可引导预训练强化学习策略实现福利公平性目标。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习智能体训练后策略难以适应新的性能标准。现有实现公平性的方法通常假设偏好先验已知，且需要按公平性度量完全重新训练策略，成本高昂。受大语言模型推理时对齐启发，研究如何在推理时引导预训练策略实现福利公平性。
AI.method: 将推理时公平性对齐形式化为策略塑形问题，提出乘性策略塑形框架。该框架使用动作依赖的福利分数调整动作概率，无需修改基础策略参数，与任意深度强化学习智能体兼容。
AI.result: 在多个领域的广泛实验表明，推理时策略塑形能显著改善福利公平性目标，同时保持核心任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 推理时策略塑形为预训练强化学习策略提供了一种高效、通用的公平性对齐方法，在实现福利公平性的同时保持了任务性能。

title: GPU-Accelerated Multilevel Graph Clustering: A Parallel Perspective on Louvain and Leiden
comment: Published at 2026 IEEE International Parallel and Distributed Processing Symposium (IPDPS)
summary:
The sequential Louvain and Leiden algorithms are widely used techniques for modularity-optimizing clustering (or community detection) in large graphs. We present pLouvain and pLeiden, two new GPU parallelizations. pLouvain is based on the Louvain+ extension. pLeiden is the first parallel implementation to provably preserve all quality guarantees of sequential Leiden. We achieve this through a novel spanning-tree-based refinement approach. Both pLouvain and pLeiden use a lightweight symmetry-breaking technique that emulates an ordered traversal of vertices. For pLouvain, we develop an alternative iteration strategy to rectify the weak internal cluster connectivity observed in Louvain/Louvain+. Further, both pLouvain and pLeiden optimize the LambdaCC objective function, a generalization of modularity and the related Constant Potts model.
  On a collection of 57 graphs from 10 families, our results show that pLouvain and pLeiden achieve geometric mean speedups of 3.1x and 8.8x, respectively, over the current fastest open-source parallelizations of Louvain and Leiden. For the clusterings generated, pLouvain yields the highest modularity scores on nearly all tested graphs. The subroutines within these two multilevel approaches could aid in the parallelization of other Louvain-based techniques.

AI.tldr: 提出了pLouvain和pLeiden两种GPU并行化算法，分别实现3.1x和8.8x加速，其中pLeiden是首个能保留Leiden所有质量保证的并行实现。
AI.motivation: Louvain和Leiden算法是大规模图中广泛使用的模块度优化聚类（社区检测）技术，但在GPU上的高效并行化存在挑战，特别是如何在并行环境下保持算法的质量保证（如Leiden的质量保证）。
AI.method: 提出两种GPU并行化算法：pLouvain（基于Louvain+扩展）和pLeiden。关键技术包括：（1）基于生成树的精炼方法以保留Leiden的质量保证；（2）轻量级对称破除技术模拟顶点的有序遍历；（3）为pLouvain开发替代迭代策略以改善Louvain/Louvain+中观察到的弱内部集群连通性；（4）优化LambdaCC目标函数。
AI.result: 在10个家族的57个图上的实验表明，pLouvain和pLeiden分别相比当前最快的开源并行化实现实现了3.1倍和8.8倍的几何平均加速。pLouvain在几乎所有测试图上产生最高的模块度分数。
AI.conclusion: pLouvain和pLeiden在保持聚类质量的同时显著提升了性能，pLeiden是首个能保留Leiden所有质量保证的并行实现。这些多层方法中的子程序可用于其他基于Louvain技术的并行化。

title: Beyond Static Policies: Dynamic Selection Among Modern Microarchitectural Policies
summary: Modern processors gain performance from interacting policies: prefetchers, predictors, replacement rules, and schedulers. These policies are often evaluated one at a time, yet a policy that wins in one stack may lose in another. To study these effects, we present the first systematic composition study of two L1D prefetchers, two L1I prefetchers, and two L2 replacement policies across 490 phases from 49 SPEC CPU2006 and SPEC CPU 2017 traces. We define the best global static policy (BGSP) by phase-level oracle-win frequency. Gaze/Entangling/Mockingjay is the BGSP, winning 33.47% of phases, yet it remains 1.33% below the phase oracle on average, with 52 phases across eight benchmarks losing more than 2.5%. The opportunity is highly compressible: a Berti/Gaze pair that changes only the L1D prefetcher comes within 0.039% aggregate IPC of the eight-configuration oracle, reducing runtime control to one bit per 200K-instruction window. Given that one-bit interface, we frame selector design as an information problem: what can hardware know before choosing? We evaluate selectors that use only chosen-policy IPC, selectors that passively monitor the demand stream before either prefetcher changes cache state, and an ideal counterfactual observer that exposes the inactive-policy winner signal. The main practical result is that both executed-performance feedback and passive demand monitoring techniques capture much of the two-policy opportunity, recovering 62.4% to 73.4% of the pairwise oracle gap without executing or emulating the inactive prefetcher. The counterfactual study shows that inactive-policy observation must be nearly exact and available within one window to improve on executed-performance or passive demand monitoring. These results suggest a general method for adapting among microarchitectural policies as an additional pathway for processor improvement, distinct from structural resizing.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了处理器中预取器和替换策略的组合效应，发现策略组合存在显著优化空间，并提出通过一位接口选择策略，可在不执行非活跃策略的情况下恢复62.4%-73.4%的oracle性能差距。
AI.motivation: 现代处理器的性能依赖于预取器、预测器、替换规则和调度器等多种策略的交互作用。然而，这些策略通常被单独评估，忽略了不同策略组合之间的相互影响。一个策略在一种配置下表现优异，可能在另一种配置下表现不佳，这种组合效应的系统研究缺失，为性能优化带来了被忽视的机会。
AI.method: 研究者对两个L1D预取器、两个L1I预取器和两个L2替换策略在49个SPEC CPU2006和SPEC CPU2017基准的490个阶段上进行了系统组合研究。定义了最佳全局静态策略（BGSP）作为评估基准，将选择器设计建模为信息问题，评估了三种选择机制：仅使用已执行策略IPC的反馈、被动监控需求流、以及理想的反事实观察器，并分析它们捕获两策略机会的能力。
AI.result: BGSP（Gaze/Entangling/Mockingjay组合）在33.47%的阶段获胜，但平均仍比阶段oracle低1.33%。通过一位接口（每200K指令窗口）在预取器之间切换，可以达到与八配置oracle仅差0.039%的IPC性能。实用的选择技术（执行性能反馈和被动需求监控）可以恢复62.4%至73.4%的两两oracle差距，无需执行或仿真非活跃预取器。反事实研究表明，非活跃策略观察必须近乎精确且在一个窗口内可用才能超越实用方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，在微架构策略之间自适应切换是一条独特的处理器性能改进路径，与传统结构调整方法不同。只需简单的硬件反馈或被动监控即可捕获大部分组合优化机会，为未来处理器设计提供了新的优化方向，即可通过策略选择而非结构调整来提升性能。

title: Imprecise Belief Fusion Improves Multi-agent Social Learning
summary: In social learning, agents learn not only from direct evidence but also through interactions with their peers. We investigate the role of imprecision in such interactions and ask whether it can improve the effectiveness of the collective learning process. To that end we propose a model of social learning where beliefs are equivalent to formulas in a propositional language, and where agents learn from each other by combining their beliefs according to a fusion operator. The latter is parametrised so as to allow for different levels of imprecision, where a more imprecise fusion operator tends to generates a more imprecise fused belief when the two combined beliefs differ. In this context we describe both difference equation models and agent-based simulations of social learning under a variety of conditions and with different initial biases. The results presented suggest that for populations with a strong initial bias towards incorrect beliefs some level of imprecision in fusion can improve learning accuracy across a range of learning conditions. Furthermore, such benefits of imprecision are consistent with a stability analysis of the fixed points of the proposed difference equation models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在群体初始信念偏差较大时，社会学习中的信息融合过程引入一定程度的“不精确性”反而能提升整体学习准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有社会学习研究多关注信息的准确性传递，较少探讨“不精确性”在信息交互中的作用。作者旨在探究在信念融合过程中引入可控的不精确性，是否会提升集体学习过程的效率与准确性。
AI.method:
1. 提出一个社会学习模型，其中信念表示为命题语言中的公式，通过参数化的融合算子进行组合。
2. 融合算子允许不同级别的不精确性：当两个信念不一致时，更不精确的算子会生成更不精确的融合信念。
3. 采用差分方程模型和基于主体的仿真模拟，在不同初始偏差和学习条件下进行分析。
4. 通过稳定性分析验证差分方程模型固定点的性质。
AI.result:
1. 当群体初始信念强烈偏向错误信念时，适度的融合不精确性能显著提升学习准确性。
2. 该结论在多种学习条件和参数设置下得到仿真结果支持。
3. 稳定性分析与仿真结果一致，证实了不精确性益处的理论可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在社会学习过程中，适度的不精确性并非总是有害的；特别是在初始偏差较大时，它能作为纠正机制，促进群体更快收敛至正确信念。这为理解人类认知中的“模糊性”功能及设计更鲁棒的集体学习算法提供了新视角。

title: Augmented Backpressure for Decentralized Management of Agentic Networks
summary: Agentic foundation-model service networks handle requests spanning retrieval, planning, generation, verification, and tool use. Unlike traditional communication networks, control performance depends on queue dynamics and contextual memory states, including prefix/KV blocks, retrieved contexts, expert warm states, and verified tool outputs. These states arise from execution history and alter service work and downstream successor laws under finite local budgets. Treating them as passive caches or an independent process leaves a queueing-control gap. To this end, we propose \emph{Memory-Augmented Backpressure} (MABP), a queue--memory control framework for stateful foundation-model service networks (SFMSNs) that jointly models commodity queues and causal contextual memory dynamics. MABP represents each request by service and state types, estimates memory-dependent work, penalties, and successor probabilities, then reads queues and resident memory each slot, selects feasible routing, transfer, activation, and service actions using a memory-dependent pressure score, and retains a budget-feasible subset of resident and newly generated objects. We prove an occupation-measure capacity outer bound with conditional tightness. We show that modeling contextual memory can strictly increase the stability region through work reduction and transition shaping, establishing a separation between memory-aware and memory-oblivious decisions. We also prove throughput and drift-plus-penalty guarantees for exact frame-MABP with bounded-loss extensions to approximate solvers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MABP框架，通过联合建模队列和上下文记忆动态，解决了有状态基础模型服务网络中的队列-记忆控制问题，并证明了记忆感知决策可以显著增加稳定性区域。
AI.motivation: 传统的通信网络控制方法将上下文记忆状态（如前缀/KV块、检索上下文、专家预热状态和验证工具输出）视为被动缓存或独立过程，这导致了队列控制的空白。这些状态源于执行历史，在有限本地预算约束下会改变服务工作和下游后继规律，因此需要一种新的控制框架来联合处理队列和记忆动态。
AI.method: 提出记忆增强反压力（MABP）框架：1）用服务和状态类型表示每个请求；2）估计记忆依赖的工作、惩罚和后继概率；3）每个时隙读取队列和常驻记忆，使用记忆依赖的压力分数选择可行的路由、传输、激活和服务动作；4）保留预算可行的常驻和新生成对象子集。还提出了精确frame-MABP和有界损失的近似求解器扩展。
AI.result: 证明了占用度量容量外边界及其条件紧性；表明建模上下文记忆可以通过工作减少和转移塑造严格增加稳定性区域，建立了记忆感知和记忆遗忘决策之间的分离；证明了精确frame-MABP的吞吐量和漂移加惩罚保证，以及近似求解器的有界损失扩展。
AI.conclusion: MABP框架成功填补了有状态基础模型服务网络中队列-记忆控制的空白，通过记忆感知决策实现了比传统记忆遗忘方法更大的稳定性区域，为智能体基础模型服务网络提供了理论基础和实用算法保证。

title: Motif-Mamba: network motif improved mamba for long-range sequence modeling
comment: 9 pages of main text, 8 pages of appendix, 6 figures. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Efficient long-sequence modeling remains a central challenge for large language models, as self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Mamba offers a linear-time alternative through selective state space recurrence, but its predominantly diagonal state transitions restrict explicit interactions among state dimensions. We propose Motif-Mamba, a structured state space model that augments Mamba with a motif-constrained low-rank recurrent pathway. Inspired by the dynamics of three-node network motifs, the proposed pathway projects hidden states into a compact dynamical subspace, imposes motif-guided interactions, and maps the resulting dynamics back to the original state space. This design enhances cross-dimensional communication while preserving the linear-time recurrent structure of Mamba. Experiments on long-sequence extrapolation, language modeling benchmarks, and brain--computer interface decoding show consistent improvements over Mamba backbones, suggesting that motif-guided low-rank dynamics provide an effective structural prior for long-range sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Motif-Mamba，一种结构化状态空间模型，通过引入受网络模体约束的低秩递归路径来增强Mamba的跨维度交互能力，在保持线性时间复杂度的同时提升了长序列建模性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管Mamba通过选择性状态空间递归提供了线性时间复杂度的方案，但其主要的对角状态转移限制了状态维度间的显式交互。长序列建模仍然是大语言模型面临的核心挑战，因为自注意力机制随序列长度呈二次方增长。
AI.method: 提出Motif-Mamba，在Mamba基础上增加受模体约束的低秩递归路径。该路径受三节点网络模体动力学启发，将隐藏状态投影到紧凑的动力学子空间，施加模体引导的交互，然后将结果映射回原始状态空间。这种设计既增强了跨维度通信，又保持了Mamba的线性时间递归结构。
AI.result: 在长序列外推、语言建模基准测试和脑机接口解码任务上的实验表明，Motif-Mamba相比Mamba基线取得了持续的改进。
AI.conclusion: 模体引导的低秩动力学为长程序列建模提供了有效的结构先验，证明了增强跨维度交互对提升长序列建模性能的重要性。

title: AutoCause: A Python framework that automates expert decisions in environmental time-series causal discovery
comment: 33 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to Environmental Modelling & Software
summary: Environmental time-series causal discovery requires expert decisions about method choice, conditional-independence tests, lag horizons, sample-size adequacy, multiple-testing control, and evidence interpretation. Applied inconsistently across datasets, these choices yield graphs that cannot be compared, reproduced, or audited. We present AutoCause, an open-source Python workflow that records each decision, derives defaults from an extended causal-audit module, and admits domain-informed overrides. The workflow wraps four established causal-discovery methods from three families, adds non-causal reference models, and grades links by method-count support. On 145 datasets from DGP-Atlas, TimeGraph, and a topology-derived CausalRivers reference, the methods recover complementary parts of the reference graphs. Majority-supported links are more precise than single-method links on the synthetic benchmarks but not against river topology. AutoCause converts inconsistent expert practice into an auditable, repeatable analysis; causal interpretation remains with the analyst. Available at https://github.com/marcoruizrueda/autocause.

AI.tldr: 提出了AutoCause，一个开源Python工作流，通过记录决策过程、整合四种因果发现方法并评估方法间一致性，将环境时间序列因果发现从不一致的专家实践转变为可审计、可重复的分析流程。
AI.motivation: 环境时间序列因果发现需要专家在方法选择、条件独立性检验、滞后范围、样本量充足性、多重检验控制和证据解释等方面做出决策。这些决策在不同数据集间应用不一致，导致生成的因果图无法比较、复现或审计，影响了研究的可靠性和可重复性。
AI.method: 开发了AutoCause开源Python工作流，记录每个决策，从扩展的因果审计模块导出默认值并接受领域知识覆盖。工作流整合了来自三个家族的四种已建立因果发现方法，添加非因果参考模型，并根据方法计数支持对因果链接进行分级评估。在来自DGP-Atlas、TimeGraph和基于拓扑的CausalRivers参考的145个数据集上进行验证。
AI.result: 不同方法能够恢复参考图中的互补部分。在合成基准测试中，多数方法支持的链接比单一方法的链接更精确，但在河流拓扑对比中未呈现此优势。多数支持链接在合成数据上显示出更高的精确度，证明了方法集成策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AutoCause成功将不一致的专家实践转化为可审计、可重复的分析流程，提高了因果发现结果的可靠性。但因果解释权仍保留给分析师，工具本身不作最终解释判断。代码已在GitHub开源，促进了环境时间序列因果发现研究的标准化和透明化。

title: On the Limits of Machine-Learned Ranking for Modern Microarchitectural Policies
summary: Machine-learning predictors estimate processor performance far faster than cycle-level simulation. For design-space exploration, however, the valuable test is not merely reproducing the usual hardware ordering, but identifying how different hardware configurations rank on individual program phases. We evaluate four ML-predictors in two design regimes: \emph{Structural Parameters} (SP), varying hardware resources such as issue width, ROB size, and cache capacity; and \emph{Behavioral Policies} (BP), varying prefetching and replacement algorithms. In the SP regime, aggregate ranking is strong, yet counter-intuitive windows(CIW)---where the configuration expected to be slower is faster---constitute $22.4\%$ of non-tied windows across five pairs with a clear architectural prior. CIW match across these pairs is only $23.3$--$39.9\%$; every point estimate is below the $50\%$ random strict-ordering reference. The BP regime presents a different failure: ground-truth ties cover $37.8\%$ of pair-windows, most strict pairs have margins of only a few cycles, and no model family reliably beats a feature-free majority baseline. NeuroScalar and SimNet fall below that baseline, Concorde is statistically tied with it, and the best selected OneDSE head improves by only $2.1$ percentage points. Accuracy rises mainly at large margins. We further show that this failure is not a matter of model capacity: an information-theoretic analysis reveals that when ranking outcomes depend on hidden microarchitectural state absent from the instruction stream, no trace-based predictor can exceed the Bayes accuracy determined by observable inputs alone. Thus high cycle or aggregate ranking accuracy can reflect mastery of easy, high-margin cases while missing the local reversals that carry the most architectural insight and for which cycle-level simulation remains indispensable.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了四种机器学习性能预测器在处理器设计空间探索中的有效性，发现在结构参数设计域中存在22.4%的反直觉窗口（预期较慢的配置反而更快），在行为策略设计域中所有模型都无法可靠超越无特征多数基线，并从信息论角度证明当排序结果依赖指令流中缺失的隐藏微架构状态时，基于trace的预测器无法超过贝叶斯准确率上限。
AI.motivation: 机器学习预测器能够比周期级模拟器更快地估计处理器性能，但在设计空间探索中，关键需求不仅是复现常规硬件排序，而是识别不同硬件配置在单个程序阶段上的相对排名。现有研究缺乏对ML预测器在细粒度排序准确性方面的深入评估，特别是在存在反直觉排序和架构先验知识的情况下。
AI.method: 评估四种ML预测器（NeuroScalar、SimNet、Concorde、OneDSE）在两种设计域的表现：结构参数域（改变发射宽度、ROB大小、缓存容量等硬件资源）和行为策略域（改变预取和替换算法）。引入反直觉窗口(CIW)概念衡量预测器捕捉局部排序反转的能力，并通过信息论分析揭示基于trace的预测器的理论准确率上限。
AI.result: SP域：聚合排序准确率高，但CIW占22.4%，跨配置对匹配率仅23.3%-39.9%，均低于50%随机参考。BP域：真实并列占37.8%，多数严格排序对差距仅几个周期，无模型家族可靠超越无特征多数基线；NeuroScalar和SimNet低于基线，Concorde与基线统计持平，最优OneDSE仅提升2.1个百分点。准确率提升主要出现在大差距案例。
AI.conclusion: 高周期准确率或聚合排序准确率可能反映对简单大差距案例的掌握，同时错过了携带最多架构洞察的局部排序反转，这类反转仍需周期级模拟才能准确捕捉。模型容量并非问题根源：当排序结果依赖指令流中缺失的隐藏微架构状态时，任何基于trace的预测器都无法超过由可观测输入单独决定的贝叶斯准确率。

title: Training Small LLMs as Spatial Multi-Agent Policies
summary: Training LLM-based multi-agent systems with multi-agent reinforcement learning is rapidly gaining traction, and a parallel line of work argues that such systems should be judged by their behavior, not only their reward. We take up both threads in spatial cooperative games, where small frozen LLMs prompted with low-level actions fail outright, earning zero reward. Guided by the options/semi-MDP framework---and, because option execution is asynchronous across agents, its multi-agent extension in macro-action Dec-POMDPs---we equip each game with a library of symbolic \emph{options}: typed, state-feasible, short-horizon behaviors executed by a symbolic planner. Each library is drafted by a frontier coding model from the game's source code; the feasibility guards that filter each menu are then synthesized mechanically from cheap random-policy burn-in rollouts---a guard is adopted only if it explains repeated execution failures while hiding no logged success---so no guard is authored, selected, or reward-tuned by hand. Each agent's LLM acts as its policy over options, with a private per-agent LoRA adapter trained by a per-agent variant of multi-agent GRPO (PA-MAGRPO); this lifts frozen bases from zero reward to competent play across three games and four small backbones. Behavioral audits then reveal that reward and cooperation decouple: a rising reward curve may simply mean that one agent has learned to run the entire task alone while its partner idles---cooperation emerges only when the task makes it necessary. Reward alone is thus an unreliable readout of cooperation; behavioral evaluation must sit alongside it.

AI.tldr: 本文针对小型冻结LLM在空间合作博弈中失败的问题，提出了基于符号选项库和PA-MAGRPO的训练方法，成功提升了模型表现。研究发现奖励与合作行为可能解耦，单一奖励指标无法可靠反映合作效果，需结合行为评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM多智能体强化学习方法仅关注奖励，但奖励不能完全反映智能体的合作行为；同时，小型冻结LLM在空间合作博弈中直接应用低级动作提示会完全失败，获得零奖励。因此需要一种既能提升性能又能进行行为评估的方法。
AI.method: 基于选项/半马尔可夫决策过程框架及其多智能体扩展（宏动作Dec-POMDP），为每个博弈构建符号选项库：由前沿编码模型从源代码起草选项，通过随机策略预热rollout机械合成可行性守卫。每个智能体的LLM作为选项策略，使用私有LoRA适配器通过PA-MAGRPO（多智能体GRPO的变体）进行训练。
AI.result: 在三个博弈和四个小型骨干网络上，将冻结基础模型从零奖励提升至有能力进行博弈；行为审计发现奖励曲线上升可能仅表示单个智能体独自完成任务而其伙伴闲置，真正的合作仅在任务必要时才出现。
AI.conclusion: 奖励是合作不可靠的读出指标，行为评估必须与奖励并行存在；奖励与合作行为可能解耦，仅依赖奖励无法准确评估多智能体系统的合作质量。

title: Topology-Age-Aware Cooperative Awareness in Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks
summary: In vehicular ad-hoc networks (VANETs), maintaining the freshness of status information among vehicles is critical for enabling timely and reliable safety-related decisions. In this paper, we consider the problem of scheduling cooperative status broadcasting in VANETs, where vehicles are allowed to broadcast not only their own updates but also the updates of other vehicles. We propose the age-aware cooperative broadcasting (A-CB) policy, in which a road-side unit (RSU) schedules target-sender pairs based on the total achievable age-gain over the sender's network links. Moreover, through exploiting the network topology, we introduce two topology-age-aware cooperative broadcasting (TA-CB) policies; the Local TA-CB that weights links according to the number of second-hop neighbors, and the Global TA-CB that leverages the betweenness centrality of vehicles to prioritize broadcasting decisions. The proposed policies are evaluated under both random and clustered network topologies. Numerical results demonstrate that cooperative policies significantly outperform non-cooperative broadcasting. Notably, in clustered network structures, the Local and the Global TA-CB policies achieve substantial improvements over A-CB, with each outperforming the other under different network conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了车载自组网(VANETs)中的协作状态广播调度问题。提出了基于信息年龄增益的A-CB策略，以及利用网络拓扑特性的两种TA-CB策略。实验表明，协作广播策略显著优于非协作方式，且在集群网络结构中，基于拓扑的策略进一步提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 在车载自组网中，保持车辆间状态信息的时效性对于实现及时可靠的安全决策至关重要。现有研究缺乏针对协作广播场景的优化调度机制，因此需要设计能够有效降低信息年龄、提升状态更新新鲜度的广播策略。
AI.method: 提出三种协作广播策略：(1)A-CB策略：RSU基于发送者网络链路的总可达成信息年龄增益来调度目标-发送者对；(2)局部TA-CB策略：根据二跳邻居数量对链路进行加权；(3)全局TA-CB策略：利用车辆的中介中心性来优先调度广播决策。后两种策略通过挖掘网络拓扑特性来优化广播调度。
AI.result: 在随机和集群网络拓扑下进行了性能评估。结果表明：(1)协作广播策略显著优于非协作广播；(2)在集群网络结构中，局部和全局TA-CB策略相比A-CB实现了显著性能提升；(3)局部和全局TA-CB策略在不同网络条件下各有优势，相互补充。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的年龄感知协作广播策略能够有效降低VANETs中的信息年龄。通过协作广播机制和拓扑信息的合理利用，可以显著提升状态信息的时效性，为车辆安全决策提供更可靠的支撑。拓扑感知策略在特定网络环境下展现出进一步的优势。

title: Nova: An End-to-End MLIR Compiler for Deep Learning
summary: The performance of deep learning models at scale relies heavily on how effectively high-level mathematical operations are mapped to underlying physical hardware. While high-level tensor frameworks provide flexible abstractions for model design, their eager execution models inherently lack the whole-graph visibility and granular control over hardware and memory required to maximize physical hardware utilization natively. To bridge this gap, we designed Nova, an automated end-to-end JIT compiler whose defining purpose is to achieve absolute control over this hardware mapping: fusing operations across operation boundaries, optimizing complex memory hierarchies, and tuning execution down to the register level. By capturing eager executions and unifying forward and backward passes into a single value-semantic dialect, Nova unlocks aggressive whole-graph optimizations. It then utilizes an Analytic Configurator to deterministically derive optimal execution schedules based on arithmetic intensity, dropping search time to zero. Backed by a structural hashing runtime, Nova synthesizes fine-grained kernels directly from the computation's structure. In our evaluations on an RTX 3060, Nova matches or modestly exceeds cuBLAS and XLA on TF32 matmuls on most shapes, maintaining a stringent < 5e-4 relative error. At the model level, Nova achieves up to 10.6% greater throughput than PyTorch and 4.4% greater than XLA on a 42-million parameter model, without compromising on numerical fidelity. Crucially, by reducing the memory footprint by up to 29% relative to PyTorch, Nova successfully trains a 144-million parameter model at 17,900 tokens/s where PyTorch encounters Out-Of-Memory (OOM) failures on the same 12 GB consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: Nova是一个自动化端到端JIT编译器，通过捕获急切执行并统一前向和反向传播，实现跨操作边界的融合、内存层次优化和寄存器级调优，在RTX 3060上实现了比PyTorch高10.6%、比XLA高4.4%的吞吐量提升，内存占用降低29%，成功在12GB消费级GPU上训练1.44亿参数模型而PyTorch发生OOM。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习框架的急切执行模型缺乏全图可见性和对硬件内存的细粒度控制，无法最大化物理硬件利用率，导致大规模深度学习模型性能受限。
AI.method: 设计Nova自动化端到端JIT编译器：1)捕获急切执行并统一前向反向传播为单一值语义方言；2)使用解析配置器基于算术强度确定性推导最优执行调度；3)基于结构哈希运行时直接从计算结构合成细粒度内核；实现跨操作边界融合、内存层次优化和寄存器级调优。
AI.result: 在RTX 3060上评估：TF32矩阵乘法性能匹配或略超cuBLAS和XLA，相对误差<5e-4；模型级吞吐量比PyTorch高10.6%，比XLA高4.4%；内存占用降低29%，在12GB GPU上成功训练1.44亿参数模型（17900 tokens/s），而PyTorch发生OOM。
AI.conclusion: Nova通过全图优化和确定性执行调度成功桥接高层框架与底层硬件之间的鸿沟，在不牺牲数值精度的前提下显著提升了深度学习模型的吞吐量和内存效率，使消费级GPU能够训练更大规模模型。

title: A Physics-Chemistry-Informed Neural Network (PCINN) for Real-Time Spatial-ALD Coverage Prediction and Reliable Kinetics Inversion
summary:
Spatial atomic layer deposition (SALD) is a leading atmospheric-pressure, high-throughput route to industrial ALD, but design and control are limited by the cost of predicting surface coverage: high-fidelity CFD is far too slow for operating-window scans, while analytic models miss transport modulation such as the gas curtain. We present a physics-chemistry-informed neural network (PCINN), a hybrid surrogate with CFD-level accuracy at real-time speed: a query returns coverage in about 7 ms, roughly 5x10^4 times faster than a CFD solve, reaching a test R^2_log = 0.998 (leave-one-out R^2_raw = 0.974) from only 30 training cases spanning four orders of magnitude in coverage.
  The architecture is not a black box: a small network learns only the operating-condition to near-wall concentration closure, while the known surface kinetics is a hard-coded, trainable chemistry layer integrated along the substrate trajectory. This single-scalar bottleneck keeps it accurate under sparse data, interpretable and invertible.
  We add a full identifiability analysis (Fisher information, profile likelihood). The adsorption energy E_ads and desorption rate k_des are robustly identifiable; k_ads is not separately identifiable at a single temperature (only k_ads*c_wall is). Across four temperatures the prefactor nu and E_ads bind along a weakly identifiable degeneracy valley of slope 0.065 eV/decade, derived analytically as k_B T_eff ln(10) and turned into a reliability diagnostic: a seven-chemistry mismatch matrix shows it is invariant under any single-Arrhenius mismatch and shifts only when a second thermally activated process appears, so a slope departure flags unmodelled site heterogeneity.
  Data come from simulation with known ground truth inverted by the same kinetic form, so the study verifies pipeline self-consistency and the identifiability boundary, not real parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出了PCINN混合代理模型，实现了空间原子层沉积（SALD）的实时表面覆盖率预测，速度比CFD快约5万倍且精度相当，并进行了完整的参数可识别性分析。
AI.motivation: 空间原子层沉积（SALD）的工业应用中，高保真CFD模拟速度太慢无法进行操作窗口扫描，而解析模型又忽略了气帘等传输调制效应，亟需一种兼具CFD级精度和实时速度的预测方法。
AI.method: 开发了物理-化学信息神经网络（PCINN），采用混合架构：小网络仅学习操作条件到近壁浓度的映射，已知表面动力学作为硬编码、可训练的化学层沿基底轨迹积分。这种单标量瓶颈设计使模型在稀疏数据下保持准确、可解释且可逆。采用Fisher信息和轮廓似然进行完整的可识别性分析。
AI.result: 查询响应时间约7毫秒，比CFD快约5×10^4倍；仅用30个训练样本（覆盖率跨4个数量级）达到测试R²_log=0.998（留一法R²_raw=0.974）。可识别性分析表明：吸附能E_ads和脱附速率k_des可稳健识别；单温度下k_ads单独不可识别；四温度下指前因子ν和E_ads沿弱可识别简并谷（斜率0.065 eV/decade）结合，该斜率可作为可靠性诊断指标检测未建模的位点异质性。
AI.conclusion: PCINN成功将CFD级精度与实时速度结合，单标量瓶颈架构解决了稀疏数据下的准确性问题。可识别性分析揭示了参数估计的边界，导出的简并谷斜率可作为检测模型偏差的诊断工具。通过已知真值的模拟数据验证了方法的自一致性。

title: Bole: Efficient Tree Speculation for Hybrid-Attention Language Models
summary: Hybrid-attention large language models combine full attention with recurrent linear attention to reduce long-context inference costs, yet their autoregressive decoding remains memory-bound. Tree speculative decoding offers an attractive acceleration path, but existing tree-speculation systems are designed around the key--value caches of full-attention models. On hybrid models, they traverse recurrent layers branch by branch and materialize a full state for every proposal node, causing verification latency and transient memory to scale poorly with tree and batch sizes. We present Bole, a kernel--runtime co-design that enables efficient tree speculation for hybrid-attention LLMs. Bole transforms the linear-attention recurrence into a tree-structured closed form and realizes it with a resource-efficient GPU kernel, verifying all proposal nodes in parallel and accelerating linear-attention tree verification by 3.4--7.7$\times$. It losslessly encodes speculative state updates as token-level factors and reconstructs only the state selected after sampling, reducing transient state memory by 82--99$\times$ and freeing GPU capacity for KV caches. Its integration into SGLang, a widely deployed production LLM serving engine, couples efficient state management with a batch-wide verification budget calibrated to the complete hybrid forward. Across four models, two GPU platforms, and diverse datasets, Bole delivers up to $4.72\times$ the offline decode throughput of autoregressive decoding and up to $2.03\times$ that of the strongest tree-speculative baseline. Under online agent workloads, it reduces TTFT and TPOT by up to $67.6%$ and $49.9%$, respectively, over the strongest tree-speculative baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出Bole框架，通过内核-运行时协同设计实现混合注意力大语言模型的高效树推测解码，在离线和在线场景下均显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 混合注意力大语言模型结合全注意力和循环线性注意力以降低长上下文推理成本，但其自回归解码仍受内存限制。现有树推测系统针对全注意力模型的KV缓存设计，在混合模型上需要逐分支遍历循环层并为每个提议节点实例化完整状态，导致验证延迟和瞬态内存随树规模和批大小增长而恶化。
AI.method: 提出Bole内核-运行时协同设计方案：1)将线性注意力循环转化为树结构闭式形式，通过资源高效GPU内核实现并行验证；2)将推测状态更新无损编码为令牌级因子，仅重构采样后选中的状态，大幅降低瞬态内存占用；3)集成到SGLang生产级LLM服务引擎，配合面向完整混合前向的批验证预算校准。
AI.result: 线性注意力树验证加速3.4-7.7倍；瞬态状态内存减少82-99倍；在四个模型、两个GPU平台和多个数据集上，离线解码吞吐量较自回归解码提升达4.72倍，较最强树推测基线提升达2.03倍；在线代理负载下TTFT和TPOT分别降低达67.6%和49.9%。
AI.conclusion: Bole成功解决了混合注意力模型上树推测解码的效率瓶颈，在保持无损精度的前提下，通过算法创新和系统优化实现了显著的性能提升，为生产环境中的长上下文LLM服务提供了有效解决方案。

title: Forbench: Symbolic Simulation Helps Make Your Testbench More Formal
summary: Simulation remains the dominant approach in pre-silicon verification due to its ease of deployment and intuitive workflow. However, as simulation only explores a limited subset of possible execution traces within feasible time budgets, it often fails to explore rare corner cases, leaving latent bugs undetected. In contrast, formal verification offers mathematically rigorous guarantees of correctness. However, its practical adoption is constrained, not only by the scalability challenges over large-scale designs, but also by the change of mindset from stimulus-driven operations to the sequence-centric axiomatic view of design behaviors, introducing extra difficulty of writing precise properties to capture the exact verification intent. This paper aims to lower the barrier of applying formal methods in verification, by making simulation "more formal." It introduces Forbench, a word-level symbolic simulation framework that retains the familiar execution semantics of simulation but augments it with solver-backed symbolic signals and state transitions, enabling systematic exploration of RTL behaviors under symbolic inputs and conditions. It offers a Python interface, similar to the existing simulation-based frameworks, for defining constraints, coordinating symbolic (co-)simulations, and performing property checks. In additional to this more accessible interface, experiments also show that Forbench achieves notably speed-up over prior symbolic methods without the loss of coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Forbench框架，通过符号仿真将形式验证能力融入传统仿真流程，在保持易用性的同时实现了对RTL设计的系统性验证，并在速度和覆盖率上取得了良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 传统仿真验证易用但覆盖率有限，难以发现罕见边界情况；形式验证虽能提供数学严谨性保证，但存在可扩展性挑战且需要验证工程师转变思维方式、编写精确属性，导致实际应用门槛较高。
AI.method: 提出Forbench——一个字级符号仿真框架。该框架保留仿真熟悉的执行语义，同时引入求解器支持的符号信号和状态转换，实现对符号输入和条件下RTL行为的系统性探索。提供类似现有仿真框架的Python接口，用于定义约束、协调符号协同仿真和执行属性检查。
AI.result: 实验表明，Forbench在保持覆盖率不降低的前提下，相较于之前的符号方法实现了显著的速度提升，同时降低了形式方法的应用门槛。
AI.conclusion: Forbench成功地将形式验证能力嵌入传统仿真流程，在保持易用性的同时弥补了仿真的覆盖局限性和形式验证的应用障碍，为工业界采用形式方法提供了更平滑的过渡路径。

title: Can LLM Agents Price Competitively? A Dynamic Multi-Attribute Auction Benchmark for Agentic Commerce
summary: Agentic commerce is moving from concept to deployed infrastructure: payment networks, retailers, and AI platforms are setting the stage for agents to transact on behalf of merchants and consumers. Yet whether the LLMs behind these agents can price competently in real markets, where customer preferences are hidden, competitors adapt in real time, and demand can shift without warning, has not been systematically tested. We introduce Bazaar, a dynamic sealed-bid benchmark for multi-attribute auction under these conditions. Despite its dynamics, the benchmark is grounded in closed-form customer utilities, enabling exact evaluation. Across 11 frontier LLMs from four providers, the leading agents on customer acquisition (e.g. Gemini 3.1 Pro) are often not the leading agents on profit (e.g. Opus 4.6). The ranking shifts again under demand shocks: agents that learned fastest pre-shock are typically the slowest to revise their beliefs afterwards, while Gemini 3.1 Pro recovers fastest despite not leading on profit. However, even the strongest agent captures less than a third of hindsight-optimal profit, suggesting current LLMs are progressing in agentic commerce but leave substantial headroom.

AI.tldr: 提出了Bazaar基准测试，评估LLM在动态多属性拍卖中的定价能力，发现最强代理仅能获得不到三分之一的最优利润，显示LLM在代理商务中仍有很大提升空间。
AI.motivation: 代理商务正从概念走向实际部署，支付网络、零售商和AI平台正在为代理代表商家和消费者进行交易搭建基础设施。然而，在客户偏好隐藏、竞争对手实时调整、需求可能突然变化的真实市场环境中，支撑这些代理的LLM是否能够进行有效的定价，尚未得到系统性测试。
AI.method: 引入Bazaar，一个动态密封投标基准测试，用于多属性拍卖场景。该基准考虑了客户偏好隐藏、竞争对手实时适应和需求冲击等真实市场条件。尽管具有动态性，该基准基于闭式客户效用函数，能够进行精确评估。研究测试了来自四个提供商的11个前沿LLM模型。
AI.result: 在客户获取方面表现最佳的代理（如Gemini 3.1 Pro）往往不是在利润方面表现最佳的代理（如Opus 4.6）。在需求冲击下，排名再次发生变化：冲击前学习最快的代理通常是冲击后修正信念最慢的，而Gemini 3.1 Pro尽管不在利润上领先，却是恢复最快的。然而，即使是最强的代理也只能获得不到三分之一的后见之明最优利润。
AI.conclusion: 当前的LLM在代理商务方面正在进步，但仍有巨大的提升空间，在真实市场环境中的定价能力需要进一步改进。

title: VeraRAN: Pre-Actuation Certification and Event-Causal Synchronization Repair for Asynchronous Multi-Interface RAN Plans
summary: Agentic RAN controllers combine mobility, energy, and resource actions across independently implemented interfaces. Even when each command is valid and the target state is safe, asynchronous actuation can drive the network through unsafe intermediate states. In a frozen study of a 35B planner, 28.8% of locally valid plans remained asynchronously unsafe. We introduce VeraRAN, which checks plans before actuation by modeling request, delivery, acceptance, application, completion, and observation for each action while exploring plausible delays and event orders. When VeraRAN finds a counterexample, VeraSync inserts versioned event barriers and rechecks the repaired plan for safety and completion. MI-POR prunes independent interleavings using RAN lifecycle and resource footprints. In a post-freeze stratified confirmation within the declared repair domain, VeraSync re-certified every confirmation plan while leaving 87% of action pairs unordered. MI-POR matched exact search in a property-stratified audit and reduced explored states by 94.6-95.0% on 20-40-action plans. Native ns-O-RAN replay and an independent live E2 audit showed why distinguishing these events matters: acceptance may precede the authoritative state transition, so dependent actions must wait for direct APPLY evidence or a contract-backed completion event causally downstream of APPLY.

AI.tldr: 提出VeraRAN系统检测异步执行下的不安全中间状态，通过VeraSync修复和MI-POR剪枝技术，显著提升RAN控制器安全性并减少状态空间。
AI.motivation: 智能RAN控制器在独立实现的接口上组合移动性、能量和资源操作。即使每个命令有效且目标状态安全，异步执行可能使网络经过不安全的中间状态。研究表明，35B规划器中28.8%的局部有效计划在异步执行下不安全。
AI.method: 1) VeraRAN通过建模请求、交付、接受、应用、完成和观察等动作事件，探索合理延迟和事件顺序来检查计划；2) 发现反例时，VeraSync插入版本化事件屏障并重新检查修复后的计划；3) MI-POR利用RAN生命周期和资源足迹剪枝独立交错。
AI.result: VeraSync在修复域内重新认证所有确认计划，87%的动作对保持无序；MI-POR在属性分层审计中匹配精确搜索，在20-40动作计划上减少94.6-95.0%的探索状态。原生ns-O-RAN重放和独立E2审计验证了区分这些事件的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 区分接受、应用、完成等事件对RAN安全至关重要，依赖动作必须等待直接APPLY证据或因果下游的合约支持完成事件，VeraRAN系统有效解决了异步执行安全问题。

title: SIRIN: A Unified Toolkit for Detecting Contextual Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented and Memory-Grounded LLM Systems
summary:
SIRIN (Semantic Inconsistency Recognition and Inspection Nexus) is a unified toolkit and interactive web UI for detecting contextual hallucinations (fluent, plausible responses unsupported by the provided evidence) in retrieval-augmented, agentic, and memory-grounded LLM systems. SIRIN unifies three detector paradigms (representation probing, uncertainty estimation, and judge-style verification) and the complementary task of pre-generation query answerability under one interface, configuration system, and evaluation pipeline, supporting response- and span-level inspection in both white-box and black-box settings. The web UI enables live analysis of user-supplied context-query-answer triples through hallucination scores, unsupported-span highlighting, and side-by-side detector comparison, with a lightweight plug-in design for adding new detectors. We demonstrate SIRIN on hallucination detection, query answerability, and as a faithfulness gate within long-term memory systems.
  The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sb-ai-lab/SIRIN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SIRIN，这是一个统一的工具包和交互式Web UI，用于检测检索增强、智能体和记忆增强LLM系统中的上下文幻觉。它整合了三种检测器范式和查询可回答性任务，支持白盒和黑盒设置下的响应级和片段级检查。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM系统在检索增强、智能体和记忆增强场景中的广泛应用，检测上下文幻觉（流畅、合理但缺乏证据支持的响应）成为一个关键挑战。现有检测方法分散且缺乏统一框架，因此需要一个整合多种检测范式并提供交互式分析界面的工具包。
AI.method: SIRIN统一了三种检测器范式：表示探测（representation probing）、不确定性估计（uncertainty estimation）和裁判式验证（judge-style verification），以及预生成查询可回答性任务。系统提供统一的界面、配置系统和评估流程，支持白盒和黑盒设置。Web UI实现了实时分析功能，包括幻觉评分、不支持片段高亮和检测器对比。采用轻量级插件设计便于添加新检测器。
AI.result: SIRIN成功应用于幻觉检测、查询可回答性评估，以及作为长期记忆系统中的忠实性门控。系统支持响应级和片段级检查，能够实时分析用户提供的上下文-查询-答案三元组，并通过幻觉评分、片段高亮和检测器对比等功能提供可视化分析。
AI.conclusion: SIRIN为LLM系统的上下文幻觉检测提供了一个全面、统一的解决方案，通过整合多种检测范式和提供交互式分析界面，有效支持了检索增强、智能体和记忆增强系统的幻觉检测需求，为研究者和实践者提供了实用的工具。

title: Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization
summary: We show that on-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve the current objective while making successful behaviors for later objectives too rare to sample and reinforce. We call this verifier-induced support reshaping and define effective rewardable support as successful trajectories reachable within a fixed rollout budget. Across two model families, we study this effect through repeated verifier-scored sampling and bidirectional training on mathematical reasoning and constrained instruction following, including sequential training with the opposite verifier. Math-RLVR raises average instruction-following success but reduces the number of prompts with any successful response under repeated sampling. On IFEval with Qwen3-8B-Base, pass@1 rises by 6.5 percentage points while best@32 falls by 9.8 percentage points, and the same divergence appears across both models and IF benchmarks. Conversely, IF-RLVR shifts math responses from step-by-step openings toward direct answers, lowers best@k across sampling budgets, and reduces reward variation for later Math-RLVR. Token-distribution analyses and controlled opening interventions show that these changes concentrate in the first few response tokens. RLVR mainly reranks openings already available in the base policy, and the selected opening causally affects math searchability.
