The tested reference-policy constraints, routing priors, and on-policy distillation preserve cross-task support only partially; MathIF and ReasonIF show that marginal gains translate only partly into responses that are both correct and constraint-following. Therefore, endpoint improvements do not guarantee future trainability or joint capability under on-policy optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/verifier-induced-support-reshaping

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了策略上强化学习(RLVR)中的验证器诱导支持重塑现象：优化当前目标可能会使后续目标的成功行为变得稀缺，端点性能提升不能保证未来的可训练性或联合能力。
AI.motivation: 研究者观察到在策略上强化学习过程中，针对特定验证奖励的优化可能意外改变模型的响应分布，导致原本可达到的成功轨迹变得难以采样和强化。这种验证器诱导的支持重塑效应可能影响模型在后续任务上的性能和可训练性。
AI.method: 通过两个模型家族，使用重复验证器评分采样和双向训练方法，在数学推理和约束指令遵循任务上进行实验。包括顺序使用相反验证器的训练、Token分布分析、受控开头干预等手段，分析RLVR对有效可奖励支持空间的影响。
AI.result: Math-RLVR提升平均指令遵循成功率但减少重复采样下有成功响应的提示数量（Qwen3-8B-Base上pass@1上升6.5个百分点，best@32下降9.8个百分点）；IF-RLVR将数学响应从逐步解答转向直接答案，降低各采样预算下的best@k；变化集中在响应的前几个token；参考策略约束、路由先验和策略蒸馏仅部分保留跨任务支持。
AI.conclusion: RLVR主要通过重新排序基础策略中已有的开头发起响应，所选开头因果地影响数学可搜索性。端点改进不能保证未来可训练性或联合能力，边际收益仅部分转化为既正确又遵循约束的响应。这揭示了当前强化学习范式中的基本局限性。

title: PrefixPlace: Provable Prefix Key-Value Placement for Large Language Model Serving under Heterogeneous Compute and Transfer Costs
summary: Prefix Key-Value (KV) reuse avoids repeated prefill in Large Language Model (LLM) inference, but local misses require recomputation or replica fetches. Their relative cost varies with hardware, prefix depth, KV goodput, and replica location, making hit-rate-based placement suboptimal. To address this issue, we propose an epoch-level planner, PrefixPlace, which assigns prefix-complete targets under memory budgets and profiled demand, compute, and transfer costs. The objective decomposes into local-copy value plus first-replica coverage, and source-dependent costs yield a monotone facility-location objective; each worker update is an additive rooted-tree problem solved exactly in O(nk) time for n chunks and capacity k, giving a fixed-order 1/2-approximation that coordinate refinement and order-diverse starts improve without weakening. T4, L4, and A100 measurements reveal distinct regimes. Across 432 instances with exact optima, PrefixPlace averages 99.84% of optimum and never falls below 98.02%. In Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) replays, it improves materialization-cost saving by 40.3% over vLLM Automatic Prefix Caching (vLLM-APC) and 6.3% over the best offline baseline. On WikiQA, gains are 40.4% and 5.3%. Finally, PrefixPlace solves a 50,000-node, 16-worker placement in 12.3 s on one processor, enabling timely replanning.

AI.tldr: 提出了PrefixPlace，一种基于代价模型的LLM前缀KV缓存放置优化方法，相比现有方法在RAG场景下提升40.3%的物化成本节约，求解效率高且接近最优。
AI.motivation: 现有基于命中率的前缀KV缓存放置策略未考虑硬件、前缀深度、KV吞吐量及副本位置等因素导致的重计算与副本获取的相对成本差异，因而无法实现最优放置。
AI.method: 提出了epoch级规划器PrefixPlace，在内存预算和画像化的需求、计算及传输成本约束下分配前缀完整目标。将问题建模为单调设施选址目标，每个worker更新为可加性根树问题，以O(nk)时间精确求解并提供1/2近似保证，通过坐标细化与多样化初始解进一步优化。
AI.result: 在T4、L4、A100三种硬件上展现出不同性能模式。在432个可求精确最优的实例中，PrefixPlace平均达到最优的99.84%，最低不低于98.02%。在RAG重放场景中，相比vLLM-APC提升40.3%物化成本节约，相比最佳离线基线提升6.3%；WikiQA任务分别提升40.4%和5.3%。5万节点16 worker规模在单处理器上仅需12.3秒求解。
AI.conclusion: PrefixPlace通过显式建模成本结构实现了接近最优的前缀KV放置，在多种硬件和任务场景下显著优于现有方法，且具备足够求解效率支持及时重规划。

title: Celty: SpMspV GPU Kernel and SIMT Co-Design for Efficient Dual-Sparse LLM Inference
comment: ICCAD 2026. Will update with the camera-ready version once ready. The code is available on Github at https://github.com/RuokaiYin/Celty
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on sparsity to reduce inference cost, but most prior work targets a single sparsity source-either weight or activation-and optimizes for batched multi-user inference. Dual-sparsity, which combines unstructured weight pruning with runtime activation sparsity, offers a compelling tradeoff among model size, accuracy, and latency for single-user decoding, but formulates as a Sparse Matrix-Sparse Vector (spMspV) workload that existing GPU kernels handle poorly. We propose Celty, a co-designed sparse format, GPU kernel, and SIMT microarchitecture for efficient spMspV in LLM inference. At the kernel level, Celty introduces a Run-Length Compressed CSC (RLC-CSC) format that enables vectorized loading of compressed weight columns and exploits both sparsity sources to skip unnecessary memory accesses, with shared memory used for scattered partial-product accumulation. At the microarchitecture level, the Celty Sparse SIMT Core integrates a pipelined RLC decoder to eliminate software-level index reconstruction and repurposes local register files for conflict-free accumulation-operating directly on the same RLC-CSC format without data layout changes. The Celty GPU kernel achieves up to 2.8x speedup over cuBLAS and 2.4x over Flash-LLM. With the Sparse SIMT Core, speedups reach up to 5.3x over cuBLAS at 70% dual-sparsity.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型推理中双稀疏性（权重+激活）导致的稀疏矩阵-稀疏向量（spMspV）计算效率低下问题，提出了Celty系统，包括RLC-CSC稀疏格式、GPU内核和稀疏SIMT核心，实现了相比cuBLAS最高5.3倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型稀疏优化工作通常只针对单一稀疏来源（权重或激活），且面向批量多用户推理优化。双稀疏性虽能在单用户解码场景下提供更好的模型大小、精度和延迟权衡，但其形式化为现有GPU内核处理效率极低的稀疏矩阵-稀疏向量（spMspV）负载，亟需高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出Celty系统，包含三个协同设计层面：1）内核层引入运行长度压缩CSC（RLC-CSC）格式，支持压缩权重列的向量化加载，利用双稀疏跳过不必要内存访问，并使用共享内存进行分散部分积累；2）微架构层设计稀疏SIMT核心，集成流水线RLC解码器消除软件级索引重建，重新配置本地寄存器文件实现无冲突累加，直接操作RLC-CSC格式无需数据布局转换。
AI.result: Celty GPU内核相比cuBLAS实现最高2.8倍加速，相比Flash-LLM实现2.4倍加速。配合稀疏SIMT核心，在70%双稀疏度下相比cuBLAS加速比达到5.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过稀疏格式、GPU内核和SIMT微架构的协同设计，Celty有效解决了LLM推理中双稀疏性带来的spMspV计算瓶颈，显著提升了单用户解码场景下的推理效率，为大语言模型的稀疏化部署提供了新的技术路径。

title: Neural operator learning for collision-aware trajectory planning of spacecraft swarms
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to Nature Machine Intelligence. Video abstract included as ancillary file
summary: Autonomous spacecraft swarms must plan fuel-efficient, collision-free maneuvers in increasingly congested orbits, yet classical trajectory optimization scales poorly as pairwise safety constraints multiply with swarm size, and learning-based planners rarely transfer across swarm sizes or debris densities. Here we introduce a permutation-equivariant neural operator that maps distributions of spacecraft, targets and debris to collision-aware trajectories for an entire swarm in a single forward pass, paired with a batched Gauss-Newton finish that enforces exact orbital dynamics. The operator is trained without optimal-trajectory labels, combining self-supervised physics objectives with adversarial threats generated against its own rollouts. Trained on ten spacecraft, it generalizes zero-shot to swarms of 1,000 amid more than 11,000 catalogued objects, matching a per-agent optimal-control solver's accuracy, evading worst-case threats that a debris-blind baseline cannot, and reducing proximity within the swarm several-fold. Physics-grounded operator learning thus offers a fast, scalable alternative to optimal control for crowded orbits.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种置换等变神经算子，可一次性为整个航天器集群生成碰撞感知轨迹，在无需最优轨迹标签的情况下训练，实现了从10个航天器到1000个集群的零样本泛化，在保持精度的同时显著提升了计算效率。
AI.motivation: 随着航天器集群规模增大，传统轨迹优化方法中的成对安全约束数量呈爆炸式增长，导致计算复杂度急剧上升；而基于学习的规划器难以在不同集群规模或碎片密度间迁移。现有方法在日益拥挤的轨道环境中面临可扩展性和泛化性的双重挑战。
AI.method: 提出置换等变神经算子，将航天器、目标和碎片的分布映射为整个集群的碰撞感知轨迹，仅需单次前向传播。结合批量Gauss-Newton精化步骤以强制精确轨道动力学约束。采用无最优轨迹标签的训练策略，融合自监督物理目标与针对自身展开生成的对抗性威胁。
AI.result: 在10个航天器上训练后，零样本泛化至包含1000个航天器的集群（周围有超过11000个编目物体）。精度与逐智能体最优控制求解器相当，成功规避碎片盲基线无法处理的极端威胁，并将集群内部接近距离降低数倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于物理的算子学习为拥挤轨道环境下的轨迹规划提供了一种快速、可扩展的最优控制替代方案，在保证安全性和精度的同时实现了数量级的效率提升。

title: A Wireless Network Architecture for Monitoring of Hospitalized Patients
summary: Monitoring of vital parameters plays a key role in better understanding the clinical condition of hospitalized patients. In this perspective, the virtual biosensor for MEDIcal WARNing precursor (MEDIWARN) aims to help the medical team to take a prompt action in response to the evolution of patients' health condition. This paper presents the MEDIWARN network architecture and discusses the design challenges that such a system poses. Simulative assessments provide a preliminary evaluation of the system in realistic scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MEDIWARN医疗预警系统网络架构，通过仿真评估验证了其在真实场景中的性能表现。
AI.motivation: 生命体征监测对于理解住院患者的临床状况至关重要，需要开发一种能够帮助医疗团队及时响应患者健康状况变化的虚拟生物传感器预警系统。
AI.method: 提出MEDIWARN网络架构，讨论系统设计面临的挑战，并通过仿真评估在真实场景下对系统进行初步评估。
AI.result: 完成了MEDIWARN系统网络架构的设计，并通过仿真评估验证了系统在真实场景中的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: MEDIWARN系统能够有效支持医疗团队及时响应患者健康状况的变化，为临床监测提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: Linguistic Context Recodes Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Goal-directed visual processing is a hallmark of human visual intelligence, resulting in representations that support downstream tasks such as categorization or search. Though vision-language models (VLMs) are often faced with these same tasks, their ability to recode visual representations when presented with goal-directed language remains poorly characterized. Indeed, prior work largely treats visual representations in VLMs as static repositories of visual information that are manipulated by language representations. In the present work, we provide evidence for two concrete instances of language-induced recoding of visual representations. First, we identify an abstract reference representation that denotes which objects are goal-relevant under a natural language prompt. We extract contrastive steering vectors corresponding to this reference representation and demonstrate that they are causally implicated in model predictions. These reference representations are abstract in that they generalize to different objects, different task contexts, and even from synthetic to naturalistic images. Second, we demonstrate language-induced attribute modulation: later layers selectively amplify goal-relevant attributes in visual representations of objects. We demonstrate this phenomenon across a range of different prompts. Finally, we provide a causal intervention that demonstrates that attribute modulation mediates a VLM's response distribution. Together, our results support a more dynamic account of cross-modality processing in VLMs -- rather than vision tokens serving as static repositories of information, they are modulated to support queries articulated in language.

AI.tldr: 本文证明视觉语言模型(VLMs)中的视觉表征会根据语言目标动态重构，而非静态信息库。研究识别出抽象参考表征和属性调制两种语言诱导的视觉重编码机制，并验证其因果作用。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将VLMs中的视觉表征视为静态的视觉信息库，仅通过语言表征进行操纵，而忽视了语言可能诱导视觉表征动态重构的可能性。人类视觉智能具有目标导向特性，VLMs面临相同任务时是否具备类似能力尚不清楚。
AI.method: 通过提取对比引导向量识别抽象参考表征，验证其在模型预测中的因果作用；分析模型后期层对目标相关属性的选择性放大现象；设计因果干预实验验证属性调制对模型响应分布的中介作用。
AI.result: 发现两种语言诱导的视觉重编码机制：(1)抽象参考表征，可泛化至不同物体、任务上下文及从合成到自然图像，在模型预测中具有因果作用；(2)属性调制机制，后期层选择性放大目标相关属性并中介模型响应分布。
AI.conclusion: VLMs的跨模态处理具有动态特性，视觉token并非静态信息库，而是根据语言表达的目标进行调制，支持更动态的跨模态处理理论框架。

title: Similarity-Aware Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning removes the influence of user-specified training examples from a trained model, avoiding the need to retrain it from scratch. Localization-based methods improve unlearning efficiency by identifying a subset of influential model parameters. However, existing approaches select parameters based solely on forget-set importance, neglecting their role in retained dataset and often causing collateral damage to semantically similar retained examples. We address this limitation with a retain-aware localization method that considers parameter importance to both forgotten and retained data. We also introduce a retain-similar evaluation set, constructed using cosine similarity in the model embedding space, to directly measure collateral damage. Across eleven experimental settings on CIFAR-10 dataset and ResNet18 model, our method consistently reduces collateral damage while improving standard unlearning metrics, demonstrating the effectiveness of retain-aware localization for similarity-aware machine unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种保留感知的定位方法，通过同时考虑参数对遗忘数据和保留数据的重要性，减少了机器遗忘中对语义相似保留样本的附带损害，并在11个实验设置中均取得了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于定位的机器遗忘方法仅基于遗忘集的重要性来选择参数，忽略了这些参数在保留数据集中的作用，导致对语义相似的保留样本造成附带损害。
AI.method: 提出了保留感知的定位方法，在定位参数时同时考虑其对遗忘数据和保留数据的重要性；同时引入了保留相似评估集，通过模型嵌入空间中的余弦相似度构建，用于直接衡量附带损害。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10数据集和ResNet18模型上的11个实验设置中，该方法持续减少了附带损害，同时改善了标准的遗忘评估指标。
AI.conclusion: 保留感知定位方法在相似性感知的机器遗忘任务中表现出有效性，能够在保持遗忘性能的同时显著降低对保留数据的负面影响。

title: Preserving Admission Responsibility in Multi-Tenant Large Language Model Prefix Caches
summary: Shared prefix caching turns Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) memory into persistent state shared across Large Language Model (LLM) tenants. A group that materializes new Key-Value (KV) blocks can force another to lose reusable state, yet request-time schedulers account for transient service, replacement policies primarily rank object value, and static partitioning strands idle capacity. We call this mismatch the admission-responsibility gap. To close it, we propose PrefixShield, which meters newly materialized full KV blocks, carries responsibility across requests, gates reuse promotion while debt remains, and uses projected debt to select the group supplying eviction candidates. We implement PrefixShield in vLLM. In paired runs under one-touch pollution, PrefixShield improves victim cache hit ratio by 9.39 percentage points over the Least Recently Used (LRU) policy and 8.64 points over S3-FIFO, restoring the victim from 4.92% to 84.87% at 4096-block scale, and gains 2.00 points over S3-FIFO under two-pass replay. It preserves benign ShareGPT behavior and work-conserving access to idle capacity. Delayed replay yields a 35.16-point advantage while debt remains. These results show that object-value signals rank what to retain, while persistent responsibility determines which group bears reclamation pressure.

AI.tldr: PrefixShield通过追踪KV块的责任归属来弥合准入-责任差距，显著提升缓存命中率。
AI.motivation: 共享前缀缓存中存在准入-责任差距：新物化的KV块会强制其他租户丢失可复用状态，而现有请求时调度器、替换策略和静态分区无法正确处理这种跨租户的持久状态竞争问题。
AI.method: 提出PrefixShield：对新物化的完整KV块进行计量；跨请求传递责任；在债务存续期间阻止复用提升；利用预计债务选择提供淘汰候选项的组。在vLLM中实现该系统。
AI.result: 在单次污染场景下，PrefixShield将受害者缓存命中率相对LRU提升9.39个百分点，相对S3-FIFO提升8.64个百分点，在4096块规模下将受害者恢复率从4.92%提升至84.87%；在两轮重放下相对S3-FIFO获得2.00个百分点优势；延迟重放期间获得35.16个百分点优势。
AI.conclusion: 对象价值信号用于排序保留内容，而持久责任决定哪个组承担回收压力，两者共同作用可有效解决准入-责任差距问题。

title: LEAP: A Self-Supervised Per-Cycle Toggle Propagation Model Supports Fast, Transferable, and Early Analysis of Layout Power
summary: Accurate power analysis is critical in VLSI design, as it directly impacts power optimization strategies. However, traditional approaches are often hindered by the substantial runtime required for per-cycle toggle propagation in the netlist, which propagates register toggle information through combinational logic. To address this, we propose LEAP, the first work to enable per-cycle toggle propagation prediction with both high accuracy and efficiency. This is achieved through a novel, linear-complexity graph transformer capable of simulating toggle propagation, along with specially designed self-supervised pre-training tasks that enable the model to capture circuit structure and functionality. LEAP achieves a 7.6x speedup over the EDA tool in toggle propagation, and attains a near-perfect area under the Precision-Recall curve (PR-AUC) of 0.99 for prediction results. Moreover, LEAP can be seamlessly integrated with other machine learning based power models into LEAP-Power. This integration enables precise per-cycle layout power prediction directly from post-synthesis netlists, achieving a mean absolute percentage error(MAPE) of only 4.55%. By bypassing toggle propagation in the netlist, LEAP-Power delivers substantial runtime gains, running 5.3x faster than the model without LEAP.

AI.tldr: 提出了LEAP，首个实现高精度、高效率的逐周期翻转传播预测方法，通过线性复杂度图变换器和自监督预训练实现，在翻转传播任务上达到7.6倍加速和0.99的PR-AUC；与ML功耗模型集成的LEAP-Power实现了4.55%的MAPE和5.3倍加速。
AI.motivation: 传统VLSI功耗分析方法中，网表逐周期翻转传播需要大量运行时间，严重制约了功耗优化策略的效率。需要一种既高精度又高效率的方法来预测翻转传播。
AI.method: 提出LEAP框架，采用新颖的线性复杂度图变换器来模拟翻转传播，并设计专门的自监督预训练任务，使模型能够捕获电路结构和功能特性。
AI.result: LEAP在翻转传播任务上相比EDA工具实现7.6倍加速，PR-AUC达到0.99；与ML功耗模型集成的LEAP-Power实现MAPE仅4.55%，运行速度比无LEAP模型快5.3倍。
AI.conclusion: LEAP成功实现了高精度、高效率的逐周期翻转传播预测，可无缝集成到现有功耗分析流程中，显著提升VLSI设计中的功耗分析效率。

title: HetGPS: Scalable Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Physics-Anchored Adaptive Safety for EV Charging
summary: Safety interventions for large populations of network-coupled agents must protect shared constraints without unnecessarily overriding task-oriented policy decisions. We present HetGPS, a hybrid graph-control framework synergizing learned graph risk with physics-anchored correction by separating intervention magnitude from corrective direction. An action-conditioned graph residual model schedules state-dependent intervention authority, while a physics model determines its direction. For electric vehicle (EV) charging, we couple this filter with a parameter-shared heterogeneous graph soft actor-critic policy, enabling topology-aware coordination with a learned model size independent of fleet size. Across five nested distribution networks with 200--3,218 EVs and 100 evaluation days, Adaptive Authority reduces bus--step voltage violations from 3.93--7.74\% without filtering to 0.52--3.44\%, while maintaining 99.06--100\% departure success. Relative to the same physics-directed projection with fixed authority, it improves mean reward on all five networks and lowers the mean safety score on four. The deployed policy-and-risk model contains 383,702 learned parameters at every scale; at 3,218 EVs, a matched centralized SAC actor is about $170\times$ larger. A policy trained on the eight-transformer system transfers zero-shot to the 16- and 32-transformer systems, attaining 0.57--0.75\% violation rates and at least 99.99\% departure success. These results show that learned graph risk can allocate intervention authority at scale while feeder physics anchors corrective action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HetGPS，一种混合图控制框架，通过将干预幅度与纠正方向分离，有效保护共享约束且不必要地覆盖任务导向策略决策，在EV充电场景中显著降低了电压违规率并保持高出发成功率。
AI.motivation: 大规模网络耦合智能体的安全干预需要保护共享约束，同时避免不必要地覆盖任务导向的策略决策，这是一个重要但尚未很好解决的问题。
AI.method: 提出HetGPS混合图控制框架，结合学习图风险与物理锚定纠正。具体包括：(1) 动作条件图残差模型调度状态依赖的干预权限；(2) 物理模型确定纠正方向；(3) 参数共享异构图软演员-评论家策略实现拓扑感知协调。
AI.result: 在5个配电网络（200-3218辆EV）上：(1) 电压违规率从3.93-7.74%降至0.52-3.44%；(2) 出发成功率保持在99.06-100%；(3) 相比固定权限方法，在所有5个网络上提升平均奖励；(4) 模型参数量为383,702，比匹配的集中式SAC小约170倍；(5) 在8变压器系统训练的策略可零样本迁移到16和32变压器系统，违规率0.57-0.75%，出发成功率≥99.99%。
AI.conclusion: 学习图风险可以在规模上分配干预权限，而馈线物理模型锚定纠正动作，证明了HetGPS框架在大规模网络耦合系统安全干预中的有效性和可扩展性。

title: Achieving Rate-Concurrency Balance for Underwater Concurrent Random Access
summary: Underwater acoustic networks face a fundamental rate--concurrency tradeoff: high-rate waveforms (e.g., OFDM, OTFS) are designed for point-to-point links and rely on orthogonal MAC protocols (e.g., TDMA) to avoid collisions, sacrificing concurrency; conversely, collision-resilient waveforms (e.g., CDMA, ZCMod) support uncoordinated access but are inherently rate-limited by spreading or sparse index modulation. We present \system, a cross-layer concurrent random-access system that combines two new components: (i) \textbf{EZCDM}, an equidistant ZC division-multiplexing waveform that activates multiple cyclic shifts of a ZC root as parallel sub-channels with a tunable rate--robustness tradeoff, and an intra-symbol differential receiver that eliminates the shared multipath channel response without explicit CIR estimation; and (ii) a \textbf{cross-layer link adaptation (LA) framework} featuring beacon-framed random access, user-specific closed-loop power control, and overlap- and CIR-aware common-MS selection. Channel-trace- and signal-trace-driven physical-layer experiments combined with PHY-in-the-loop network simulations demonstrate that \system\ achieves significant BER and throughput gains over conventional waveforms and MAC protocols by converting traditionally destructive collisions into decodable concurrent streams.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种跨层并发随机接入系统，通过新型波形设计和链路自适应框架，将传统破坏性碰撞转化为可解码的并发数据流，显著提升水声网络性能。
AI.motivation: 水声网络面临速率-并发性权衡的根本矛盾：高速率波形依赖正交MAC协议避免碰撞，牺牲了并发性；而碰撞弹性波形虽支持非协调接入，却因扩频或稀疏索引调制而受限于速率。
AI.method: 提出两个核心组件：(i) EZCDM波形，激活ZC根序列的多个循环移位作为并行子信道，具备可调的速率-鲁棒性权衡，以及无需显式CIR估计的符号内差分接收机；(ii) 跨层链路自适应框架，包含信标帧随机接入、用户特定闭环功率控制和重叠与CIR感知的公共MS选择。
AI.result: 通过信道迹和信号迹驱动的物理层实验以及PHY-in-the-loop网络仿真表明，相比传统波形和MAC协议，该系统实现了显著的BER和吞吐量增益。
AI.conclusion: 该系统成功将传统破坏性碰撞转化为可解码的并发数据流，为水声网络的速率-并发性权衡问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: RAG-TESTER: Automated End-to-End Testing of Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to use external and domain-specific knowledge, but its reliability depends on the interaction between the generative model, embedding model, retrieval mechanism, and prompt construction strategy. We present RagTester, an automated end-to-end testing approach for RAG systems. RagTester generates retrieval documents, test inputs, and expected outputs; executes the tests; and evaluates the resulting answers using an LLM as a judge. Its test-generation strategy targets complex passages, unsupported queries, and document-coverage criteria. We evaluate RagTester using eight LLMs and six embedding models, yielding 24 compatible configurations, and compare it with a baseline test-input generator. Across 72,000 test executions, RagTester detected 21,633 failures, 6.6% more than the baseline, and outperformed it in 20 of the 24 configurations. The detected failures include inaccurate retrieval, unsupported answers, incomplete use of retrieved context, and difficulties interpreting complex passages. These results show that coverage-oriented test generation can effectively expose failures caused by the interaction between retrieval and generation components and support the assessment of RAG configurations before deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RagTester，一种针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统的自动化端到端测试方法，通过覆盖率导向的测试生成策略，在实验中比基线方法多检测出6.6%的失败案例，有效揭示了检索与生成组件交互引发的系统故障。
AI.motivation: RAG系统的可靠性取决于生成模型、嵌入模型、检索机制和提示构造策略之间的复杂交互，现有测试方法难以有效评估这些组件交互引发的潜在故障，亟需一种针对RAG系统的自动化测试方法来保障系统可靠性。
AI.method: 提出RagTester自动化端到端测试框架，采用覆盖率导向的测试生成策略，自动生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出，执行测试并使用LLM作为评判器评估答案质量，测试生成策略针对复杂段落、不支持的查询和文档覆盖率准则。
AI.result: 在8个大语言模型和6个嵌入模型的24种兼容配置上进行评估，执行72,000次测试，检测出21,633个失败案例，比基线方法多6.6%，在24种配置中的20种配置上表现优于基线，成功识别出检索不准确、答案无支持、上下文利用不完整和复杂段落理解困难等故障类型。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖率导向的测试生成方法能够有效暴露由检索与生成组件交互引发的RAG系统故障，支持在部署前对RAG配置进行评估，为RAG系统的质量保障提供了有效的自动化测试手段。

title: Stabilized Best-of-$K$ Training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Leader Reward modifies POMO training to emphasize the best trajectory produced by repeated inference. We test a narrow extension: replace its binary leader/non-leader distinction with a stabilized rank signal indexed by a sampling budget $K$. With the POMO architecture, 3,050-epoch schedule, and TSP-100 test set held fixed, the Leader Reward reimplementation obtains $7.7662$ under 100-start, 8-augmentation greedy decoding, matching the reported $7.766$ at its displayed precision. Under independent sampling, the stabilized $K=8$ recipe lowers realized Best-of-8 cost in all three paired training seeds: $7.7944$ versus $7.8136$. This observation is estimation-only and decoder-specific: three seeds are below the six-seed testing floor, Leader Reward is better at sampled $K=1$, and it remains slightly better under its original augmented-greedy protocol. We make no unbiased-estimator, universal superiority, or state-of-the-art claim.

AI.tldr: 本文对Leader Reward方法进行了扩展尝试，将二元的领导者/非领导者区分替换为基于采样预算K的稳定排名信号。实验表明该方法在特定条件下降低了成本，但改进仅限于特定解码器和估计场景，不声称具有普遍优越性。
AI.motivation: 研究者希望探索对Leader Reward方法的改进可能性，将原本的二值领导者区分机制扩展为更细粒度的排名信号，以期望在强化学习训练中获得更好的性能表现。
AI.method: 将Leader Reward中的二元领导者/非领导者区分替换为基于采样预算K的稳定排名信号。在固定POMO架构、3050轮训练计划和TSP-100测试集的条件下进行对比实验，使用独立采样方式评估性能。
AI.result: 在K=8的稳定排名方案下，三种训练种子配对的Best-of-8成本均低于原始Leader Reward：7.7944对比7.8136。但在K=1采样和原始增强贪婪协议下，Leader Reward仍略优。原有方法在100起始点、8增强贪婪解码下获得成本7.7662，与报告值7.766匹配。
AI.conclusion: 该改进方法仅在特定解码器和估计场景下有效，改进范围有限且受种子数量限制。研究者明确不声称该方法具有无偏估计、普遍优越性或达到最先进水平的性能，强调了结果的局限性。

title: HorizonServe: Coordinating Request Scheduling with GPU Sharing for Omni-Model Serving
summary: Omni models unify text, speech, image, and multimodal reasoning in a single serving backend, but this unified deployment exposes a new scheduling problem. Requests with different output modalities may share an initial multimodal backbone and then diverge into downstream generation stages, creating heterogeneous first-response metrics and service-level objective (SLO) targets on the same GPU. Existing large language model (LLM) and multimodal serving systems mainly optimize token progress or input-side processing, and they do not jointly control temporal sharing in the shared stage and spatial sharing among co-running stages. This paper presents HorizonServe, a single-GPU omni-model serving system that coordinates request admission and GPU allocation under heterogeneous SLOs. HorizonServe profiles per-class first-response latency, protects requests with limited slack, rotates shared-stage opportunities across execution paths, and throttles the shared-stage streaming multiprocessor (SM) allocation when downstream stages are active. Across three omni-model workloads and two GPU platforms, HorizonServe improves SLO attainment by up to 4.9$\times$ in arrival-rate sweeps and 7.0$\times$ under downstream-heavy traffic, and reduces per-class first-response latency by 38.4--63.7\%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HorizonServe，一个单GPU全模态模型服务系统，通过协调请求准入和GPU分配来解决异构SLO下的调度问题，显著提升了SLO达成率并降低了首响应延迟。
AI.motivation: 全模态（Omni）模型将文本、语音、图像和多模态推理统一在单一服务后端中，但这种统一部署暴露了一个新的调度问题：具有不同输出模态的请求可能共享初始的多模态骨干网络，然后分流到下游生成阶段，这导致在同一GPU上产生了异构的首响应指标和服务级目标（SLO）。现有的LLM和多模态服务系统主要优化token进度或输入侧处理，无法联合控制共享阶段的时间共享和并发运行阶段间的空间共享。
AI.method: 提出HorizonServe系统，通过以下关键技术解决调度问题：1）针对每个请求类别进行首响应延迟分析；2）保护松弛时间有限的请求；3）在执行路径间轮转共享阶段的机会；4）当下游阶段活跃时，限制共享阶段的流式多处理器（SM）分配。该系统协调请求准入和GPU分配以满足异构SLO要求。
AI.result: 在三个全模态模型工作负载和两个GPU平台上的实验表明，HorizonServe在到达率扫描中将SLO达成率提高了最高4.9倍，在下游密集型流量下提高了7.0倍，并将各类首响应延迟降低了38.4-63.7%。
AI.conclusion: HorizonServe成功解决了全模态模型服务中的新型调度挑战，通过精细化的GPU资源协调和请求管理，实现了异构SLO下的高效服务，为多模态AI系统的统一部署提供了有效的解决方案。

title: DeGS: A Scalable 3DGS Architecture via Decoupled Workload Parsing and Reorganization
comment: Accepted to the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026)
summary:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a leading technique for real-time novel view synthesis, yet existing 3DGS accelerators suffer from poor architectural scalability: increasing the number of PEs leads to marginal performance improvement during rendering. We identify that the root cause is the tightly coupled ``checking-while-blending'' dataflow, which exacerbates PE underutilization caused by spatial redundancy from irregular Gaussian coverage and temporal redundancy from asynchronous pixel-wise termination under parallel execution.
  To address this issue, we propose DeGS, a scalable architecture for efficient 3DGS inference. To systematically eliminate the redundancies inherent in rendering, DeGS exploits a decoupled dataflow, restructuring the coupled $α$-checking, transmittance checking, and $α$-blending of the standard rendering process into consecutive workload parsing, reorganization, and blending stages. This allows the fragmented, length-variable, and temporal-dependent workloads to be reorganized into compact, conflict-free, and dense workloads prior to blending, thereby significantly improving PE utilization during parallel blending. Implemented in 28 nm technology, DeGS achieves 2.36$\times$--7.25$\times$ throughput, 1.82$\times$--6.02$\times$ end-to-end speedup, and 1.59$\times$--4.42$\times$ energy efficiency over state-of-the-art 3DGS accelerators (GSCore, GBU, GCC) across diverse scenes and resolutions (720p to 8K). Moreover, scaling from 16 to 1024 PEs, DeGS maintains over 80\% PE utilization at high resolutions, significantly outperforming existing accelerators.

AI.tldr: 提出了DeGS架构，通过解耦数据流解决了现有3DGS加速器的可扩展性问题，实现了显著的性能和能效提升。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS加速器存在架构可扩展性差的问题：增加PE数量时渲染性能提升有限。根本原因是紧密耦合的“检查即混合”数据流，加剧了由不规则Gaussian覆盖的空间冗余和并行执行下异步像素级终止的时间冗余导致的PE利用率不足。
AI.method: 提出DeGS架构，采用解耦数据流系统性地消除渲染中的冗余。将标准渲染过程中耦合的α检查、透射率检查和α混合重构为连续的工作负载解析、重组和混合阶段，使碎片化、长度可变、时间依赖的工作负载重组为紧凑、无冲突、密集的工作负载，从而显著提高并行混合时的PE利用率。
AI.result: 在28nm工艺下，DeGS相比现有最优3DGS加速器（GSCore、GBU、GCC）实现了2.36×-7.25×吞吐量提升、1.82×-6.02×端到端加速和1.59×-4.42×能效提升（覆盖720p到8K分辨率）。从16扩展到1024个PE时，DeGS在高分辨率下保持80%以上的PE利用率。
AI.conclusion: DeGS通过解耦数据流有效解决了3DGS加速器的可扩展性问题，实现了高性能、高能效的实时新视角合成，为3DGS硬件加速提供了新的架构设计思路。

title: Co-evolution of social reward and punishment under institutional interventions
summary: We investigate how peer and institutional incentives jointly shape the evolution of cooperation, social welfare, and enforcement efficiency in social dilemmas. In a Prisoners Dilemma with four strategies, unconditional cooperators (C), defectors (D), social punishers (SP), and social rewarders (SR), we allow decentralised peer incentives and centralised institutional incentives to act simultaneously, with the institution able to reward or punish any subset of strategies. In infinite well-mixed populations, we analyse the resulting four-strategy replicator dynamics, and in structured populations we use agent-based simulations on square lattices to study spatial effects and network reciprocity. Intervention schemes are evaluated by equilibrium states and evolutionary flow for infinite well-mixed populations, by cooperation levels and social welfare for structured populations, defined as aggregate population payoff net of institutional cost. We find that peer punishment most strongly promotes cooperation, whereas peer reward is more beneficial for social welfare. Institutionally rewarding peer incentive strategies substantially improves both cooperation and welfare, while subsidising unconditional cooperators has little impact. Under institutional punishment, directly penalising defectors is the only consistently effective policy; punishing peer incentive strategies dismantles decentralised incentives, reduces cooperation, and harms social welfare, showing that maximising cooperation does not necessarily optimise overall societal benefit. Our findings provide design principles for institutions seeking to balance cooperation promotion with welfare maximisation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了同伴激励与制度激励如何共同影响合作演化与社会福利。发现同伴惩罚最能促进合作，而同伴奖励更有利于社会福利；制度奖励应针对同伴激励策略，制度惩罚应直接针对背叛者，为制度设计提供了平衡合作与福利的原则。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于理解去中心化的同伴激励与中心化的制度激励如何共同作用以解决社会困境，以及如何在促进合作的同时最大化社会福利和执法效率，为制度设计提供理论指导。
AI.method: 采用包含无条件合作者(C)、背叛者(D)、社会惩罚者(SP)和社会奖励者(SR)四种策略的囚徒困境模型。在无限大充分混合种群中分析四策略复制动力学，在结构化种群中使用方格网格上的agent模拟研究空间效应和网络互惠。评估指标包括均衡状态、演化流、合作水平和社会福利（总群体收益减去制度成本）。
AI.result: 同伴惩罚最有效促进合作，同伴奖励更利于社会福利。制度奖励同伴激励策略能显著提升合作与福利，而补贴无条件合作者效果甚微。制度惩罚中，只有直接惩罚背叛者政策持续有效；惩罚同伴激励策略会瓦解去中心化激励，降低合作水平并损害社会福利。
AI.conclusion: 最大化合作并不必然优化社会整体利益。制度设计应遵循以下原则：制度奖励应针对同伴激励策略，制度惩罚应直接针对背叛者。这为寻求平衡合作促进与福利最大化的制度提供了设计指导。

title: Clear-Weighted Bit Allocation for Satellite Downlinks
summary: Earth-observation satellites capture more imagery than intermittent ground contacts can transmit. Onboard systems threshold a cloud detector, discard frames or tiles, and compress the survivors with a fixed codec. On expert-labeled imagery, these rules remove more than one-fifth of clear pixels, primarily through detector false positives. We train a neural codec with a clear-probability-weighted reconstruction loss, reallocating coded bytes from clouds to clear ground without requiring or transmitting a cloud map onboard. Each capture is encoded into a resumable base layer and a dependent refinement layer, while clear content is estimated from features produced by the encoder. At each contact, we causally rank arrived layers using estimated clear content, unfinished bytes, deadline slack, and aggregate deadline pressure. The scheduler serves base and computational deadlines, bounds stored residual bytes, and resumes interrupted packets. We evaluate the onboard-to-downlink pipeline using real entropy-coded bytes, orbit-derived interruptible contact capacities, and measured service time and energy on resource-constrained embedded accelerators. Clear-weighted codecs require up to 47.8\% fewer bytes than learned-compression baselines at matched clear-region quality. The optimized encoder consumes less time and energy than one pass of the cloud detector used by the frame-discard rules. Relative to fixed two-stage service on the same streams, our scheduler more than doubles deadline-full clear-content delivery for the interrupted combined cohort, reaches 83.6\% of a certified clairvoyant upper bound, and exceeds replayed reference orders in deadline-usable delivery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向地球观测卫星的神经网络编解码器和调度器，通过清晰概率加权重构损失重新分配码率，在不传输云图的情况下将更多字节用于清晰地面区域。在匹配清晰区域质量下，该方法比学习压缩基准方法节省高达47.8%的字节，调度器使截止时间内的清晰内容交付量翻倍以上，达到83.6%的理论上界。
AI.motivation: 地球观测卫星捕获的图像数量远超间歇性地面接触的传输能力。现有星载系统采用阈值云检测器，丢弃帧或瓦片，使用固定编解码器压缩幸存数据。在专家标注的图像上，这些规则会丢弃超过五分之一的清晰像素，主要原因是检测器误报。
AI.method: 训练一种神经编解码器，使用清晰概率加权重构损失，在不要求或传输星载云图的情况下，将编码字节从云层重新分配到清晰地面。每次捕获被编码为可恢复的基础层和依赖的细化层，同时从编码器产生的特征中估计清晰内容。每次接触时，使用估计的清晰内容、未完成字节、截止时间余量和总体截止时间压力，对到达的层进行因果排序。调度器满足基础和计算截止时间，限制存储的剩余字节数，并恢复中断的分组。
AI.result: 清晰加权编解码器在匹配清晰区域质量下，比学习压缩基准方法节省高达47.8%的字节。优化后的编码器比帧丢弃规则所用的云检测器单次通过消耗更少的时间和能量。与相同流上的固定两阶段服务相比，该调度器使中断组合队列的截止时间满足的清晰内容交付量增加一倍以上，达到认证的预知上界的83.6%，并在截止时间可用交付方面超过重放的参考排序。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了星载云检测器的误报问题，在保持清晰区域质量的同时显著减少了传输数据量，调度策略显著提高了中断场景下的数据交付效率，为地球观测卫星数据传输提供了新的解决方案。

title: H+ Embedding: Harmonizing Global and Token-Level Retrieval with Context-Dependent Phrases
summary: Terminology-intensive retrieval, especially in medical settings, depends on preserving multi-word entities, abbreviations, numerical constraints, and compositional concepts. However, existing representations lie at two extremes: single-vector retrievers often over-compress local relevance signals, while token-level late interaction retains every tokenizer subword at substantial indexing, storage, and scoring cost. This mismatch raises a natural question: can context-dependent phrases provide a useful retrieval unit between global vectors and tokens? We introduce H+ Embedding, a unified multi-granularity retriever that predicts variable-length phrase partitions, preserves uncovered tokens as singletons, and applies importance-guided unit selection with weighted MaxSim interaction. Across 16 scientific, medical, and bilingual tasks, its phrase retrieval branch exceeds the global retrieval branch by 6.91 macro nDCG@10. It also nearly matches Token while using 13.7% fewer document vectors and outperforms content-independent grouping rules under moderate vector budgets. Context-dependent phrase interaction therefore provides an intermediate quality-cost point between global compression and token-level interaction for practical retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了H+ Embedding，一种统一的多粒度检索器，通过上下文相关的短语作为检索单元，在全局向量和词元级别交互之间取得了良好的质量-成本平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有检索表示方法存在两极化问题：单向量检索器过度压缩局部相关性信号，而词元级别的迟交互方法虽然保留了所有信息，但带来了巨大的索引、存储和评分成本。这种不匹配促使研究者探索介于全局向量和词元之间的中间粒度检索单元。
AI.method: 提出H+ Embedding统一多粒度检索器：1) 预测变长短语划分；2) 保留未覆盖的词元作为单例；3) 应用重要性引导的单元选择和加权MaxSim交互机制。该方法实现了上下文相关短语作为检索单元的表示。
AI.result: 在16个科学、医学和双语任务上，短语检索分支比全局检索分支提升6.91个宏平均nDCG@10；在减少13.7%文档向量数量下几乎达到Token级别性能，并在中等向量预算下优于内容无关的分组规则。
AI.conclusion: 上下文相关的短语交互为实际检索系统提供了介于全局压缩和词元级交互之间的有效质量-成本平衡点，证明了中间粒度检索单元的实用价值。

title: Abstention as an Action Can Kill Both the Reward Gradient and the KL Anchor: Collapse Law and Repair for Error-Penalized Reinforcement Learning
summary: Error-penalized scoring rules ($+1$ for a correct answer, $-λ$ for a wrong one, $0$ for abstaining) are increasingly prescribed against hallucination: a rational agent facing such a rule answers exactly when its correctness probability exceeds Chow's threshold $t^\ast=λ/(1+λ)$. We prove that a KL-anchored gradient learner can do the opposite. When abstention is a discrete action, the reward gradient and the anchor's restoring force are throttled by the same gate-saturation factor and die together: under explicit conditions (among them, blanket answering loses score in expectation and prompts share a bounded readout) the model drifts toward refusing everything, its mean training reward rising to zero like $1/t$ in training time $t$, so the curve reads as improvement while coverage collapses. The advantage estimator compounds the failure: in its sparse-answer regime, group normalization silently replaces every designed penalty with an effective penalty of one, moving the learned threshold from $t^\ast$ to $1/2$. The repair is structural: train a mandatory confidence report with a strictly proper score plus a correctness reward, and abstain only at deployment by thresholding the report. The always-emitted report has no gate to saturate, so no shared factor can kill its reward gradient and its anchor together, and its calibrated optimum is attracting. Simulations confirm every prediction, and experiments on language models at two scales confirm the mechanism live: the rule silences questions the models demonstrably still solve within ten optimizer steps, an ablation isolates the cause, and report-level training raises coverage, accuracy, and calibration together.

AI.tldr: 研究发现现有的错误惩罚评分规则会导致模型倾向于完全 abstain（拒绝回答），训练过程中覆盖率逐渐下降；提出通过引入强制置信度报告机制，在部署阶段进行阈值判断，可以有效解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 错误惩罚评分规则（正确+1，错误-λ， abstain 0）被广泛用于抑制模型幻觉，理论上理性代理应在正确率超过阈值t*=λ/(1+λ)时回答。然而，本文发现 KL 锚定的梯度学习可能产生相反效果——模型可能完全拒绝回答，导致覆盖率崩塌，而训练奖励曲线却呈现虚假改善。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：证明当 abstain 作为离散动作时，奖励梯度与锚点的恢复力受同一饱和因子控制，导致模型漂移至完全拒绝；2) 识别优势估计器（advantage estimator）在稀疏回答 regime 下将惩罚归一化，使阈值从 t* 偏移至 1/2；3) 提出结构化修复方案：训练强制置信度报告（使用严格 proper score + 正确性奖励），仅在部署时对报告进行阈值判断。
AI.result: 理论预测得到仿真完全验证；在两个规模的语言模型实验中确认该机制：评分规则会抑制模型在十步优化器步数内仍能解决的问题；消融实验分离出成因；报告级别训练同步提升覆盖率、准确性和校准性能。
AI.conclusion: 现有错误惩罚评分规则存在根本性缺陷，会导致模型"沉默崩溃"；通过强制置信度报告的结构化训练方案可有效解决该问题，使模型在保持校准的同时提升回答覆盖率和准确性。

title: FedJigsaw: Multi-Agent Collaborative Model Reassembly for Decentralized Heterogeneous Federated Learning
summary: Model Heterogeneous Federated Learning (MHFL) addresses client-level resource heterogeneity by allowing each participant to train a personalized model architecture under a shared training objective. A prevalent paradigm, Partial Training (PT), achieves this by allowing each client to train a subnetwork of the global model. However, existing PT methods typically rely on predefined architectural templates or over-parameterized supernets, limiting fine-grained personalization and imposing substantial computational and memory overhead. We propose FedJigsaw, a novel framework that reshapes model personalization as a dynamic and decentralized model assembly problem. Instead of selecting subnetworks from a predefined supernetwork, each client constructs its model by assembling reusable modules learned from neighboring clients. At the client level, we introduce AttenAssemble to enable each participant to adaptively construct a tailored model based on local observations. To support efficient knowledge sharing under communication and privacy constraints, we design SymbioArchitect, a mechanism that allows clients to exchange granular model modules with their topological neighbors. To mitigate training instability introduced by decentralized module exchange, we design CoRe-Tune, an attention-enhanced centralized training with a decentralized execution strategy, which guides local policies to foster implicit collaboration and stabilize training dynamics, without compromising data privacy. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FedJigsaw outperforms state-of-the-art MHFL baselines by up to 13.8% in relative accuracy while significantly shrinking cross-client performance variance, but also slashes decision-making latency and peak memory footprint compared to existing policy-driven methods.

AI.tldr: 提出FedJigsaw框架，通过动态模块组装解决模型异构联邦学习中的资源异构性问题，相比现有方法准确率提升13.8%，同时降低性能差异和资源开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的部分训练方法依赖预定义架构模板或过度参数化的超网络，限制了细粒度个性化并带来显著的计算和内存开销。需要一种更灵活、高效的模型个性化方案来应对客户端资源异构性挑战。
AI.method: 提出FedJigsaw框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) AttenAssemble：使客户端能根据本地观察自适应构建定制模型；(2) SymbioArchitect：支持客户端与拓扑邻居交换细粒度模型模块，实现高效知识共享；(3) CoRe-Tune：采用注意力增强的集中训练与去中心化执行策略，引导本地策略促进隐式协作并稳定训练动态，同时保护数据隐私。
AI.result: 相比最先进的MHFL基线方法，FedJigsaw在相对准确率上提升高达13.8%，显著降低跨客户端性能差异，同时相比现有策略驱动方法大幅降低决策延迟和峰值内存占用。
AI.conclusion: FedJigsaw通过动态去中心化的模块组装方式有效解决了模型异构联邦学习中的个性化与资源效率问题，在准确率、性能稳定性和资源开销方面均取得显著改进，为资源异构环境下的联邦学习提供了新思路。

title: Humans Are More Diverse: Frontier LLMs Show Extreme Policies in Idealised AI Development Races
summary: An AI development race creates a multi-agent safety dilemma. Each company can develop slowly and safely, or move faster while taking a risk that may remove its final reward. We use this repeated game to study strategic safety behaviour among large language model (LLM) agents in races with two to five players. However, a valid action does not show that an agent understands the game. We therefore place an audit gate before behavioural interpretation. We first verify the game engine, then test rule recall, state tracking, payoff calculation, and stability under different but equivalent task descriptions. We then compare LLM action sequences with an evolutionary game-theory benchmark and published human data, and explore differences across models, risk conditions, personas, and two- to five-player races. The audit shows that strong rule recall can coexist with weak state tracking and expected-payoff calculation. Providing verified arithmetic and changing the response representation can also change later actions, even when the game rules stay fixed. Across seven tested model endpoints, aggregate rates hide large differences in action sequences, responses to opponents, and responses to race position. Patterns across the tested three- to five-player races are also model-specific rather than a single effect of adding competitors. These results show why multi-agent AI-race simulations need validity checks and trajectory-level analysis before their outputs are described as strategic, human-like, or safety-aware. Our findings are exploratory and apply only to the tested models, prompts, and decoding settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型语言模型在AI竞赛博弈中的策略行为，发现通过审计验证，模型虽能记住规则但状态跟踪和收益计算能力较弱，不同模型的行为差异显著，强调多智能体仿真需进行有效性检查。
AI.motivation: AI开发竞赛中存在多智能体安全困境，企业可选择慢速安全或快速冒险。研究旨在探索大型语言模型在此类博弈中的策略行为，但意识到有效行为不等同于理解博弈，因此需要审计验证来确保行为解释的有效性。
AI.method: 构建2至5玩家的重复博弈框架，设置审计门控验证博弈引擎、规则回忆、状态跟踪、收益计算及稳定性；将LLM行为序列与演化博弈论基准和人类数据对比；分析不同模型、风险条件、角色设定和玩家数量的影响。
AI.result: 审计显示强规则回忆可与弱状态跟踪和收益计算共存；提供验证算术和改变响应表示会影响后续行为；七个模型端点间行为序列、对对手响应和对竞赛位置响应存在巨大差异；3至5玩家竞赛模式呈模型特异性而非单一的竞争对手效应。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体AI竞赛仿真在进行有效性检查和轨迹级分析之前，不应将其输出描述为策略性、类人或具备安全意识；研究发现仅适用于测试的模型、提示和解码设置，属于探索性结果。

title: An Internet for the KV Cache: Rethinking Classical Infrastructure Boundaries in the LLM Inference Age
summary: LLM inference has become a global-scale, heterogeneous workload spanning agents, retrieval, tool-use, code execution and multi-modal reasoning. These workloads naturally enable context reuse from overlapping inputs, creating a major opportunity to store and reuse the contexts' KV Caches instead of recomputing them. However, model-side advances that shrink the KV Cache and system-side advances that reduce compute, storage, and transfer costs are evolve independently within legacy cloud boundaries. We argue that future inference infrastructure should allow decoupling of compute and KV Cache storage across cloud and datacenters. The network becomes an active distribution channel; bandwidth, latency and pricing directly determines how the KV Cache should be managed. We propose a vision for an Internet for the KV Cache, with KV Cache management working as a content-distribution system. In this view, KV Cache storage and recompute decisions are driven by model, infrastructure, and application metrics, to enable adaptive, content-driven decisions for minimizing latency and cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"KV Cache互联网"的愿景，通过跨云和数据中心的计算与存储解耦，将KV Cache管理视为内容分发系统，以实现自适应的延迟和成本优化。
AI.motivation: LLM推理已成为全球规模、异构的工作负载，涉及智能体、检索、工具使用、代码执行和多模态推理。这些工作负载自然地实现了来自重叠输入的上下文重用，为存储和重用上下文的KV Cache（而非重新计算）创造了重大机会。然而，缩减KV Cache的模型侧进步与降低计算、存储和传输成本的系统侧进步在传统云边界内独立演进，缺乏协同。
AI.method: 提出未来推理基础设施应允许跨云和数据中心的计算与KV Cache存储解耦。将网络视为主动分发通道，带宽、延迟和定价直接决定KV Cache的管理方式。提出"KV Cache互联网"愿景，将KV Cache管理视为内容分发系统，由模型、基础设施和应用指标驱动存储和重计算决策。
AI.result: 构建了一个自适应、内容驱动的KV Cache管理框架，能够根据模型、基础设施和应用指标做出存储和重计算决策，从而最小化延迟和成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦计算与KV Cache存储，并将KV Cache管理视为内容分发系统，可以打破传统云边界的限制，实现更高效的LLM推理基础设施，为未来大规模、异构的LLM工作负载提供支持。

title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
summary:
AI coding agents like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of this workload using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June 2026, comprising 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, and 95T tokens.
  Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with important systems implications. For example, agentic coding sessions consist of sparse user-initiated turns, each unfolding into an autonomous agent loop of LLM calls almost always coupled with tool execution. This structure yields KV cache hit rates averaging 90% within a turn, but falling to 55\% across turn boundaries and drastically invalidated after events like model switches or context compaction. Diverse workflows and user behaviors are observed with variable and long-tailed token consumption, time span, and tool calls. We highlight the difference between quick agentic turnaround times and the minutes-long user idle periods at turn boundaries, and design a lightweight idle-time predictor that captures 86-90\% of total idle time, enabling proactive decisions for efficient resource orchestration. These findings challenge assumptions underlying current LLM-serving systems and provide an empirical foundation for agent-native infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对生产级AI编码智能体（如GitHub Copilot）的工作负载进行了大规模实证分析，揭示了智能体会话独特的结构特征和系统优化机会。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM服务系统主要针对聊天机器人等交互模式设计，而AI编码智能体将多步LLM推理与工具执行交织在一起，形成了截然不同的工作负载特征。缺乏对这种新型工作负载的生产级实证分析，阻碍了智能体原生基础设施的优化与发展。
AI.method: 基于2026年6月GitHub Copilot的生产环境追踪数据，构建了包含3.2M用户、13M会话、761M次LLM调用和95T tokens的数据集，对智能体编码工作负载进行了全面的特征分析，并设计了一个轻量级的空闲时间预测器。
AI.result: 发现了智能体会话的独特结构：稀疏的用户发起轮次展开为自主的智能体循环，KV缓存在轮次内平均命中率达90%，但跨轮次边界降至55%，模型切换或上下文压缩后几乎完全失效；观测到多样且长尾的token消耗、时间跨度和工具调用模式；设计的空闲时间预测器可捕获86-90%的总空闲时间。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现挑战了当前LLM服务系统的基本假设，揭示了快速智能体响应时间与用户轮次边界间分钟级空闲期的差异，为构建智能体原生基础设施提供了实证基础和优化方向。

title: Agentic Bayesian Optimization through Surrogate-Augmented Autoresearch
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) has become the standard tool for sample-efficient optimization and owes its efficiency to uncertainty-aware search driven by generic statistical priors. Richer domain priors can improve BO in principle, but encoding them through tailored kernels or problem structure is difficult and rarely done in practice. LLMs can help sidestep this difficulty by making informal priors from natural language, code, and documentation directly available to the optimizer. However, existing LLM-based BO methods either insert the LLM into a fixed role (surrogate, acquisition proxy, or configuration interface) or hand it broad control, sacrificing the systematic exploration that makes BO reliable. We introduce agentic Bayesian optimization: a paradigm in which an LLM agent is the central decision maker in the BO loop while a Bayesian backend provides the uncertainty-aware optimization substrate. The agent configures the problem, queries the backend, selects and commits evaluations, and can revise the optimization strategy during the run by tightening bounds, switching acquisition functions, proposing targeted evaluations, or even reframing the problem following new instructions or observed evidence. We instantiate this idea in Sara, a surrogate-augmented autoresearch agent, and lenz, a modular BoTorch-based backend that the agent can inspect and modify through a structured interface. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, Sara preserves the reliability of state-of-the-art BO without prior knowledge, outperforms LLM-based baselines, and uses natural-language priors to improve beyond standard BO. We further demonstrate the practical value of agentic BO in dynamic settings, where Sara reconfigures the full optimization problem on the fly as requirements change, a capability not previously available in standard BO.

AI.tldr: 提出"智能体贝叶斯优化"范式，使LLM智能体作为核心决策者驱动贝叶斯优化，结合自然语言先验知识提升优化性能，并支持动态重配置。
AI.motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化难以有效编码丰富的领域先验知识（通过定制核函数或问题结构）。虽然LLM可从自然语言、代码和文档中提取非形式化先验，但现有LLM-BO方法要么将LLM固定在特定角色（如代理模型、采集函数代理或配置接口），要么赋予其宽泛控制权，牺牲了BO的系统化探索能力。需要一种新范式既保留BO的可靠性，又能灵活利用LLM提供的先验知识。
AI.method: 提出智能体贝叶斯优化范式：LLM智能体作为核心决策者，贝叶斯后端提供不确定性感知的优化基础。智能体负责：配置问题、查询后端、选择和提交评估、动态调整优化策略（收紧边界、切换采集函数、提出定向评估、根据新指令或观测证据重构问题）。具体实现为Sara（代理增强的自动研究智能体）和lenz（模块化BoTorch后端），智能体通过结构化接口检查和修改后端。
AI.result: 在合成和真实基准测试中，Sara在无先验知识时保持与SOTA BO相当的可靠性；超越LLM基线方法；利用自然语言先验优于标准BO。在动态设置中展示了实用价值：Sara能随需求变化实时重新配置完整优化问题，这是标准BO不具备的能力。
AI.conclusion: 智能体贝叶斯优化成功融合了LLM的灵活先验编码能力与贝叶斯优化的系统化探索机制，既保持可靠性又提升了性能，并首次实现了动态问题重配置能力，为BO应用开辟了新方向。

title: Energy-Efficient LLM Serving via Disaggregated Attention--FFN and Flexible Frequency Scaling
summary: Large language model (LLM) serving spans diverse applications with stringent service-level objectives (SLOs), often requiring GPUs to run at maximum frequencies and increasing energy consumption. Existing energy-management approaches adapt GPU frequencies only at the request or inference-phase level, overlooking operator-level differences in frequency sensitivity between Attention and feed-forward networks (FFNs). We find that the energy-optimal frequencies of Attention and FFN (A/F) differ and vary with the inference phase, workload, and system configurations. However, runtime variability and independent A/F frequency control create a large search space and high communication overhead. To address these challenges, we present AFlex, a framework that jointly optimizes resource provisioning and GPU frequency scaling for disaggregated A/F serving. AFlex introduces a global scheduler and a local operator-level dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) controller to determine A/F resource allocations and frequencies. It further introduces an interleaved A/F pipeline with dynamic microbatch depth and adaptive request batching to reduce pipeline bubbles. We implement AFlex in SGLang and evaluate it on NVIDIA A800 GPUs using Qwen3-32B and Mixtral-8$\times$7B under production Conversation and Coding traces. \AFlex reduces energy per token by up to 49\% over state-of-the-art disaggregated serving and 48\% over frequency-scaling systems while satisfying TTFT and TPOT SLOs.

AI.tldr: AFlex框架通过细粒度的注意力/前馈网络（A/F）分离服务与动态频率调节，在满足SLO前提下将每token能耗降低高达49%。
AI.motivation: 现有能耗管理方法仅在请求或推理阶段层面调整GPU频率，忽视了注意力机制与前馈网络（A/F）在算子层面对频率敏感度的差异；且两者的最优频率随推理阶段、负载和系统配置变化，但运行时变异性与独立控制带来了巨大的搜索空间和通信开销。
AI.method: 提出AFlex框架，采用全局调度器与局部的算子级动态电压频率调节（DVFS）控制器，联合优化资源分配与GPU频率；引入交织式A/F流水线，配合动态微批次深度与自适应请求批处理以减少流水线气泡；在SGLang上实现。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA A800 GPU上使用Qwen3-32B和Mixtral-8×7B，基于生产对话与编码迹进行评估；在满足TTFT和TPOT的SLO前提下，相比最先进的分离式服务系统每token能耗降低高达49%，相比频率调节系统降低高达48%。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、算子级的A/F资源与频率联合优化可在满足严格服务级目标的同时显著降低LLM服务的能耗。

title: CRAFTS: Collaborative Role-Adaptive Fine-Tuning of LLM Agents for Chemical Process Simulation
summary: Constructing an executable chemical-process model remains manually intensive. Chemical engineers translate underspecified requests into coupled decisions about unit operations, thermodynamics, streams, specifications, degrees of freedom (DoF), initialization, solver repair, and optimization; one error can invalidate the model. CRAFTS mirrors the staged workflow of chemical engineers by decomposing simulation building into bounded subtasks assigned to seven bounded roles, with deterministic IDAES/Pyomo gates between stages. Given a natural-language request, process flowsheet diagram (PFD) evidence, and curated chemical-engineering knowledge, Input Understanding and Intent recover requirements, constraints, and process semantics; visual, topology, and specification specialists translate them into typed simulator contracts; and Debug and Optimization support bounded repair and eligible optimization. Fine-tuning is applied to the three schema-critical visual, topology, and specification roles, while the remaining roles use untuned Qwen. The resulting VisualGraphIR, TopologyIR, SpecIR, BuildPlan, and SolveReport expose unit, port, thermodynamic, numerical, and execution decisions. Compatible constructors, property packages, and runners are attached only after semantic artifacts pass engineering gates. We introduce OpenIDAES-450, a 450-case IDAES process- simulation dataset, and evaluate the complete seven-role LangChain/LangGraph workflow through solve and eligible optimization on its frozen 82-case held-out split. CRAFTS completes the prescribed validation and execution contract for for 91.5% of cases and achieves unit, stream, and directed-connection F1 scores of 0.815, 0.791, and 0.782. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of role specialization, typed intermediate representations, and deterministic engineering gates for reliable automated process-model construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CRAFTS系统，通过角色分解和类型化中间表示实现自动化化学过程模型构建，在OpenIDAES-450数据集上达到91.5%的成功率和约0.8的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 构建可执行的化学过程模型仍然需要大量人工工作。化学工程师需要将欠规范的请求转化为关于单元操作、热力学、物流、规格、自由度、初始化、求解器修复和优化等多方面耦合决策，一个错误就可能导致模型失效。
AI.method: CRAFTS模拟化学工程师的分阶段工作流程，将仿真构建分解为有限子任务，分配给七个有限角色，并在阶段之间设置确定性的IDAES/Pyomo门控。系统包含输入理解、意图恢复、视觉、拓扑和规格专家等角色，以及调试和优化支持。对关键的视觉、拓扑和规格角色进行微调，其他角色使用未调优的Qwen。通过VisualGraphIR、TopologyIR、SpecIR、BuildPlan和SolveReport等中间表示暴露各类决策。
AI.result: 在OpenIDAES-450数据集（450个IDAES过程仿真案例）的82个案例保留分割集上，CRAFTS完成了91.5%案例的验证和执行合约，在单元、物流和有向连接上的F1分数分别达到0.815、0.791和0.782。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了角色专业化、类型化中间表示和确定性工程门控在可靠自动化过程模型构建中的有效性。

title: From Network Automation to Trustworthy Autonomous Networking in the LLM Era: A Network Control Intelligence Perspective
summary: Since the inception of modern communication networks, the quest for operations automation has never ceased. Yet the evolution of network automation is difficult to characterize with a single maturity ladder. Throughout this history, network control systems have expanded their capabilities for observation, decision support, routine execution, and operator interaction, but these capabilities have not advanced uniformly. Such uneven progress makes the degree of automation an unreliable proxy for trustworthy network-side actuation. The unresolved question is not simply how much automation a system provides, but under what conditions it can be entrusted to change the network state. This paper examines that question through Network Control Intelligence (NCI), a five-axis framework spanning Decision Logic, Adaptability, Knowledge, Control Delegation, and Interface. We use NCI to organize the evolution of network-control systems into three eras: rule-based and scripted automation, programmable and data-driven control, and Large Language Model (LLM)-enabled network operations. Viewed through this framework, the three eras reveal a persistent asymmetry. None of these gains, however, automatically determines when network control should be trusted to change the network state. We frame trustworthy autonomy as a governed alignment between what a system can infer, what it can verify, and what it is authorized to execute. On that basis, the paper develops a reference architecture that separates proposal generation from governed execution, identifies recurring integration patterns for LLM-enabled operations, and derives a research agenda for higher network autonomy under explicit assurance, safety, and governance constraints.

AI.tldr: 论文提出网络控制智能(NCI)五轴框架分析网络自动化演进，揭示可信自主性的核心挑战，并构建分离提案生成与受管执行的参考架构。
AI.motivation: 网络自动化发展历程中，各能力维度进展不均衡，自动化程度无法作为可信网络执行的有效代理。核心问题不在于系统提供多少自动化，而在于在何种条件下可信任其改变网络状态。
AI.method: 提出网络控制智能(NCI)五轴框架（决策逻辑、适应性、知识、控制委托、接口），将网络控制系统演进划分为三个时代：基于规则和脚本的自动化、可编程和数据驱动控制、大语言模型赋能的网络运维。基于此框架分析各时代的持续不对称性，构建可信自主性的治理对齐模型。
AI.result: 将可信自主性建模为系统能推断、能验证和被授权执行三者之间的治理对齐关系。提出了分离提案生成与受管执行的参考架构，识别了LLM赋能运维的递归集成模式。
AI.conclusion: 自动化能力的提升不自动转化为可信的网络控制授权。需要在明确的保障、安全和治理约束下，构建更高网络自主性的研究议程，实现可验证、可治理的网络自动化系统。

title: Diagnosing High-Performance BFT Consensus via Mixture Modeling of Block Time Distributions
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, published as a full paper at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Cryptocurrency (ICBC)
summary: High-performance Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) blockchains are designed to achieve high throughput and low latency, yet their observed block time distributions often reveal complex behaviors arising from networking, pipelining, and deployment heterogeneity. In this paper, we diagnose HotStuff-based high-performance BFT consensus by modeling block times through a quorum-based multicast framework that links each block interval to quorum formation latency. We capture multimodal block time distributions using mixture models, where each component represents a distinct network condition characterized by effective transfer rate of block information. The proposed model is fitted to the bulk of mainnet block time data, while tail decay is analyzed separately to assess asymptotic behavior. Applying this methodology to Hyperliquid and Aptos mainnets, we find that Hyperliquid is well explained by a unimodal distribution, consistent with a relatively homogeneous validator deployment. In contrast, Aptos exhibits persistent multimodal structure and a pronounced shift following a consensus upgrade, reflecting heterogeneous deployments and diverse communication paths. These results demonstrate that mixture modeling of block time provides a practical and informative diagnostic tool for analyzing and monitoring high-performance BFT consensus.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于混合模型的区块时间诊断方法，揭示高性能BFT区块链中网络异构性对共识性能的影响，发现Hyperliquid呈单峰分布而Aptos表现为多峰分布及共识升级后显著变化。
AI.motivation: 高性能BFT区块链虽设计目标为实现高吞吐低延迟，但实际区块时间分布常呈现由网络、流水线和部署异构性引发的复杂行为，缺乏有效的诊断分析工具来理解这些行为背后的网络条件差异。
AI.method: 通过基于仲裁的多播框架建模区块时间，将每个区块间隔与仲裁形成延迟关联；采用混合模型捕获多峰区块时间分布，每个分量代表具有不同有效传输率的网络条件；主体数据拟合混合模型，尾部衰减单独分析以评估渐近行为。
AI.result: 应用于Hyperliquid和Aptos主网发现：Hyperliquid符合单峰分布，与其相对同构的验证者部署一致；Aptos呈现持续多峰结构并在共识升级后出现显著偏移，反映异构部署和多样化通信路径；混合模型成功拟合主网区块时间数据的大部分。
AI.conclusion: 区块时间混合建模为分析和监控高性能BFT共识提供了实用且信息丰富的诊断工具，能有效识别部署异构性和共识升级影响，有助于理解网络条件对共识性能的作用机制。

title: Where Reasoning Diverges: Localized Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate commonly exchanges complete reasoning traces even when disagreements concern only a few intermediate claims. We introduce Localized Multi-Agent Debate (LMAD), an inference-time protocol that represents agent traces as typed nodes, locates their earliest conflict, and restricts debate to the corresponding local segments. Guarded resolution extends a shared committed state so that later conflicts can be addressed without reopening accepted steps. We evaluate a single fixed LMAD configuration on four multi-hop question-answering benchmarks using ten backbones from four model families. Our method achieves the highest macro-averaged judge accuracy across all ten backbones, outperforming the strongest conventional baseline by up to 7.20 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为LMAD的多智能体辩论方法，通过定位最早冲突并将辩论限制在局部片段，在4个多跳问答基准测试中取得了最高准确率，相比最强基线提升了最多7.20个百分点。
AI.motivation: 传统的多智能体辩论方法在智能体之间交换完整的推理轨迹，即使分歧仅涉及少数中间结论。这种做法效率低下，且可能引入不必要的干扰。
AI.method: 提出Localized Multi-Agent Debate (LMAD)协议：1) 将智能体推理轨迹表示为类型化节点；2) 定位最早的冲突点；3) 仅针对相应的局部片段进行辩论。引入受保护解析机制，维护共享的已提交状态，使后续冲突能够在不重新打开已接受步骤的情况下得到解决。
AI.result: 在四个多跳问答基准测试上，使用四个模型家族的十个骨干模型进行评估，单一固定的LMAD配置在所有十个骨干模型上均取得最高的宏平均判断准确率，相比最强的传统基线方法提升最多7.20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: LMAD通过局部化辩论策略有效提升了多智能体辩论的效率和准确性，验证了将辩论聚焦于冲突区域的合理性和有效性。

title: Sensitivity-driven Adaptive Contention Window Optimization for IEEE 802.11 based V2I Networks
summary: In vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication the setting of IEEE 802.11 Distributed Coordination Function (DCF) parameters has a decisive bearing on performance, yet the literature seldom pins down how much each parameter actually matters once traffic, MAC and queueing are modelled together. Treating a previously validated analytical framework as a fixed deterministic input-output map, we rank the DCF and traffic parameters that shape throughput, collision probability, delay, packet delivery ratio and Age of Information in a single-AP V2I network. A local one-factor-at-a-time analysis, cast in dimensionless elasticities so that parameters of different units become comparable, is paired with a variance-based global analysis built on first-order and total-effect Sobol indices. Two clean groups emerge: collision probability is set by the contending-vehicle population -- itself governed by vehicle velocity and density -- together with the minimum contention window, whereas delay is driven by the channel rate, the offered load and the packet size, and carries strong interaction effects that no local reading can expose. We then derive the closed-form structure of these sensitivities from the model relations, which explains the rankings, forces certain parameters into equal-magnitude elasticities, and locates where the local ranking reverses. Finally the collision-sensitivity structure is turned into a design output rather than a ranking: a closed-form contention-window control law, linear in the contending population and closed with a Greenshields density model, that a roadside access point can evaluate online from measured density or velocity. The fixed IEEE 802.11 default is recovered as the single population at which this law is optimal; away from it the throughput gain grows with density and is largest in the dense, safety-critical regime.

AI.tldr: 本文通过局部弹性分析和全局Sobol指数，量化V2I网络中DCF参数的敏感性，揭示了碰撞概率由车辆密度和最小竞争窗口主导，而延迟由信道速率和负载驱动；据此提出了在线竞争窗口控制律，在密集场景下显著提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 在V2I通信中，IEEE 802.11 DCF参数设置对性能影响重大，但现有文献缺乏对参数实际重要性的定量分析，难以指导参数优化设计。
AI.method: 采用确定性分析框架，结合局部单因素弹性分析和基于方差的Sobol全局敏感性分析，量化各参数对吞吐量、碰撞概率、延迟等性能指标的影响，并推导敏感性闭式结构。
AI.result: 碰撞概率由竞争车辆数量和最小竞争窗口主导，延迟由信道速率、负载和包大小驱动且具有强交互效应；提出了线性竞争窗口控制律，可在密集场景下显著提升吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 参数敏感性分析揭示了两类参数组的独立性，基于此的控制律设计将敏感性分析转化为实际工程输出，为V2I网络参数优化提供了理论基础和实用方案。

title: Shared Organizational Memory for Enterprise Coding Agents: System Design and Deployment Snapshot
summary: Enterprise coding agents rely on tools and retrieval, yet enterprise knowledge often remains outside public training data and formal documentation: internal DSLs, proprietary platforms, local conventions, recent fixes, and tacit workflows. Existing knowledge interfaces expose stored resources but still depend on agents recognizing and explicitly recording lessons worth reusing, disconnecting capture from the coding workflow and leaving development experience repeatedly rediscovered. We report an ongoing production deployment of a shared organizational memory system that makes capture a platform-level part of coding work: it collects task-adjacent experience with contributor approval, curates it into reusable question-answer memories, gates obvious security and privacy risks, and retrieves memories for future agents. This short paper describes the deployed lifecycle and an operational snapshot. Effects on retrieval and coding tasks remain under evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种企业级共享组织记忆系统的生产部署，该系统通过在编码工作流程中集成经验捕获功能，将任务相关的隐性知识（如内部DSL、专有平台规范等）转化为可复用的问答记忆，从而解决企业知识难以被编码代理有效利用的问题。
AI.motivation: 企业编码代理依赖工具和检索系统，但大量企业知识（如内部领域特定语言、专有平台、本地约定、近期修复和隐性工作流程）往往不在公开训练数据或正式文档中。现有知识接口虽然能够暴露存储的资源，但仍然依赖代理主动识别并显式记录值得复用的经验教训，这导致捕获过程与编码工作流程脱节，开发经验需要被反复重新发现。
AI.method: 作者部署了一个共享组织记忆系统，将经验捕获作为平台级别的编码工作一部分。该系统在贡献者批准的前提下收集任务相关经验，将其整理成可复用的问答记忆，对明显的安全和隐私风险进行控制，并为未来的代理提供记忆检索功能。论文描述了该系统的部署生命周期和运营快照。
AI.result: 论文报告了该系统正在进行的生产行署情况，并提供了运营快照。关于检索和编码任务效果的具体评估仍在进行中。
AI.conclusion: 该系统通过将经验捕获集成到编码工作流程中，有效解决了企业隐性知识难以被编码代理利用的问题，为企业知识的共享和复用提供了一种可行的解决方案。系统已在生产环境中部署，但其对检索和编码任务的具体影响仍需进一步评估。

title: Ensemble of Unsupervised Deep Learning for Clustering Imbalanced Tabular Data
summary: Data imbalance poses a major challenge in supervised classification, where the majority-class bias contributes to false negatives and overestimates classification accuracy. Unsupervised deep clustering can be immune to class imbalance because representation learning for clustering is performed without class labels. Deep clustering has been proposed for images, languages, and graphs, while its application to tabular data has only emerged recently. This paper is among the first to examine the performance of state-of-the-art deep clustering methods under varying levels of data imbalance. We introduce two novel cluster ensemble approaches: one aggregates deep clustering assignments across different embedding dimensions, and the other applies majority voting to the best-performing clustering algorithms. Experiments on 16 binary tabular datasets with varying and artificially induced levels of imbalance reveal distinct strengths of different deep clustering methods. On average, our ensemble methods outperform individual clustering methods in ACC, NMI, and ARI scores, offering greater resilience to data imbalance when identifying ground-truth classes without supervision. Therefore, in an imbalanced data scenario, deep clustering can serve as a strong alternative to supervised classification.

AI.tldr: 本文针对不平衡表格数据，提出了两种深度聚类集成方法，在无监督设置下优于单一方法，可作为监督分类的有效替代方案。
AI.motivation: 监督分类中数据不平衡导致多数类偏差、假阴性增加和准确率高估。无监督深度聚类不依赖类标签，理论上对类别不平衡具有免疫性，但在表格数据上的应用及在不平衡条件下的性能研究尚属空白。
AI.method: 在16个具有不同程度（含人工诱导）不平衡的二元表格数据集上评估多种最先进深度聚类方法的性能。提出两种新型聚类集成方法：一种跨不同嵌入维度聚合深度聚类分配结果，另一种对表现最佳的聚类算法应用多数投票。
AI.result: 不同深度聚类方法在应对数据不平衡时表现出各自独特的优势。所提出的两种集成方法在ACC、NMI和ARI指标上平均优于单一聚类方法，在无监督识别真实类别时展现出更强的抗数据不平衡鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 在数据不平衡场景下，深度聚类可以作为监督分类的有力替代方案，为处理类别不平衡问题提供了新的解决思路。

title: TALSC: Timeliness-Aware Large-Small VLM Collaboration for Infrastructure-Assisted Autonomous Driving
comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE GLOBECOM 2026
summary: The deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in autonomous driving (AD) systems is constrained by on-board computing power, restricting vehicles to small VLMs (SVLMs) with limited perception and reasoning capabilities. Infrastructure-assisted AD alleviates this resource constraint by enabling collaboration with large VLMs (LVLMs) at edge servers. However, in dynamic vehicular environments, the utility of sensory data for downstream tasks decays rapidly, making timeliness of information a critical concern. To balance the accuracy gains of LVLMs with their latency-induced timeliness degradation, we develop a Timeliness-Aware Large-Small VLM Collaboration (TALSC) framework. Specifically, we first model the Age of Information (AoI) evolution for VLM inference and characterize the coupling among AoI, token length, and task performance to formulate a general timeliness metric. Building on this, we propose the TALSC online scheduling algorithm. Since scheduling decisions have a delayed impact on future timeliness metric and the output token number is unknown at scheduling time, we design a Lyapunov drift-plus-estimated-penalty algorithm and provides a guaranteed performance. In simulation, we first conduct a case study to derive a fitted timeliness metric based on nuScenes dataset, and further show that TALSC outperforms baselines under various communication and computing settings, achieving up to a 12.6\% normalized improvement in Micro-F1 score compared with the best-performing baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种时效性感知的大-小视觉语言模型协作框架(TALSC)，用于解决自动驾驶场景下车载小型VLM与边缘服务器大型VLM协作中的时效性与准确性权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统中车载计算资源受限，只能部署能力有限的小型视觉语言模型(SVLM)；虽然基础设施辅助自动驾驶可通过边缘服务器上的大型VLM(LVLM)缓解资源约束，但在动态车联网环境中，传感器数据效用快速衰减，信息时效性成为关键挑战。
AI.method: 首先建立VLM推理的信息年龄(AoI)演化模型，刻画AoI、token长度与任务性能之间的耦合关系，构建通用时效性度量指标；进而提出TALSC在线调度算法，针对调度决策对未来时效性指标的延迟影响以及调度时刻输出token数未知的问题，设计Lyapunov漂移加估计惩罚算法。
AI.result: 在nuScenes数据集上进行案例研究并拟合时效性度量指标；仿真表明TALSC在各种通信与计算设置下均优于基线方法，相比最优基线在Micro-F1分数上实现了高达12.6%的归一化提升。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的TALSC框架通过Lyapunov优化方法有效平衡了大型VLM的准确性增益与其延迟带来的时效性损失，在保证理论性能界的同时，显著提升了自动驾驶场景下VLM协作系统的整体性能。

title: Securing Agentic AI: From Per-Action Checks to Trajectory Assurance
comment: 6 pages. Accepted to the ACM AI Leadership Summit 2026 (Visionary Track)
summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly used to execute consequential tasks in environments governed by operational constraints, organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and technical standards. Their safety is therefore determined not by the correctness of individual actions, but by whether their overall behavior remains consistent with the rules and invariants of the systems in which they operate. As large language model (LLM)-based agents become more autonomous and increasingly delegate tasks across organizational boundaries, securing them evolves from a single challenge into a broad and interconnected landscape spanning the entire agentic stack. At the single-agent level, untrusted inputs through prompts, memory, retrieved knowledge, and tool interfaces create attack surfaces. In multi-agent settings, delegation and communication introduce challenges related to identity, trust, capability control, and decision transparency, while the underlying model routing and execution control plane remains vulnerable to manipulation and to unverified model provenance. Perhaps the most fundamental challenge is behavioral containment: sequences of individually permissible actions may collectively violate system-level constraints and safety invariants. At the broader level, supply-chain integrity, provenance, accountability, and end-to-end observability remain largely open problems. A common principle unifies these directions: security must become a verifiable property of the architectures, protocols, and runtimes that govern agent behavior, rather than an optional layer of guidance. Charting these challenges provides a roadmap toward trustworthy autonomous agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了LLM自主代理安全从单点防护向全栈安全演进的挑战，提出安全必须成为架构、协议和运行时的可验证属性，而非可选指导层。
AI.motivation: 随着基于大语言模型的自主代理在受约束环境中执行关键任务，其安全性不再取决于单个动作的正确性，而是取决于整体行为是否与系统规则保持一致。当代理变得更加自主并跨组织边界委托任务时，安全问题从单一挑战演变为跨越整个代理技术栈的互联景观。
AI.method: 从多层次视角系统梳理安全挑战：单代理层面的提示、记忆、检索知识和工具接口等攻击面；多代理场景中的身份、信任、能力控制和决策透明性问题；模型路由和执行控制平面的脆弱性；行为约束问题（个别允许的动作序列可能集体违反系统约束）；以及供应链完整性、溯源、问责和端到端可观测性等开放问题。
AI.result: 识别了自主代理安全的关键挑战域，包括单代理攻击面、多代理信任与控制问题、行为约束难题以及供应链安全缺口。揭示了安全问题的互联性和系统性特征。
AI.conclusion: 提出统一原则：安全必须成为架构、协议和运行时的可验证属性，而非可选的指导层。为可信自主代理部署提供了研究路线图和方向指引。

title: LLM-Driven Automated Reward Design for Reinforcement Learning-Based Routing in LEO Satellite Networks
comment: This paper was accepted for publication at the IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM 2026)
summary: Routing in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite networks is challenging due to highly dynamic topologies and spatio-temporal network conditions. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach for adaptive routing; however, its performance critically depends on reward function design, which must balance objectives such as goodput and end-to-end delay. In practice, reward design remains a complex manual process requiring significant domain expertise and extensive trial-and-error. Recent works have explored Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated reward design, but their application to highly dynamic systems such as LEO satellite networks remains largely unexplored. We propose LARGE, a framework that automates reward design for RL-based routing by combining LLM- driven generation with iterative simulator-in-the-loop evaluation. LARGE generates an initial reward from LLM prior knowledge and iteratively refines it using simulation feedback. This loop enables exploration of diverse reward formulations while aligning them with network objectives. Results show that LARGE improves reward quality within a few iterations through feedback-driven refinement. Across different backbones, the framework achieves performance comparable to an expert-designed baseline, with the best-performing configuration reaching goodput within approximately 3% of the baseline and slightly lower end-to-end delay, without manual reward engineering. These results indicate that effectiveness emerges from the iterative feedback-driven process enabled by LARGE, highlighting the potential of framework-driven LLM-in-the-loop optimization for RL-based routing in dynamic satellite networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LARGE框架，利用大语言模型(LLM)自动化设计LEO卫星网络中强化学习路由的奖励函数，通过迭代仿真反馈优化，性能接近专家设计的基线方案。
AI.motivation: LEO卫星网络路由面临高度动态拓扑和时空网络条件的挑战。虽然强化学习(RL)在自适应路由中表现出潜力，但其性能严重依赖奖励函数设计。现有方法需要大量领域专业知识和反复试验，过程复杂且手动。尽管已有研究探索LLM用于自动化奖励设计，但在高度动态的LEO卫星网络系统中的应用仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 提出LARGE框架，将LLM驱动的生成与迭代仿真闭环评估相结合。框架首先利用LLM先验知识生成初始奖励函数，然后通过仿真反馈迭代优化。这种闭环机制能够探索多样化的奖励函数形式，同时将其与网络目标对齐，实现自动化的奖励函数设计。
AI.result: LARGE通过反馈驱动的优化过程，在少数迭代内即可提升奖励质量。在不同骨干网络配置下，框架性能与专家设计的基线相当，最佳配置的吞吐量达到基线的约97%以内，端到端延迟略低，且无需手动奖励工程设计。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明LARGE框架通过迭代反馈驱动过程实现了有效性，突显了框架驱动的LLM闭环优化在动态卫星网络RL路由中的潜力，为自动化奖励设计提供了新思路。

title: AgentStream: How Well Do Self-Evolving LLM Agents Perform Under Streaming Tasks?
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve by continually improving from their own accumulated experience. However, existing studies predominantly adopt independent evaluation. Consequently, the behavior of self-evolving agents in realistic streaming settings, where agents adapt to diverse and complex task streams, remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce AgentStream, a unified framework that evaluates self-evolving agents spanning diverse evolution components by organizing agentic benchmarks into a configurable task stream and instantiating the \texttt{Isolated}, \texttt{Sequential}, and \texttt{Interleaved} streaming scenarios at test time, which progressively vary the scope and domain composition of the stream. Over these scenarios, we combinatorially evaluate five representative self-evolving methods across three frontier foundation models, disentangling how model capability, method architecture, and streaming scenario jointly shape self-evolution. Our results show that self-evolution reliability varies across streaming scenarios, the benefit of self-evolution is gated by model capability and non-monotonic in model strength, and no single method dominates across models and scenarios. These findings offer concrete guidance for selecting self-evolving methods across models and streaming scenarios. Overall, we advocate that self-evolving agents should be evaluated under realistic task streams rather than isolated single-task settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AgentStream框架，用于在现实任务流场景下评估自进化大语言模型代理，发现自进化的可靠性在不同流式场景中存在差异，且没有单一方法在所有模型和场景中均占优。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要采用独立评估方式，缺乏对自进化代理在现实流式场景（代理需适应多样化、复杂任务流）中行为的理解，因此亟需在更贴近实际应用的流式设置下系统评估自进化方法。
AI.method: 提出AgentStream统一评估框架，将代理基准组织为可配置任务流，在测试时实例化Isolated、Sequential和Interleaved三种流式场景，系统性地改变任务流的范围与领域组成，并组合评估五种代表性自进化方法在三个前沿基础模型上的表现。
AI.result: 自进化的可靠性在流式场景间存在差异；自进化的收益受模型能力限制，且与模型强度呈非单调关系；没有单一方法在所有模型和场景中均占优。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在不同模型和流式场景下选择自进化方法提供了具体指导，主张自进化代理应在现实任务流而非孤立单任务设置下进行评估。

title: Modeling Unknown Nonlocal PDE Systems via Flow Map Learning
summary: Nonlocal partial differential equations arise in many applications but are often difficult to model and learn because of the presence of nonlocal operators. We present a flow-map learning (FML) framework for modeling unknown nonlocal PDEs directly from solution data. Rather than learning or approximating the underlying nonlocal operators, the proposed approach learns the finite-time evolution operator in either modal or nodal space. Two complementary formulations are developed for spectral and grid-based solution representations. Numerical experiments on one- and two-dimensional fractional diffusion and wave equations demonstrate accurate and stable long-time prediction using only short observation windows. The proposed approach provides an effective data-driven framework for learning unknown nonlocal dynamics without explicit evaluation of nonlocal operators.

AI.tldr: 提出流映射学习(FML)框架，通过学习有限时间演化算子而非非局部算子本身，实现从未知非局部PDE解数据中建模动力学。
AI.motivation: 非局部偏微分方程在众多应用场景中广泛出现，但由于非局部算子的存在，传统建模和学习方法面临显著困难。现有方法通常需要直接处理或逼近这些复杂的非局部算子，这导致计算复杂度和模型精度的权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出流映射学习(FML)框架，核心思想是绕过直接学习非局部算子的难点，转而学习有限时间演化算子。开发两种互补形式：模态空间形式（针对谱表示）和节点空间形式（针对网格表示），分别适用于不同的解表示方法。
AI.result: 在一维和二维分数阶扩散方程及波动方程的数值实验中验证了方法有效性。仅使用短时观测窗口即可实现准确且稳定的长时预测，证明了方法在处理非局部动力学问题上的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: FML框架为学习未知非局部动力学提供了有效的数据驱动方法，通过避免非局部算子的显式求值，成功解决了传统方法的关键难点，为非局部PDE的建模开辟了新途径。

title: Learning-Based Collaborative MEC for LLM Inference with Soft-Deadline Awareness via Transformer-Enhanced PPO
summary: This paper investigates collaborative mobile edge computing (MEC) servers for large language model (LLM) inference under soft deadline constraints. In this system, to improve the quality of service, computations are expected to be completed within their deadlines. However, due to dependencies among tasks or subtasks, any missed deadline can lead to catastrophic consequences for the entire request. In this context, this work proposes an extended deadline mechanism with constrained flexibility. The main challenges lie in handling large-scale computations under strict latency constraints while limiting the number of allowable deadline extensions, especially in the presence of task dependencies within each request. To tackle these challenges, we develop a transformer-enhanced proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework that enables efficient collaboration among MEC servers. The proposed approach aims to maximize the number of tasks completed within their deadlines while minimizing the use of deadline extensions. By capturing temporal dependencies and cross-server interactions, the transformer improves decision-making for task migration. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms conventional PPO and heuristic-based approaches in terms of task completion rate and overall system efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer增强的近端策略优化(PPO)框架，用于解决移动边缘计算(MEC)服务器在软截止期约束下进行大语言模型(LLM)推理时的任务协作调度问题，在限制截止期扩展次数的同时最大化任务完成率。
AI.motivation: 在协作移动边缘计算服务器上进行大语言模型推理时，由于任务或子任务之间存在依赖关系，任何截止期错过都会导致整个请求的灾难性后果。系统需要在严格的延迟约束下处理大规模计算，同时限制允许的截止期扩展次数，这带来了巨大的调度挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种扩展截止期机制，并开发了Transformer增强的近端策略优化(PPO)框架。该框架通过Transformer捕捉时间依赖关系和跨服务器交互信息，从而改进任务迁移的决策能力，实现MEC服务器间的高效协作。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的方法在任务完成率和整体系统效率方面显著优于传统PPO方法和基于启发式的方法，证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过Transformer增强的PPO框架能够有效解决软截止期约束下LLM推理的协作计算问题，在最大化截止期内任务完成数量的同时最小化截止期扩展的使用，为MEC环境下的LLM推理服务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: LEO-Aware DRL Meta-Scheduler for 5G Non-Terrestrial Network Slicing
comment: This paper was accepted for publication at the IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM 2026)
summary: The integration of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTNs) into 5G and upcoming 6G architectures introduces various challenges, including severe propagation delays, ultra-high base station mobility, and channel non-stationarity, complicating radio resource management of heterogeneous network slices. In this paper, we propose a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) meta-scheduler for twin-timescale resource allocation. Our solution adopts a decoupled Open Radio Access Network (RAN) architecture, in which a strategic 100 ms meta-scheduler selects scheduling policies for the different network slices using stale telemetry, while a fast-timescale MAC packet scheduler processes per-TTI user requests. The resulting Markov Decision Process captures non-stationary orbital dynamics and heterogeneous SLAs constraints via a TD3 agent. Simulation results under varying traffic load show that, unlike other solutions, the proposed meta-scheduler explicitly trades a statistically insignificant 1% capacity fraction (p > 0.05) to strictly bound the variance and overall magnitude of RLC-layer queuing delay for Mission-Critical (MC) traffic. Crucially, it enforces this isolation without inducing the broadband slice starvation characteristic of standard maximum-CQI heuristics, establishing a robust foundation for 6G O-RAN NTN resource allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习的双时间尺度元调度器，用于LEO NTN网络切片资源分配，能在几乎不损失容量的前提下有效隔离任务关键业务延迟。
AI.motivation: 将低地球轨道(LEO)非地面网络(NTN)集成到5G/6G架构中面临严峻传播延迟、超高速基站移动性和信道非平稳性等挑战，使得异构网络切片的无线资源管理变得复杂，需要新的资源分配方案。
AI.method: 采用解耦的开放无线接入网(O-RAN)架构，设计了双时间尺度资源分配方案：战略级100ms元调度器基于陈旧遥测数据为不同网络切片选择调度策略，快速时间尺度MAC包调度器处理每个TTI的用户请求。通过TD3智能体构建马尔可夫决策过程，捕获非平稳轨道动态和异构SLA约束。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，与其他方案不同，该方法仅以统计上不显著的1%容量份额(p > 0.05)为代价，就能严格限制任务关键(MC)业务RLC层排队延迟的方差和总体幅度，同时避免了标准最大CQI启发式算法导致的宽带切片饥饿问题。
