AI.conclusion: 该元调度器为6G O-RAN NTN资源分配建立了稳健的基础，能够在不引起切片饥饿的情况下实现有效的业务隔离，为未来非地面网络资源管理提供了可行的解决方案。

title: TRACE-TS: Attribution-Grounded and Traceable Sensor-Language Reasoning for Human Activity Understanding
summary: Wearable sensors capture fine-grained motion patterns that support rich behavioral understanding, yet most existing methods reduce these signals to activity labels. Recent LM-based approaches generate natural-language explanations for sensor data, but their reasoning is weakly grounded in the underlying signal, leading to fluent yet unverifiable explanations. We introduce TRACE-TS (Traceable Reasoning with Attribution-Grounded Evidence), a framework for structured and signal-grounded reasoning over wearable time series. TRACE-TS uses attribution from an expert classifier to identify salient spatio-temporal sensor regions, uses them to construct DAG reasoning traces with explicit evidence provenance, and trains a compact language model to generate these traces through gated cross-attention over sensor memory tokens. At inference, the adapted model jointly outputs the activity prediction and its reasoning trace, without requiring attribution computation or teacher guidance. We introduce Semantic Node Match(SNM), an LLM-as-judge metric that diagnoses reasoning fidelity at the observation, inference, and synthesis levels, localizing hallucinated observations and broken evidence chains missed by standard NLG metrics. Across seven wearable benchmarks, TRACE-TS achieves the best average accuracy and F1 among all evaluated methods (84.43%/81.24%), and outperforms the best LLM-based baseline by 17.96% in F1. Our code is available at https://github.com/SparshRastogi/TRACE-TS.

AI.tldr: 提出了TRACE-TS框架，通过归因方法识别关键传感器区域，构建具有证据溯源的DAG推理链，实现可验证的穿戴设备时间序列推理，在七个基准数据集上取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有穿戴传感器方法将信号简化为活动标签，而基于语言模型的方法生成的自然语言解释虽然流畅但缺乏信号依据，导致不可验证的解释。需要一种能够生成结构化且基于信号推理的框架。
AI.method: TRACE-TS框架：利用专家分类器的归因识别显著的时空传感器区域，构建具有明确证据溯源的有向无环图(DAG)推理轨迹，通过门控交叉注意力机制在传感器记忆token上训练紧凑语言模型来生成这些推理轨迹。推理时无需归因计算或教师指导，联合输出活动预测和推理轨迹。引入Semantic Node Match (SNM)作为LLM-as-judge指标来诊断推理保真度。
AI.result: 在七个穿戴设备基准数据集上，TRACE-TS在所有评估方法中取得了最佳的平均准确率和F1值（84.43%/81.24%），F1值比最佳LLM基线高出17.96%。
AI.conclusion: TRACE-TS成功实现了结构化和信号导向的推理，通过归因和证据溯源提高了穿戴传感器数据分析的可解释性和可靠性，解决了现有方法缺乏信号依据的问题。

title: DSETA: A Dual-Stage Continual Learning Framework for Travel Time Prediction in Dynamic Traffic Environments
summary: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction is a core component of intelligent transportation systems. As traffic congestion patterns become increasingly dynamic in large cities, maintaining high prediction accuracy poses a major challenge for ride-hailing platforms. Existing methods either fail to adapt to irregular traffic patterns and sudden congestion, or suffer from new distributions without disentangling long-term trends from short-term fluctuations, thereby degrading model performance in real-world scenarios. To address this challenge, we propose DSETA, an incrementally updated Dual-Stage ETA prediction framework. Specifically, the continual learning process is divided into \textit{inter-day} and \textit{intra-day} stages. We first design the \textit{intra-day} learning stage, which relies entirely on real-time data to enable dynamic adaptation to short-term traffic patterns caused by events like holidays or accidents. Next, we develop the \textit{inter-day} learning stage, which leverages aggregated historical data from a short time window to capture knowledge of long-term distribution shifts, such as seasonal trends and traffic network evolution. Subsequently, to prevent catastrophic forgetting and preserve knowledge of regular patterns, we explore a \textit{Historical Traffic Knowledge Consolidation} module. Finally, we validate DSETA's effectiveness and robustness through extensive offline and online experiments conducted on real-world datasets from DiDi's platform. Online A/B tests across three major cities including Beijing, Wuhan, and Xi'an consistently demonstrated performance gains, achieving MAE reductions of 6.62\%, 0.73\%, and 2.40\% respectively. This framework has been successfully deployed in DiDi's production environment, processing hundreds of millions of daily requests and validating its strong performance in industrial applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DSETA框架，通过日内和日间两阶段持续学习解决ETA预测中的动态交通模式适应问题，在滴滴平台实现6.62%的MAE降低并成功部署。
AI.motivation: 现有ETA预测方法无法适应不规则交通模式和突发拥堵，且在处理长期趋势与短期波动分离时面临新分布挑战，导致实际场景中模型性能下降。
AI.method: 提出DSETA双阶段增量更新框架：日内学习阶段利用实时数据适应短期交通模式（如节假日、事故）；日间学习阶段使用短期历史聚合数据捕捉长期分布偏移（如季节趋势、路网演化）；设计历史交通知识巩固模块防止灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在滴滴平台真实数据集上进行离线和在线实验，北京、武汉、西安三城市在线A/B测试分别实现MAE降低6.62%、0.73%和2.40%，框架已成功部署于生产环境，日均处理数亿请求。
AI.conclusion: DSETA框架通过双阶段持续学习有效解决了动态交通环境下的ETA预测挑战，在实际工业应用中展现出良好的有效性和鲁棒性，为智能交通系统提供了可行的解决方案。

title: DEFT: Joint Task Placement and DVFS for Energy-Efficient Multi-GPU Runtimes
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 40th ACM International Conference on Supercomputing (ICS 26)
summary:
Energy efficiency has become a first-order concern in modern high-performance computing systems, as it directly determines achievable throughput under fixed power budgets. Although Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) provides an effective mechanism for reducing GPU energy consumption, existing runtime systems decouple DVFS from task placement and inter-GPU communication, focus on single-GPU execution, or cannot adapt frequency to task granularity and runtime contention in multi-GPU environments. Consequently, current schedulers fail to capture the tight coupling between task placement, frequency selection, and inter-GPU data movement that fundamentally governs energy-performance trade-offs on multi-GPU systems.
  This paper presents DEFT, an energy-aware scheduling framework that jointly optimizes task-to-device assignment and per-GPU DVFS configuration for task-based multi-GPU applications. DEFT employs a cost-model-driven strategy that integrates slack awareness, throughput awareness, and explicit modeling of task execution cost, inter-GPU data movement, and DVFS transition overheads, enabling coordinated placement and frequency decisions at task granularity under dynamic runtime conditions. We prototype DEFT within the CUDASTF runtime and demonstrate its effectiveness across five optimization objectives. The evaluation shows that DEFT reduces energy consumption by 14.8% and 4.8% on average on NVIDIA L40S and L4, and reduces EDP by 9.9% and 3.7%, respectively, while maintaining performance within 1.5% of the fastest baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DEFT框架，通过联合优化任务分配和GPU频率设置，在多GPU环境下实现了显著的能效提升。
AI.motivation: 现代高性能计算系统中能效已成为首要关注点，现有运行时系统将DVFS与任务放置和GPU间通信解耦，仅关注单GPU执行，或无法在多GPU环境中根据任务粒度和运行时争用情况调整频率，导致无法捕捉多GPU系统中任务放置、频率选择和GPU间数据移动之间的紧密耦合关系。
AI.method: 提出DEFT能源感知调度框架，采用成本模型驱动策略，集成松弛感知、吞吐量感知，以及对任务执行成本、GPU间数据移动和DVFS转换开销的显式建模，在动态运行时条件下实现任务粒度的协调放置和频率决策。在CUDASTF运行时中原型实现DEFT。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA L40S和L4 GPU上的评估显示，DEFT平均降低14.8%和4.8%的能耗，降低9.9%和3.7%的EDP，同时保持性能在最快基准的1.5%范围内。
AI.conclusion: DEFT通过联合优化任务放置和频率配置，在多GPU任务应用中实现了显著的能效提升，同时保持了接近最优的性能表现。

title: On Topology's Role in ML Training Performance
summary: Modern machine learning training workloads run on large-scale networks of compute accelerators. The networks commonly deployed in these systems are typically variations of two basic topologies: the fat-tree Clos and the torus. In this paper, we derive analytical results the elucidate how the choice of topology shapes achievable performance for the small set of collective communication operations that underlies modern machine learning workloads. We also consider how these results change when we include additional factors such as network failures and job placement strategies. Overall, we find that one topology does not dominate in all cases, but that the Clos achieves better collective completion time in most cases and provides benefits in resilience and flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论分析对比了Fat-Tree Clos和Torus网络拓扑在现代机器学习训练任务中的性能表现。结果显示Clos拓扑在大多数情况下能实现更好的集体通信完成时间，并在容错性和灵活性方面具有优势，但并非在所有场景下都占优。
AI.motivation: 现代大规模机器学习训练任务运行在由计算加速器组成的大规模网络上，而网络拓扑结构（主要是Fat-Tree Clos和Torus）直接影响系统性能。为了指导系统设计，需要深入理解不同拓扑结构如何影响底层集体通信操作的性能。
AI.method: 采用解析分析方法，推导并比较Fat-Tree Clos和Torus两种基本拓扑在支持现代机器学习工作负载的核心集体通信操作上的性能差异。同时将网络故障和作业放置策略等实际因素纳入分析框架，评估其对拓扑性能比较结果的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现不存在一种在所有场景下都占主导地位的拓扑结构。但Fat-Tree Clos拓扑在大多数情况下能够实现更优的集体通信完成时间，并且在网络容错性和系统灵活性方面展现出明显优势。
AI.conclusion: 网络拓扑的选择需要根据具体场景权衡，虽然Clos拓扑在性能、容错和灵活性方面整体表现更佳，但Torus拓扑在特定情况下仍有其适用价值。研究为大规模机器学习系统的网络架构设计提供了理论依据和决策参考。

title: Personalizing Large Language Model Agents with Small Policy Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can retrieve memory, call tools, ask clarifying questions, and vary response style, yet adapting these execution decisions to an individual user remains difficult. Fine-tuning a separate LLM is costly or impossible for proprietary systems, while prompts and memory primarily expose user information to the agent rather than adapt its execution decisions from feedback. We formulate personalization of a frozen agent as online learning of a per-user execution policy from scalar feedback observed only for the executed action. We propose FABLE (Factorized Adaptive Bandit Layer for Execution), a lightweight policy layer outside a potentially black-box host agent. FABLE factorizes memory, information-acquisition, and response decisions so feedback updates related choices; filters actions through an externally specified feasible set before exploration; and learns user-specific residual preferences relative to a fixed default-and-cost score via Bayesian contextual Thompson sampling. Under a linear residual-reward model, a calibrated variant inherits an expected-regret bound against the best feasible action. We also characterize preferences unidentifiable under persistent feasibility constraints and provide anytime-valid false-promotion control. Across personalized-reasoning, controlled-feedback, and executable tool-use evaluations, FABLE improves several preference-sensitive behaviors relative to rule-only control while remaining competitive on end-to-end task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FABLE（Factorized Adaptive Bandit Layer for Execution），一个部署在冻结大语言模型外部、无需微调的轻量级个性化执行策略层。通过因子化分解执行决策、约束集过滤和贝叶斯汤普森采样，实现在仅能观测执行动作反馈条件下的在线用户适配，在多项评估中改善偏好敏感行为。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型代理具备记忆检索、工具调用、澄清提问等能力，但针对个体用户适配执行决策仍然困难。对专有系统进行微调成本高昂甚至不可行，而提示和记忆主要向代理暴露用户信息，难以根据反馈调整执行决策。因此需要在冻结代理条件下实现个性化执行策略的在线学习。
AI.method: 提出FABLE框架：（1）将个性化形式化为在线学习问题，从仅执行动作的标量反馈学习用户特定执行策略；（2）因子化分解记忆、信息获取和响应决策，使反馈仅更新相关选择；（3）通过外部可行集过滤动作后再进行探索；（4）采用贝叶斯上下文Thompson采样学习相对于固定默认-成本分数的用户特定残差偏好。提出校准变体并证明在可行动作上的期望遗憾界。
AI.result: FABLE在个性化推理、控制反馈和可执行工具使用评估中，相对于仅使用规则的控制器改善了多项偏好敏感行为，同时保持了端到端任务性能的竞争力。在残差奖励模型下提供理论遗憾界保证，并刻画了持久可行性约束下的偏好不可识别性，提供了任意时刻有效的虚假提升控制。
AI.conclusion: FABLE作为冻结大语言模型外部的轻量级策略层，无需对代理进行微调即可实现个性化执行决策，在理论保证和实证评估上均表现良好。这为专有系统或禁止微调场景下的个性化应用提供了可行方案，同时因子化结构提升了学习的样本效率与可解释性。

title: Unleashing the Potential of Large Language Models: A Blueprint for Real-Time, Enterprise-Ready Deployments
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Authors' accepted version of an article published in IEEE Computer. The version of record is available at the DOI below
summary: Large language models deployed in real-time, regulated settings face knowledge staleness, catastrophic forgetting, hallucination, and weak feedback loops. We present a unified, pattern-driven LLMOps architecture integrating real-time data ingestion, continual learning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and human-in-the-loop feedback into a single operational pipeline. Four contributions map to established software design patterns: an adaptive ingestion pattern orchestrator (AIPO) evaluated with FreshStreamBench; STAR+FAR continual learning with sparse temporal adapter routing and freshness-aware replay; SAGE, an SLO-aware adaptive retrieval policy predicting a per-query passage budget to meet tail-latency targets; and an automated feedback-driven convergence stage with RLHF triggers. The result reduces latency-cost-accuracy trade-offs while supporting auditability and rollback for high-risk sectors such as health care and finance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的模式驱动LLMOps架构，集成了实时数据摄取、持续学习、RAG和人机反馈回路，通过四个软件设计模式组件解决了大语言模型的知识陈旧、灾难性遗忘、幻觉和反馈弱等问题。
AI.motivation: 部署在实时、受监管环境中的大语言模型面临知识陈旧、灾难性遗忘、幻觉现象和反馈回路薄弱等关键挑战，缺乏统一的运营架构来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出统一的模式驱动LLMOps架构，包含四个贡献：1)自适应摄取模式编排器(AIPO)配合FreshStreamBench评估；2)STAR+FAR持续学习方法，采用稀疏时间适配器路由和新鲜度感知重放；3)SAGE，SLO感知的自适应检索策略，预测每查询段落预算以满足尾延迟目标；4)自动化反馈驱动收敛阶段配合RLHF触发器。
AI.result: 该架构有效降低了延迟-成本-准确性之间的权衡冲突，同时支持高风险行业（如医疗和金融）的审计性和回滚能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将实时数据摄取、持续学习、检索增强生成和人机反馈集成到统一运营管道中，该LLMOps架构成功解决了大语言模型在受监管环境中的核心挑战，为高责任领域的部署提供了可行方案。

title: Efficiency and Cost Alignment in Batched LLM Serving via Resource-Fair Scheduling
summary: This paper studies a resource-allocation inefficiency in batched large language model (LLM) serving: heterogeneous requests that share a decode batch impose max-driven computational costs on one another. Because the wall-clock cost of a batch step is largely governed by the largest active KV-cache footprint, a short request co-batched with a long request can experience latency and GPU-resource consumption disproportionate to its own token workload. We formalize this phenomenon as a resource-fair scheduling problem. We develop a mathematical scheduling model that connects within-batch resource fairness to system throughput. The proposed fairness constraint bounds the disparity in decode progress, equivalently KV-cache footprint, among co-batched requests. Based on this model, we design the Insert-Short-Jobs-with-Limit (ISJL) algorithm, a parameterized hybrid batching policy. We prove that ISJL achieves a global competitive-ratio lower bound of $3/4$. We further examine the profit implications of resource-fair scheduling under the token-metered pricing convention used by commercial LLM APIs. Numerical experiments show that ISJL occupies a favorable middle ground between FCFS, which has large batching externalities, and LJF, which is cost-aligned but sacrifices batching flexibility. Thus, ISJL provides a bi-criterion scheduling policy: it maintains high throughput while aligning max-driven batch cost with token-metered revenue.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM批处理服务中的资源分配不公问题，提出ISJL算法，通过限制KV-cache足迹差异实现资源公平调度，在保持高吞吐量的同时使成本与收入对齐。
AI.motivation: 批处理LLM服务中存在资源分配效率问题：异构请求共享解码批次时会产生最大驱动的计算成本。由于批次步骤的墙钟成本主要由最大的活跃KV-cache足迹决定，短请求与长请求共批次时会经历与自身token负载不成比例的延迟和GPU资源消耗。
AI.method: 将此现象形式化为资源公平调度问题，建立数学调度模型将批次内资源公平性与系统吞吐量联系起来。提出公平性约束以限制共批次请求间的解码进度（即KV-cache足迹）差异。基于该模型设计Insert-Short-Jobs-with-Limit (ISJL)算法，这是一种参数化混合批处理策略。
AI.result: 证明了ISJL达到3/4的全局竞争比下界。数值实验表明ISJL在FCFS（具有大批处理外部性）和LJF（成本对齐但牺牲批处理灵活性）之间占据有利的中立地位，在token计量定价下实现了高吞吐量与成本收入对齐的双目标。
AI.conclusion: ISJL提供了一个双准则调度策略：在保持高吞吐量的同时，将最大驱动的批次成本与token计量收入对齐，有效解决了批处理LLM服务中的资源公平性问题。

title: CENTILE: A Telemetry Foundation Model Evaluated by the Decisions It Drives
summary: Modern computing and networking infrastructure emits telemetry continuously, yet operators convert it into decisions with a separate predictor per task, entity, and horizon. One generative model, pretrained once over an operator's own event streams, could replace this fleet, an approach that already scales to high-cardinality streams in recommendation systems. However, point-forecast error on operational telemetry saturates near simple last-value baselines, so lower error alone need not improve the decisions it feeds. To close this gap, we present \sys, a generative foundation model for network and systems telemetry, evaluated by replaying the decisions its calibrated conditional quantiles drive. \sys treats heterogeneous telemetry as event-driven, irregularly timed entity streams and serves flexible forecast horizons in a single pass, requiring no future timestamps. To our knowledge, \sys is the first pretrained telemetry model to improve both HPC scheduling and network provisioning decisions under replay, its runtime estimator transferring zero-shot across months and its pretrained weights across domains from hours of target data. Extensive experiments on HPC job logs and network traffic confirm that \sys lowers the mean bounded slowdown of backfilling by up to approximately $77\%$ over deployed user estimates and roughly halves the deployed rule's violation rate. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZzZTripleZzZ/all-in-one.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了\sys，一种用于网络和系统遥测数据的生成式基础模型，通过条件分位数预测来驱动决策，在HPC调度和网络配置任务中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现代计算和网络基础设施持续产生遥测数据，但运维人员通常为每个任务、实体和时间范围构建单独的预测器，这种方式效率低下。虽然生成式预训练模型在推荐系统中已证明可扩展到高基数流，但在运维遥测中，点预测误差往往接近简单的"最后值"基线，仅降低误差并不一定能改善最终决策，因此需要一种能直接提升决策质量的模型。
AI.method: \sys将异构遥测数据视为事件驱动的、不规则时间间隔的实体流，在单次前向传递中提供灵活的预测范围，无需未来时间戳。模型采用生成式方法，通过校准的条件分位数来驱动决策，通过决策回放的方式评估模型效果，而非仅关注预测误差。
AI.result: 在HPC作业日志和网络流量的广泛实验中，\sys将回填调度（backfilling）的平均有界减速降低了约77%（相比已部署的用户估计），并将部署规则的违规率降低约一半。模型的运行时估计器可在数月间零样本迁移，其预训练权重可从数小时的目标数据跨域迁移。
AI.conclusion: \sys是首个在回放评估中同时改善HPC调度和网络配置决策的预训练遥测模型，证明了生成式基础模型在系统运维领域的可行性，为替代传统的单一任务预测器提供了新思路。

title: More Debate, Same Evidence: Structural Limits of Homogeneous Multi-Agent Groundedness
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly organized as multi-agent panels under the assumption that exchanging critiques improves judgment quality. We test this assumption for \emph{groundedness verification}, where a judge must determine whether a claim is supported by the supplied evidence. We evaluate a homogeneous three-agent panel on six public fact-verification and hallucination-detection benchmarks. Relative to a fixed single-agent reference, the panel's system-level accuracy difference ranges from $+8.5$ to $-4.4$ percentage points: two datasets show reliable gains, one shows a reliable loss, and three are statistically inconclusive. Because the reference and panel use different model variants, these differences characterize the complete systems rather than isolate a causal debate effect.

AI.tldr: 多智能体辩论式LLM裁判在接地性验证任务上的表现存在显著差异，6个基准测试中增益范围从+8.5%到-4.4%，质疑了辩论机制普遍有效的假设。
AI.motivation: 当前普遍假设多智能体之间的辩论交流能够提升大语言模型的判断质量，但这一假设缺乏系统性验证。研究旨在检验在接地性验证（判断主张是否由证据支持）任务中，多智能体辩论机制是否确实能带来性能提升。
AI.method: 构建同质化三智能体面板作为辩论裁判系统，在六个公开的事实核查和幻觉检测基准测试上进行评估。将该面板系统与固定单智能体基准进行对比，分析系统级准确率差异。
AI.result: 相对于单智能体基准，多智能体面板的系统级准确率差异范围为+8.5%至-4.4个百分点：两个数据集显示可靠增益，一个显示可靠损失，三个统计结果不确定。由于对比系统使用不同模型变体，差异反映的是完整系统性能而非纯辩论效应。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体辩论机制对接地性验证任务的效果并不一致，无法保证性能提升。辩论机制的有效性可能因数据集特性而异，需要针对具体任务和场景进行评估，不能简单假设其普遍适用。

title: HP-JEPA: Hierarchical Partitioning for Multi-Resolution Graph Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
summary: Graph self-supervised learning aims to learn transferable representations from large-scale unlabeled graph data. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) avoid explicit negative-pair construction and raw-input reconstruction by predicting masked targets directly in latent space. However, existing graph JEPAs typically rely on a single predefined graph partition, biasing the learned representations toward one structural granularity and limiting their ability to capture complementary patterns at different graph scales. To address this limitation, we propose HP-JEPA, a hierarchical partitioning framework for multi-resolution graph joint-embedding prediction. HP-JEPA organizes each graph into an ordered bank of coarse-to-fine partition resolutions and performs context-target latent prediction separately at each resolution using an online encoder, an exponential-moving-average target encoder, and a latent predictor. The resulting resolution-specific graph representations are subsequently integrated through concatenation or task-specific resolution weighting, allowing downstream models to combine complementary local, regional, and global structural information. Experiments on seven graph classification benchmarks and one graph regression benchmark show that HP-JEPA outperforms the fixed-resolution Graph-JEPA baseline on 6 of 8 tasks, improving upon Graph-JEPA on most evaluated benchmarks. Size-stratified analyses further show that HP-JEPA achieves higher accuracy than Graph-JEPA in most evaluated graph-size quartiles on three representative datasets. These results highlight the effectiveness of hierarchical multi-resolution partitioning for transferable graph representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HP-JEPA，一种用于图自监督学习的分层多分辨率联合嵌入预测框架，通过整合不同粒度的结构信息，在多个基准数据集上优于固定分辨率基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的图联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）通常依赖于单一预定义的图划分，导致学习到的表示偏向于某种特定的结构粒度，限制了其在不同图尺度上捕获互补模式的能力。
AI.method: 提出HP-JEPA框架：1）将每个图组织成从粗到细的有序划分分辨率库；2）在每个分辨率上独立执行上下文-目标潜在预测，使用在线编码器、指数移动平均目标编码器和潜在预测器；3）通过拼接或任务特定的分辨率加权来整合分辨率特定的图表示。
AI.result: 在7个图分类基准和1个图回归基准上，HP-JEPA在8个任务中的6个上优于固定分辨率的Graph-JEPA基线。分层分析显示在三个代表性数据集的大多数图大小四分位数上，HP-JEPA准确率高于Graph-JEPA。
AI.conclusion: 分层多分辨率划分对于可迁移图表示学习具有有效性，能够更好地结合局部、区域和全局结构信息，从而提升下游任务性能。

title: Epico: Long-Lived WebAssembly Components for High-Performance Serverless Stream Processing
comment: Paper peer reviewed and accepted by the 21st Workshop on Virtualization, Containers, and Resource Isolation for Supercomputer AI Co-located with Euro-Par 2026, it will appear in the proceeding of Euro-Par 2026 conference
summary: While serverless computing is popular, its dominant Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) model is ill-suited for stream processing because its stateless, centrally orchestrated functions cannot efficiently handle continuous, low-latency event flows. We introduce Epico, a serverless runtime explicitly designed to resolve these inefficiencies at the runtime level. Epico executes pipeline stages as persistent WebAssembly components, enabling independent, zero-to-infinity autoscaling based on queue-depth SLOs and routing events directly between stages using broker-free ZeroMQ channels. To optimize short execution paths, it utilizes a credit-based sliding window to amortize inter-process communication costs. Evaluations demonstrate that Ahead-of-Time (AOT) compilation reduces cold-start latencies from hundreds of milliseconds to sub-millisecond ranges, while the credit window improves single-worker throughput by up to \(4.3\times\). Compared to Apache OpenWhisk, Epico bypasses the orchestrator bottlenecks and container overheads that typically hinder FaaS streaming workloads.

AI.tldr: 提出了Epico，一种面向流处理的无服务器运行时，通过持久化WebAssembly组件、无代理直接路由和信用滑动窗口机制，解决了传统FaaS在流处理场景下的低效问题，实现了亚毫秒级冷启动和显著吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 现有无服务器计算的主流FaaS模型因无状态、中心化编排特性，难以高效处理连续、低延迟的事件流，无法满足流处理需求。
AI.method: 将流水线阶段作为持久化WebAssembly组件执行；采用无代理ZeroMQ通道实现阶段间直接路由；引入基于信用的滑动窗口分摊进程间通信开销；使用AOT编译优化冷启动。
AI.result: AOT编译将冷启动延迟从数百毫秒降至亚毫秒级；信用窗口使单工作者吞吐量提升最高4.3倍；相比Apache OpenWhisk，有效规避了编排器瓶颈与容器开销。
AI.conclusion: Epico证明了通过运行时层面的针对性设计，可以根本性解决FaaS在流处理工作负载中的性能瓶颈，为无服务器流处理提供了高效可行的新范式。

title: Predictive Exposure and Cryptographic Readiness: A Vendor-Neutral Framework, a, Bounded Multivocal Evidence Analysis, and Reproducible Synthetic Evaluation for SD-WAN Environments
comment: 14 pages, IEEE two-column format, 9 tables. Multivocal evidence review and reproducible synthetic evaluation
summary: SD-WAN teams often use static severity scores to decide what to fix first. These scores do not show live exploitation, network exposure, attack paths, business impact, or cryptographic migration risk. This study asks whether a vendor-neutral PECR framework can produce a different and more traceable ranking than CVSS alone. We reviewed 19 DOI-verified publications from 2020-2026 and five current NIST documents. The review supported ten normalized factors, one weighted score, and a separate confidence measure. We then compared equal-weight PECR with CVSS in five synthetic cases. The tests used Kendall's $τ_b$, mean absolute rank shift (MARS), top-three Jaccard overlap ($J_3$), factor removal, and bounded weight changes. CVSS ranked the cases A-D-B-E-C. PECR ranked them A-B-E-C-D. The results were $τ_b = 0.40$, MARS = 1.2, and $J_3 = 0.50$. The exact $τ$ test was not significant ($p = 0.483$) because the sample had only five cases. The PECR order remained unchanged in 87.5% of 1,024 weight combinations. It also remained unchanged in eight of ten single-factor removal tests. The evidence supports separate measures for severity, exploitation, and organizational context. Evidence for live SD-WAN attack paths and daily PQC triage is still limited. PECR can produce a different and auditable ranking. This synthetic test does not prove better operational results or better human understanding.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种供应商中立的PECR框架，用于SD-WAN漏洞优先级排序，通过纳入实时利用、网络暴露、攻击路径等因素，产生了与CVSS不同的可审计排序结果。
AI.motivation: SD-WAN团队通常使用静态严重性评分来决定修复优先级，但这些评分未反映实时利用情况、网络暴露、攻击路径、业务影响或加密迁移风险，缺乏可追溯性。
AI.method: 回顾了2020-2026年间19篇DOI验证的出版物和5份NIST当前文档，构建了包含10个标准化因子、一个加权评分和独立置信度度量的PECR框架，并通过5个合成案例与CVSS进行对比测试，使用Kendall's τ_b、MARS、J_3重叠度等指标评估。
AI.result: CVSS排序为A-D-B-E-C，PECR排序为A-B-E-C-D；τ_b=0.40，MARS=1.2，J_3=0.50；PECR排序在87.5%的权重组合中保持稳定，在10个单因子移除测试中有8个保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持对严重性、利用情况和组织上下文采用独立度量，PECR可产生不同且可审计的排序，但该合成测试未能证明更好的运营效果或更好的人类理解，实时SD-WAN攻击路径和日常PQC分类的证据仍然有限。

title: Geometric Self-Supervised Pre-training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary:
Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) techniques have emerged as a highly efficient alternative to traditional exact algorithms for solving routing problems such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). However, the generalization capabilities of these Reinforcement Learning-based models are severely hindered when scaling to high-dimensional instances. This issue has been mitigated in other domains, like computer vision and natural language processing, by adopting a self-supervised pre-training strategy. Nevertheless, its application to routing graphs, which lack complex topological attributes beyond 2D spatial coordinates, remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose a geometric self-supervised pre-training framework specifically designed to capture spatial invariance and global relative distance distributions. By applying isometric transformations, such as rotations and axial reflections, the model learns robust structural representations prior to the policy optimization phase. Empirical results demonstrate that this strategy consistently outperforms models trained from scratch (baselines), achieving a 7.23\% improvement in tour length for massive zero-shot extrapolation scenarios (TSP1,000). Furthermore, the proposed model exhibits remarkable computational efficiency, delivering speedups of up to two orders of magnitude over the exact solver Concorde at massive scales.
  The source code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/davidaguadocosano/TSP-GeoPretrain.git.

AI.tldr: 提出了针对路由问题的几何自监督预训练框架，通过等距变换学习鲁棒的结构表示，在TSP1000上比从头训练提升7.23%，比精确求解器快两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 基于强化学习的神经组合优化方法在扩展到高维实例时泛化能力严重受限，而自监督预训练策略在其他领域（如计算机视觉和自然语言处理）已成功缓解此问题，但在缺乏复杂拓扑属性的路由图上应用仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出几何自监督预训练框架，通过旋转和轴对称反射等等距变换，专门设计以捕获空间不变性和全局相对距离分布，使模型在策略优化阶段之前学习鲁棒的结构表示。
AI.result: 在TSP1000大规模零样本外推场景中，路径长度比从头训练的基线模型持续提升7.23%；在大规模问题上相比精确求解器Concorde实现高达两个数量级的加速。
AI.conclusion: 几何自监督预训练策略有效提升了神经组合优化模型在高维路由问题上的泛化性能和计算效率，为路由问题的预训练方法提供了新的解决方案。

title: Agentic Graph Token Reasoning
summary: Graphs model relational data throughout science and industry, from citation networks to product co-purchase graphs. Because the nodes of many such graphs carry rich text, a growing line of work applies large language models (LLMs) to graph analysis. The most graph-native of these methods use graph tokens: a graph encoder compresses a graph view, such as a node, its k-hop neighbourhood, or a cluster, into a short block of continuous tokens that jointly encodes node attributes and topology and is read directly by the model. Existing methods, however, use graph tokens in a static single-shot manner: they encode one predefined graph view before the model has even seen the target and never revise it, leaving the model's step-by-step reasoning ability unused. We introduce agentic graph token reasoning, which recasts graph tokenization as part of the reasoning process itself. At each step, the model chooses which graph view to encode and at what granularity; a graph encoder is invoked on demand to materialise the corresponding graph tokens; and the resulting block is spliced into the running context. The model thus reasons step by step in the graph token space, and the tokens it reads are trajectory-dependent. We realise this with a three-stage training pipeline: (i) self-supervised tasks that teach the model to read heterogeneous graph tokens, (ii) a token-robust trajectory stage with a graph-token consistency regulariser, and (iii) preference optimisation that rewards trajectories in which the graph-token evidence and the node-text evidence agree. Across evaluations spanning seven graph domains, our models outperform a broad set of baselines by a large margin and transfer zero-shot to unseen domains without any per-target fine-tuning. More broadly, this work pushes LLM-based graph analysis from static graph-token encoders towards a graph-native agent paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了智能体图令牌推理方法，将图令牌化过程融入推理流程，使模型能够动态选择编码视图并在图令牌空间中进行逐步推理，在七个图领域的评估中显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的图分析方法采用静态单次图令牌编码，即在模型看到目标之前就编码预定义的图视图且不再修订，未能利用模型的逐步推理能力。这种静态方法无法根据具体任务动态调整编码策略，限制了模型在复杂图分析任务中的表现。
AI.method: 提出智能体图令牌推理框架，将图令牌化重构为推理过程的一部分。在每一步，模型选择编码哪个图视图及其粒度，按需调用图编码器生成相应图令牌，并将结果拼接到运行上下文中。实现采用三阶段训练流程：(i)自监督任务教会模型读取异构图令牌；(ii)具有图令牌一致性正则化的令牌鲁棒轨迹阶段；(iii)偏好优化，奖励图令牌证据与节点文本证据一致的轨迹。
AI.result: 在跨越七个图领域的评估中，该模型大幅优于广泛的基线方法集合，并且无需任何针对目标的微调即可零样本迁移到未见过的领域。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将基于LLM的图分析从静态图令牌编码器推向了图原生智能体范式，证明了动态、交互式图令牌推理的有效性，为未来图与语言模型的深度融合提供了新方向。

title: Greedy-Like Defective Coloring: Distributed Algorithms and Applications
summary: A $d$-defective $c$-coloring of a graph $G=(V,E)$ is a coloring of the nodes $V$ with $c$ colors such that every node has at most $d$ neighbors of the same color. Distributed algorithms for computing different variants of defective coloring are at the core of most deterministic state-of-the-art distributed coloring algorithms, and they are also an important tool in many other distributed graph algorithms. In several cases, the overall complexity could be improved if some version of defective coloring could be solved more efficiently. Barenboim and Elkin [STOC '09] introduced a two-pass greedy algorithm that uses $p^2$ colors with defect $\lfloor Δ/p\rfloor$ in $O(Δ+\log^{\ast} n)$ rounds. This remains the best defect/color tradeoff for $O(\log^{\ast} n)$-time algorithms in bounded-degree graphs. This paper expands the capabilities of this two-pass algorithm. First, we generalize it to the \emph{list defective coloring} problem (Fuchs and Kuhn, [DISC '23]). Consequently, we obtain an alternative algorithm for computing a proper $(Δ+1)$-coloring in $\tilde{O}(\sqrtΔ) + O(\log^{\ast} n)$ rounds in the CONGEST model. Second, we analyze a generalized two-pass algorithm for standard defective colorings. We prove that if the number of colors $c$ is not a perfect square, we can improve the state-of-the-art defect for distributed $c$-colorings by a constant factor in most cases. However, we also prove a limitation: for any $c\geq 1$, this generalized algorithm cannot achieve a $c$-coloring with defect below $(1-o(1))\cdotΔ/\sqrt{c}$.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Barenboim和Elkin的经典两遍贪婪缺陷着色算法，将其推广到列表缺陷着色问题，并改进了非完全平方数颜色数量情况下的缺陷界限。
AI.motivation: 缺陷着色是大多数确定性分布式着色算法的核心，也是许多其他分布式图算法的重要工具。现有的两遍贪婪算法在O(log* n)时间内使用p²种颜色实现缺陷⌊Δ/p⌋，这一缺陷/颜色权衡在O(log* n)时间算法中仍是最优的。为了提高整体算法复杂度，需要更高效地解决缺陷着色问题。
AI.method: 首先将经典两遍贪婪算法推广到列表缺陷着色问题（Fuchs和Kuhn [DISC '23]提出的问题）。其次，分析针对标准缺陷着色的广义两遍算法，研究当颜色数c不是完全平方数时能否改进现有缺陷界限。
AI.result: （1）获得了在CONGEST模型下计算正常(Δ+1)着色的替代算法，时间复杂度为Õ(√Δ) + O(log* n)轮。（2）证明了当颜色数c不是完全平方数时，大多数情况下可以将分布式c着色的缺陷改进常数因子。（3）证明了算法的理论限制：对于任意c≥1，广义算法无法实现缺陷低于(1-o(1))·Δ/√c的c着色。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功扩展了两遍贪婪缺陷着色算法的能力，包括推广到列表缺陷着色和改进非完全平方数颜色情况下的缺陷界限，同时确立了该方法的根本限制，为分布式着色算法提供了新的理论工具和界限认知。

title: Cross-Layer Optimization and System-Level Design of Next-Generation Wireless Networks via Intelligent RAN Control
summary: Recent years have seen the evolution of the traditional Radio Access Network (RAN) toward more open, programmable, disaggregated, and intelligent architectures, known as an Open RAN. Future Next Generation (NextG) networks are envisioned to be AI-native, enabling data-driven closed-loop optimization of Base Station resources, while Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) emerge as key enablers for wireless propagation and spectral efficiency toward 6G and beyond. This dissertation focuses on the design, optimization, and experimental evaluation of NextG RANs integrating Open RAN principles, data-driven control loops, and intelligent resource allocation. The work emphasizes cross-layer optimization, including energy-efficient power control, and explores AI-driven network slicing, scheduling, and link adaptation, demonstrating NextG RANs reconfigurable in real time to meet 6G requirements, first analyzing architectural enablers and modeling frameworks, then prototyping and evaluating solutions on experimental platforms and Digital Twins. Main contributions include: (i) Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) solutions for network slicing and scheduling; (ii) PandORA, a framework for automatic design, training, and deployment of DRL-based Open RAN applications on the Colosseum wireless network emulator; (iii) physical-layer RIS channel modeling and optimized resource allocation across spectrum bands; (iv) system-level evaluation of RIS-assisted channels for eMBB and URLLC traffic; (v) integration of RIS within Open RAN; (vi) online RL solutions for link adaptation; and (vii) spectrum sharing between cellular and Non-Terrestrial Network links via power control and beamforming. This work provides algorithmic designs, frameworks, and validation from simulation and hardware-in-the-loop emulation to over-the-air 5G testbed experiments, addressing industry and academic needs for wireless research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向6G的下一代无线接入网（NextG RAN）设计，通过深度强化学习（DRL）实现网络切片与调度优化，开发了PandORA框架实现DRL应用在Open RAN上的自动部署，并结合可重构智能表面（RIS）技术提升频谱效率，为未来AI原生网络架构提供了系统性解决方案。
AI.motivation: 随着无线接入网（RAN）向开放、可编程、解耦和智能化的Open RAN架构演进，未来6G网络需要实现AI原生的数据驱动闭环优化。同时，可重构智能表面（RIS）作为提升无线传播和频谱效率的关键技术，需要与Open RAN架构深度集成。现有研究缺乏跨层优化的系统化方案和实验验证，亟需设计能够满足6G需求的智能化RAN架构。
AI.method: 采用跨层优化方法，设计基于深度强化学习（DRL）的网络切片和调度解决方案；开发PandORA框架，在Colosseum无线网络仿真器上实现DRL应用的自动化设计、训练和部署；建立物理层RIS信道模型并优化跨频谱资源分配；将RIS集成到Open RAN架构中；采用在线强化学习解决链路自适应问题；通过功率控制和波束赋形实现蜂窝网络与非地面网络之间的频谱共享。研究涵盖仿真、硬件在环仿真到空中5G测试床实验的完整验证流程。
AI.result: 成功实现了DRL网络切片和调度解决方案；PandORA框架实现了DRL应用在Open RAN上的自动化部署；完成RIS辅助信道的系统级评估，验证了对eMBB和URLLC业务的支持；实现了RIS与Open RAN的集成；开发了在线RL链路自适应方案；实现了蜂窝与非地面网络链路的频谱共享。所有方案均通过仿真、硬件在环仿真和空中5G测试床实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为下一代无线接入网提供了完整的算法设计、框架开发和实验验证，成功将Open RAN原则、数据驱动控制循环和智能资源分配集成到统一架构中。研究成果满足了6G网络的实时可重配置需求，为学术界和工业界的无线研究提供了从仿真到实际部署的系统性解决方案，推动了AI原生网络架构的发展。

title: RF-HOI: Recognize Human-Object Interaction with Radio Frequency Signals
summary: Recognizing Human-Object Interactions (HOI) is essential for intelligent systems, underpinning applications in virtual and augmented reality, embodied AI, and assistive robotics. However, vision-based HOI methods face challenges in privacy concerns and poor light conditions. In this work, we introduce RF-HOI, the first framework that only uses radio frequency (RF) signals for HOI recognition. A key challenge of RF-HOI is that single-modality RF sensing is insufficient to recognize both actions and the objects being interacted with. RF-HOI addresses this through a novel modality fusion that combines mmWave radar and RFID, enabling simultaneous action recognition and target identification. Another challenge is limited training data across diverse setups, which impairs the generalizability of the recognition model. To overcome this, we develop a simulator that synthesizes multimodal RF data for diverse HOIs at scale, allowing us to fine-tune with only a small amount of real-world data. Experiment results show that RF-HOI outperforms all baselines, approaching vision model performance, and that our diverse synthetic training data can significantly boost our system's performance on real-world scenarios. These results highlight the potential of multimodal RF sensing for robust and privacy-preserving HOI recognition as well as the effectiveness of our RF data synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RF-HOI，首个仅使用射频信号进行人-物交互识别的框架，通过融合毫米波雷达和RFID信号实现动作识别和目标识别，并开发了模拟器生成大规模合成数据以解决训练数据不足问题，实验表明其性能接近视觉模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的人-物交互识别方法面临隐私问题和光照条件限制，而单模态射频感知难以同时识别动作和交互物体，且跨场景训练数据有限影响模型泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出RF-HOI框架，采用新颖的模态融合策略结合毫米波雷达和RFID，实现同步动作识别和目标识别；开发模拟器大规模合成多模态射频数据，仅需少量真实数据微调即可适配实际场景。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，RF-HOI性能超越所有基线方法，接近视觉模型性能，多样化的合成训练数据能显著提升系统在真实场景中的表现。
AI.conclusion: 多模态射频感知在鲁棒且隐私保护的人-物交互识别方面具有巨大潜力，射频数据合成方法有效可行。

title: Crushing the Evidence: A Dual-Penalty Evasion Framework for Fooling White-Box Explainable AI Auditors
summary: Post-hoc model explainers such as LIME, SHAP, and Integrated Gradients are widely deployed to audit models in high-stakes sensitive domains, including finance, healthcare, and social welfare. This ensures the model's transparency and acceptability. However, a few studies have examined potential attacks in the explainability pipeline. Adversaries can attempt to conceal algorithmic biases or backdoors using adversarial explanation attacks. These attacks have relied on scaffolding out-of-distribution (OOD) detectors that toggle predictions when queried by an explainer. Consequently, defenses have been developed to successfully neutralize these black-box attacks by identifying their anomalous perturbation footprints. In this paper, we demonstrate a critical vulnerability by introducing a more potent white-box, gradient-regularized evasion attack framework. By employing a continuous-embedding dual-penalty framework, we directly penalize trigger feature gradients during training on in-distribution data. Since our approach embeds the evasion logic natively into the model parameters, without relying on OOD scaffolding wrappers, it generates smooth, in-distribution predictions that leave no anomaly footprint. Empirical evaluations across four benchmark tabular datasets (COMPAS, German Credit, IEEE-CIS, and Communities & Crime) confirm that our method systematically crushes target feature attribution to near-zero (<0.02), maintains >90% Attack Success Rates, and fundamentally bypasses Conditional Anomaly Detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种更强大的白盒对抗性解释攻击框架，能够绕过现有的防御机制，在保持高攻击成功率的同时将目标特征归因压制到接近零。
AI.motivation: 现有的后 hoc 模型解释器（如LIME、SHAP）被广泛用于审计高风险领域的模型，但对抗者可以通过对抗性解释攻击来隐藏算法偏见或后门。现有攻击依赖OOD检测器，容易被防御方法通过识别异常扰动足迹来防御。本文旨在发现这一漏洞并提出更有效的攻击方法。
AI.method: 提出白盒、梯度正则化的逃避攻击框架，采用连续嵌入双惩罚机制，在训练过程中直接惩罚触发特征梯度。该方法将逃避逻辑原生嵌入模型参数中，不依赖OOD包装器，生成平滑的分布内预测。
AI.result: 在四个基准表格数据集（COMPAS、German Credit、IEEE-CIS和Communities & Crime）上的实验表明，该方法能将目标特征归因压制到接近零（<0.02），保持超过90%的攻击成功率，并成功绕过条件异常检测。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了现有防御机制的关键漏洞，证明了不依赖OOD检测器的原生嵌入攻击方法能够有效规避检测，对模型可解释性审计的安全性提出了新的挑战。

title: Analyzing GPU Performance in Virtualized Environments: A~Case Study
summary: The graphics processing unit (GPU) plays a crucial role in boosting application performance and enhancing computational tasks. Thanks to its parallel architecture and energy efficiency, the GPU has become essential in many computing scenarios. On the other hand, the advent of GPU virtualization has been a significant breakthrough, as it provides scalable and adaptable GPU resources for virtual machines. However, this technology faces challenges in debugging and analyzing the performance of GPU-accelerated applications. Most current performance tools do not support virtual GPUs (vGPUs), highlighting the need for more advanced tools. Thus, this article introduces a novel performance analysis tool that is designed for systems using vGPUs. Our tool is compatible with the Intel GVT-g virtualization solution, although its underlying principles can apply to many vGPU-based systems. Our tool uses software tracing techniques to gather detailed runtime data and generate relevant performance metrics. It also offers many synchronized graphical views, which gives practitioners deep insights into GVT-g operations and helps them identify potential performance bottlenecks in vGPU-enabled virtual machines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对虚拟GPU(vGPU)系统的性能分析工具，解决了现有工具不支持vGPU的问题，通过软件追踪技术实现了对Intel GVT-g虚拟化方案的深度性能分析。
AI.motivation: GPU虚拟化技术虽然提供了可扩展和自适应的GPU资源，但在调试和分析GPU加速应用性能方面面临挑战。当前大多数性能分析工具不支持虚拟GPU(vGPU)，这凸显了对先进工具的需求。
AI.method: 开发了一个针对vGPU系统的性能分析工具，采用软件追踪技术收集详细的运行时数据并生成相关的性能指标。该工具与Intel GVT-g虚拟化解决方案兼容，其底层原理可应用于多种基于vGPU的系统。提供了多个同步的图形化视图。
AI.result: 工具能够收集详细的运行时数据并生成性能指标，通过多个同步的图形化视图，为实践者提供对GVT-g操作的深入洞察，帮助他们识别启用vGPU的虚拟机中的潜在性能瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 该工具填补了vGPU性能分析领域的空白，为虚拟化环境中的GPU性能优化提供了有效解决方案，具有重要的实用价值。

title: Energy-Latency Trade-offs in O-RAN with Distributed Baseband Processing and AI Inference
summary: The Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) architecture introduces flexible functional splits and open interfaces that enable distributed and centralized deployment of baseband processing. While this flexibility offers opportunities for improved resource utilization, it also introduces fundamental trade-offs between energy efficiency and latency. In this paper, we develop a throughput-based end-to-end energy consumption model for O-RAN and extend it by incorporating detailed latency modeling and application-specific Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning inference costs. The proposed end-to-end modeling framework provides a general representation of processing, transport, and inference-related energy and delay across the access, metro, and long-haul network segments. Building on this general model, we formulate an optimization problem that selects the placement of baseband processing and AI inference tasks across candidate O-RAN configurations to analyze energy-latency tradeoffs under network load, server frequency, and energy-budget constraints. Using representative hardware platforms and realistic traffic assumptions, we evaluate multiple baseband processing placements corresponding to different O-RAN functional configurations. Our results reveal how user quality of service requirements and network load conditions jointly determine the optimal placement of baseband processing and AI inference tasks, highlighting the inherent trade-off between energy efficiency and latency. The analysis provides practical insights for latency-aware and energy-efficient O-RAN deployments supporting emerging AI-driven services.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向O-RAN的端到端能耗建模框架，将详细的延迟建模和AI/ML推理成本纳入考量，揭示了能量效率与延迟之间的内在权衡关系。
AI.motivation: O-RAN架构通过灵活的功能拆分和开放接口实现了基带处理的分布式和集中式部署，虽然这种灵活性提供了改善资源利用率的机会，但也引入了能效与延迟之间的基本权衡问题，需要建立全面的建模框架来分析和优化这一权衡。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于吞吐量的端到端能耗模型，并通过整合详细的延迟建模和特定应用的AI/ML推理成本进行扩展。该框架提供了接入、城域和长距离网段中处理、传输和推理相关能耗与延迟的通用表示。基于此模型，构建了一个优化问题，在网络负载、服务器频率和能耗预算约束下选择基带处理和AI推理任务的部署位置。
AI.result: 在代表性硬件平台和实际流量假设下，评估了对应不同O-RAN功能配置的多种基带处理部署方案。结果表明，用户服务质量要求和网络负载条件共同决定了基带处理和AI推理任务的最优部署位置，揭示了能效与延迟之间的内在权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 该分析为支持新兴AI驱动服务的延迟感知和能效O-RAN部署提供了实用见解，指导运营商根据具体的服务质量要求和网络负载条件优化基带处理和AI推理任务的部署策略。

title: WM-Cov: Test Adequacy for Interactive World-Model-Style Autonomous Driving Simulation
summary: World models and generative simulators are emerging as interactive testing infrastructure for autonomous driving because they can react to the ego planner and produce counterfactual, rare, and safety-critical rollouts. This changes a test scenario from a fixed replayed trajectory into an interactive scenario family whose realized evolution depends on the planner under test. The unresolved question is therefore not only whether dangerous rollouts can be generated, but what valid closed-loop evidence is enough to support a specified testing intent and stopping decision. This paper formulates interactive world-model-style testing adequacy and introduces WM-Cov, a provider-agnostic evaluation layer that converts raw provider outputs into requested, realized, and valid evidence. WM-Cov reports adequacy through coverage growth, valid-failure discovery, failure-mode diversity, realism, artifact suppression, duplicate accounting, and valid-evidence precision. Studies on executed TeraSim/SUMO events, WM-like mixed trace pools, and a real DriveArena TrafficManager--WorldDreamer matrix show that dangerous-looking events can include valid ADS failures, duplicates, partial realizations, and artifacts. The DriveArena matrix evaluates two planners, two horizons, six prompt conditions, and 360 ego-route requests; 304 attempts become fully realized evidence and 56 remain partial. A disjoint 80-request route-slice check yields 74 fully realized and 6 partial attempts. The results support evaluating world-model-style testing by convergence of valid interactive evidence under budget, rather than by raw generated failures or prompt coverage alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了WM-Cov框架，用于评估基于世界模型的自动驾驶测试的充分性，通过多种指标将原始输出转化为有效的闭环证据，而非仅关注原始生成的失败案例。
AI.motivation: 世界模型和生成式模拟器正成为自动驾驶交互式测试的基础设施，能够产生反事实、罕见和安全关键的推演。然而，未解决的问题不仅是能否生成危险推演，而是什么样的有效闭环证据足以支持特定的测试意图和停止决策。
AI.method: 本文提出WM-Cov，一个提供商无关的评估层，将原始提供商输出转换为请求、实现和有效的证据。WM-Cov通过覆盖率增长、有效失败发现、失败模式多样性、真实性、伪影抑制、重复计算和有效证据精度来报告测试充分性。
AI.result: 在TeraSim/SUMO事件、类世界模型混合轨迹池以及真实DriveArena TrafficManager-WorldDreamer矩阵上的研究表明，看似危险的事件可能包含有效ADS故障、重复、部分实现和伪影。在DriveArena矩阵评估中（2个规划器、2个视界、6种提示条件、360个自我路线请求），304次尝试成为完全实现的证据，56次仍为部分实现。在不相交的80请求路线切片检查中，74次完全实现，6次部分尝试。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持通过有效交互证据在预算约束下的收敛性来评估世界模型风格的测试，而非仅通过原始生成故障或提示覆盖率来评估。

title: Fairness Auditing: Lower Bounds on Company Manipulation
summary: Fairness audits are increasingly mandated in high-stakes applications such as hiring, lending, and automated decision-making. Recent work has established fundamental impossibility results for black-box fairness auditing, showing that sufficiently expressive models can evade any auditing strategy. We complement these results by quantifying the extent of unavoidable post-audit manipulation under finite audit resources. We formulate fairness auditing as a min-max optimization between a computationally unbounded company and a budget-constrained auditor. We study two auditing regimes: (i) a budgeted auditor that certifies fairness using a fixed-size audit set, and (ii) a budgeted α-tolerant auditor that additionally requires the audit set to estimate the fairness of the certified model within an α approximation. For both settings, we derive explicit lower bounds on the worst-case post-audit demographic parity deviation as functions of the audit budget, group imbalance, and fairness tolerance. Finally, we empirically illustrate these theoretical limits using simple audit-set construction heuristics with linear and neural network classifiers. Our results demonstrate that increasing audit resources reduces, but does not eliminate, the scope for post-audit manipulation, highlighting fundamental limitations of finite-budget fairness certification.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了有限审计资源下公平性审计后不可避免的操纵程度，为预算约束的公平性认证建立了理论基础。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已证明黑盒公平性审计存在根本性的不可能结果，即表达能力足够强的模型可以逃避任何审计策略。然而，这些理论结果缺乏对有限审计资源下可避免的操纵程度的量化分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，量化审计资源有限时的不可避免的后审计操纵范围。
AI.method: 将公平性审计建模为计算能力无界的公司与预算约束的审计员之间的最小-最大优化问题。研究两种审计机制：（i）使用固定大小审计集的预算约束审计员；（ii）额外要求审计集在α近似范围内估计认证模型公平性的预算约束α容忍审计员。为两种场景推导了后审计人口统计差异偏差的显式下界。
AI.result: 获得了最坏情况下后审计人口统计差异偏差的下界，这些下界是审计预算、群体不平衡和公平性容忍度的显式函数。经验实验（使用线性和神经网络分类器）验证了这些理论界限。结果表明增加审计资源可以减少但不能消除后审计操纵的范围。
AI.conclusion: 有限预算公平性认证存在根本性局限。虽然增加审计资源可以降低操纵范围，但无法完全消除后审计操纵，这为高 stakes 应用中的公平性审计实践提供了重要的理论指导。

title: Emulation vs Simulation: A Case Study from Congestion Control Algorithms in Low Earth Orbit Satellite Networks
summary: Evaluating congestion control is inherently challenging because performance depends on the interaction between the congestion-control algorithm, transport stack, application behaviour, measurement process, and network dynamics. This challenge is growing as state-of-the-art protocols incorporate pacing, selective loss recovery, model-based control, and, more recently, reinforcement learning. Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite networks are a particularly demanding setting: rapidly changing paths, handovers, non-congestive loss, RTT variation, and transient hotspots all affect transport behaviour. This paper reports the lessons learned from an extensive evaluation campaign across both simulation and emulation for LEO satellite congestion control. We compare multiple classes of congestion-control algorithms, including Cubic, BBR variants, LEO-specific protocols, and reinforcement-learning-based control, using comparable implementations across OMNeT++/INET simulation and Mininet-based emulation with the Linux transport stack. This gives us a rare opportunity to examine not only protocol performance, but also the methodological strengths and limitations of each experimental environment. Our findings show that simulation is indispensable for constellation-scale exploration, controlled parameter sweeps, and future deployment studies, but can miss behaviours caused by production transport-stack mechanisms such as pacing, SACK, RACK, kernel timing, and rate sampling. Emulation exposes these implementation-dependent effects and provides a necessary validation step, but is harder to scale and less exactly repeatable. We distil these experiences into practical lessons for combining simulation and emulation to obtain results that are scalable, reproducible, and deployment-relevant.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模仿真与模拟实验，系统评估了LEO卫星网络中多种拥塞控制算法（包括Cubic、BBR系列、LEO专用协议及强化学习方法），总结了仿真与模拟环境的互补优势与局限，并提出了结合两者的实践方法。
AI.motivation: 拥塞控制评估面临诸多挑战，算法性能受传输栈、应用行为、测量过程及网络动态等多因素影响。随着现代协议引入pacing、选择性丢包恢复、模型控制及强化学习等技术，评估复杂度进一步提升。LEO卫星网络因其路径快速变化、频繁切换、非拥塞丢包、RTT波动及瞬态热点等特性，成为极具挑战性的评估场景。
AI.method: 研究在OMNeT++/INET仿真环境与基于Mininet的模拟环境（使用Linux传输栈）中开展了大规模对比实验。评估对象涵盖多类拥塞控制算法：Cubic、BBR系列、LEO专用协议及强化学习控制方法。通过在两种环境中采用可比较的实现，研究者能够同时考察协议性能表现以及不同实验环境在方法论层面的优势与局限。
AI.result: 仿真在星座规模的探索、受控参数扫描及未来部署研究方面不可或缺，但可能遗漏生产级传输栈机制（如pacing、SACK、RACK、内核定时及速率采样）引发的行为特性。模拟环境能够揭示这些实现相关的影响，并提供必要的验证步骤，但在可扩展性方面面临困难且可重复性较差。研究提炼了结合仿真与模拟的实践经验，以获得可扩展、可复现且具有部署相关性的评估结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，仿真与模拟环境各有不可替代的价值：仿真适合大规模、可控、面向未来的研究；模拟则揭示真实实现细节。两者结合是实现可扩展、可复现、面向部署的LEO卫星拥塞控制评估的关键。本文的经验教训为后续研究提供了方法论的实践指导。

title: CrystalMem: Elastic Memory for Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Knowledge Crystallization
summary: Memory for self-evolving large language model (LLM) agents is often provisioned as if its byte budget only grows. Cloud platforms, however, adjust quotas with load and cost, and we show that capability does not follow the budget back up: after a squeeze-and-recover cycle, the agent settles below its pre-squeeze level, a gap we call memory hysteresis. The cause is structural. Deletion and one-way compression discard the material needed for later rebuilding, and we prove that any policy that only keeps or drops entries carries a residual-deficit floor. We propose CrystalMem (Crystallized Memory), an elastic memory sidecar that demotes entries across four fidelity states under a crystallization-energy schedule, orders demotions by advantage-weighted influence with dependency coupling, and recovers capability through verified recrystallization under explicit compute and byte caps. Across seven environments, seventeen methods, and six backbones, with multi-tenant serving and a physical edge-cloud deployment, CrystalMem achieves the highest restored capability in every setting and closes the loop left open by every baseline. From a 50% byte budget, CrystalMem matches the strongest budgeted baseline at full provision on every environment; at equal budgets, it leads by +4.6 pp on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrystalMem，一种弹性内存架构，通过多保真度状态转换和验证重结晶机制，有效解决了LLM智能体在内存预算波动后出现的"记忆滞后"能力损失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的内存管理假设预算持续增长，但云平台会根据负载和成本调整配额。研究发现，在内存压缩-恢复周期后，智能体能力无法恢复到压缩前水平，存在"记忆滞后"现象。传统的删除和单向压缩策略丢弃了重建所需的关键信息，导致不可逆的能力损失。
AI.method: 提出CrystalMem（结晶化记忆）弹性内存边车系统：1) 采用四层保真度状态转换机制，按结晶能量调度降级条目；2) 基于优势加权影响力和依赖耦合关系排序降级顺序；3) 通过验证重结晶机制恢复能力，在显式计算和字节约束下重建记忆；实现从低保真状态可逆恢复到高保真状态。
AI.result: 在7个环境、17种方法和6个骨干模型的广泛测试中，CrystalMem在所有设置下均达到最高恢复能力。在50%字节预算下，CrystalMem在各环境上匹配全预算的最强基线；在同等预算下，平均领先+4.6个百分点，成功弥合了所有基线遗留的能力缺口。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化的多保真度内存管理，CrystalMem证明了在内存预算波动场景下实现可逆能力恢复的可行性，为资源受限环境中的LLM智能体部署提供了有效的内存弹性解决方案。

title: CoSynFlow: Conformal Symplectic Neural Flows for Cross-System Prediction of Dissipative Hamiltonian Dynamics
summary: Learning solution operators for differential equations is a central problem in scientific machine learning. However, many neural operator methods optimize prediction accuracy without explicitly enforcing the geometric structure of the dynamics. Structure-preserving models such as SympNets and Symplectic Neural Flows address this issue for conservative Hamiltonian systems by preserving the symplectic form. In dissipative Hamiltonian systems with conformal symplectic structure, however, the symplectic form evolves according to a conformal factor determined by the dissipation. We propose CoSynFlow, a conformal symplectic neural flow for learning continuous-time solution maps of dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics. CoSynFlow composes symplectic shear maps with explicit conformal scaling, preserving the conformal symplectic structure by construction. By conditioning it on a finite-dimensional Hamiltonian descriptor and the dissipation parameter, a single trained model predicts solution maps for unseen systems without retraining. CoSynFlow keeps the structure error at machine precision, attains the lowest long-horizon error, and admits physics-informed training.

AI.tldr: 提出CoSynFlow，一种保持共形辛几何结构的神经流模型，用于学习耗散哈密顿系统的解映射，在长期预测中实现最低误差且结构误差达到机器精度。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子方法在优化预测精度时未显式约束动力学几何结构；辛神经网络和辛神经流虽能保持保守哈密顿系统的辛结构，但无法处理具有共形辛结构的耗散哈密顿系统——其辛形式按由耗散决定的共形因子演化。
AI.method: 提出共形辛神经流CoSynFlow，将辛剪切映射与显式共形缩放复合，从而在构造上保持共形辛结构；通过以有限维哈密顿描述符和耗散参数为条件，单一训练模型可在无需重训练的情况下预测未见系统的解映射，并支持物理信息训练。
AI.result: CoSynFlow将结构误差控制在机器精度，取得最低的长期预测误差，并支持物理信息驱动的训练范式。
AI.conclusion: CoSynFlow成功将几何结构先验嵌入神经算子，为耗散哈密顿系统提供了长期稳定、可泛化且物理一致的解算子学习方法。

title: When Discovery Becomes a Storm: A ROS 2 Discovery Model for Wireless Robotic Networks
summary: In Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2), Data Distribution Service (DDS) participants must discover one another before exchanging data. In wireless environments, delayed or lost discovery messages cause reliability timers to expire, triggering retransmissions that intensify channel contention and further delay the delivery of discovery messages. This self-reinforcing feedback can escalate into a discovery storm. Existing models characterize discovery demand under fixed delivery conditions, but do not capture how shared-channel delay changes protocol state and generates further traffic. To address this issue, we present the first closed-loop analytical model of ROS 2 discovery that characterizes how delay-induced feedback amplifies retransmission overhead and leads to severe discovery storms. Our model represents channel contention as a shared service process, coupling message-delivery latency with receiver states and reliability timers. The model predicts both discovery completion time and per-class message counts. We validate the model through 1,350 experimental runs across 90 topology configurations. An open-loop airtime baseline captures only a fraction of the high-load completion time. The closed-loop model reproduces this rise and conservatively upper-bounds the observed high-load range. Guided by insights from the model, we further design a response-aware discovery policy that reduces mean discovery completion time by 25.3% to 39.7%.

AI.tldr: 本文首次建立了ROS 2发现的闭环分析模型，揭示了无线环境下延迟诱导的反馈如何放大重传开销并引发发现风暴，并提出了响应感知的发现策略，将平均发现完成时间减少了25.3%至39.7%。
AI.motivation: 在ROS 2系统中，DDS参与者必须相互发现后才能交换数据。在无线环境中，发现消息的延迟或丢失会导致可靠性定时器超时，触发重传，进而加剧信道争用并进一步延迟发现消息的传递。这种自我强化反馈可能会升级为发现风暴。现有模型仅在固定交付条件下表征发现需求，未能捕捉共享信道延迟如何改变协议状态并生成更多流量。
AI.method: 提出了首个ROS 2发现的闭环分析模型，将信道争用表示为共享服务过程，将消息交付延迟与接收器状态和可靠性定时器耦合。该模型能够预测发现完成时间和各类消息计数。通过1,350次实验运行和90种拓扑配置对模型进行验证。
AI.result: 开环空中时间基准仅捕获了高负载完成时间的一小部分。闭环模型重现了这一上升趋势，并保守地对观察到的高负载范围进行了上限界定。基于模型的洞察，设计了响应感知发现策略，将平均发现完成时间减少了25.3%至39.7%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的闭环分析模型成功表征了延迟诱导反馈如何放大重传开销并导致严重的发现风暴。模型不仅能够准确预测发现性能，还为设计优化策略提供了理论指导，显著改善了无线环境下ROS 2的发现效率。

title: Trust and Its Betrayal under Three Representational Strategies
summary: Trust is a propositional attitude of a distinctive kind: to trust is to rely on another under conditions where reliance could be disappointed, and the disappointment of trust---betrayal---differs qualitatively from the disappointment of a prediction. We treat trust as a \emph{subjunctive} epistemic state: $A$ trusts $B$'s competence when $A$ believes that \emph{were $P$ true, $B$ would know it}, and $B$'s integrity when $A$ believes that \emph{were $B$ to know $P$, he would disclose it to $A$}. We develop three representations of this state---as lexicographic \emph{assumption} as \emph{ordinal closeness} in a Lewis--Stalnaker sphere system , and as \emph{strong belief} in a conditional probability system and for each we ask whether the Brandenburger--Keisler impossibility on common belief survives when the assumption of rationality is replaced by an assumption of trustworthiness. The three representations agree that every \emph{finite} depth of common trust is realizable while the \emph{completed} common-trust fixed point is the locus of difficulty, but they differ sharply in \emph{how} the difficulty manifests, and---our organizing finding---in how each survives a concrete betrayal. W show that the same betrayal refutes an agent's \emph{level ordering} under the lexicographic representation, contaminates her \emph{closeness ordering} in proportion to the betrayer's deliberateness under the ordinal representation, and merely \emph{shifts her operative conditioning hypothesis} while leaving her belief structure coherent under the strong-belief representation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信任的主观认知状态定义，通过三种表示方法分析共同信任的可能性，发现有限深度的共同信任可实现，但完整固定点存在困难，且不同表示方法对背叛的反应机制显著不同。
AI.motivation: 信任是一种独特的命题态度，其失望（背叛）在性质上不同于预测的失望。现有研究缺乏对信任作为主观认知状态的精确刻画，特别是在形式化表示下分析共同信任的可行性及其对背叛的响应机制。
AI.method: 将信任定义为主观认知状态：A信任B的能力当且仅当A相信"若P为真，B会知道P"；A信任B的正直当且仅当A相信"若B知道P，B会向A披露P"。发展三种形式化表示：（1）词典式假设；（2）Lewis-Stalnaker球系统中的序数接近性；（3）条件概率系统中的强信念。对每种表示检验Brandenburger-Keisler不可能性在以可信性替代理性假设下是否成立。
AI.result: 三种表示方法一致表明：每一有限深度的共同信任均可实现，而完整的共同信任不动点是困难所在。不同表示方法在困难呈现方式和应对背叛上差异显著：词典式表示下背叛反驳主体的层序排序；序数表示下背叛按背叛者的故意程度污染接近性排序；强信念表示下背叛仅转移操作性条件假设而保持信念结构的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 信任的三种形式化表示在理论性质和实际应用上存在根本差异。词典式表示对背叛脆弱（破坏层序结构），序数表示呈现"污染"特征（严重程度取决于背叛故意性），强信念表示具有鲁棒性（维持结构一致性）。这为理解信任的形式性质及其在博弈论、认识论中的应用提供了新视角。

title: From field-scale to large-scale spectral libraries: Tabular foundation models in soil spectroscopy
summary: Visible and near-infrared (vis-NIR) and mid-infrared (MIR) spectroscopy enable rapid, cost-effective prediction of soil properties. Yet, translating high-dimensional, highly collinear spectra into accurate soil property predictions remains challenging, particularly when employing machine learning. We systematically investigated regression models and dimensionality reduction approaches for spectroscopic modeling across 85 regression tasks from open benchmark datasets in pedometrics spanning field-scale digital soil mapping and a global soil spectral library. We compared an in-context learning tabular foundation model (TabPFN), a convolutional neural network (CNN), rule-based regression (Cubist), Random Forest, and partial least squares regression (PLSR) using full spectra as well as features derived from principal component analysis (PCA) and partial least squares (PLS) latent variables. TabPFN consistently delivered the best overall performance across scales, including large spectral library tasks with tens of thousands of soil samples. Notably, TabPFN applied directly to full spectra already surpassed all classical baselines, showing that explicit dimensionality reduction is not strictly required for strong performance. Further improvements were achieved through PLS, which proved to be an effective dimensionality reduction strategy for all models. Combining PLS latent variables with TabPFN yielded the best predictions overall. Our findings provide evidence-based guidance for spectroscopic calibration model selection across operational scales, demonstrating that the long-standing advantages of PLSR and modern tabular foundation models complement each other in chemometrics.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统比较了多种机器学习模型在土壤光谱预测中的表现，发现TabPFN基础模型结合PLS降维方法在各种尺度任务中均取得最佳预测效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管可见光-近红外(vis-NIR)和中红外(MIR)光谱技术能够实现土壤属性的快速、经济预测，但将高维、高度共线性的光谱数据转化为准确的土壤属性预测仍面临挑战，特别是在应用机器学习方法时缺乏系统的模型选择指导。
AI.method: 研究在85个回归任务上系统比较了TabPFN、CNN、Cubist、随机森林和PLSR等回归模型，结合全光谱输入、PCA降维和PLS潜变量特征，数据涵盖田间尺度数字土壤制图和全球土壤光谱库。
AI.result: TabPFN在所有尺度上均表现最佳，直接应用于全光谱即可超越所有传统基线方法；PLS被证明是所有模型的有效降维策略，PLS潜变量与TabPFN结合实现了整体最优预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究为不同操作尺度的光谱校准模型选择提供了循证指导，证明了PLSR的长期优势与现代表格基础模型在化学计量学中具有互补性，无需显式降维即可获得良好性能，结合PLS降维可进一步提升预测精度。

title: Broadcast Rate Limits in Wi-Fi: A Forgotten Bottleneck for Collaborative Edge LLM Inference
summary: LLM deployment is migrating from data centers to edge devices, where Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer a promising path: sparse expert activation allows the model to be spread across multiple low-cost edge nodes. Distributed MoE inference repeatedly dispatches embeddings from one main node to many workers - a one-to-many pattern poorly served by the sequential unicasts of mainstream stacks (NCCL, TCP), yet naturally matched by UDP broadcast. We propose a UDP broadcast method for collaborative edge MoE inference, augmented with timeout-driven retransmission exploiting near deterministic latency in distributed MoE for reliability and unordered result gathering for robustness to expert mispredictions, yielding a consistent 1.4x speedup over NCCL and TCP on a wired 8-node cluster. In wireless settings, however, we uncover a deeper, long-forgotten bottleneck: IEEE 802.11 caps broadcast rates at 54 Mbps regardless of physical-layer capacity - a legacy policy built for sparse control traffic, not edge AI. NS-3 simulations at distances 1m, 2m and 5m show that the optimal rates are much higher (64x, 43x, and 32x, respectively) than the 54 Mbps cap applied in standard. Thus, we argue that broadcast is no longer a control-plane relic: it is time for Wi-Fi standards to treat it as a high-throughput data-plane citizen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于UDP广播的协作边缘MoE推理方法，相比NCCL和TCP实现了1.4倍加速；同时揭示了IEEE 802.11将广播速率限制在54 Mbps的瓶颈，并呼吁Wi-Fi标准应将广播视为高吞吐量数据平面。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型部署从数据中心向边缘设备迁移，混合专家模型通过稀疏专家激活可在多个低成本边缘节点上分布式运行。然而，分布式MoE推理中嵌入从主节点到多个工作节点的分发模式（一对多）在主流通信栈中效率低下，而UDP广播天然适合这种模式。
AI.method: 提出一种UDP广播方法用于协作边缘MoE推理，结合超时驱动的重传机制利用分布式MoE中近乎确定的延迟来保证可靠性，以及无序结果收集机制来提高对专家误预测的鲁棒性。通过有线8节点集群和NS-3无线仿真进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在有线8节点集群上，相比NCCL和TCP实现了一致的1.4倍加速。在无线设置中，发现IEEE 802.11将广播速率限制在54 Mbps，而NS-3仿真显示1米、2米和5米距离下的最优速率分别为标准上限的64倍、43倍和32倍。
AI.conclusion: UDP广播在边缘MoE推理中具有显著性能优势，但当前Wi-Fi标准中的54 Mbps广播速率限制已成为瓶颈。呼吁Wi-Fi标准组织将广播视为高吞吐量数据平面的重要组成部分，而非仅用于控制平面。

title: Learning to Coordinate Symbolic Tools: LLM Agents for Verified Sum-of-Squares Certificates
summary: Tool calling allows large language models (LLMs) to invoke external computation during problem solving, a useful capability in various fields including AI for mathematics. We study this setting through weighted sum-of-squares (SOS) decomposition, a machine-checkable route to proving polynomial nonnegativity and hence polynomial inequalities. A candidate decomposition can be checked exactly, but finding one requires choosing among non-unique regroupings and coordinating multiple symbolic transformations. We develop an agent that combines algebraic task training, symbolic tools, and verifier-grounded optimization for this task. Rather than training only on the composite SOS task, we construct 1.35 million synthetic examples covering eight supporting polynomial tasks together with weighted-SOS decomposition. We first apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to direct algebra problems and simulated symbolic traces, and then use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task-specific symbolic rewards. The SFT corpus contains no native tool-calling messages; at evaluation, the agent uses native SymPy calls for expansion, collection, reordering, and factorization. Every final SOS answer is checked by exact expansion and coefficient comparison. On held-out, same-generator synthetic problems, the full SFT+GRPO+tools system is the strongest of four evaluated configurations, reaching 78.96% verified success on weighted SOS, compared with 44.73% for the base model with the same tools, and 91.75% macro accuracy across nine polynomial tasks. Within this controlled setting, our work provides a case study of combining domain-specific skill training, executable tools, and verifier feedback, and may inform the design of tool-calling agents in other domains with exactly checkable outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了通过加权平方和分解让大语言模型调用符号计算工具来证明多项式非负性，构建了包含135万合成样本的代数任务训练体系，结合监督微调和强化学习，最终模型在加权SOS任务上达到78.96%验证成功率。
AI.motivation: 工具调用使大语言模型能够在问题求解过程中调用外部计算，这在数学AI等领域具有重要价值。加权平方和分解是一种机器可检验的证明多项式非负性的方法，虽然候选分解可以被精确检验，但找到合适的分解需要处理非唯一的重组方式并协调多个符号变换，这构成了一个具有挑战性的研究问题。
AI.method: 研究方法包括三个核心组件：1）构建包含135万个合成示例的数据集，覆盖八个支持性多项式任务和加权SOS分解；2）首先对直接代数问题和模拟符号轨迹进行监督微调，然后使用带有任务特定符号奖励的组相对策略优化进行强化学习；3）模型在评估时调用原生SymPy工具进行展开、收集、重排序和因式分解，每个最终SOS答案都通过精确展开和系数比较进行检验。
AI.result: 在留出的同分布合成问题上，完整的SFT+GRPO+工具系统在四种评估配置中表现最强：加权SOS任务达到78.96%验证成功率（相比使用相同工具的基础模型44.73%），在九个多项式任务上达到91.75%宏观准确率。
AI.conclusion: 本研究在受控环境下展示了如何结合领域特定技能训练、可执行工具和验证器反馈来构建工具调用智能体，为其他具有精确可检验输出的领域设计工具调用智能体提供了有价值的案例研究。

title: RHEA: Reliability-Harmonized Reconstruction and Assignment for Robust Multimodal-Attributed Graph Clustering
summary: Multimodal-attributed graphs (MAGs), whose nodes carry heterogeneous attributes such as text and images over a relational structure, have become a fundamental substrate for label-free entity grouping tasks, including community discovery and product segmentation. Existing MAG clustering methods effectively integrate complementary modalities when attributes are clean and complete, but degrade substantially under noisy or missing attributes because they implicitly assume equal modality reliability across all nodes. In practice, modality reliability is inherently node-specific: images may be corrupted or absent, while textual descriptions are incomplete or noisy. We argue that, under attribute homophily, graph neighborhoods naturally provide supervision-free evidence for estimating node-specific modality reliability. Based on this insight, we propose RHEA, a reliability-aware framework for MAG clustering that estimates node-specific modality reliability from neighborhood consensus and propagates this signal throughout the clustering pipeline. RHEA reconstructs unreliable or missing modalities from graph neighborhoods, adaptively weights modalities during reliability-aware fusion, and performs topology-aware optimal transport clustering with reliability-aware transport assignment and neighbor-consensus assignment distillation. Furthermore, the confidence of reconstructed representations is incorporated into the clustering objective, allowing uncertain reconstructions to contribute proportionally during optimization. Experiments on four MAG benchmarks under five attribute conditions show that RHEA consistently outperforms the strongest baseline, with NMI gains increasing as attribute quality deteriorates.

AI.tldr: 提出了RHEA框架，通过利用图邻域估计节点特定的模态可靠性并自适应融合多模态属性，有效解决了多模态属性图聚类中属性噪声或缺失的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态属性图聚类方法假设所有节点的模态可靠性相同，在属性存在噪声或缺失时性能显著下降。然而在现实中，模态可靠性具有节点特异性（如某些节点的图像可能损坏，而文本描述不完整），需要针对每个节点动态评估其模态可靠性。
AI.method: 提出RHEA框架：1) 基于邻域一致性无监督估计节点级模态可靠性；2) 从图邻域重构不可靠或缺失的模态；3) 自适应权重融合模态；4) 结合可靠性感知传输分配和邻域一致性分配蒸馏的拓扑感知最优传输聚类；5) 将重构表示的置信度纳入聚类目标函数。
AI.result: 在四个多模态属性图基准数据集和五种属性条件下的实验表明，RHEA一致性地超越最强基线，且属性质量越差，NMI提升越显著。
AI.conclusion: RHEA通过利用图邻域信息动态估计节点级模态可靠性并自适应融合多模态，有效增强了多模态属性图聚类对属性噪声和缺失的鲁棒性。

title: In-Network Market Prediction Using Machine Learning and Limit Order Books
summary: Machine learning is significantly transforming algorithmic trading, yet the requirement for rapid execution speeds persists. While both aspects aim to boost profitability, embedding advanced machine-learning techniques with reduced trading latency presents a notable challenge. Adopting in-network machine learning, which involves offloading inference to programmable network devices, offers a delicate equilibrium in this trade-off. In this paper, we present LOBIN, a solution that utilizes machine learning within the network for market prediction based on high-frequency market data feeds. LOBIN is adept at constructing limit order books and performing inference directly within programmable switches. When compared to server-based benchmarks, LOBIN not only predicts future stock price movements with higher throughput but also maintains robust machine learning performance. It achieves over a 10% reduction in latency compared to the NASDAQ order-matching server benchmark and delivers microsecond-level latency. Furthermore, the machine learning performance of LOBIN can be further enhanced through the adoption of a hybrid deployment approach that integrates both the switch and the servers. Our evaluation demonstrates that among all data feeds of evaluated stocks, the application of hybrid deployment results in approximately 45% of the traffic and 38\% of the total potential transaction value being processed within switches without server intervention, reducing latency while ensuring that the average change in error rate of predictions remains at around 3% relative to benchmarks based solely on server use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LOBIN系统，利用可编程交换机实现网络内机器学习进行市场预测，相比服务器基准降低超过10%延迟并实现微秒级响应，同时保持ML性能稳健。
AI.motivation: 算法交易中机器学习应用与快速执行速度需求之间存在矛盾：虽然两者都旨在提高盈利能力，但在嵌入先进机器学习技术的同时降低交易延迟是一个重大挑战。需要在预测精度和执行速度之间找到平衡。
AI.method: 采用网络内机器学习策略，将推理卸载到可编程网络设备。LOBIN在可编程交换机内直接构建限价订单簿并执行推理，利用高频市场数据流进行市场预测。同时提出混合部署方法，整合交换机和服务器资源。
AI.result: 相比NASDAQ订单匹配服务器基准实现超过10%的延迟降低，达到微秒级延迟；混合部署方案中约45%的流量和38%的潜在交易总值在交换机内处理无需服务器干预；预测错误率平均变化仅约3%。
AI.conclusion: LOBIN成功实现了机器学习与低延迟交易的有效融合，证明了网络内机器学习在算法交易中的可行性。混合部署策略在保证预测精度的同时显著提升了处理效率和降低了系统延迟。

title: RMSWeb: Reflection, Failure-Mode Mining, and Salvage-DS for Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures, and 6 tables. Includes appendices
summary: Compact web agents can reduce deployment cost, but training them poses challenges in both data collection and post-SFT reinforcement learning (RL). Successful trajectories are expensive to collect and often contain inefficient detours. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), full trajectory corpora are dominated by routine states; moreover, when group-relative RL is applied to web actions, inadequately designed action-level rewards can yield weak or misleading relative updates, while groups rejected as unsuitable for such updates receive no fallback learning signal. We present RMSWeb, a three-part recipe for Qwen3-VL-Instruct at 8B and 32B. Reflection-conditioned retries increase collection yield and shorten successful trajectories; failure-mode mining concentrates offline RL on critical states exposed by the SFT policy; and Salvage-DS combines an action-semantic polarized reward, contrast-and-competence-gated dynamic sampling, and an action-only anchor for rejected groups. Policies trained with reflection-collected data use up to 19.7% fewer action steps on solved tasks. On WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and WebTailBench, RMSWeb improves over SFT by 2.4-7.0 points at 8B and 1.2-7.7 points at 32B. Our 8B model also achieves the strongest reported Online-Mind2Web result among similarly sized open-weight models in our comparison and a leading reported accuracy-cost trade-off on WebVoyager and WebTailBench, with the caveat that external evaluation protocols differ.

AI.tldr: 提出了RMSWeb三部分方法来训练紧凑型网页智能体，通过反思重试、失败模式挖掘和改进的强化学习策略，在多个基准测试上显著提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 紧凑型网页智能体虽然能降低部署成本，但训练面临两大挑战：成功轨迹收集成本高昂且包含冗余路径；SFT后强化学习存在动作级奖励设计不当和拒绝组缺乏学习信号等问题。
AI.method: 提出RMSWeb三部分方法：1)反思条件重试提高收集效率并缩短成功轨迹；2)失败模式挖掘集中离线RL于关键状态；3)Salvage-DS结合动作语义极化奖励、对比-能力门控动态采样和动作锚点机制。
AI.result: 在WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web和WebTailBench基准上，8B模型相比SFT提升2.4-7.0分，32B模型提升1.2-7.7分；8B模型在类似规模开源模型中取得最佳Online-Mind2Web结果，并在准确率-成本权衡方面表现领先。
AI.conclusion: RMSWeb有效解决了紧凑型网页智能体训练中的数据收集和强化学习难题，显著提升了模型性能，证明了该方法在训练高效网页智能体方面的有效性。

title: Towards Effective Federated Multimodal Graph Learning via Navigating Multifaceted Heterogeneity
summary: Multimodal-attributed graphs (MAGs), where nodes carry heterogeneous semantic content across multiple modalities while edges encode relational dependencies, have been widely adopted across diverse domains. Federated multimodal graph learning (FMGL) extends federated graph learning (FGL) to MAGs, enabling collaborative optimization across decentralized MAGs without exposing raw data. However, naively applying existing FGL methods to FMGL is insufficient, as they fail to navigate the multifaceted heterogeneity inherent in decentralized MAGs, including task heterogeneity across diverse client objectives, modality heterogeneity from discrepant modality quality and semantic domains, and topology heterogeneity arising from divergent topological patterns with low cross-modality correlation. To address these challenges, we propose Federated multimodal graph learning with Topology-aware Cross-modal Routing (FedTCR), the first systematic algorithm designed for FMGL. To handle task heterogeneity, FedTCR employs a two-stage paradigm that comprises federated task-agnostic pre-training followed by isolated task-oriented fine-tuning. To jointly address modality and topology heterogeneity, FedTCR introduces a topology-aware cross-modal routing mechanism. Concretely, each client distills modality-specific knowledge into compact prototypes via topology-aware importance-weighted aggregation informed by graph structure; the server then evaluates cross-client cross-modal relationships among these structure-informed prototypes and routes informative ones as contrastive references, driving a tri-level cross-modal contrastive learning scheme that jointly aligns cross-client modalities while preserving discrimination. Experiments across 7 domains demonstrate that FedTCR outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on both graph-centric and modality-centric tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了FedTCR，首个针对联邦多模态图学习的系统算法，通过两阶段训练范式和拓扑感知跨模态路由机制有效处理任务、模态和拓扑异构性。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦图学习方法无法有效处理联邦多模态图学习中的多重异构性挑战：任务异构性（客户端目标差异）、模态异构性（模态质量和语义域差异）以及拓扑异构性（拓扑模式差异和低跨模态相关性）。
AI.method: 提出FedTCR算法：1）两阶段范式：联邦任务无关预训练+隔离任务导向微调处理任务异构性；2）拓扑感知跨模态路由机制：通过拓扑感知重要性加权聚合将模态特定知识蒸馏为紧凑原型，服务器评估跨客户端跨模态关系并路由信息原型作为对比参考，驱动三层跨模态对比学习方案。
AI.result: 在7个领域的实验表明，FedTCR在图中心任务和模态中心任务上均优于现有最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FedTCR成功解决了联邦多模态图学习中的多重异构性问题，为跨去中心化多模态属性图的协作优化提供了有效解决方案。

title: Reputation-driven Cooperation in Lattice-based Decentralized Federated Learning through Evolutionary Game Theory
summary: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) has emerged as an optimal privacy-preserving solution; however, it remains vulnerable to opportunistic behaviors due to the absence of a central coordinator. While Evolutionary Game Theory (EGT) serves as a powerful framework for analyzing such behaviors, existing studies often assume that agents possess perfect rationality and maintain static strategies. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel EGT framework designed to analyze strategic evolution and enhance overall system performance. The primary contributions of this work are threefold: First, we model peer-to-peer (P2P) interactions on a lattice network structure under the assumption of bounded rationality. Second, we formulate a comprehensive payoff matrix incorporating training costs, communication overhead, and cooperative rewards, while tailoring a strategy update rule that captures spatial propagation dynamics. Third, we integrate a reputation-based reward-and-punishment mechanism to effectively deter free-riding behaviors. Simulation results demonstrate that the framework significantly outperforms the baseline. Specifically, it increases average accuracy from approximately 70% to 82%, elevates cooperation frequency to approach 100% (compared to below 5% in the baseline), and drops accuracy variance from around 0.40 to 0.002, thereby accelerating uniform convergence and ensuring system stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于进化博弈论的新型框架，用于分析和优化去中心化联邦学习中的策略演化，通过引入有限理性假设和声誉机制，显著提升了系统性能和合作频率。
AI.motivation: 去中心化联邦学习虽然能够保护隐私，但由于缺乏中央协调器，容易受到机会主义行为（如搭便车行为）的影响。现有的进化博弈论研究通常假设智能体具有完美理性和静态策略，这与实际场景不符，因此需要新的分析框架来应对这些局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一个新颖的进化博弈论框架，包含三个主要贡献：1）在有限理性假设下，基于格状网络结构建模点对点交互；2）构建了包含训练成本、通信开销和合作奖励的综合收益矩阵，并设计了捕捉空间传播动力学的策略更新规则；3）集成了基于声誉的奖惩机制，有效遏制搭便车行为。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，该框架显著优于基线方法：平均准确率从约70%提升至82%；合作频率接近100%（基线低于5%）；准确率方差从约0.40降至0.002，实现了更快的均匀收敛并确保了系统稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功解决了去中心化联邦学习中的机会主义行为问题，通过有限理性假设和声誉机制的结合，不仅提高了模型性能和合作水平，还保证了系统的稳定性，为去中心化联邦学习的实际应用提供了有效的理论框架和解决方案。

title: Dynamic Modeling of Target Cell Location for Mobility Robustness Analysis in Cellular Networks: Technical Report
summary: Mobility robustness optimization (MRO) requires an appropriate selection of handover (HO) parameters such as the time-to-trigger (TTT) and the offset margin to balance HO failures and ping-pong HOs. Existing stochastic-geometry-based analyses for MRO often characterize the target base station (BS) by assuming that its angular position is uniformly distributed over a feasible region. However, this assumption does not explicitly capture the spatial distribution of the target BS dynamically selected as a user equipment (UE) moves through the network. In this paper, we develop a stochastic-geometry-based analytical framework for MRO in sub-6 GHz cellular networks. We first derive the distribution of the HO triggering time and the spatial distribution of the dynamically selected target BS under straight-line UE mobility. Based on these distributions, we formulate too-late HO and ping-pong HO events as mutually exclusive mobility events and analytically derive their probabilities. Numerical results validate the analytical expressions and demonstrate that explicitly characterizing the target BS distribution has a non-negligible impact on the evaluated HO performance. Furthermore, the derived framework quantifies the tradeoff between too-late HO and ping-pong HO probabilities with respect to the TTT and enables the identification of a TTT value that minimizes their sum.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于随机几何的MRO分析框架，通过明确刻画动态选择的目标基站分布，推导了切换失败和乒乓切换的概率表达式，并实现了切换参数优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于随机几何的MRO分析方法通常假设目标基站的角位置均匀分布，这一假设无法准确捕捉用户移动过程中动态选择的目标基站的空间分布特性，导致分析结果与实际性能存在偏差。
AI.method: 针对sub-6 GHz蜂窝网络，首先推导了切换触发时间分布和动态选择目标基站的空间分布（基于直线用户移动模型），在此基础上将过晚切换和乒乓切换建模为互斥的移动性事件，并解析推导其发生概率。
AI.result: 数值仿真验证了解析表达式的正确性，表明显式刻画目标基站分布对评估切换性能有不可忽略的影响；该框架能够量化TTT参数对过晚切换和乒乓切换概率的权衡关系，并确定使两者之和最小化的最优TTT值。
AI.conclusion: 通过明确刻画目标基站的动态空间分布，本文提出的分析框架为MRO提供了更准确的性能评估方法，能够有效指导切换参数的优化选择，具有较好的实用价值。

title: Bayesian and Motivated Reasoning in AI Agents
summary: AI agents increasingly perform open-ended tasks in settings where their conclusions can guide consequential decisions. We provide evidence that AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical data when the substantive framing changes. We demonstrate this behavior in high-stakes domains in medicine, election forensics, and geopolitical forecasting by holding the evidence fixed while changing the scenario in which the evidence appears. Across twelve agent-domain comparisons, agents' conclusions are strongly influenced by their prior beliefs. They are more likely to reach an affirmative conclusion when it is framed around a proposition they already regard as likely, while the reverse holds when the framing conflicts with their prior. The framing also changes how some agents work: they search more extensively, choose different analytical specifications, and evaluate the same evidence differently. These results identify a particular risk of delegating decision-making to AI agents, as their decisions may depend on prior beliefs that are neither specified in the task nor visible in the decision record.

AI.tldr: AI agents在处理相同数值数据时，会因实质性框架的变化而得出不同结论，且受其先验信念影响，这在高风险领域构成决策风险。
AI.motivation: AI agents越来越多地在关键决策领域（如医学、选举取证、地缘政治预测）执行开放式任务，其结论可能指导重要决策。作者旨在揭示AI agents在处理相同数值证据时，是否会因场景框架的变化而产生不同的结论，从而评估将决策权下放给AI agents的风险。
AI.method: 研究者通过控制数值证据保持不变，仅改变证据呈现的场景框架，在医学、选举取证和地缘政治预测三个高风险领域进行了实验。共进行了12组agent-domain比较，分析AI agents在不同框架下的结论差异、推理过程变化（如搜索行为、分析规格选择、证据评估方式）以及先验信念对结论的影响。
AI.result: AI agents的结论强烈受其先验信念影响：当框架围绕其认为可能成立的命题时，agents更倾向于得出肯定性结论；反之，当框架与其先验信念冲突时则相反。框架变化还导致部分agents改变推理过程，包括更广泛的搜索、不同的分析规格选择以及对相同证据的不同评估。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出将决策权下放给AI agents的一个特定风险：其决策可能依赖于既未在任务中明确说明、也未在决策记录中可见的先验信念，这可能导致基于相同证据却得出不同结论的情况，影响决策的一致性和可靠性。
