Integrated into the iterative multi-source beam search framework, the resulting hybrid approach outperforms existing methods on both synthetic benchmark instances and newly introduced real-world instances with data-driven gap constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于学习的神经进化方法，用于自动设计VGLCSP问题的高效启发式算法，结合学习到的启发式和人工启发式的集成方法在实验中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 针对多序列变间隙最长公共子序列问题(VGLCSP)，现有的基于束搜索的启发式方法依赖人工设计，往往缺乏鲁棒性。研究旨在通过学习自动化地设计更有效的数据驱动启发式方法来克服这一局限。
AI.method: 采用神经进化框架，将启发式表示为预定义架构的神经网络，通过遗传算法优化其权重。学习过程在迭代多源束搜索程序中交替进行权重优化和评估。引入集成启发式方法，将学习到的启发式与最佳人工启发式的得分进行结合。
AI.result: 在合成基准实例和新引入的具有数据驱动间隙约束的真实实例上，所提出的混合方法优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过神经进化学习自动设计启发式并与人工启发式结合的方法能够有效解决VGLCSP问题，在实验验证中展现出优越性能。

title: EulerLoRA: Rank-Driven Jump Dynamics for Calibrated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning, but standard LoRA produces a single deterministic model and does not directly support predictive uncertainty estimation. We introduce EulerLoRA, a stochastic extension of LoRA that generates multiple predictive trajectories by sampling structured variations along the rank-one components of shared low-rank adapters, while preserving the deterministic LoRA transformation in expectation. We evaluate EulerLoRA with vision transformers on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and HAM10000, together with out-of-distribution detection on SVHN. Across these benchmarks, EulerLoRA achieves comparable or improved performance relative to strong LoRA-Ensemble baselines. Using two rank-20 adapters, EulerLoRA requires approximately 3 million trainable adapter parameters, compared with about 10 million for a rank-8, 16-adapter LoRA-Ensemble, corresponding to roughly 69% fewer trainable parameters. These results show that useful predictive diversity can be obtained from a small number of shared adapters.

AI.tldr: 提出EulerLoRA，一种随机扩展的LoRA方法，通过在共享低秩适配器的秩一组件上采样结构化变化来生成多条预测轨迹，在实现预测不确定性估计的同时，参数量比LoRA-Ensemble减少约69%。
AI.motivation: 标准LoRA生成单一确定性模型，无法直接支持预测不确定性估计，而现有的集成方法需要大量参数。
AI.method: 在共享低秩适配器的秩一组件上采样结构化变化，生成多条预测轨迹，同时在期望上保持确定性LoRA变换。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和HAM10000上达到与LoRA-Ensemble相当或更优的性能；使用两个秩-20适配器约300万可训练参数，相比秩-8的16适配器LoRA-Ensemble（约1000万参数）减少约69%参数量。
AI.conclusion: 少量共享适配器即可获得有价值的预测多样性，证明了随机扩展方法在参数效率和不确定性估计方面的有效性。

title: CADIR: A Cross-Backend Editable Intermediate Representation for Agentic CAD Generation
summary: Large language models have made it possible to generate executable computer-aided design (CAD) programs from natural-language descriptions or images. However, existing methods represent modeling processes as backend-specific sequential scripts with implicit dependencies or as static geometry, making it difficult to simultaneously preserve construction history, stable topological references, and feature-level editability across different CAD systems. We present CADIR, an agent-friendly executable intermediate representation for CAD generation and cross-backend editing. Built on the OCCT geometry kernel via OCP, CADIR provides explicit, compositional modeling operations and fine-grained execution diagnostics. During program execution, CADIR records modeling operations, parameter dependencies, constraints, and topology selections in a construction graph. To enable reliable cross-backend reconstruction, we introduce Geometric Signature Matching, which identifies corresponding edges and faces despite parameter changes and backend differences, allowing adapters to reconstruct native editable feature histories in FreeCAD, SolidWorks, and Fusion 360. Building on this representation, we further propose a construction-graph retrieval method for text and image queries that supports both full-graph and subgraph retrieval, enabling agents to leverage complete models and modeling substructures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CADIR achieves higher geometric fidelity and execution reliability than existing CAD representations, that construction-graph retrieval further improves model generation quality, and that cross-backend editing enables reliable model reconstruction and post-reconstruction editing across multiple CAD environments.

AI.tldr: 提出了CADIR，一种面向代理的可执行CAD中间表示，支持跨后端编辑和构造图检索，解决了现有方法难以同时保留构建历史、拓扑引用和可编辑性的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将建模过程表示为后端特定的顺序脚本（隐式依赖）或静态几何，难以在不同CAD系统中同时保留构建历史、稳定的拓扑引用和特征级可编辑性。
AI.method: 基于OCCT几何内核构建CADIR中间表示，提供显式、组合式的建模操作和细粒度执行诊断；执行过程中构建包含建模操作、参数依赖、约束和拓扑选择的构造图；引入几何签名匹配技术识别对应的边和面，支持跨后端重建原生可编辑特征历史；提出构造图检索方法支持文本和图像查询的全图与子图检索。
AI.result: 实验表明CADIR在几何保真度和执行可靠性方面优于现有CAD表示；构造图检索进一步提升了模型生成质量；跨后端编辑在FreeCAD、SolidWorks和Fusion 360中实现了可靠的模型重建和后重建编辑。
AI.conclusion: CADIR成功实现了跨CAD系统的可编辑模型表示，为LLM驱动的CAD生成和跨平台编辑提供了统一的中间表示框架，显著提升了几何保真度、执行可靠性和跨后端兼容性。

title: Differentiable Lifting for Topological Neural Networks
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026 (OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=eC89CbINIw). 20 pages, 4 figures
summary: Topological neural networks (TNNs) enable leveraging high-order structures on graphs (e.g., cycles and cliques) to boost the expressive power of message-passing neural networks. In turn, however, these structures are typically identified a priori through an unsupervised graph lifting operation. Notwithstanding, this choice is crucial and may have a drastic impact on a TNN's performance on downstream tasks. To circumvent this issue, we propose $\partial$lift (DiffLift), a general framework for learning graph liftings to hypergraphs and cellular- and simplicial complexes in an end-to-end fashion. In particular, our approach leverages learned vertex-level latent representations to identify and parameterize distributions over candidate higher-order cells for inclusion. This results in a scalable model which can be readily integrated into any TNN. Our experiments show that $\partial$lift outperforms existing lifting methods on multiple benchmarks for graph and node classification across different TNN architectures. Notably, our approach leads to gains of up to 45% over static liftings, including both connectivity- and feature-based ones.

AI.tldr: 提出了∂lift框架，通过端到端学习图提升操作，显著提升了拓扑神经网络在下游任务中的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有拓扑神经网络依赖预先定义的无监督图提升操作来识别高阶结构（如环和团），这种选择对下游任务性能影响巨大且缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 提出∂lift框架，利用学习的顶点级潜在表示来识别和参数化候选高阶单元的分布，从而以端到端方式学习从图到超图、胞腔复形和单纯复形的提升操作。
AI.result: ∂lift在多个图分类和节点分类基准测试中优于现有提升方法，在不同TNN架构下相比静态提升方法（包括基于连通性和特征的方法）性能提升高达45%。
AI.conclusion: 学习的图提升操作能够有效识别任务相关的高阶结构，显著提升拓扑神经网络性能，且该模型可扩展并易于集成到现有TNN架构中。

title: Modeling Social Dynamics with an LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) Model
summary: Social dynamics encode the process in which individual network and discourse interactions aggregate into collective influence, narrative dominance and coordinate behavior. This paper uses the the GhostField architecture, a hybrid LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) model as a social simulation framework to build the AuraSight scenario. In the AuraSight scenario, 314,244 heterogeneous cyber social agents and human actors exchange 529,327 messages over 30 days surrounding a fictional international song-writing contest. We methodologically examine emergent social dynamics across four analytical layers: ego-network topology, semantic network evolution, coordination dynamics and influence dynamics. Our results show how generated social simulations do also produce social dynamics, and how the dynamics of coordination and influence emerge not from individual agents but from the recursive interaction between network topology and narrative exchange.

AI.tldr: 本文使用GhostField架构构建AuraSight场景，通过31万多个异构网络社交代理在30天内交换53万条消息，验证了社交仿真能够产生真实的社交动态，且协调与影响力动态源于网络拓扑与叙事交换的递归交互。
AI.motivation: 研究社交动态如何从个体网络和话语交互聚合为集体影响力、叙事主导和协调行为，探索生成的社交仿真是否能产生真实的社交动态现象。
AI.method: 采用GhostField架构（混合LLM使能的基于代理的网络动态模型LAND）构建AuraSight场景，包含314,244个异构网络社交代理，在30天内围绕虚构的国际歌曲创作比赛交换529,327条消息；从四个分析层面考察涌现的社交动态：自我网络拓扑、语义网络演化、协调动力学和影响力动力学。
AI.result: 生成的社交仿真确实能够产生社交动态；协调与影响力动态并非源自个体代理，而是由网络拓扑与叙事交换之间的递归交互产生。
AI.conclusion: 社交仿真可作为研究社交动态涌现机制的有效工具，揭示了协调和影响力动态的本质在于网络结构与叙事内容的相互作用，而非个体代理的简单叠加。

title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Traffic Congestion Prediction: Unveiling the Impact of Different COVID-19 Periods
summary: Traffic congestion prediction is essential for congestion mitigation, but the COVID-19 pandemic and related control measures altered travel behavior and increased prediction complexity. This study predicts congestion in Alameda County, California, during pre-lockdown, lockdown, and post-lockdown periods. Weather, seasonality, and COVID-19 variables are incorporated, and Recursive Feature Elimination with Cross-Validation is used to select important features and reduce overfitting. Support vector regression, multiple linear regression, recurrent neural networks, and long short-term memory networks are trained and optimized. Because LSTM is more sensitive to hyperparameter settings, an adaptive parameter selection approach is used, while SVR and RNN are manually tuned. Performance is evaluated using Normalized Root Mean Square Error. Bidirectional LSTM consistently performs best across all periods because it captures temporal dependence in both directions. Integrated Gradients is used to interpret Bi-LSTM predictions, and SHapley Additive exPlanations is applied to SVR. New COVID-19 cases have a mainly negative effect on congestion during lockdown and post-lockdown, likely due to greater risk awareness, voluntary travel reduction, and compliance with mobility restrictions. In the post-pandemic period, higher hospitalization reduces travel and congestion, while higher fuel prices do not prevent a shift toward private vehicles and therefore increase congestion.

AI.tldr: 本研究预测COVID-19疫情期间不同阶段的交通拥堵，发现双向LSTM模型表现最佳，新增病例对拥堵有负向影响，而高油价反而增加拥堵。
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情及相关管控措施改变了出行行为，增加了拥堵预测的复杂性，需要在不同疫情阶段进行准确的拥堵预测以支持缓解措施。
AI.method: 整合天气、季节性和COVID-19变量，采用递归特征消除交叉验证进行特征选择；训练并优化SVR、MLR、RNN和LSTM模型，其中LSTM使用自适应参数选择方法；使用NRMSE评估性能，采用Integrated Gradients和SHAP解释模型预测。
AI.result: 双向LSTM在所有时期表现最佳，归因于其能捕捉双向时间依赖性；新增COVID-19病例在封锁期和后封锁期主要对拥堵产生负向影响；后疫情时期住院率上升减少拥堵，而油价上涨未能阻止私家车使用反而增加拥堵。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功预测了疫情不同阶段的交通拥堵，揭示了COVID-19相关因素对出行行为和拥堵的影响机制，为疫情及后疫情时代的交通管理提供了决策支持。

title: PMMC: Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation for Long-Term LVLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is essential for LVLM agents to maintain consistency and integrate information across extended multimodal interactions. Existing agent memory systems, however, often reduce visual experiences into textual summaries or rely on static retrieve-then-reason pipelines, which are inefficient at query time and brittle when questions require image-text binding, temporal updates, or visual details. We propose Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation, a framework that shifts part of the memory reasoning process from query time to memory consolidation time. Given accumulated multimodal interactions, a Questioner predicts future question candidates, a Planner compiles question-conditioned multimodal memory programs, and a Doubter verifies whether the planned evidence path can support the predicted answer. The verified question-program pairs form a structured question bank for efficient query-time routing and evidence retrieval. Experiments on multimodal long-term memory benchmarks show that our method improves answer quality and visual evidence recall while reducing query-time token and latency costs. Extensive ablations analyze the effects of self-feedback, dynamic planning, raw-image access, and question bank coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出前瞻性多模态记忆编译框架，通过在记忆整合阶段预生成和验证问题-程序对，显著提升LVLM代理的查询效率和回答质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的LVLM代理记忆系统通常将视觉体验简化为文本摘要，或在查询时依赖静态的检索-推理流程，导致查询效率低下，且在需要图文绑定、时序更新或视觉细节的问题上表现脆弱。
AI.method: 提出前瞻性多模态记忆编译框架，将部分记忆推理过程从查询时转移到记忆整合时。框架包含三个组件：Questioner预测未来问题候选，Planner编译问题条件化的多模态记忆程序，Doubter验证计划的证据路径是否能支持预测答案。验证后的问题-程序对形成结构化问题库，用于高效的查询时路由和证据检索。
AI.result: 在多模态长期记忆基准测试上的实验表明，该方法在提高回答质量和视觉证据召回率的同时，显著降低了查询时的token消耗和延迟成本。消融实验分析了自反馈、动态规划、原始图像访问和问题库覆盖率的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过将记忆推理部分转移到记忆整合阶段，并构建结构化问题库，该方法有效解决了现有系统查询效率低和处理复杂视觉问题能力不足的问题，为LVLM代理的长期记忆提供了新的解决方案。

title: SAFE-Merge: Data-Free Continual Model Merging with General Knowledge Preservation
summary: Data-free continual model merging must incorporate a stream of specialized models while retaining both pretrained general knowledge and previously acquired tasks, without access to task data. Existing methods mainly merge task updates by suppressing interference among downstream tasks; while this protects previously acquired tasks, it overlooks the safety of the pretrained knowledge itself, whose erosion degrades generalization to held-out distributions and weakens the foundation for future task acquisition. We propose SAFE-Merge, a simple data-free continual-merging framework that first decides which parameter updates are safe to retain, and then recovers the task information lost through masking. Specifically, to ensure safety, risk-aware sparse masking selects parameter updates that carry task-specific information while posing low risk to general knowledge. Masked low-rank recovery then compensates for the lost task information using only the same retained parameter updates, while leaving all masked-out parameters strictly unchanged. Finally, the combined update is fused into the backbone, incurring no additional inference cost. Across vision and language benchmarks, SAFE-Merge consistently achieves the best H-score. On longer CLIP task sequences, it substantially improves H-score over NUFILT while also achieving the highest accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出了SAFE-Merge，一种无数据持续模型合并框架，通过风险感知的稀疏掩码和低秩恢复机制，有效保护预训练知识的同时整合任务特定更新，在视觉和语言基准测试中显著提升了H-score和准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的无数据持续模型合并方法主要通过抑制下游任务之间的干扰来合并任务更新，虽然保护了已获取的任务，但忽略了预训练知识本身的安全性，导致泛化能力下降并削弱了未来任务获取的基础。
AI.method: 提出了SAFE-Merge框架，包含两个核心步骤：(1)风险感知稀疏掩码：选择携带任务特定信息但对通用知识风险较低的参数更新；(2)掩码低秩恢复：仅使用保留的参数更新来补偿因掩码丢失的任务信息，同时严格保持所有被掩码的参数不变。最后将组合更新融合到骨干网络中，不增加额外推理成本。
AI.result: 在视觉和语言基准测试中，SAFE-Merge持续实现了最佳的H-score。在更长的CLIP任务序列上，相比NUFILT显著提高了H-score，同时达到了最高的准确率。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-Merge成功解决了无数据持续模型合并中预训练知识安全问题，通过安全参数选择和任务信息恢复的协同机制，在保护通用知识的同时有效整合任务特定更新，为持续学习场景提供了更可靠的模型合并方案。

title: TrajWiki: Source-Grounded Memory Trajectories for Long-Horizon Dialogue Agents
summary: Large language model agents have shown strong capabilities in generating coherent and contextually appropriate responses, yet robust long-horizon dialogue remains limited by the lack of external memory that is traceable, updatable, and diagnostically transparent. Existing memory-augmented agents often store memories as isolated records or overwritable states, making it difficult to preserve how information originates, evolves, conflicts, or becomes obsolete over time. We propose TrajWiki, a trajectory-based memory framework for long-horizon conversational agents. Instead of treating memory as static entries, TrajWiki represents each memory as a source-grounded evolution trajectory, maintained through immutable episodic snapshots and claim-level operations such as ADD, REVISE, and DEPRECATE. To reduce fragmentation and retrieval cost, TrajWiki further introduces Memory Wiki, a persistent intermediate layer that incrementally compiles dialogue history into structured and interlinked wiki pages capturing salient entities, events, quantities, topics, and conflicts. At inference time, queries are routed hierarchically from relevant wiki pages to linked memory trajectories, then to corresponding snapshots and source messages for evidence-grounded answer synthesis. Experiments on LoCoMo and MedMT show that TrajWiki improves long-horizon dialogue performance across both open-source and closed-source LLM backbones, while providing greater interpretability and diagnostic visibility into memory evolution, retrieval failures, and answer generation.

AI.tldr: 提出了TrajWiki，一个基于轨迹的记忆框架，通过将记忆表示为源依赖的进化轨迹并维护结构化的维基页面中间层，实现了可追溯、可更新且可诊断的长时域对话。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强型大语言模型代理通常将记忆存储为孤立记录或可覆盖状态，难以追踪信息随时间的起源、演变、冲突和过时过程，缺乏外部记忆的可追溯性、可更新性和诊断透明度。
AI.method: 提出TrajWiki框架：1) 将每个记忆表示为源依赖的进化轨迹，通过不可变的情节快照和声明级操作（ADD、REVISE、DEPRECATE）进行维护；2) 引入Memory Wiki作为持久中间层，增量编译对话历史为结构化且互联的维基页面；3) 推理时采用层次化路由机制，从维基页面到记忆轨迹再到源消息进行证据基础的答案合成。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和MedMT数据集上的实验表明，TrajWiki在开源和闭源LLM骨干网络上均提升了长时域对话性能，同时提供了更好的可解释性和对记忆演变、检索失败及答案生成的诊断可见性。
AI.conclusion: TrajWiki成功解决了长时域对话中记忆管理的核心挑战，通过轨迹表示和维基页面结构实现了记忆的可追溯性和可诊断性，为构建更可靠的长时域对话代理提供了有效解决方案。

title: ReBRAC-v2: The Return of the King
summary: Recent offline reinforcement learning methods increasingly rely on expressive generative policies and specialized value-guidance mechanisms. We ask whether comparable progress can instead come from systematically modernizing a conventional behavior-regularized actor-critic while preserving its algorithmic simplicity. We introduce ReBRAC-v2, which directly trains an exact-likelihood normalizing flow as the RL actor, combines likelihood, MSE, and MAE behavior regularization, and integrates a classification-based residual critic, staged optimization, and multi-sample test-time action selection. Rather than tuning this recipe separately for every task, we develop a single shared configuration via roughly 600 Bayesian proposals on six challenging OGBench tasks, freeze all structural and optimization choices, and adapt only two behavior-regularization coefficients over a 16-point grid. Across ten common state-based OGBench categories, ReBRAC-v2 averages 74.8 compared to 52.3 for the next-best aggregate result and ranks first in eight categories. The same recipe, without structural changes, obtains the strongest averages in our comparisons on D4RL AntMaze (90.2) and Adroit (33.6). Fixed-recipe ablations show the largest sensitivity to the selected mixed cloning objective, staged training, sufficient flow capacity, and multi-sample inference, while showing that several smaller choices depend on the values of other hyperparameters. These results show that disciplined, transferable engineering can achieve state-of-the-art aggregate performance without abandoning a minimalist offline RL foundation.

AI.tldr: ReBRAC-v2通过系统化改进传统行为正则化Actor-Critic算法，在OGBench、D4RL等基准测试中取得领先的聚合性能，证明了无需复杂生成策略也能达到SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 现有离线强化学习方法过度依赖复杂的生成策略和专用价值引导机制，研究动机是探索是否可以通过系统化现代化传统行为正则化Actor-Critic算法来获得可比的性能提升，同时保持算法的简洁性。
AI.method: 提出ReBRAC-v2算法：(1)使用精确似然的归一化流作为RL Actor；(2)组合似然、MSE和MAE行为正则化；(3)集成分类式残差Critic；(4)采用分阶段优化和多样本测试时动作选择；(5)通过贝叶斯优化开发单一共享配置，固定结构和优化选择，仅调整两个行为正则化系数。
AI.result: 在10个OGBench状态类任务中平均得分74.8（次优结果52.3），8个类别排名第一；在D4RL AntMaze（90.2）和Adroit（33.6）基准上获得最强平均性能；消融实验显示混合克隆目标、分阶段训练、充足的流容量和多样本推理最为关键。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统性、可迁移的工程设计，可以在不牺牲算法简洁性的前提下实现SOTA聚合性能，证明了传统离线RL基础经过现代化改进后仍具竞争力。

title: PROGRESS: Coverage-guided RL to Train Search-augmented LLM Agent
summary: Existing search-augmented LLM agents are trained using Reinforcement Learning to boost its reasoning capabilities. However, these approaches primarily rely on outcome-level rewards, which provide little supervision over search behavior and overlook agent's ability to decompose complex queries properly. To mitigate this issue, we propose PROGRESS which utilizes teacher-guided coverage reward to explicitly shape decomposed query generation of the policy model. During training, frozen teacher models are used to decompose complex queries into essential search queries. These essential search queries are utilized to guide the search behavior of the policy model. Integrated into an R1-style training framework, our approach provides lightweight guidance over query decomposition decisions without dense process-level supervision. Experiments show that coverage-guided RL improves overall task performance, highlighting the importance of explicitly supervising search strategies in agentic LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出PROGRESS框架，通过教师引导的覆盖率奖励显式监督搜索增强LLM代理的查询分解策略，在R1风格训练中提升智能体性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的搜索增强LLM代理仅依赖结果级奖励，缺乏对搜索行为的细粒度监督，忽视了智能体正确分解复杂查询的能力，导致搜索策略次优。
AI.method: 提出PROGRESS方法：利用冻结的教师模型将复杂查询分解为必要搜索查询，以此为引导信号设计覆盖率奖励，在R1风格强化学习框架中显式塑造策略模型的查询分解行为，无需密集的过程级监督。
AI.result: 实验表明，覆盖率引导的强化学习训练显著提升了整体任务性能，验证了显式监督智能体搜索策略的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 显式监督查询分解等搜索策略对提升智能体LLM的推理能力至关重要，为搜索增强型智能体的训练范式提供了新思路。

title: AdaHAT: Adaptive Hard Attention to the Task in Task-Incremental Learning
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, published in ECML PKDD 2024
summary: Catastrophic forgetting is a major problem in task-incremental learning, where neural networks tend to overwrite previously learned knowledge when trained on new tasks. A number of architecture-based approaches have been proposed to address this problem. However, the architecture-based approaches suffer from another problem related to network capacity when the networks learn long task sequences: As a network is trained on an increasing number of new tasks in a long task sequence, a growing proportion of active parameters becomes static to prevent forgetting of previously learned knowledge. In this paper, we propose Adaptive Hard Attention to the Task (AdaHAT) with an adaptive attention mechanism which allows adaptive updates to static parameters by taking into account the information about previous tasks on both the importance of these parameters to previous tasks and the current network capacity. Based on this idea, we develop a new neural network architecture incorporating our proposed AdaHAT mechanism. AdaHAT extends an existing architecture-based approach, Hard Attention to the Task (HAT), to better support task-incremental learning over long task sequences. We conduct experiments on a number of datasets and compare AdaHAT with task-incremental learning baselines including HAT. Our experimental results show that AdaHAT achieves better average performance across tasks than these baselines, especially on long task sequences, demonstrating the benefits from balancing the trade-off between stability and plasticity of a network when learning such sequences of tasks, alleviating the network capacity problem. Our code is available at pengxiang-wang.com/projects/continual-learning-arena.

AI.tldr: 提出了AdaHAT方法，通过自适应注意力机制动态更新静态参数，解决了长任务序列下的网络容量问题，在任务增量学习中优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的架构式方法在长任务序列学习中存在网络容量问题：随着任务数量增加，越来越多参数被冻结以防止遗忘，导致网络容量不足。需要在稳定性和可塑性之间找到更好的平衡。
AI.method: 提出自适应硬注意力机制（AdaHAT），在原有HAT方法基础上引入自适应注意力机制。该方法综合考虑参数对先前任务的重要性以及当前网络容量信息，实现对静态参数的自适应更新，从而更好地支持长任务序列学习。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，AdaHAT相比包括HAT在内的任务增量学习基线方法取得了更好的平均任务性能，特别是在长任务序列场景下表现突出，有效缓解了网络容量问题。
AI.conclusion: AdaHAT成功平衡了网络的稳定性和可塑性，有效解决了长任务序列学习中的网络容量问题，为任务增量学习提供了一种更优的架构式解决方案。

title: Search-GRT: Guided Retrieval Training of Search Agents to Optimize for Complex Question Answering
summary: The effective use of search engines by large language models (LLMs) remains a significant challenge, particularly in complex, multi-hop question-answering (MHQA) tasks. These tasks require the model to decompose questions into subqueries, retrieve relevant information, and synthesize answers from multiple sources, often leading to cascading errors due to poor retrieval in early stages. Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise in improving LLMs' search capabilities, but it often suffers from sparse rewards during training, hindering the model's ability to learn effectively. To address these challenges, we introduce Guided Retrieval Training (GRT), a novel method that improves the performance of a search agent by restricting the retrieval process during RL training using ground truth information. By focusing on a curated set of relevant documents, GRT provides the model with a stronger learning signal, mitigating the problem of sparse rewards and improving its ability to generate accurate subqueries and synthesize correct answers. Our experimental results demonstrate that GRT achieves consistent performance improvements over existing methods, such as Search-R1, across a wide range of question-answering (QA) tasks. Notably, GRT excels in MHQA tasks, achieving over 40% improvements in performance. Additionally, GRT enhances training efficiency by achieving better QA performance with fewer training steps.

AI.tldr: 提出了引导检索训练（GRT）方法，通过在强化学习训练中利用真实信息约束检索过程，解决了多跳问答任务中稀疏奖励问题，在MHQA任务上性能提升超过40%。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在复杂的多跳问答任务中有效使用搜索引擎仍面临重大挑战，主要问题包括：需要分解问题为子查询、检索相关信息并综合多个来源的答案，早期阶段的检索质量差会导致级联错误；现有强化学习方法在训练过程中存在稀疏奖励问题，阻碍模型有效学习。
AI.method: 提出引导检索训练（GRT）方法，在强化学习训练过程中利用真实信息约束检索过程，使模型专注于经过筛选的相关文档集合，从而提供更强的学习信号，缓解稀疏奖励问题，提升模型生成准确子查询和综合正确答案的能力。
AI.result: GRT在广泛的问答任务上相比Search-R1等现有方法取得了一致的性能提升；在多跳问答任务中表现尤为突出，性能提升超过40%；在训练效率方面，GRT能够以更少的训练步骤实现更好的问答性能。
AI.conclusion: GRT方法有效解决了大型语言模型在复杂问答任务中使用搜索引擎的挑战，特别是在多跳问答任务中表现优异，同时提高了训练效率，为LLM的搜索能力提升提供了一种有效的解决方案。

title: Distill What the Student Can See: Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) samples trajectories from the current student policy and minimizes token-level divergence between student and teacher next-token distributions at prefixes along those trajectories. This aligns the distillation states with the student's own generation distribution. However, it still assumes that the complete teacher distribution is an appropriate target across student capacities. In vision--language reasoning, teacher corrections can depend on visual distinctions that a compact student cannot represent. Our target-scaling study shows that, as the target approaches the complete teacher distribution, the student realizes less of the prescribed shift and obtains worse downstream performance. We therefore propose \emph{Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation} (FP-OPD), which distills only locally realizable teacher corrections. FP-OPD uses continuous visual perturbations to estimate the student's local visual tangent space and projects the centered teacher--student log-probability gap onto this space under the student's Fisher metric. The resulting capacity-aware target is optimized with full-vocabulary reverse KL on student trajectories, retaining the standard OPD framework. In 8B-to-2B distillation, FP-OPD improves all seven evaluated multimodal benchmarks. It raises the average score by 2.77 points over the pretrained student and by 1.60 points over standard OPD. These results demonstrate that locally realizable teacher corrections provide a more effective target for distilling compact vision--language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FP-OPD方法，通过Fisher投影仅蒸馏学生在其视觉表示空间内可实现的教师修正，在8B到2B的视觉-语言模型蒸馏任务中平均性能提升2.77分。
AI.motivation: 传统在线策略蒸馏（OPD）假设完整的教师分布适用于所有学生模型，但在视觉-语言推理中，教师基于视觉细节的修正可能超出紧凑学生的表示能力。研究显示，随着蒸馏目标接近完整教师分布，学生实际学到的修正减少且下游性能下降。
AI.method: 提出Fisher投影在线策略蒸馏（FP-OPD）：1）使用连续视觉扰动估计学生的局部视觉切空间；2）在学生Fisher信息度量下，将教师-学生对数概率差距投影到该切空间；3）该容量感知目标通过全词汇表反向KL散度在学生轨迹上优化，保持标准OPD框架。
AI.result: 在8B到2B模型蒸馏实验中，FP-OPD在全部7个多模态基准测试上均取得提升。相比预训练学生平均提升2.77分，相比标准OPD平均提升1.60分。
AI.conclusion: 局部可实现的教师修正为蒸馏紧凑视觉-语言模型提供了更有效的目标，验证了容量感知蒸馏方法的优越性。

title: Passing Coarse Marginal Checks Can Be Cheap: Persona Mixtures and Imprecise Treatment-Response Estimates in an LLM Persona Panel
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Project site: https://yoheinakajima.github.io/synthetic-players/ ; code, data, registrations, review record, and zero-call replay capsule: https://github.com/yoheinakajima/synthetic-players
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as synthetic research participants and are often validated by whether their marginal responses resemble human data. We study a fixed panel of sixteen lightweight persona-conditioned GPT-4.1 configurations in repeated strategic games. The panel met preregistered broad-reference condition-mean criteria in three of four repeated-game cells; the sole miss was 0.011 below the lower reference bound. Variation was strongly prompt-indexed, but its share depended on uncertainty assumptions: fixed-panel symmetric-Dirichlet sensitivities produced median between-prompt shares of 63%-71% under Jeffreys alpha=0.5 and 47%-53% under alpha=1, while finite-opportunity plug-in estimates were 85%-96%. Aggregate continuation-probability contrasts were +0.083 and +0.078, with conservative simultaneous 95% intervals [-0.171, +0.330] and [-0.181, +0.330]. The treatment jointly changed the continuation process and its textual representation. A separate wording-and-position operation shifted cooperation from 0/40 to 37/40 in the bare configuration, and a label conflict also revealed representation control. The original persona-level p13 result was not prospectively family-controlled, while a post-adjudication exact gate was structurally underpowered; p13 is therefore a replication target rather than a finding. External review exposed family-error, dependence, construct, and boundary-uncertainty defects, and zero-call reanalysis changed the interpretation without rewriting the historical record. The registered marginal criteria could be passed without precisely estimating the treatment-response object. A public capsule verifies 4,916 confirmatory Phase 3-5 runs with no live model calls. The results concern one fixed model-prompt panel and do not establish human substitutability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个由16个轻量级角色条件化GPT-4.1配置组成的固定面板在重复策略博弈中的表现，评估其作为合成研究参与者的有效性和局限性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用作合成研究参与者，通常通过其边际响应是否类似于人类数据来验证。然而，这种验证方法的有效性尚不确定，需要系统性地研究模型在重复策略博弈中的表现和变异性来源。
AI.method: 使用一个固定的16个轻量级角色条件化GPT-4.1配置面板，在重复策略博弈中进行实验。采用预注册的广泛参考条件均值标准进行评估，并通过对称Dirichlet敏感性分析和有限机会插件估计来量化变异性来源。同时进行外部审查和零调用重新分析。
AI.result: 面板在四个重复博弈单元中有三个满足了预注册标准，唯一的偏差为0.011。变异性强烈依赖于提示索引，其份额取决于不确定性假设：固定面板对称Dirichlet敏感性产生的提示间份额中位数为63%-71%（Jeffreys alpha=0.5）和47%-53%（alpha=1），而有限机会插件估计为85%-96%。单独的措辞和位置操作将合作率从0/40改变为37/40。外部审查揭示了家族误差、依赖性、构造和边界不确定性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 预注册的边际标准可以在不精确估计治疗响应对象的情况下通过，固定面板的结果不建立人类可替代性。原始的p13结果是复制目标而非发现，零调用重新分析改变了解释但没有重写历史记录。结果仅适用于一个固定的模型-提示面板。

title: Riemannian Attention Mechanisms for Transformers: A Theoretical Framework and Architecture Design
summary: All Transformer-based large language models compute attention via the Euclidean inner product, an architectural choice that Dong et al. (2021) proved causes representational rank to decay doubly exponentially with depth in pure self-attention stacks. We develop a theoretical framework that targets this structural limitation at the mathematical level by replacing the flat Euclidean metric with learned per-token Riemannian metrics. Our contributions are threefold. (1) We prove that Riemannian attention scores with heterogeneous per-token metrics are non-Gram---they cannot be factorized as QK^T with factorization dimension O(d). We are explicit that this is a structural observation, not a proof of rank preservation. (2) We establish that low-rank metric factors render all geometric operations tractable: geodesic distance in O(d*r) per token and metric inversion in O(d*r^2) via the Woodbury identity---both far below the O(d^3) cost of a general matrix---making Riemannian attention feasible at billion-parameter scale with negligible overhead. (3) We present the Fiber Bundle Transformer, a complete architecture specification in which each token position carries its own Riemannian metric, attention is geodesic distance computation, feed-forward updates use metric-preconditioned steps, and the connection carries explicit curvature and torsion proxies. We derive formal predictions about correctly implemented geometric architectures and identify the central open problem: proving or disproving that heterogeneous Riemannian metrics prevent the rank collapse that row-stochastic attention matrices otherwise cause. This paper presents theoretical analysis and architectural design; empirical validation is the subject of future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Fiber Bundle Transformer，通过用黎曼度量替代欧几里得内积来缓解Transformer的秩塌缩问题，并证明其计算可行。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer架构使用欧几里得内积计算注意力，Dong等人（2021）证明了这种结构会导致表示秩随深度呈双指数衰减，这是纯自注意力堆栈的结构性局限。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个理论框架，将平坦的欧几里得度量替换为可学习的逐token黎曼度量。他们引入Fiber Bundle Transformer架构，其中每个token位置携带自身的黎曼度量，注意力通过测地距离计算，前馈更新使用度量预条件步骤。采用低秩度量因子保证计算可行性：测地距离计算复杂度O(d*r)，度量求逆复杂度O(d*r^2)。
AI.result: 证明了异质逐token黎曼度量的注意力分数是非Gram矩阵（无法用O(d)分解维度因子化为QK^T形式）。展示了低秩度量因子使几何操作计算可行。提出完整的Fiber Bundle Transformer架构规范，包含曲率和挠率代理。识别了核心开放问题：证明或反驳异质黎曼度量能否防止秩塌缩。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了理论分析和架构设计，证明了黎曼注意力的结构特性和计算可行性，但尚未提供实证验证，该部分留待未来工作。核心理论问题（黎曼度量是否阻止秩塌缩）仍待解决。

title: Auditing Discovery Claims: A Two-Sided Criterion for Agentic Science, with the Negative Side Decidable
summary: When a self-improving AI-for-science system claims a new capability, the evidence is usually a benchmark delta, a description-length gate, or a p-value. None separates a real gain from extra search, from a changed verifier, or from adaptation to a fallible oracle. We build a two-sided audit whose negative side is a formal fact: a pseudoknot-free oracle provably cannot represent a crossing base pair, so the prior verifier's range is bounded exactly, offline, before any run. "New" is relative to the agent's prior self, never to the base model. First, how far a single fallible oracle can inflate a capability claim. An invented, solver-free operator solves 43/60 crossing RNA targets under the predictor it optimizes, above a context-free floor of 0/60; under three predictors, 1/60 survives. Paired on the same 43 targets, a predictor the operator never saw confirms 2 of its designs against 26 for a minimum-free-energy solver (p = 8e-7). No statistic computed from the system and its own oracle sees that gap. Second, agent-written procedures can beat a human-written one under a judge no objective can flatter, at a fraction of the compute. Of six frontier models, the two whose operators ran without timeouts carry over at 0.293 against our 0.095 (n = 951 paired units, target-clustered [+0.108, +0.297], p = 5e-5) while spending 4.6-10x fewer oracle calls. Three rungs: difference under an outside adjudicator (reached), not bought with compute (reached, both directions), mechanism identified and transferable (not reached; seven candidates tested, none moves the statistic). The ceiling is the panel itself: its three predictors share nearest-neighbour thermodynamic parameters, two agreeing at kappa = 0.673. The audit is as unsparing about our own system: matched undirected search is an exact zero, and a search-free probe puts 84% of our headline effect on targets a random sequence already solves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双重审计框架来科学验证AI系统的能力声明，通过RNA结构预测的伪结问题，揭示了现有验证方法的局限性，并展示了智能体编写程序在效率和性能上的优势。
AI.motivation: 当前自改进科学AI系统声称具备新能力时，通常依赖基准测试差值、描述长度门槛或p值作为证据。然而这些指标无法区分真实的能力增益与额外搜索、验证器变更或对有缺陷oracle的适应性。现有验证方法存在根本缺陷，可能导致能力声明的虚假膨胀。
AI.method: 构建双重审计框架：（1）负面审计端利用形式化事实：无伪结oracle在理论上无法表示交叉碱基对，从而精确界定先验验证器的范围；（2）正面审计端引入外部评判器进行验证。通过设计无求解器的操作器在RNA交叉目标测试，对比多个预测器的结果，并使用独立预测器进行交叉验证。以新能力相对于智能体自身先验状态而非基础模型来定义。
AI.result: （1）单一有缺陷oracle可显著夸大能力声明：发明的操作器在优化的预测器下解决43/60交叉RNA目标，但在三个预测器下仅1/60存活；独立预测器仅确认2个设计，而最小自由能求解器确认26个（p=8e-7）；（2）智能体编写程序在计算量减少4.6-10倍的情况下，以0.293对比0.095的性能超越人工程序（n=951，p=5e-5）；（3）无向搜索匹配为精确零，84%的效应来自随机序列已能解决的目标。
AI.conclusion: 该双重审计框架有效揭示了现有验证方法的局限性，证明了引入外部评判器的必要性。虽然实现了在外部评判下的真实差异且未通过计算量购买性能，但未能识别可迁移的机制（测试了七个候选均无效）。框架对自身系统同样严格审查，展现了科学的自我批判精神。研究为AI科学发现系统的可信验证提供了重要方法论贡献。

title: Training nGPT
summary: The normalized Transformer (nGPT) realizes hyperspherical representation learning by constraining model parameter vectors and activation vectors to the unit hypersphere. In this paper, we describe a practical training recipe for nGPT and evaluate it on modern hybrid Mamba-2--Transformer Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The recipe introduces Logit Gradient Preconditioning, Logarithmic Learning Rate Decay, GatedAdamW, angular update control, and optional exploration mechanisms. Compared with an unnormalized model of the same hybrid MoE architecture trained with AdamW, the 14B-total-parameter nGPT model reaches the same validation loss using approximately half as many training tokens. The recipe scales across the models considered, which contain up to 14B total parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对归一化Transformer（nGPT）的实用训练方案，在混合Mamba-2—Transformer MoE模型上实现了训练效率的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 旨在为在单位超球面上约束参数和激活向量的归一化Transformer（nGPT）提供一套实用的训练方案，以充分发挥其超球面表示学习的优势。
AI.method: 引入了一套包含Logit梯度预处理、对数学习率衰减、GatedAdamW、角度更新控制以及可选探索机制的新型训练方案，并在现代混合Mamba-2—Transformer Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）架构上进行评估。
AI.result: 在与使用AdamW训练的同架构非归一化模型相比，14B参数的nGPT模型仅需约一半的训练token即可达到相同的验证损失，且该方案在高达14B参数的模型规模上均表现出良好的扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的训练方案能有效提升nGPT模型的训练效率，并成功扩展至数十亿参数级别的现代混合架构，证明了其实用性和有效性。

title: SCHEDBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Constraint Faithfulness in Natural-Language Combinatorial Scheduling
summary: This paper introduces SCHEDBench, a natural-language benchmark for evaluating combinatorial scheduling constraint faithfulness under surface-form variation. Grounded in canonical scheduling instances and solver-derived feasibility and optimality, SCHEDBench assesses whether large language models (LLMs) generate schedules with the same constraint-feasible behavior across varied natural-language (NL) surface forms. SCHEDBench spans 1,132 instances across job-shop scheduling problems (JSP), single and multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling problems (RCPSP), nurse rostering/scheduling, and curriculum timetabling problems of varying difficulty. Instances are templated into natural language problems using domain-specific templates, themed entities, lexical-syntactic template rephrasing, and constraint-level surface-form variation, with reference solutions verified for feasibility and objective optimality. Across thirteen frontier and open-weight LLMs, we find that models are not reliably invariant to semantically equivalent renderings of the same scheduling problem. Surface-form variation reduces feasibility and induces above-noise shifts in per-instance hard-constraint violations on matched instances. Among the tested isolated axes, constraint reordering yields the clearest above-noise sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SCHEDBench基准，用于评估大语言模型在调度约束问题上的表现。实验发现模型对语义相同但表述不同的调度问题缺乏鲁棒性，表面形式变化会降低可行性并增加约束违规。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏针对调度约束问题的系统性基准来评估大语言模型在面对自然语言表面形式变化时是否能够保持语义等价性和约束满足能力。为了填补这一空白，作者希望构建一个能够系统评估LLM在组合调度问题中约束忠实度的基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建SCHEDBench基准，涵盖1,132个调度实例，包括作业车间调度(JSP)、单/多模式资源受限项目调度(RCPSP)、护士排班和课程时间表问题。使用求解器验证可行性及最优性，通过领域特定模板、主题实体、词汇-句法模板重述和约束级表面形式变化将实例模板化为自然语言问题，系统性地引入表面形式变化以测试模型鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在13个前沿及开源大语言模型上的实验表明：模型对语义等价的调度问题表述缺乏可靠的鲁棒性；表面形式变化降低可行性，并在匹配实例上引发超出噪声水平的硬约束违规；在测试的孤立变化轴中，约束重排序产生最明显的超噪声敏感度。
AI.conclusion: 当前大语言模型在处理组合调度问题时对自然语言表面形式变化存在显著敏感性，无法可靠地保持语义等价问题的约束可行性，这揭示了LLM在实际调度应用中的局限性。

title: Stop When Memory Suffices: Evidence-Conditioned Progressive Execution for LLM Agents
summary: The continued development of LLMs toward persistent and adaptive intelligence increasingly requires long-term memory mechanisms that preserve and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems either compress and structure histories for efficient access or perform deep research over broader trajectories. The former lowers online cost but may omit temporal, causal, or cross-step dependencies, while the latter improves evidence coverage at substantial latency and inference cost. This raises a key question: can a memory system achieve strong answer quality while maintaining low online latency? We introduce Router-Mem, an evidence-conditioned progressive execution framework for long-horizon agent memory. Router-Mem first applies a shared low-cost retrieval prefix to obtain evidence. A lightweight sufficiency router then predicts whether the context supports early termination, which enable a single-token decision at inference time. It is trained with evidence-level supervision and rationale-conditioned representation distillation. When evidence is insufficient, Router-Mem reuses retrieval hits to expand memory blocks and perform deeper analysis and aggregation. Experiments on AMA-Bench and BEAM show that Router-Mem achieves 55.17\% and 38.77\% score while reducing average inference time by 27.3\% and 25.5\% compared with full memory execution.

AI.tldr: Router-Mem通过证据条件化的渐进式执行框架，在长时记忆系统中实现了强答案质量与低在线延迟的平衡，相比全记忆执行在AMA-Bench和BEAM上分别降低27.3%和25.5%的推理时间。
AI.motivation: 现有长时记忆系统存在权衡：压缩结构化方法在线成本低但可能遗漏时序、因果或跨步依赖；深度研究方法证据覆盖好但延迟和推理成本高。关键问题是如何同时实现强答案质量和低在线延迟。
AI.method: 提出Router-Mem证据条件化渐进式执行框架：(1)应用共享低成本检索前缀获取证据；(2)轻量充分性路由器预测上下文是否支持早期终止，实现推理时单令牌决策；(3)采用证据级监督和理由条件化表示蒸馏训练；(4)证据不足时重用检索命中扩展记忆块并进行深度分析聚合。
AI.result: 在AMA-Bench上达到55.17%分数，降低27.3%推理时间；在BEAM上达到38.77%分数，降低25.5%推理时间。相比全记忆执行，在保持竞争力的答案质量同时显著减少了推理时间。
AI.conclusion: Router-Mem成功解决了长时记忆系统中答案质量与在线延迟的权衡问题，通过渐进式执行和早期终止机制，在适度降低推理成本的同时维持了良好的记忆利用效果，为持久自适应智能提供了有效的记忆解决方案。

title: Judging Is Not Enumerating: Silent Omissions in LLM-Authored Acceptable Sets
summary: Language models are increasingly promoted from examinees to examiners: they write the test suites, answer keys, rubrics, and reward functions that define correctness for other systems. We measure the capability that role assumes and find it lacking under the protocol the role is usually deployed with, one-shot greedy authoring with no test-time reasoning. Across four reference constructions - two with complete finite truth, one with a hardened executable reference (HumanEval+/MBPP+), one with an explicitly incomplete lexical reference (WordNet) - models judge whether a candidate belongs far better than they author the set itself. On the incompleteness-proof algorithmic construction the gap is +0.34 to +0.29 F1 over a 24x parameter range and does not close; on executable code, models judging at F1 0.74-0.90 author suites admitting only 19-42% of oracle-correct solutions. A control locates the deficit: asked to emit the predicate rather than its extension, the same models reach F1 about 0.99. The failure is not missing knowledge or an inability to specify, but an inability to materialise the region a specification induces. The dominant error is omission, which resists audit: an over-inclusion is a token a reviewer can challenge, a missing member an absence whose discovery is the authoring problem itself. Models detect planted over-inclusions 6-7x more often than planted omissions, and a production deployment of 43,227 items fails omission-first at 10:1. Wired into RLVR, an authored key costs 1.9 points of accuracy against an exact oracle and 18.5 WordNet-relative (six paired seeds, p=0.031). Gating authored verifiers on a known-correct probe cuts false rejection from 58-92% to at most 5%, but keeps only 5-39% of suites. Repairing them instead, by rewriting each wrong expected value to what a reference execution returns, raises yield 3.3-10.6x across four author families.

AI.tldr: 研究发现语言模型作为“考官”编写测试套件时表现不佳，主要表现为遗漏错误，导致拒绝正确答案。提出通过探测和修复策略可显著提升测试套件质量。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型从“考生”转变为“考官”，被广泛用于编写测试套件、答案键和奖励函数来评估其他系统。然而，这种角色通常采用一次性贪婪生成方式，缺乏测试时推理。作者旨在测量模型在这种部署协议下的能力是否充足，并揭示其失败的根本原因。
AI.method: 研究在四种参考构建上进行对比实验：两类完备的有限真理集、一类可执行的代码基准（HumanEval+/MBPP+）、一类显式不完备的词汇参考（WordNet）。对比模型“评判”候选（判断某项是否属于集合）与“撰写”集合本身的能力差距。通过控制实验要求模型输出谓词而非其扩展来定位缺陷来源。分析错误类型，测试模型对人为植入的过度包含与遗漏的检测率，并在生产部署中统计失败比例。进一步在RLVR中量化 authored key 对准确率的影响，提出并验证两种缓解策略：用已知正确探针对撰写器进行门控，以及对错误期望值进行重写修复。
AI.result: 模型在评判任务上显著优于撰写任务：在不完备证明的算法构建上，F1差距为+0.34至+0.29（跨越24倍参数范围）；在可执行代码基准上，模型评判F1达0.74-0.90，但撰写的测试套件仅允许19-42%的oracle正确解通过。控制实验表明，当要求输出谓词时，模型F1接近0.99，说明缺陷不在于知识缺失或无法描述，而是无法将规范所诱导的区域具体化。主要错误类型是遗漏：模型检测人为植入过度包含的频率是遗漏的6-7倍；在43,227项生产部署中，遗漏优先的失败比例达10:1。在RLVR中使用撰写的答案键相对于精确oracle导致准确率损失1.9个百分点，WordNet相对损失18.5。门控策略可将错误拒绝率从58-92%降至最多5%，但仅保留5-39%的套件；修复策略通过重写错误期望值，可将产出率提升3.3-10.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在当前典型的一次性贪婪生成协议下，无法可靠地撰写测试套件，核心问题在于无法将规范具体化为完整的集合，表现为难以审计的遗漏错误。通过探针门控或基于参考执行结果的自动修复，可以显著缓解这一问题，提升生成测试套件的有效性和可用性。

title: From AI Technical Debt to Agentic Technical Debt: A Systematic Mapping of Root Causes and Manifestations in Agentic AI Systems
comment: 32 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering
summary: The emergence of Agentic AI systems, characterized by autonomous reasoning, multi-agent collaboration, tool orchestration, adaptive decision-making, and persistent memory, represents a fundamental shift from traditional AI pipelines to dynamic software ecosystems. While AI Technical Debt (AITD) has been widely studied in machine learning and software engineering, existing models assume static, component-level architectures and fail to capture the dynamic and emergent behaviors of agentic environments. To address this gap, this paper introduces Agentic Technical Debt (AgTD), defined as technical debt that emerges, accumulates, propagates, and amplifies due to the autonomous and collaborative nature of Agentic AI systems. Building on our prior systematic scoping review of 31 AITDs across seven root-cause categories, we employ a theory-informed transformation methodology to reinterpret these debts in Agentic AI through direct transformation, contextual transformation, and manifestation expansion. We present the first systematic mapping of established AITDs to their agentic manifestations, showing how conventional debts evolve into system-level liabilities, including memory inconsistencies, orchestration fragility, cascading failures, and unsafe autonomous decision-making. Our findings show that technical debt extends beyond software artifacts to encompass agent behaviors, coordination mechanisms, and interactions among agents, tools, and execution environments. We further examine its implications for AI Trust, Risk, and Security Management (AI TRiSM), highlighting impacts on trustworthiness, governance, security, operational resilience, and Sustainability Technical Debt. Overall, this work establishes AgTD as a foundational software engineering construct and provides a transformation framework, taxonomy, and research agenda for managing technical debt in autonomous multi-agent AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地提出了“智能体技术债务”（AgTD）概念，将其定义为因智能体AI系统的自主与协作特性而产生、累积、传播和放大的技术债务，并提供了首个从传统AITD到AgTD的系统性映射与转化框架。
AI.motivation: 传统AI技术债务（AITD）研究多基于静态、组件级架构，无法充分刻画智能体AI系统（具备自主推理、多智能体协作、工具编排等动态行为）中技术债务的动态与涌现特性，因此亟需建立适配该类新型系统的新框架。
AI.method: 作者基于先前对31种AITD（跨越7类根因）的系统性综述，采用理论驱动的转化方法论，通过直接转化、情境转化和表现形式扩展，将既有的AITD映射到智能体场景中，进行重新诠释与系统性映射。
AI.result: 研究揭示了传统技术债务在智能体系统中演化为系统级负债（如记忆不一致、编排脆弱性、级联失败、不安全的自主决策等），其范围从软件制品扩展到智能体行为、协调机制及智能体-工具-环境的交互，并影响AI可信赖性、治理、安全、运营韧性与可持续性。
AI.conclusion: 本工作将AgTD确立为基础性软件工程构造，并提供了转化框架、分类法与研究议程，为在自主多智能体AI系统中管理和缓解技术债务奠定了理论与实践基础。

title: AlphaG-OPD: Reliability-Gated Sibling Counterfactuals for On-Policy Distillation in Symbolic Alpha Factor Discovery
summary: Symbolic alpha factor discovery can score a completed expression, but it provides no direct label for the structural decisions that produced it. Generative flow networks (GFlowNets) preserve a diverse, reward-proportional distribution over complete expressions, yet their trajectory-level objective does not compare unchosen sibling actions at an intermediate state. We introduce AlphaG-OPD, a structural on-policy distillation framework that turns terminal factor evaluations into local action guidance. Its design separates three decisions. Component I determines where to teach by exposing grammar-valid siblings at partial abstract-syntax-tree (AST) states visited by the current forward policy. Component II determines what is reliable enough to teach: it evaluates three supported siblings under four shared suffixes and admits a KL-bounded target only when their matched comparisons exhibit sufficient winner agreement and a positive empirical lower confidence bound (LCB). Component III determines how strongly and for how long to teach by consolidating accepted targets through bounded replay, score-indexed expiry, and forward-gradient balancing, without additional factor evaluations. Terminal reward, Trajectory Balance, the backward policy, grammar, and factor-pool rules remain unchanged. An equal-physical-score four-arm ablation tests paired teaching, reliability gating, and consolidation. Across China's CSI300, CSI500, and CSI1000 and the U.S. S&P 500, the complete method delivers strong cross-market performance over multiple random seeds.

AI.tldr: 提出AlphaG-OPD框架，将符号化Alpha因子发现的终端评估转化为局部动作指导，通过三组件设计实现结构化策略蒸馏，在中美股市指数上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 符号化Alpha因子发现能够对完整表达式评分，但无法为产生该表达式的结构决策提供直接标签；而生成流网络(GFlowNets)虽能保持多样性分布，但其轨迹级目标无法在中间状态比较未被选择的兄弟动作。
AI.method: 提出AlphaG-OPD结构化策略蒸馏框架，包含三个组件：I) 确定教学位置——在当前前向策略访问的部分抽象语法树状态下暴露语法有效的兄弟动作；II) 确定可靠教学内容——在四个共享后缀下评估三个兄弟动作，当匹配比较显示足够的一致性和正的经验下置信界时才接受KL约束的目标；III) 确定教学强度和时长——通过有界回放、分数索引过期和前向梯度平衡来巩固已接受的目标，无需额外因子评估。
AI.result: 在CSI300、CSI500、CSI1000和S&P 500指数上，完整方法在多个随机种子下展现出强劲的跨市场性能；等物理分数四臂消融实验验证了配对教学、可靠性门控和巩固机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AlphaG-OPD成功将终端因子评估转化为局部动作指导，通过分离where/what/how三个决策维度实现了有效的结构化策略蒸馏，在不改变终端奖励、轨迹平衡、后向策略、语法和因子池规则的前提下，显著提升了跨市场Alpha因子发现的性能。

title: Toward Fine-Grained Forgetting:Attribute Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit strong vision--language capabilities but may also memorize and disclose sensitive information. Machine unlearning seeks to remove designated knowledge without retraining from scratch while preserving general utility. Existing privacy-oriented benchmarks primarily adopt profile-level deletion, whereas practical requests are often finer grained: a model should forget a specified attribute while retaining non-sensitive information about the same identity. We therefore introduce attribute-level MLLM unlearning as a finer-grained task and construct a benchmark spanning long-text, numeric, and short-text targets, multiple forget ratios, and diverse question types. Our evaluation reveals that target and retained attributes share identity-specific and visual evidence, making selective forgetting susceptible to residual leakage or collateral degradation; accordingly, existing methods exhibit unstable forgetting--retention trade-offs in this setting. To address this challenge, we propose Causal Localization and Retain-Aware Projection (CLRP), a lightweight training-free framework. CLRP uses activation patching to identify the layer that causally mediates target-attribute disclosure, then applies a retain-aware projection that removes the target-attribute subspace while preserving same-identity evidence. Experiments across multiple widely used MLLMs with distinct architectures and parameter scales demonstrate the effectiveness of CLRP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了属性级MLLM遗忘任务，构建了细粒度基准，并提出了无需训练的CLRP框架，通过因果定位和保持感知投影实现选择性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型（MLLM）遗忘研究主要关注身份级别的删除，但实际需求往往更为细粒度：模型需要遗忘特定属性同时保留同一身份的非敏感信息。目标属性与保留属性之间存在身份特定和视觉证据的共享，导致现有方法在选择性遗忘时容易出现残留泄露或连带退化问题。
AI.method: 提出了因果定位与保持感知投影（CLRP）框架：1）利用激活修补技术识别因果中介目标属性披露的层；2）应用保持感知投影，在移除目标属性子空间的同时保留同一身份的证据。该框架轻量级且无需训练。
AI.result: 在多种架构和参数规模的MLLM上进行的实验表明，CLRP能够有效解决属性级遗忘任务中目标属性与保留属性共享证据的挑战，在遗忘-保持权衡方面优于现有方法。构建的基准涵盖长文本、数值和短文本目标、多种遗忘比例和多样化问题类型。
AI.conclusion: 属性级MLLM遗忘是一个重要的细粒度任务，现有方法在此设置下表现不稳定。所提出的CLRP框架通过因果定位和保持感知投影，成功解决了选择性遗忘中的残留泄露和连带退化问题，为细粒度隐私保护提供了有效解决方案。

title: Spatiotemporal Proximal Causal Inference under Hidden Confounding and Interference
summary: Estimating causal effects from real-world spatiotemporal data is challenging due to hidden confounders and interference. Standard causal identification methods assume conditional exchangeability given observed covariates, which fails whenever hidden confounders affect both treatment and outcomes - a common setting in domains such as climate, environmental policy, epidemiology, and regional economics. In this paper, we propose a novel spatiotemporal proximal causal inference framework that extends proximal identification theory to spatiotemporal settings. The proposed method jointly captures local and neighborhood-level confounding information by introducing treatment- and outcome-inducing proxies, and we derive a spatiotemporal outcome confounding bridge function that identifies the potential outcome without requiring direct recovery of the hidden confounder. We establish the identifiability of this bridge function under proxy exclusion restrictions and a spatiotemporal completeness condition, and show that the resulting estimator recovers the outcome through a proximal generalization of the g-computation formula. To operationalize this identification result, we propose a neural architecture that learns proxies via transformer-based spatiotemporal encoders - coupled with a conditional mutual information critic to enforce exclusion restrictions and a moment-matching network to guarantee that the learned bridge function satisfies the underlying identifying equation. We further introduce a stabilized weighting scheme to address treatment support imbalance. Experiments on synthetic datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves comparable performance to baseline causal inference methods, while providing, to our knowledge, the first theoretically grounded outcomes for the hidden confounding in the presence of spatiotemporal interference through a proximal causal inference framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个处理时空干扰下隐藏混杂的近端因果推断框架，通过引入代理变量学习桥接函数，实现了在无需恢复隐藏混杂因子的情况下识别因果效应。
AI.motivation: 现有因果识别方法假设给定观测协变量后的条件可交换性，但在气候、环境政策、流行病学和区域经济学等领域的时空数据中，普遍存在影响处理和结果的隐藏混杂因子及时空干扰，导致标准方法失效。
AI.method: 提出时空近端因果推断框架：1)引入处理诱导和结果诱导代理变量捕捉局部与邻域混杂信息；2)推导时空结果混杂桥接函数，在代理排除限制和时空完整性条件下实现识别；3)基于Transformer的时空编码器学习代理，结合条件互信息批判器强制排除限制、矩匹配网络保证桥接函数满足识别方程；4)引入稳定加权方案解决处理支持不平衡。
AI.result: 在合成数据集上的实验表明，该方法在存在时空干扰和隐藏混杂的情况下，达到了与基线因果推断方法相当的性能，并提供了理论上可证明的因果效应估计。
AI.conclusion: 本工作首次建立了时空干扰下隐藏混杂的近端因果推断理论框架，证明了通过代理变量和桥接函数识别潜在结果的可能性，为气候、环境、流行病学等领域的时空因果推断提供了新的理论基础和方法论支持。

title: FactorJEPA: Factorizing Monolithic Futures into Layout-Agent-Interaction Channels for Crowded and Chaotic Global South Urban Worlds
summary:
World models have attracted significant attention for their ability to capture and predict the structure and dynamics of the physical world. In this emerging landscape, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) offer a particularly compelling direction.
  We study a largely unexplored regime: populous, crowded, and chaotic Global South urban environments, which we call DENSEWORLD. Unlike the lower-density, lane-structured settings that dominate existing evaluations, these scenes exhibit soft spatial boundaries, extreme agent heterogeneity, persistent occlusion, and rapid social negotiation under mixed traffic. We introduce the first large-scale dataset for this regime: 1,000 hours of drive-through, walk-through, and aerial video across 22 cities. Existing JEPA formulations struggle to preserve dense interaction dynamics under heterogeneity and partial observability.
  We introduce FactorJEPA, which makes world structure a first-class predictive primitive. Rather than encoding the future in a monolithic latent, it composes layout, entities, and interactions, using a visibility gate and separated subspaces to preserve partially observed agents and discourage cross-factor shortcuts. FactorJEPA improves (i) future-latent accuracy (Future-frame L1), (ii) intervention-sensitive prediction (Causal L1), and (iii) robustness to reduced visual evidence (Mask-ratio slope), while exposing (iv) a reproducible motion-information trade-off (Motion cosine). Method rankings replicate across 2B and 1B V-JEPA 2.1 backbones, with rho = 0.895 to 0.978.
  We publicly release the DENSEWORLD-115k dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymousML123/denseworld-115k) and the surgery-trained FactorJEPA checkpoints (https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymousML123/factorjepa-outputs/tree/main/outputs/full/vjepa_2_1_vitg_1B/train/m09c_surgery_3stage_DI_diheavy_encoder).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DENSEWORLD数据集和FactorJEPA方法，用于解决拥挤混乱的全球南方城市环境中的世界建模问题。FactorJEPA通过分解布局、实体和交互来提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型评估主要关注低密度、车道结构的场景，而拥挤混乱的全球南方城市环境（具有软空间边界、极端代理异质性、持续遮挡和混合交通下的快速社交协商）的研究严重不足。现有JEPA公式在异质性和部分可观测性下难以保持密集交互动态。
AI.method: 提出FactorJEPA，将世界结构作为一级预测原语。该方法不将未来编码为单一潜在表示，而是组合布局、实体和交互三个因子，通过可见性门控和分离子空间来保持部分观测代理并防止跨因子捷径。同时发布了DENSEWORLD-115k数据集（1000小时、22个城市数据）。
AI.result: FactorJEPA在以下方面取得改进：(i) 未来潜在准确率（Future-frame L1），(ii) 干预敏感预测（Causal L1），(iii) 对减少视觉证据的鲁棒性（Mask-ratio slope），同时揭示了(iv)可复现的运动-信息权衡（Motion cosine）。方法排名在2B和1B V-JEPA 2.1主干网络上复现，rho=0.895到0.978。
AI.conclusion: FactorJEPA成功解决了密集异质环境中的世界建模挑战，为全球南方城市环境的世界模型研究提供了新的基准和方法。研究公开了数据集和模型检查点，促进了该领域的进一步研究。

title: Do Neural Networks Really Beat the Curse of Dimensionality? A Bit-Complexity View
summary:
Traditional approximation theory measures convergence rates in terms of the number of parameters or degrees of freedom. However, practical computation operates under finite precision: parameters must be encoded using a finite number of bits. Therefore, approximation efficiency should be evaluated in terms of computational bit complexity, which is intrinsically connected to the metric entropy of the underlying function class.
  In this work, we develop a unified approximation framework based on binary encoding and metric entropy. We analyze classical methods (including polynomial approximation, sparse grids, and finite elements) as well as shallow and deep neural networks, and compare their approximation rates for function classes with comparable metric entropy. We observe that, when evaluated in terms of bits, most classical methods are in general suboptimal relative to the intrinsic limits dictated by metric entropy, while neural network methods may exhibit different behaviors. We show that when complexity is measured in bits rather than parameters, no method fundamentally exceeds the approximation order achieved by classical approaches.
  Our results also indicate that many seeming advantages of neural networks, including dimension-independent rates and superconvergence phenomena, stem from differences in function class complexity rather than intrinsic architectural superiority. In this sense, the traditional curse of dimensionality can be misleading; the fundamental limitation is instead a curse of bit complexity, governed by metric entropy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于计算比特复杂度的统一逼近框架，发现传统方法和神经网络均受度量熵制约，神经网络看似优越的逼近性能源于函数类复杂度差异而非架构优势。
AI.motivation: 传统逼近理论以参数数量或自由度衡量收敛率，但实际计算需用有限比特编码参数，因此逼近效率应从计算比特复杂度角度评估，这与函数类的度量熵本质相关。
AI.method: 建立基于二进制编码和度量熵的统一逼近框架，分析多项式逼近、稀疏网格、有限元等经典方法以及浅层和深层神经网络，比较它们在具有相近度量熵的函数类上的逼近率。
AI.result: 以比特衡量时，大多数经典方法相对于度量熵的内在极限普遍次优；神经网络方法表现出不同行为，但以比特复杂度衡量时，其逼近阶并不根本超越经典方法；神经网络所谓维度无关收敛率和超收敛现象源于函数类复杂度差异而非架构优势。
AI.conclusion: 传统的维数灾难具有误导性，根本限制是由度量熵支配的比特复杂度灾难；神经网络在逼近阶上并无根本优势，其优势源于复杂度量差异。

title: Don't Offer What Can't Be Done: Deterministic Executability Gating for LLM Skill Selection at Scale
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Preprint. Submitted to the ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2027), Applied Data Science Track; currently under review
summary:
Production LLM agents that select from large skill libraries face a limitation that semantic relevance alone cannot resolve: a skill may match a user's topic yet be impossible to execute in the current account state. We present a deployed three-stage selection pipeline for Helpmate, Wix's customer-care assistant. First, a recall-oriented semantic matcher identifies messages related to a ten-skill domain family without consulting account state. Second, a deterministic executability gate removes candidates whose internal hard-stop conditions hold. Because the gate and the skill evaluate the same exit predicates, every blocked candidate would be unable to complete under the same account state, provided predicate parity is preserved and both checks observe fresh authoritative state. Finally, the LLM decides whether to invoke one of the remaining candidates.
  In a post-launch production analysis of 756.6K user messages across 267.6K conversations, semantic matching retained 174,927 messages (23.1%). Within this matched stream, the gate removed 1,039,462 of 1,749,270 skill-message pairs (59.4%), saving 228.8 million skill-description tokens -- 59.1% of the post-semantic skill-description footprint. Together, semantic matching and executability gating reduced skill-description context by 90.5% relative to exposing all ten skills to every message.
  To test whether this pruning affects model behavior rather than context size alone, we replayed a risk-enriched cohort of 1,000 conversations with all ten skills exposed. The model selected a production-blocked skill in 78 conversations (7.8%). This counterfactual result shows that deterministic gating prevents non-executable candidates from influencing model selection, while not claiming downstream tool execution or customer-outcome effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于生产环境LLM智能体的三阶段技能选择管道，通过语义匹配和可执行性门控机制，在保持选择准确性的同时大幅降低了上下文开销。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的LLM智能体在面对大型技能库时存在一个关键限制：仅依靠语义相关性无法判断技能是否能在当前账户状态下执行，某些技能可能匹配用户话题但在特定账户状态下无法执行。
AI.method: 提出三阶段选择管道：(1)召回导向的语义匹配器，识别与十技能域相关的消息，不检查账户状态；(2)确定性可执行性门控，通过内部硬停止条件移除不可执行的候选技能；(3)LLM决定是否调用剩余候选技能。门控和技能评估相同的退出谓词，确保被阻塞的候选技能在相同账户状态下无法完成。
AI.result: 在756.6K用户消息的生产分析中，语义匹配保留了23.1%的消息。在匹配流中，门控移除了59.4%的技能-消息对，节省了228.8M个技能描述令牌（59.1%的后语义技能描述足迹）。语义匹配和可执行性门控共同将技能描述上下文减少了90.5%。在1000个对话的风险丰富队列重放测试中，模型在78个对话（7.8%）中选择了生产阻塞的技能。
AI.conclusion: 确定性门控能够有效防止不可执行候选技能影响模型选择，证明了该管道在降低上下文开销的同时能够保持选择准确性，为生产环境中的LLM智能体技能选择提供了有效的解决方案。

title: When May a Model Replace the Experiment? Audits, Licenses, and the Price of Trust in Surrogate-Driven Design
comment: 47 pages (18 pages main text, 29 pages Supporting Information), 9 figures, 2 tables, 70 references. SI contains complete proofs of all theorems, extended experiments, and the verification methodology
summary: Design campaigns in chemistry, materials science, and machine learning share a bottleneck: determining how good a candidate truly is requires an expensive evaluation - an experiment, a first-principles simulation, or a full training run. Machine-learning surrogates that predict these outcomes are increasingly used not only to propose candidates but to grade them, and even to feed their own predictions back into the search as though they were measurements. Through mathematical analysis validated on three exhaustively ground-truthed design tasks, we establish when this practice is safe, what any certificate of safety must cost, and when the substitution provably pays. Predictive accuracy cannot anchor trust: near-perfect R^2 is compatible with worst-possible selections, and screening N candidates inflates the over-prediction at the selected candidate by a quantifiable "selection tax" with matching upper and lower bounds. Safety follows instead from an architectural rule - predictions may propose and train without restriction, but every certified conclusion must rest on true evaluations - which is sufficient with no assumptions on the surrogate, and necessary, since admitting predictions into certification with the standing of measurements opens a deterministic self-confirmation failure mode. We derive the minimal criterion under which a model may act as an oracle (rank preservation, not accuracy), show that trust must be purchased through selection-aware audits that are optimal in query complexity, and prove a dichotomy fixing when audited surrogates cut certified evaluation cost. Across 432 surrogate fits over six task-regime conditions, the audit statistic tracks deployed search performance at Spearman rank correlation 0.80-0.99, while the rank correlation of R^2 with deployed regret falls as low as 0.33; audited screening reduces certified oracle cost by a measured factor of 25.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了在科学设计与机器学习中，将预测值当作真实评估结果使用的风险，提出通过“选择审计”替代预测精度作为安全认证标准，并证明了该方法的必要性与有效性。
AI.motivation: 在化学、材料科学及机器学习的设计活动中，评估候选方案的真实性能成本高昂（如实验、第一性原理计算、完整训练）。为降低成本，研究者常使用机器学习代理模型预测结果，并将这些预测值反馈到搜索过程中，甚至将其视为真实测量结果来对候选方案进行定级和筛选。这种做法存在潜在风险，但缺乏对其安全性边界和有效性的系统性分析。
AI.method: 通过数学分析与三个具有完整真实标签的设计任务进行验证。理论推导了预测模型用于认证的安全边界、必要条件与代偿机制（“选择税”）。实验部分对比了预测精度（R²）与“选择审计”统计量在实际部署中的表现，分析不同代理模型在多种任务设置下的行为。
AI.result: （1）预测精度不可作为信任锚点：近乎完美的R²与最差选择共存；（2）筛选过程会产生可量化的“选择税”，导致被选候选的过高预测；（3）提出架构规则——预测可提出候选，但任何认证结论必须基于真实评估，证明其充分且必要；（4）导出模型作为“oracle”的最小准则（保序性），并提出选择感知审计方法，其在查询复杂度上最优；（5）在432个代理模型拟合中，审计统计量与部署搜索性能的Spearman相关系数达0.80-0.99，而R²与部署遗憾的相关性最低仅0.33；（6）审计筛选使认证oracle成本降低25倍。
AI.conclusion: 将机器学习预测值直接用于候选认证具有确定性的自确认失败模式，不安全。安全的做法是遵循“预测提出、真实认证”的架构规则，并采用选择感知审计代替预测精度作为信任度量。该方法理论上有保障，实验中显著降低了认证评估成本，为科学设计与自动化机器学习提供了安全、高效的代理使用框架。

title: Control Under Compression: Reliability Frontiers for Tool-Using Agents
summary: Tool-using language-model agents are governed not only by task prompts but also by persistent system-side instructions that specify tools, arguments, policies, execution protocols, and recovery. Compressing these agent control contexts (ACCs) can reduce input cost and context use, yet existing prompt-compression evaluations do not reveal whether the resulting control remains operationally reliable. We introduce CompressAgent, an environment-verified benchmark for ACC compression across nine independently constructed ACCs, three task families, three fixed Qwen API model identifiers, six retained-context budgets, and 15,525 runs. We uncover a nonlinear, method-dependent reliability frontier. At 75% retained context, generic rewriting and section-based compression achieve 92.7% and 92.4% success, close to the 93.8% full-context baseline. Between 50% and 35%, methods diverge sharply; at 35%, section-based, obligation-aware, and generic rewriting achieve 47.0%, 39.0%, and 19.9%. At retained-context budgets from 25% to 10%, executable protocols become fragile. Reliability also varies substantially across ACCs, making universal compressor rankings inappropriate and motivating per-context qualification. Failure analysis shows that compression primarily surfaces as tool-execution and action-parsing errors. These findings recast ACC compression from token reduction into a runtime-reliability problem that must be evaluated through executable outcomes.

AI.tldr: 提出了CompressAgent基准，用于评估智能体控制上下文（ACC）压缩的运行可靠性，发现压缩率与任务成功率之间存在非线性关系，不同压缩方法在不同保留上下文比例下表现差异显著，强调ACC压缩需通过可执行结果进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的提示词压缩评估方法无法揭示压缩后的智能体控制上下文（ACC）是否保持运行可靠性，而ACC压缩对降低输入成本和上下文使用至关重要，因此需要建立一个基于环境验证的基准来评估ACC压缩的实际效果。
AI.method: 引入CompressAgent基准，在九个独立构建的ACC、三个任务家族、三个固定的Qwen API模型标识符、六个保留上下文预算和15,525次运行的环境中验证ACC压缩效果，系统性地评估不同压缩方法的可靠性表现。
AI.result: 发现压缩率与可靠性之间存在非线性的方法依赖关系：在75%保留上下文时，通用重写和基于分段的压缩成功率接近基线（92.7%和92.4% vs 93.8%）；在50%-35%区间方法差异显著，35%时分别为47.0%、39.0%和19.9%；在25%-10%时协议执行变得脆弱。可靠性在不同ACC间差异显著，无法进行通用压缩器排名。压缩失败主要表现为工具执行和动作解析错误。
AI.conclusion: ACC压缩应从单纯的token减少问题重新定义为运行时可靠性问题，必须通过可执行结果进行评估，并需要针对每个上下文进行压缩器的资格认证，而非采用通用排名。

title: On the Identifiability of Masked Prediction: Mode Blindness and Mask Schedules
summary: Masked prediction learns representations by fitting a schedule-weighted family of conditional laws, but it remains unclear when near-optimal conditional prediction pins down the underlying joint law. We study this question for data with two well-separated global modes, outside the reach of rapid-mixing recovery guarantees, and show that the answer is decided by the mask schedule alone. Under large-context mode pinning, reweighting the two modes can move the joint law by a constant in total variation while perturbing the masked objective exponentially little in the visible-context size: mask schedules dominated by large contexts are provably blind to the global mode weights. To quantify this, we introduce an $\varepsilon$-identifiability modulus, the largest distributional error consistent with a given excess risk, and prove that it remains macroscopic at an excess risk that is exponentially small. An exact information decomposition pinpoints what restores identifiability: mode-weight sensitivity is governed by the residual mode uncertainty given the visible context. Consequently, low-visibility masks recover this sensitivity, and positive full-mask mass anchors the joint law over all admissible models with no assumption on the data law. Empirically, we test our theory at three levels: enumeration on computable laws verifies the predicted rates, gradient training reproduces both the mode blindness and the recovery, and measurements on real corpora place natural text between the two certified regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了掩码预测中掩码调度对全局模式权重的“盲区”现象，并提出ε-可识别性模量化这一缺陷，指出低可见性掩码可恢复对模式权重的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 掩码预测通过拟合条件分布族学习表示，但在何种条件下条件预测能唯一确定联合分布尚不清晰；本文旨在回答在数据具有两个全局模式时，掩码调度如何决定联合分布的可识别性。
AI.method: 作者构建了具有两个全局模式的数据模型，定义ε-可识别性模来刻画给定过剩风险下最大分布误差；通过信息分解分析可见上下文给定后残余模式不确定性，从而识别恢复可识别性的条件。
AI.result: 在大上下文模式锁定下，模式权重调整可在总变差上移动联合分布常数级距离而掩码目标扰动仅指数级小；ε-可识别性模在过剩风险指数小时仍为宏观尺度；低可见性掩码可恢复模式权重敏感性，正的全掩码质量可锚定联合分布。
AI.conclusion: 掩码调度单独决定联合分布的可识别性；实践中应在低可见性掩码与正全掩码质量之间取得平衡，以确保对全局模式权重的敏感性；实验在可计算法则、梯度训练及真实语料上验证了理论预测。

title: Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals: Separating Matching and Content Retrieval Across Depth
summary: Depth-routing residual architectures allow Transformer layers to retrieve earlier representations instead of inheriting only the immediately preceding state. Existing Block Attention Residuals, however, use a single content-dependent depth mixture to construct the inputs to queries, keys, and values. This design couples two functionally different decisions: queries and keys determine where attention matches, whereas values determine what content is retrieved. We therefore ask whether matching and content retrieval should be forced to read from the same depth. We introduce Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals (RD-AttnRes), a minimal extension that shares one depth route between queries and keys while learning an independent value route over the same residual sources. Tying the two routing queries exactly recovers the parent architecture, while decoupling them adds only one model-width vector per layer and introduces no additional token-to-token attention operation. We evaluate RD-AttnRes using a frozen, paired pretraining protocol on FineWeb-Edu with five matched seeds for both 120M- and 343M-parameter models and a 2.0B-token training budget. RD-AttnRes improves validation negative log-likelihood in all 10 matched comparisons. The mean reductions are 0.0301 and 0.0247, corresponding to perplexity reductions of 2.97 percent and 2.43 percent at 120M and 343M parameters, respectively. Early-budget controls indicate that neither the additional parameter count, duplicated routing execution, nor a fixed value route reproduces the improvement. Routing diagnostics further reveal persistent divergence between the query-key and value depth distributions. These results suggest that, within the evaluated training regime, attention matching and content retrieval benefit from distinct reads over the residual hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 提出角色解耦注意力残差（RD-AttnRes），将查询-键与值的深度路由分离，在相同计算预算下显著降低验证集困惑度（120M和343M参数模型分别降低2.97%和2.43%）。
AI.motivation: 现有块注意力残差架构使用单一的内容相关深度混合来构建查询、键和值，这将两个功能不同的决策耦合在一起：查询和键决定注意力匹配的位置，而值决定检索的内容。作者质疑是否应该强制匹配和内容检索从同一深度读取。
AI.method: 提出角色解耦注意力残差（RD-AttnRes），这是一个最小扩展：在查询和键之间共享一条深度路由，同时在相同的残差源上学习一条独立的值路由。解耦路由仅增加每个层一个模型宽度向量，不引入额外的token到token注意力操作。使用冻结配对预训练协议在FineWeb-Edu上评估，采用五个匹配种子分别训练120M和343M参数模型，训练预算为2.0B token。
AI.result: RD-AttnRes在所有10组配对比较中均改善了验证负对数似然。120M和343M参数模型的平均降低分别为0.0301和0.0247，对应困惑度分别降低2.97%和2.43%。消融实验表明额外参数量、重复路由执行或固定值路由均无法复现该改进。路由诊断显示查询-键与值的深度分布存在持续差异。
AI.conclusion: 在评估的训练框架内，注意力匹配和内容检索从残差层次结构的不同读取中受益，表明解耦查询-键和值的深度路由是有益的设计选择。

title: TabDPT-Turbo: Efficient In-Context Learning for Tabular Prediction
comment: Presented as a poster at the non-archival ICML workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (FMSD)
summary: Tabular foundation models, driven by in-context learning, have rapidly grown in quality and popularity. However, recent approaches with either cell-based architectures or retrieval have sacrificed efficiency for raw performance, restricting their utility in situations where compute is limited or inference speed is crucial. We adopt an alternate approach, sticking with row-based attention while incorporating long context pre-training to eliminate the need for retrieval. By combining this with architectural improvements and SSL pre-training on a newly-sourced, larger corpus of real data results, we present TabDPT-Turbo, a model that provides comparable default performance to TabDPT v1.1 on TabArena-Lite, CC18, and CTR23, at orders of magnitude faster. In our experiments, TabDPT-Turbo is the fastest model overall among leading foundation models. We have released the new model as TabDPT v1.2 at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/TabDPT-inference.

AI.tldr: 提出了TabDPT-Turbo，通过行级注意力机制和长上下文预训练，在保持与TabDPT v1.1相当性能的同时，实现了数量级的推理速度提升，成为当前最快的基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的表格基础模型（基于单元格架构或检索方法）为了追求性能而牺牲了效率，限制了其在计算资源受限或推理速度至关重要场景中的应用。
AI.method: 采用基于行的注意力机制，结合长上下文预训练来消除对检索的需求；引入架构改进；在新收集的更大规模真实数据结果语料库上进行自监督学习预训练。
AI.result: 在TabArena-Lite、CC18和CTR23基准测试中，性能与TabDPT v1.1相当，但推理速度提升数个数量级；在领先的基础模型中整体速度最快。
AI.conclusion: TabDPT-Turbo成功平衡了性能与效率，已作为TabDPT v1.2发布，为计算受限场景提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: Inter-Residue Geometry Attention for Antibody-Specific Epitope Prediction
summary: Antibody-specific epitope prediction aims to identify which antigen residues are recognized by a given antibody, a task that depends on the three-dimensional complementarity between antibody CDRs and the antigen surface. Existing methods usually leverage PLM embeddings and inject structure through additional graph, surface, or point-cloud encoders, where the positional mechanism inside attention remains largely tied to one-dimensional sequence order. For proteins, the analogue of a token offset is not only sequence separation, but also the three-dimensional displacement between residues after folding. This raises a question, can folded residue geometry serve as the positional mechanism of attention itself? We propose Local-Frame 3D Rotary Position Encoding (LF3DRoPE), which expresses inter-residue displacements in backbone-defined local frames and injects them directly into rotary attention. This design preserves continuous directional geometry while ensuring invariance to global $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ transformations. On the AsEP benchmark, LF3DRoPE achieves state-of-the-art $\mathrm{MCC}$ on both ratio and epitope-group splits. Ablations and rigid transformation tests show that local three-dimensional geometry provides information beyond sequence-order attention while preserving invariance to arbitrary global coordinate systems. Mutation ranking results further indicate that LF3DRoPE captures antigen-specific structural compatibility.

AI.tldr: 提出了LF3DRoPE方法，将蛋白质骨架局部坐标系中的三维几何位移直接注入旋转注意力机制，在抗体特异性表位预测任务上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖一维序列顺序的位置编码，而蛋白质折叠后的三维空间位移比序列距离更具生物学意义。作者提出一个核心问题：能否将折叠后的残基几何信息直接作为注意力的位置机制？
AI.method: 提出Local-Frame 3D Rotary Position Encoding (LF3DRoPE)，在主链定义的局部坐标系中表示残基间位移，并将其直接注入旋转注意力机制。该设计既保留了连续的方向几何信息，又确保了对全局SE(3)变换的不变性。
AI.result: 在AsEP基准测试中，LF3DRoPE在ratio和epitope-group两种划分下均达到了最先进的MCC性能。消融实验和刚性变换测试表明，局部三维几何信息超越了一维序列顺序注意力的表达能力，同时保持了对任意全局坐标系的变换不变性。突变排序结果进一步验证了该方法能够捕获抗原特异性的结构兼容性。
AI.conclusion: 蛋白质三维折叠几何信息可以有效作为注意力机制的位置编码，为蛋白质表示学习提供了新的几何感知范式，在抗体-抗原识别等结构敏感任务中展现出显著优势。

title: Fighting Fire with Fire: On the Feasibility of Protecting Exercises Against AI Cheating
summary: The widespread adoption of generative AI enables students to outsource cognitive effort to increasingly capable assistants, creating an illusion of competence while undermining the independent reasoning that education aims to cultivate. We investigate whether adversarial machine learning can be repurposed to protect educational exercises against such corrosive reliance. Our approach uses multimodal multiple-choice questions whose visual components can be protected with subtle visual perturbations that steer AI solvers toward designated incorrect answers. These responses form a statistical fingerprint: students who blindly copy a solver reproduce the induced answer pattern more frequently than genuine students. We study the feasibility of this paradigm under realistic black-box assistant assumptions using three of the most common state-of-the-art multimodal language models: Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini, and OpenAI's ChatGPT. By using accessible surrogate models, we optimize adversarial perturbations that induce consistent response patterns. Those patterns enable principled detection through statistical hypothesis testing. These findings establish both the promise and the limitations of fighting machine-assisted reasoning with the vulnerabilities of the machines themselves.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出利用对抗性机器学习方法，通过在多模态选择题中添加视觉扰动来误导AI助手，从而检测学生是否过度依赖AI完成作业。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的普及使学生能够将认知努力外包给AI助手，这种做法虽然创造了能力假象，却破坏了教育旨在培养的独立推理能力，因此需要开发技术手段来检测和防范这种对AI的不当依赖。
AI.method: 研究者设计了一种多模态选择题，在视觉组件上施加细微的对抗性视觉扰动，引导AI解题者选择指定的错误答案。这些被诱导的回答模式形成统计指纹，盲目复制AI答案的学生比真实学生更频繁地复制这些模式。研究采用黑盒假设，通过可获取的代理模型优化对抗性扰动，在Claude、Gemini和ChatGPT三个主流多模态大模型上进行验证。
AI.result: 在三个最先进的多模态语言模型上的实验证明，使用可获取的代理模型可以成功优化出能够诱导一致响应模式的对抗性扰动，这些模式可通过统计假设检验进行原理性检测，证实了该方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 研究既确立利用机器自身的脆弱性来对抗机器辅助推理的潜力，也揭示了其局限性，为教育领域防范AI过度依赖提供了新的技术思路。

authors: Srinivasa Rao P Vangmayi P Reddy
title: Statistical Mechanics of Learning on Product Wasserstein Manifolds
summary: Normally the statistical mechanics of learning treats constraints on weight distributions as restrictions that shrink the space of possible solutions. Therefore, it reduces model capacity. In this paper we would like to take a contrary approach, which, however, is based on the earlier work on distribution-constrained perceptrons. Rather than treating a prescribed weight distribution as a mere restriction, we propose that it defines the intrinsic geometry upon which learning naturally unfolds. We formulate both deep neural networks and variational quantum circuits as gradient flows on a product of Wasserstein manifolds -- one classical Wasserstein space for each layer and one quantum Wasserstein space for the circuit parameters. Within this geometry, the capacity reduction, which was previously associated with distributional constraints, appears as the metric structure of the constraint manifold itself. We develop a hierarchical mean-field description for deep networks, extend the framework to the quantum setting using the quantum Wasserstein distance of order 1, and introduce two such practical algorithms, Hierarchical DisCo-SGD and Quantum DisCo, that follow approximate geodesics on the manifold of the product itself. Experiments on teacher-student problems, standard image classification tasks, and small variational quantum classifiers show that respecting these distributional geometries improves generalization, stabilizes training, and reduces the severity of barren plateaus compared with unconstrained and purely norm-based baselines. This approach firstly reframes structural constraints as geometric priors and suggests a route for incorporating biological, spectral, or hardware-derived distributional information into both learning systems, viz., classical and quantum learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将权重分布约束视为学习自然展开的内禀几何结构，而非单纯的容量限制，在此基础上构建了深度神经网络和变分量子线路的Wasserstein几何框架，并开发了两种实用算法以改善泛化性能与训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统统计力学将权重分布约束视为对解空间的限制，从而导致模型容量降低。作者基于分布约束感知机的早期工作，提出一种相反的视角：将预设的权重分布定义为学习自然展开的内禀几何结构，而非简单限制，旨在重新诠释分布约束的作用并利用其改善学习性能。
AI.method: 将深度神经网络和变分量子电路表述为Wasserstein流形乘积上的梯度流：每一层对应一个经典Wasserstein空间，量子电路参数对应一个量子Wasserstein空间。在此几何框架下，容量缩减被视为约束流形本身的度量结构。发展了深度网络的层次平均场描述，采用1阶量子Wasserstein距离将框架扩展到量子场景，并提出两种实用算法：Hierarchical DisCo-SGD和Quantum DisCo，它们在流形乘积上遵循近似测地线。
AI.result: 在教师-学生问题、标准图像分类任务和小规模变分量子分类器上的实验表明，遵循分布几何约束能够提升泛化性能、稳定训练过程，并与无约束及纯范数基准方法相比，有效降低了平坦高原的严重程度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将结构约束重新框架化为几何先验，为将生物学、光谱或硬件导出的分布信息融入经典与量子学习系统提供了一条新途径，拓展了分布约束在学习系统中的应用潜力。

title: MA-HEAD-Net: Adaptive Rule-Guided Multi-Agent DRL for AoI Minimization in UAV-Assisted Emergency Networks
summary: In post-disaster scenarios, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are critical for establishing emergency communication networks. For time-critical rescue missions, information freshness is crucial because decisions based on outdated data may lead to ineffective control actions. This paper investigates age of information (AoI) minimization for UAV-assisted emergency communications with heterogeneous emergency services. We model bursty packet arrivals using a Markov-modulated Poisson process and adopt finite blocklength theory to capture the coupling among transmission duration, packet completion, and AoI evolution. To balance delay-tolerant long-packet transmission and urgent short-packet response, we propose a mini-slot-embedded scheduling mechanism with adaptive checkpoint-interval selection. We formulate the joint optimization of UAV trajectory control, user scheduling, and checkpoint-interval selection as a multi-agent decision problem, and develop MA-HEAD-Net, an adaptive rule-guided multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework. MA-HEAD-Net incorporates communication-domain rule priors into a gated multi-head policy, where adaptive gates regulate the contributions of rule-prior and learned-policy logits for different subtasks. The policy and gating components are jointly optimized under multi-agent proximal policy optimization.
