summary: Automatic modulation classification research has largely emphasized representation accuracy, but a cognitive receiver must also decide when heterogeneous evidence justifies overriding a trusted default prediction. We study this post-inference problem through cross-fitted residual utility and a primary-preserving cognitive decision policy. A structured KAN-Fourier classifier supplies the default probability, while neural and non-neural candidates provide observable evidence. Candidate-specific residual utility is learned from train-split out-of-fold predictions, and a disjoint validation split freezes action thresholds, approved transitions, conditional routes, and a unified risk mask before held-out evaluation. On RMLA, RMLB, and HISAR, the complete system improves overall accuracy from 63.632% to 66.332%, 65.161% to 66.168%, and 77.769% to 79.867%, respectively. Controlled comparisons show that the isolated utility target does not uniformly dominate alternative out-of-fold meta-learners; the consistent gain comes from the complete evidence-and-action policy. Paired bootstrap and Holm-corrected McNemar analyses support the controlled gains. A frozen-policy stress test under carrier-frequency offset, I/Q imbalance, and synthetic Rayleigh/Rician fading yields positive gains in all 11 conditions, with every paired 95\% confidence interval above zero.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个认知决策框架，通过整合异构证据源来改进自动调制分类，在三个数据集上实现了准确率提升，并在多种信道损伤条件下表现出良好的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动调制分类研究主要关注表示准确性，但认知接收机还需要决定何时异构证据足以覆盖可信的默认预测。这一后推断问题此前未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 提出跨拟合残差效用和主保持认知决策策略。使用结构化KAN-Fourier分类器提供默认概率，神经网络和非神经网络候选者提供可观测证据。从训练集袋外预测学习候选者特定的残差效用，在独立验证集上冻结动作阈值、批准转换、条件路由和统一风险掩码，最后在留出集上评估。
AI.result: 在RMLA、RMLB和HISAR数据集上，完整系统将整体准确率分别从63.632%提升至66.332%、65.161%提升至66.168%、77.769%提升至79.867%。冻结策略压力测试在载波频偏、I/Q不平衡和合成Rayleigh/Rician衰落等11种条件下均获得正向增益，所有配对95%置信区间均大于零。
AI.conclusion: 孤立的效用目标并不能一致地优于其他袋外元学习器，一致的增益来源于完整的证据-动作策略。配对Bootstrap和Holm校正McNemar分析支持了受控增益的有效性。

title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning
summary: Optimization-based latent reasoning improves large language model outputs by optimizing instance-specific continuous states at test time while keeping model parameters frozen. Existing methods, however, typically connect these states to the reasoning trajectory through decoded tokens, making sequence-level credit assignment indirect and obscuring how latent updates shape subsequent reasoning. We introduce GradCuit (gradient through circuit), which inserts optimizable latent states at a selected Transformer layer between the hidden representations of the prompt and the generated continuation. Causal self-attention provides every continuation-token log-probability with a differentiable path to every preceding latent state through the remaining Transformer blocks, enabling reward-weighted gradients from the entire continuation to be assigned directly to the latents. Across five instruction-tuned backbones, three reasoning benchmarks, and two answer formats, GradCuit achieves an average accuracy of 64.5%, outperforming chain-of-thought prompting by 6.6 percentage points and the strongest competing method by 2.4 points. GradCuit also demonstrates greater robustness: across seven learning-rate settings, it consistently outperforms LatentSeek while reducing the standard deviation of accuracy from 1.53 to 0.82, and even its random-walk variant remains competitive with LatentSeek. For interpretability, token-level gradient attribution reveals that latent influence concentrates on reasoning-connector tokens, while layer analysis identifies early-to-middle Transformer layers as the most effective optimization space. By directly optimizing internal reasoning from outcome feedback, GradCuit opens a new axis of robust and interpretable test-time scaling, where LLMs adapt how they reason rather than merely regenerate, sample, or rerank outputs.

AI.tldr: GradCuit通过在Transformer层中插入可优化的潜在状态，实现了从续写文本奖励直接到潜在状态的梯度分配，在推理任务上比链式思维提示提升6.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于优化的潜在推理方法通过解码词元将连续状态连接到推理轨迹，导致序列级信用分配间接且难以理解潜在更新如何影响后续推理。
AI.method: 在提示词和生成续写之间的选定Transformer层插入可优化潜在状态，利用因果自注意力机制为每个续写词元的对数概率提供到每个潜在状态的可微路径，使整个续写的奖励加权梯度能够直接分配到潜在状态。
AI.result: 在五个指令微调骨干模型、三个推理基准和两种答案格式上，GradCuit平均准确率达64.5%，比链式思维提示高6.6个百分点，比最强竞争方法高2.4个百分点；在七个学习率设置下准确率标准差从1.53降至0.82，表现出更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: GradCuit通过从结果反馈直接优化内部推理，开辟了鲁棒且可解释的测试时扩展新方向，使大语言模型调整推理方式而非仅仅重新生成、采样或重排序输出。

title: Instruction-Conditioned Exploration with Asymmetric Reinforcement Learning and Self-Distillation
comment: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (ARR) May 2026 cycle. OpenReview submission record at https://openreview.net/forum?id=PV945lekMa
summary: Post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important tool for improving model capabilities, but the LLM action-space structure introduces challenges distinct from classical RL, with implications for inducing exploration. New methods are required that leverage the broad knowledge and flexibility of pre-trained LLMs to deliberately generate diverse experience at training time. We propose Instruction-Conditioned Exploration (ICE), which supplements task prompts during training with one of several distinct instructions, increasing the coverage of behaviours attempted. To facilitate ICE, we propose Asymmetric-RL/SD, a combined Reinforcement Learning and Self-Distillation training objective, to transfer explored behaviours to the unconditioned test-time policy. ICE with the Asymmetric-RL/SD objective improves Qwen3-1.7B held-out pass@1 performance at $4$K response length on mathematical reasoning tasks by $5.0\%$ relative to training with DAPO, with improvement persisting at a longer 8K context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ICE（Instruction-Conditioned Exploration）方法，通过在训练时向任务提示添加多样化的指令来增强探索，并配合Asymmetric-RL/SD训练目标将探索行为迁移到测试时策略，在数学推理任务上相对DAPO基线提升了5.0%的pass@1性能。
AI.motivation: LLM的后训练中，RL方法面临与经典RL不同的动作空间结构挑战，特别是在探索策略方面存在不足。预训练LLM具备广泛知识和灵活性，但现有方法未能有效利用这些特性在训练时主动生成多样化经验，因此需要新的探索方法。
AI.method: 提出Instruction-Conditioned Exploration (ICE)方法，在训练阶段向任务提示补充多个不同的指令，增加行为尝试的覆盖范围；同时提出Asymmetric-RL/SD联合训练目标，结合强化学习和自蒸馏，将探索到的行为迁移到无条件的测试时策略中。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B模型上的实验表明，ICE配合Asymmetric-RL/SD目标在数学推理任务的held-out pass@1性能上，4K响应长度时相比DAPO训练提升5.0%，且该改进在8K更长上下文中依然保持。
AI.conclusion: ICE方法有效解决了LLM后训练中的探索挑战，通过指令条件化探索和Asymmetric-RL/SD目标，成功提升了模型在数学推理任务上的泛化性能，验证了该方法的有效性和稳定性。

title: onepot-Bench 0: towards lab-aware in silico chemistry benchmarks
summary:
Language models are playing an increasingly important role in laboratory science, performing tasks such as experiment planning, execution, and post-hoc analysis. However, precisely measuring their abilities is difficult, as scientific capabilities require a mixture of both problem-solving skills and domain-specific intuition. Existing evaluations rarely measure the capabilities required to make reliable decisions in a physical laboratory and often rely on public data that may have appeared in model training corpora.
  We introduce onepot-Bench 0, a proprietary benchmark suite for evaluating language models on synthetic chemistry capabilities relevant to wet-lab execution. onepot-Bench 0 comprises three complementary evaluations: ChemAbacus measures tool-free cheminformatics literacy and numerical reasoning; SynthRefusal characterizes safety and refusal behavior across a variety of benign, controlled, and designer-drug targets; and SynthBench evaluates reaction-outcome prediction and catalyst selection using private experimental data generated in our laboratory. Together, these evaluations probe basic competency, reliability, and deeper knowledge, all skills which are required for reliable performance in the lab.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了onepot-Bench 0，一个用于评估语言模型在湿实验室合成化学能力的专有基准测试套件，包含三个互补评估：ChemAbacus（化学信息学素养）、SynthRefusal（安全拒绝行为）和SynthBench（反应预测与催化剂选择）。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法难以精确测量语言模型在物理实验室中做出可靠决策所需的能力，因为科学能力需要问题解决技能和领域特定直觉的结合。现有评估很少测量实验室执行所需的能力，且常依赖可能出现在模型训练语料库中的公开数据。
AI.method: 引入onepot-Bench 0基准套件，包含三个互补评估：1) ChemAbacus测量无工具化学信息学素养和数值推理；2) SynthRefusal表征在多种良性、受控和设计药物目标中的安全和拒绝行为；3) SynthBench使用实验室私有实验数据评估反应结果预测和催化剂选择。
AI.result: 构建了一个完整的基准测试套件，能够探测语言模型在合成化学领域的基本能力、可靠性和深层知识，这些都是在实验室中可靠执行任务所必需的技能。
AI.conclusion: onepot-Bench 0为评估语言模型在湿实验室合成化学能力提供了全面的专有基准，填补了现有评估方法的不足，能够更好地衡量模型在真实实验室环境中的可靠性和实用性。

title: Fetch-then-Explore: Decoupling Selection from Extraction over a Persistent Workspace for Search Agents
summary: Search agents now answer questions that take dozens of searches to settle, yet how such an agent reads a page has drawn far less attention than how it finds one. Nearly all of them use one of two document interfaces, and both tie a page to the moment it is opened. \emph{Visit-and-read} injects a reading of the page into the message history at fetch time, fixing that reading before the agent knows which fact it will need. Stateful \emph{browsing} instead extracts on demand from the page in hand, but holds one page at a time and releases it as soon as the agent opens another. Either way, a page that turns out to matter many turns later has to be fetched and rendered into context all over again. We propose \textbf{Fetch-then-Explore}, which separates page selection from evidence extraction and keeps what it selects: pages are recorded in a per-question workspace on the filesystem rather than the context window or a transient session, and evidence is pulled from them on demand later. Selection becomes almost free, extraction can wait until the agent knows what to look for and be repeated as its hypothesis sharpens, and pages are not released when the agent moves on, so evidence accumulates across the trajectory. In a unified ReAct harness with fixed search, we compare Fetch-then-Explore against snippet-only, visit-and-read, and browsing baselines on two open-web benchmarks, BrowseComp and WideSearch, across three agent backbones. It leads BrowseComp accuracy at every backbone and generally matches or exceeds the baselines on WideSearch, and a behavioral analysis traces the gains to the workspace's defining move: returning to a page after leaving it, which it does far more than any transient interface, so evidence missed on a first pass can still be recovered later.

AI.tldr: 提出Fetch-then-Explore方法，通过将页面存储在文件系统工作区而非上下文窗口，实现页面选择与证据提取的分离，解决了现有搜索代理文档界面中页面无法持久保存和重复利用的问题，在BrowseComp基准上显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前搜索代理使用的两种文档界面（visit-and-read和browsing）都存在共同缺陷：页面内容仅在打开时可用，若后续需要再次访问已被关闭的页面，必须重新获取和渲染。Visit-and-read在获取时就固定了页面阅读内容，此时代理尚不知道需要哪些事实；Stateful browsing虽按需提取，但只能同时保留一个页面且打开新页面时释放旧页面。这导致重要的页面内容无法在多轮交互中被有效积累和重复利用。
AI.method: 提出Fetch-then-Explore框架，核心创新是将页面选择与证据提取解耦：（1）页面持久化：获取的页面记录在文件系统的工作区而非上下文窗口或临时会话中，页面不会因代理转向而被释放；（2）按需提取：证据提取延迟到代理明确知道需要查找什么内容之后进行，并可根据假设的细化重复提取；（3）跨轨迹积累：证据可在整个交互过程中持续积累。在统一的ReAct框架和固定搜索设置下，对比了snippet-only、visit-and-read和browsing三种基线方法。
AI.result: 在两个开放网络基准BrowseComp和WideSearch上进行实验，测试三种代理骨干网络。Fetch-then-Explore在所有骨干网络上都引领BrowseComp准确率，在WideSearch上总体匹配或超越基线。行为分析表明性能提升来源于工作区的核心特性——离开页面后返回的能力，该方法的页面返回频率远高于任何临时界面，使得首次浏览时遗漏的证据可在后续被恢复。
AI.conclusion: Fetch-then-Explore通过文件系统工作区实现页面持久化和延迟提取，有效解决了传统文档界面中页面内容无法跨时间步复用的问题。实验证明该方法在需要复杂多步搜索的任务上具有显著优势，其核心价值在于支持代理在离开页面后再次返回提取证据，提升了信息利用的完整性和效率。

title: MemArbiter: Decision-Time Memory Arbitration for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents must retain and use cross-step information to act coherently in long-horizon tasks. Existing methods improve memory accessibility, yet action-relevant information may still fail to guide the current decision because it is poorly formed, organized, prioritized, or presented. We call this post-access failure the Memory-Action Gap. We propose MemArbiter, a function-aware memory arbitration framework that addresses the memory-management-induced component of this gap. MemArbiter decomposes interaction histories into atomic items, organizes them into five functional Memory Banks, and combines bank-level demand, item-level relevance, focal-ambient representations, and a temporal presentation gate to dynamically control memory salience. We evaluate MemArbiter on ALFWorld against Flat Retrieval and Flat Recency under unified per-step memory budgets. With an open-weight action-generation model, MemArbiter achieves success rates of 82.8% and 92.5% under 500- and 750-token budgets, outperforming the strongest baseline by 20.9 and 25.4 percentage points, respectively. It also improves post-failure recovery and reduces failed-action repetition and state-action recurrence. These results show that function-aware memory arbitration enables accessible information to guide actions more effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemArbiter框架，通过功能感知的记忆仲裁机制解决大语言模型在长序列任务中的记忆-行动差距问题，在ALFWorld任务上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法虽然提高了记忆可访问性，但在长序列任务中，行动相关信息仍可能因形成、组织、优先级或呈现方式不当而无法有效指导当前决策，这种访问后失败现象被称为记忆-行动差距。
AI.method: 提出MemArbiter功能感知记忆仲裁框架：将交互历史分解为原子项，组织为五个功能性记忆库；结合库级需求、项级相关性、焦点-环境表示和时间呈现门控机制，动态控制记忆显著性。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld上统一每步记忆预算条件下，使用开放权重行动生成模型，MemArbiter在500和750 token预算下成功率分别达到82.8%和92.5%，分别超越最强基线20.9和25.4个百分点；同时改善失败后恢复能力，减少失败行动重复和状态-行动循环。
AI.conclusion: 功能感知记忆仲裁机制能够使可访问信息更有效地指导行动，证明了记忆管理对解决记忆-行动差距的重要性。

title: Beyond Solution-Centric Search: Adaptive Inquiry and Knowledge Revision for Autonomous ML Engineering
summary: Long-horizon autonomous research tasks such as machine learning engineering require systems to make interdependent decisions under a limited budget. Existing LLM-based agents typically organize candidate-solution improvement through tree, graph, or chain structures, meaning that the search process determines how information is acquired and managed. We call this design solution-centric search and propose instead the information paradigm, in which an evolving information state represents the system's understanding of the task and guides solution improvement. We instantiate this paradigm in Iris, an inquiry-revision loop. For information acquisition, Iris generates local action plans from the current information state and uses epistemic actions to probe decision-critical unknowns without modifying the retained solution. For information management, Iris synthesizes observations across experiments into task knowledge composed of revisable claims with explicit scope and status. It updates this knowledge as new evidence arrives and constructs each decision context from raw evidence, structured summaries, or task knowledge at the required level of detail. On MLE-Bench, Iris attains a 64.9% any-medal rate under a 12-hour budget, the highest among compared systems. Across four tasks spanning harness engineering and model post-training, Iris also demonstrates cross-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于信息范式的新框架Iris，通过“查询-修正”循环来管理任务知识并指导解决方案优化，在MLE-Bench上以64.9%的奖牌率超越了其他系统，并展现出跨领域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体在长时域自主研究任务（如机器学习工程）中，通常采用以解决方案为中心的搜索方式（树、图或链结构），导致搜索过程决定了信息的获取与管理方式，难以有效应对有限预算下的相互依赖决策。本文旨在突破这一局限，提出信息范式，使系统通过对任务的持续理解来驱动解决方案的改进。
AI.method: 本文提出Iris框架，采用“查询-修正”循环。在信息获取方面，Iris根据当前信息状态生成局部行动规划，并使用认知型行动探查关键的未知因素，而不改变已保留的解决方案。在信息管理方面，Iris将跨实验的观察结果综合为任务知识，由可修正的陈述构成，并明确其范围与状态；随着新证据的到来持续更新，并根据需要从原始证据、结构化摘要或任务知识中构建决策上下文。
AI.result: 在MLE-Bench基准测试中，Iris在12小时预算下达到了64.9%的奖牌率（any-medal rate），为所有对比系统中最高；在涵盖工程搭建和模型后训练的四项任务中，Iris亦展示了跨领域的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 信息范式为长时域自主研究任务提供了一种有效的框架设计，使系统能够显式管理任务知识并据此改进解决方案。Iris的成功验证了该方法的有效性和跨领域泛化潜力，为未来智能体的设计提供了新思路。

title: Beyond the Mean: Multi-Moment Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. Existing methods generally aim to reduce the failure probabilities induced across problems. In this paper, we introduce a moment-based perspective on policy optimization for LLM reasoning by treating the failure probability of a randomly sampled problem as a random variable and characterizing optimization objectives through its moments. Under this perspective, many existing methods optimize only a single moment of the failure-probability distribution, leaving its broader distributional structure largely uncharacterized. We propose \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{M}oment \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (MMPO), a novel policy optimization framework that jointly minimizes multiple moments of the failure-probability distribution. MMPO admits a direct operational interpretation as minimizing the expected truncated time required to obtain the first successful response. Beyond MMPO, we further develop a general moment-transformation framework that systematically induces different moment profiles and provides a unified view of a broader family of policy optimization objectives. Experiments across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and models of different scales demonstrate that MMPO consistently outperforms strong baselines. We hope this moment-based perspective offers new insights into the design of policy optimization objectives for LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多矩策略优化（MMPO）框架，通过联合最小化失败概率分布的多个矩来改进大语言模型的推理能力，实验表明其在数学推理基准测试中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的强化学习方法通常只优化失败概率分布的单个矩，未能充分刻画和利用失败概率分布的更广泛结构特性，导致策略优化目标的设计不够全面和系统。
AI.method: 提出多矩策略优化（MMPO）框架，将随机采样问题的失败概率视为随机变量，联合最小化其分布的多个矩；进一步发展通用的矩变换框架，系统诱导不同的矩分布轮廓，为策略优化目标提供统一视角。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准测试和不同规模的模型上，MMPO一致性地优于强基线方法，验证了多矩优化视角的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于矩的视角为大语言模型推理的策略优化目标设计提供了新的见解和更系统的理论框架，有望推动该领域的进一步发展。

title: Auditing Data Provenance in LLM Fine-tuning via Intrinsic Distributional Fingerprints
comment: This is the extended version of CCS'26 paper https://doi.org/10.1145/3830454.3832639
summary:
The proliferation of customized Large Language Models (LLMs) poses critical risks of Data Intellectual Property (Data IP) infringement via unauthorized fine-tuning on proprietary data. Existing audit techniques are limited, as they require intervention during data preparation or training and remain fragile under malicious obfuscations such as data paraphrasing and knowledge distillation.
  We propose \textit{Distribution Provenance Audit (DPA)}, a post-hoc framework for auditing data IP infringement in LLM fine-tuning under black-box and malicious settings. DPA is grounded in a critical insight: regardless of fine-tuning tactics to evade provenance, the practical necessity of maintaining utility constrains the model to preserve the fundamental intersection of semantic substance and lexical form. Accordingly, DPA captures this persistent lexical-semantic intersection as intrinsic distributional fingerprints. The framework formulates the audit as a statistical hypothesis test, effectively quantifying these fingerprints via unbiased output sampling to reliably reject the null hypothesis of non-usage.
  Extensive experiments on medical and legal fine-tuning tasks show that DPA consistently outperforms existing baselines, remaining robust against adversarial trainers employing paraphrasing and knowledge distillation. We further highlight a fundamental dual-use tension: the same high-fidelity distributional fingerprints enabling reliable auditing may also facilitate privacy attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPA框架，通过捕捉词法-语义交集的分布指纹，在黑盒和对抗设置下有效审计LLM微调中的数据知识产权侵权问题。
AI.motivation: 定制化大语言模型的普及带来了数据知识产权侵权风险，现有审计技术需要在数据准备或训练阶段介入，且在数据改写和知识蒸馏等恶意混淆攻击下表现脆弱。
AI.method: 提出分布溯源审计(DPA)框架，捕捉词法-语义交集作为内在分布指纹，将审计问题建模为统计假设检验，通过无偏输出采样量化指纹以可靠地拒绝未使用的零假设。
AI.result: 在医疗和法律微调任务上的广泛实验表明，DPA持续优于现有基线，对采用改写和知识蒸馏的对抗性训练者保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DPA框架在黑盒和恶意设置下能有效审计数据知识产权侵权，但研究也揭示了双重用途张力：高保真分布指纹既可促进可靠审计，也可能助长隐私攻击。

title: From Simple QA to Deep Research: A Verifiable Benchmark Constructed through Iterative Task Evolution
comment: 6 figures. Includes supplementary material. Code and data are publicly available
summary: Deep research benchmarks require expert-level tasks and reliable evaluation grounded in task-specific knowledge. Existing benchmarks rely heavily on expert authoring or pre-existing human-authored materials, while fully automatic construction struggles to ensure consistent and traceable verification. To address this gap, we introduce a verifiable benchmark of 500 deep research tasks spanning 31 topics and 10 major categories, with three query forms designed to probe complementary capabilities required for deep research. The benchmark is constructed automatically using an iterative Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger pipeline that progressively transforms simple questions into deep research tasks. Each task is represented as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of atomic steps and associated checkpoints, enabling the query, DAG, and rubrics to evolve together in a controlled manner. Experiments demonstrate that the benchmark clearly discriminates among models and query types, while its fact-grounded pointwise rubrics enable fine-grained, human-aligned, and stable evaluation. Our data, implementation, and results are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可自动构建且可验证的深度研究基准，包含500个任务，通过Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger管道生成DAG表示的任务及细粒度评分标准，实现了可靠、一致的模型评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度研究基准严重依赖专家人工编写或现有人类材料，全自动构建方法难以保证一致且可追溯的验证，缺乏能够同时确保任务质量与评估可靠性的自动化基准构建方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种迭代的Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger管道，将简单问题逐步转化为深度研究任务；每个任务表示为原子步骤和检查点的有向无环图（DAG），使查询、DAG和评分标准协同演化，确保构建过程的可控性与可追溯性。
AI.result: 构建了一个包含500个任务、覆盖31个主题和10个主要类别的可验证基准，提供三种查询形式以探测深度研究的互补能力；实验表明该基准能有效区分模型与查询类型，其基于事实的逐点评分标准实现了细粒度、人类对齐且稳定的评估。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功实现了深度研究基准的自动化构建与可验证评估，填补了现有基准的空白，为深度研究能力的系统评估提供了可扩展、可复现的解决方案，并公开了数据与实现以促进后续研究。

title: From Profiling to Synthesis: Benchmarking Implicit Behavioral Alignment in Personalized LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Models have enabled increasingly capable autonomous agents, yet personalization remains critical for making such agents practically useful. Recent benchmarks have begun evaluating personalization in agents, but they largely rely on static preference snapshots, fixed interaction logs, or question answering over predefined user profiles. Such designs fail to capture the complexity of evolving user preferences and neglect preference-conditioned task execution-a discrepancy we term as the knowledge-to-action gap. To address this challenge, we introduce IBA-Bench, a benchmark for implicit behavioral alignment constructed from longitudinal interaction histories that contain noise, implicit cues, and temporal inconsistencies. Unlike prior work, IBA-Bench evaluates whether an agent can execute tasks while satisfying implicit user constraints inferred from historical interactions. We further propose IBA-Agent, an agent framework that reconciles conflicting priorities through broad retrieval and trajectory-level alignment. Experiment results on IBA-Bench show that effective personalization remains a significant challenge for state-of-the-art LLM agents, and the proposed IBA-Agent substantially improves behavioral alignment in complex scenarios across nine application domains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了IBA-Bench基准和IBA-Agent框架，解决智能体个性化中的"知识-行动鸿沟"问题，评估和改进智能体从历史交互中推断隐式约束并执行任务的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化基准主要依赖静态偏好快照、固定交互日志或预定义用户问答，无法捕捉用户偏好的动态演变特性，且忽视了基于偏好条件的任务执行能力，存在"知识-行动鸿沟"的差距问题。
AI.method: 提出IBA-Bench基准，基于包含噪声、隐式线索和时间不一致性的纵向交互历史构建，评估智能体是否能在执行任务时满足从历史交互推断的隐式用户约束；提出IBA-Agent框架，通过广泛检索和轨迹级别对齐来协调冲突优先级。
AI.result: 在IBA-Bench上的实验表明，有效的个性化对当前最先进LLM智能体仍是重大挑战；提出的IBA-Agent在跨9个应用领域的复杂场景中显著改善了行为对齐性能。
AI.conclusion: IBA-Bench填补了个性化智能体评估中动态偏好和任务执行能力评估的空白，IBA-Agent为解决行为对齐问题提供了有效方法，揭示了当前LLM智能体在个性化方面仍有较大提升空间。

title: PAC Approximation and DIRECT Optimization for Parametric Markov Models
summary: In this paper, we consider the parameter synthesis and optimization problem for parametric Markov decision processes (pMDPs), the extension of classical MDPs where exact probability values are replaced by parametric expressions. Computing the rational function $f_{\lsf}$ that maps parameter valuations to the satisfaction value of a PRCTL property $\lsf$ is a computationally expensive task, particularly for pMDPs where the optimal policy may vary across the parameter space. We adopt the \emph{scenario approach} to efficiently synthesize a probably approximately correct (PAC) approximation $\ApproxFunOfProperty{f}$ of $f_{\lsf}$: by sampling parameter configurations and solving a linear program, we obtain a polynomial approximation whose error margin $\margin$ is guaranteed, with prescribed confidence, for all but an $\errorRate$-fraction of the parameter domain under the sampling distribution. We further show how this PAC framework can be combined with statistical model checking (SMC), enabling the analysis of black-box parametric models. Building on the PAC approximation, we integrate the DIRECT (DIviding RECTangles) algorithm for derivative-free global optimization over the parameter space. We establish conditional optimality-gap guarantees: under explicit Lipschitz and PAC-good-set assumptions, the difference between the true optimum $f_{\lsf}(\parameters^{*})$ and the value found by DIRECT is bounded by a partition-diameter term and, in the PAC case, an additional approximation-error term. An empirical evaluation on 2997 benchmarks focuses on the new DIRECT-based optimization component. The results show that DIRECT variants solve fewer instances than the scenario optimizer, but on their common successful instances they often return slightly better objective values and usually run faster, while remaining close to the scenario values within the PAC margin.

AI.tldr: 本文针对参数化马尔可夫决策过程(pMDPs)提出基于场景方法的PAC近似框架，结合DIRECT算法实现参数空间优化，在保证误差界限的同时提高了计算效率。
AI.motivation: 参数化马尔可夫决策过程中计算映射参数估值到性质满足值的理性函数f_φ是计算昂贵的任务，特别是当最优策略在参数空间中变化时更为复杂。需要一种高效的方法来处理参数综合与优化问题。
AI.method: 采用场景方法(sample scenario approach)通过采样参数配置并求解线性规划，获得真实函数的PAC近似。结合统计模型检验(SMC)分析黑盒参数模型。基于PAC近似，集成DIRECT（分割矩形）算法进行参数空间的无导数全局优化。
AI.result: 在2997个基准测试上的实验评估表明：DIRECT变体比场景优化器解决的实例更少，但在共同成功实例上通常返回稍好的目标值且运行更快，同时保持在PAC误差范围内接近场景值。在Lipschitz和PAC良好集合假设下建立了条件最优性间隙保证。
AI.conclusion: 提出的PAC近似框架成功解决了pMDPs中参数综合与优化的计算复杂性问题。DIRECT优化组件在保持PAC误差保证的前提下，为某些实例提供了更高效的替代方案，证明了该方法在参数化概率模型分析中的有效性。

title: MEGRAG: Multi-Granular Evidence Graphs for Answer-Aware Multi-Hop RAG
summary: Multi-hop question answering is a fundamental challenge in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), because deriving an answer requires integrating dispersed evidence. Iterative RAG (iRAG) is widely used for this challenge, but existing methods have two limitations. First, most methods still support each reasoning step with single-granularity evidence, making it difficult to balance information density and contextual noise. Second, existing methods often answer the original question only after aggregating evidence retrieved across intermediate steps, so redundant evidence and intermediate retrieval errors may accumulate and degrade the final answer. To address these limitations, we propose MEGRAG, an answer-aware framework that represents multi-hop reasoning as a path-structured multi-granular evidence graph. Offline, MEGRAG links passages to their sentences and extracted triples through a cross-granularity index. Online, it retrieves passages for the current query and selects aligned evidence, starting with compact triples and adding sentence or passage context as needed. MEGRAG uses the resulting intermediate answer and prior reasoning to decide whether the Initial Query has been resolved. If not, it identifies the missing information and formulates a focused next query; otherwise, it stops retrieval and returns the answer. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent gains over a diverse set of RAG baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了MEGRAG框架，通过构建多粒度证据图和答案感知的迭代检索策略，有效解决了多跳问答中信息密度与噪声平衡、冗余证据累积等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有迭代RAG方法在多跳问答中存在两个关键局限：(1)每个推理步骤仅支持单粒度证据，难以平衡信息密度与上下文噪声；(2)仅在聚合所有中间步骤证据后才回答原问题，导致冗余证据和中间检索错误累积，降低最终答案质量。
AI.method: 提出MEGRAG框架，将多跳推理表示为路径结构化的多粒度证据图。离线阶段构建跨粒度索引，连接文档段落与其句子和提取的三元组；在线阶段从紧凑三元组开始检索并按需添加句子或段落上下文，基于中间答案和先前推理判断初始查询是否已解决，若未解决则识别缺失信息并生成聚焦的下一查询，否则停止检索返回答案。
AI.result: 在多样化RAG基线方法上的广泛实验表明，MEGRAG取得了持续且一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: MEGRAG通过多粒度证据表示和答案感知的迭代检索策略，有效解决了现有方法的关键局限性，在多跳问答任务上展现了优越性能。

title: PosterMELD: Multi-Agent Paper-to-Poster Generation for Controllable Design Diversity with Editable Print-Ready Outputs
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, and 4 tables. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/Shannon4Science/PosterMELD
summary: Scientific poster construction compresses a long multimodal paper into a readable, editable canvas. Existing systems hide request-level failures by scoring only completed outputs; direct image generation is not element-editable, while coding-agent workflows are costly. PosterMELD is a template-conditioned multi-agent pipeline: capacity-aware slots guide writing before rendering, and deterministic gates plus vision-language model (VLM) review route failures to bounded repair. Each accepted request exports editable PowerPoint (PPTX) and Portable Network Graphics (PNG) artifacts; explicit design controls yield same-paper variants. Across 621 papers, Print-Ready Rate (PRR) counts requests passing geometric, readability, asset-integrity, and obvious-factual-error checks, with native editability reported separately. A frozen VLM assigns conditional Craftsmanship-Harmony-Expressiveness (CHE) scores to print-ready outputs. PosterMELD attains 81.3% PRR, 3.4 times P2P's rate and 5.2 times PosterGen's, and the highest conditional CHE among generated methods with multiple print-ready outputs. Native editability and explicit design controls are retained at a mean cost of USD 0.38 per request, 3.5% of Codex+Skill's. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/Shannon4Science/PosterMELD.

AI.tldr: PosterMELD是一个模板驱动的多智能体学术海报生成系统，在621篇论文测试中实现81.3%的打印就绪率，显著超越现有方法，同时保留原生可编辑性，单次请求成本仅0.38美元。
AI.motivation: 现有学术海报生成系统存在关键缺陷：仅对完成输出进行评分而隐藏请求级失败；直接图像生成无法进行元素编辑；基于编码智能体的流程成本高昂。这些限制阻碍了实用、可编辑、低成本的海报自动化生成。
AI.method: PosterMELD采用模板驱动的多智能体管道架构：(1)容量感知槽位机制，在渲染前引导内容撰写；(2)确定性门控结合视觉-语言模型(VLM)审查，将失败路由至有界修复流程；(3)每个接受请求导出可编辑的PPTX和PNG格式产物；(4)显式设计控制支持同论文变体生成。
AI.result: 在621篇论文评测中，PosterMELD实现81.3%打印就绪率(PRR)，分别是P2P方法的3.4倍和PosterGen的5.2倍。在生成多个打印就绪输出的方法中，PosterMELD获得最高的条件CHE(工艺-协调-表现力)评分。原生可编辑性和显式设计控制得以保留，平均成本仅0.38美元/请求，仅为Codex+Skill方法的3.5%。
AI.conclusion: PosterMELD成功解决了现有系统在可编辑性、失败处理和成本效率方面的核心痛点，实现了高质量的自动化海报生成，同时保持了经济可行性和编辑灵活性，为学术海报的自动化创作提供了实用解决方案。

title: Trustworthy AI in Digital Health: A Comprehensive Review of Robustness and Explainability
comment: Preprint of the paper published in Progress in Biomedical Engineering. 26 pages, 5 figures
summary: Ensuring trust in AI systems is essential for the safe and ethical integration of machine learning systems into high-stakes domains such as digital health. Key dimensions, including robustness, explainability, fairness, accountability, and privacy, need to be addressed throughout the AI lifecycle, from problem formulation and data collection to model deployment and human interaction. While various contributions address different aspects of trustworthy AI, a focused synthesis on robustness and explainability, especially tailored to the healthcare context, remains limited. This review addresses that need by organizing recent advancements into an accessible framework, highlighting both technical and practical considerations. We present a structured overview of methods, challenges, and solutions, aiming to support researchers and practitioners in developing reliable and explainable AI solutions for digital health. This review article is organized into three main parts. First, we introduce the pillars of trustworthy AI and discuss the technical and ethical challenges, particularly in the context of digital health. Second, we explore application-specific trust considerations across domains such as intensive care, neonatal health, and metabolic health, highlighting how robustness and explainability support trust. Lastly, we present recent advancements in techniques aimed at improving robustness under data scarcity and distributional shifts, as well as explainable AI methods ranging from feature attribution to gradient-based interpretations and counterfactual explanations. This paper is further enriched with detailed discussions of the contributions toward robustness and explainability in digital health, the development of trustworthy AI systems in the era of LLMs, and various evaluation metrics for measuring trust and related parameters such as validity, fidelity, and diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于数字健康领域可信AI的综述文章，重点关注鲁棒性和可解释性两个核心维度，为研究人员和实践者提供了结构化的方法框架和实践指导。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在高风险领域（如数字健康）的广泛应用，确保AI系统的可信度变得至关重要。然而，当前针对医疗健康背景下鲁棒性和可解释性的聚焦综合研究仍然有限，缺乏系统的框架来整合技术进展与实践考量。
AI.method: 采用三部分结构进行综述：首先介绍可信AI的支柱及其在数字健康中的技术与伦理挑战；其次探讨重症监护、新生儿健康、代谢健康等特定应用领域的信任考量；最后综述提升鲁棒性（应对数据稀缺和分布偏移）和可解释性（特征归因、梯度解释、反事实解释）的最新技术进展。
AI.result: 构建了一个易于访问的框架，整合了鲁棒性和可解释性的技术方法、挑战与解决方案；详细讨论了数字健康中的贡献、LLM时代的可信AI系统开发，以及验证性、保真度、多样性等评估指标。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为开发数字健康领域可靠且可解释的AI解决方案提供了结构化指导，支持研究人员和实践者应对可信AI的技术与实践挑战，推动AI在医疗健康领域的安全与伦理整合。

title: Homebot: A Personal AI Agent for Conversational Home Assistance and Automation
summary: \texttt{Homebot} is a locally deployable AI agent for conversational household assistance and automation. It accepts voice and instant-messaging requests through a shared runtime that combines language-model responses with registered tools and task-specific skills. The design separates common request processing from session ownership: messaging history remains scoped to a channel and chat, whereas voice interaction is bounded by wake-word activation. For hands-free use, \texttt{Homebot} combines local wake-word detection, streaming speech recognition and synthesis, and an explicit dialogue-state protocol for ending, following up, or continuing a conversation. Clear channel, tool, and skill contracts support practical customization for household use.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Homebot，一个可本地部署的AI家用对话助手，支持语音和即时消息交互，通过共享运行时整合语言模型与注册工具及技能，实现家庭自动化辅助。
AI.motivation: 旨在提供一个本地可部署的家用AI助手，满足家庭场景下的语音和消息交互需求，同时保障隐私和实用性，支持无手操作和灵活定制。
AI.method: 采用共享运行时架构，分离通用请求处理与会话所有权；集成本地唤醒词检测、流式语音识别与合成，以及明确的对话状态协议；通过清晰的渠道、工具和技能契约支持定制化。
AI.result: 实现了支持语音唤醒和即时消息的多模态家用AI助手，具备本地部署能力、明确的状态管理和易于定制的接口契约。
AI.conclusion: Homebot为家庭场景提供了一个实用、可本地部署的AI助手方案，其架构设计支持灵活扩展和定制，适用于智能家居对话与自动化应用。

title: Self-Certification of Representation Adequacy: Sequential Certification at Minimum Task Loss
comment: 108 pages, 3 figures. Full proofs and appendices included. Independent researcher
summary: Agents that act on a compressed representation of their history face a structural risk: if the representation aliases histories with different optimal actions, no rule measurable with respect to the representation can avoid an irreducible per-round loss, and the agent may be unable to detect this from its own transcript. This paper develops a four-layer theory of self-certification of representation adequacy. The static layer defines decision-theoretic adequacy through a Bayes-risk grouping identity and prices a one-shot external verification by an exact total-variation threshold. The sequential layer poses certification as an optimal-stopping problem in the currency of task loss: we define an environment-wise certification complexity constant through a covering linear program, prove an information-task-loss lower bound for every delta-correct strategy, and give a Certification Track-and-Stop policy whose cost matches the bound asymptotically. A final boundary layer gives an explicit kernel-switching example and identifies the open theorem needed to cover policy switching or representation repair; it does not claim that the fixed-kernel guarantees extend to representation revision. The proofs of the two main theorems are given in full in the appendices.

AI.tldr: 本文针对历史压缩表示可能存在的别名问题（不同最优行动的历史被映射为相同表示），建立了四层自我认证理论框架，包括静态层的决策理论适定性定义、序列层的最优停止认证问题、以及边界层的核切换示例，为表示充分性的在线验证提供了理论基础和算法。
AI.motivation: 智能体使用压缩的历史表示面临结构性风险：当表示将具有不同最优动作的历史混淆（别名）时，任何基于该表示的规则都无法避免不可约的每轮损失，且智能体可能无法从自身的交互记录中检测到这一问题。因此需要建立一种理论来在线认证表示的充分性。
AI.method: 提出四层自我认证理论：(1)静态层：通过贝叶斯风险分组等式定义决策理论适定性，并用精确总变差阈值定价一次性外部验证；(2)序列层：将认证建模为任务损失货币下的最优停止问题，通过覆盖线性规划定义环境级认证复杂度常数，证明了每个δ-正确策略的信息-任务损失下界，并提出Certification Track-and-Stop策略；(3)边界层：给出显式的核切换示例并识别开放问题。
AI.result: 证明了每个δ-正确策略的信息-任务损失下界，所提出的Certification Track-and-Stop策略的代价能够渐近匹配该下界。给出了显式的核切换示例来说明理论边界。
AI.conclusion: 建立了表示充分性自我认证的理论框架，为固定核情形提供了保证，但明确指出这些保证不能直接扩展到表示修正/策略切换情形，需要进一步的开放定理来覆盖这些场景。

title: Harness-R1: Learning to Edit Executable Runtime Harnesses from Agent Failure Trajectories
summary: Agents built around large language models continually accumulate interaction trajectories during deployment, yet their behavior typically remains fixed. Beyond updating model weights, these trajectories can improve the agent harness that constructs context, mediates tools, validates actions, and recovers execution. We introduce Harness-R1, the first method, to our knowledge, that makes failure-conditioned, lifecycle-wide editing of an existing executable runtime a learned capability. It post-trains a dedicated harness engineer with online reinforcement learning so that its edits are optimized for the realized task success they produce, rather than proposed by a fixed editor. A separate 9B engineer converts batches of target-agent failures into validated executable patches; fresh same-batch reruns of the frozen target provide outcome rewards, so training updates only the engineer. Cold-start supervised fine-tuning initializes this editing policy, which is then trained online with group-relative policy optimization. Across WebShop, ALFWorld, and DBBench, Harness-R1 raises vanilla Qwen3.5-9B success from 44.3% to 53.6% (+9.3 percentage points). After direct target-agent fine-tuning, a target-specific engineer raises the average further from 59.2% to 64.2% (+5.0 points); because these gains hold both before and after fine-tuning the target, Harness-R1 points toward co-evolving the harness engineer and the target agent.

AI.tldr: Harness-R1首次通过在线强化学习训练专用的harness工程师，实现了对智能体运行时环境的失败条件化、全生命周期编辑，在多个基准测试中将目标智能体成功率提升5-9个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的智能体在部署过程中持续积累交互轨迹，但其行为模式通常保持固定。除了更新模型权重外，这些轨迹可用于改进智能体的harness（上下文构建、工具中介、动作验证和执行恢复），然而如何让智能体在运行时自我修复和改进仍然是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 1. 训练一个专用的9B参数harness工程师模型，通过在线强化学习（组相对策略优化）进行后训练；2. 工程师将目标智能体的失败批次转换为已验证的可执行补丁；3. 使用冻结目标智能体的重新运行结果作为奖励信号，仅更新工程师模型；4. 采用冷启动监督微调初始化编辑策略，然后进行在线强化学习训练。
AI.result: 在WebShop、ALFWorld和DBBench三个基准测试中：1. 将vanilla Qwen3.5-9B成功率从44.3%提升至53.6%（+9.3个百分点）；2. 在目标智能体微调后，目标特定工程师将平均成功率从59.2%进一步提升至64.2%（+5.0个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: Harness-R1证明了在目标智能体微调前后均能获得性能提升，指向了harness工程师与目标智能体协同演化的方向，为智能体运行时自我改进提供了新的技术路径。

title: SKT: Skill-Use Training at Scale via Verified Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Agent skills have become an important mechanism for equipping language-model agents with reusable procedural knowledge. However, providing skills alone does not guarantee that current models can effectively identify, apply, and coordinate them. To improve skill-use capabilities, we introduce SKT, a verified data synthesis pipeline that constructs skill-grounded tasks and executable trajectories from large collections of agent skills. SKT selects suitable single-skill and multi-skill configurations, synthesizes tasks through rule-based and agent-based verification with feedback-guided repair, and retains only successful trajectories that substantially use every required skill. Using 2,000 public skills, SKT produces 4,000 task packages and 27,164 verified trajectories. Based on the same pipeline and a disjoint test pool, we further construct SkillEval, a held-out executable benchmark for evaluating skill use. Experiments across diverse models, benchmarks, and agent harnesses show that supervised fine-tuning on SKT-generated trajectories consistently improves skill-use performance. Verification ablations, cross-harness evaluation, and scaling experiments further demonstrate that these gains depend on high-quality supervision, extend beyond a single agent interface, and increase with broader skill coverage. Together, these results establish verified data synthesis as an effective and scalable approach for skill-use training.

AI.tldr: 提出了SKT验证数据合成流程，通过构建技能导向任务和可执行轨迹来提升语言模型代理的技能使用能力，实验证明该方法有效且可扩展。
AI.motivation: 尽管代理技能已成为为语言模型代理配备可重用过程知识的重要机制，但仅提供技能并不能保证当前模型能够有效地识别、应用和协调这些技能，因此需要改进模型的技能使用能力。
AI.method: 提出SKT验证数据合成流程：1)选择合适的单技能和多技能配置；2)通过基于规则和基于代理的验证及反馈引导修复来合成任务；3)仅保留成功且充分使用每个所需技能的轨迹。同时基于相同流程构建了SkillEval基准测试用于评估技能使用。
AI.result: 使用2,000个公共技能生成4,000个任务包和27,164条验证轨迹。跨多种模型、基准和代理框架的实验表明，在SKT生成的轨迹上进行监督微调能持续提升技能使用性能。验证消融实验、跨框架评估和规模实验进一步证明这些增益依赖于高质量监督、超越单一代理界面，并随更广泛的技能覆盖而增加。
AI.conclusion: 验证数据合成是一种有效且可扩展的技能使用训练方法，为语言模型代理的技能学习和应用提供了新的解决方案。

title: Shared Prefixes, Better Credit: Adaptive Routing for Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-agent reasoning (MAR) improves reasoning reliability through iterative solution exchange and refinement. Existing adaptive MAR methods typically learn routing decisions from query-level labels or trajectory-level returns, but such coarse supervision cannot accurately estimate the state-conditioned utility of individual operators in multi-step collaboration. We propose TreeCredit, a shared-prefix credit assignment framework for efficient adaptive MAR. Its core insight is to estimate operator utility through state-matched downstream comparisons, rather than directly attributing trajectory-level outcomes to preceding decisions. TreeCredit constructs shared-prefix collaboration trees by expanding candidate operators from the same intermediate state and assigns each state--operator pair a correctness-prioritized suffix credit based on the terminal correctness and cumulative additional cost of its complete continuation. These structured credits are converted into state-local operator preferences to train a lightweight pairwise state router, which dynamically selects the next admissible operator during inference. Experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that TreeCredit modestly improves accuracy while substantially reducing inference cost, achieving a better accuracy--cost trade-off than representative MAR methods.

AI.tldr: 提出TreeCredit框架，通过共享前缀的信用分配机制实现高效自适应多智能体推理，在略微提升准确率的同时大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的自适应多智能体推理方法通常从查询级标签或轨迹级回报中学习路由决策，但这种粗糙的监督信号无法准确估计多步协作中单个操作符在特定状态下的效用。
AI.method: 构建共享前缀协作树，从同一中间状态扩展候选操作符，基于终端正确性和累积额外成本为每个状态-操作符对分配正确性优先的后缀信用，将这些结构化信用转化为状态局部操作符偏好，训练轻量级成对状态路由器在推理时动态选择下一个可接受的操作符。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准测试上，TreeCredit在略微提升准确率的同时大幅降低推理成本，相比代表性MAR方法实现了更优的准确率-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过状态匹配的下游比较来估计操作符效用而非直接将轨迹级结果归因于先前决策，TreeCredit为自适应多智能体推理提供了更精细的信用分配机制，有效改善了推理效率与质量的平衡。

title: MechGeo: Autoformalizing and Proving Euclidean Geometry in Lean 4
summary: We present MechGeo, a Mathlib native agentic framework that jointly addresses faithful autoformalization and certified proof construction for Euclidean geometry. In this framework, GeoFormalizer represents informal problems in GeoIR, deterministically translates them into Lean 4, and iteratively repairs candidate statements using structural diagnostics and semantic evaluation. GeoProver constructs geometric proof plans, derives intermediate lemmas, and selectively algebraizes suitable subgoals through a library verified in Lean. Singular or SymPy may generate algebraic certificates, but all resulting proofs and counterexamples are checked by Lean's kernel. Experiments across seven LLM backbones show substantial improvements in autoformalization, particularly for models with weaker direct translation performance. On 43 historical IMO geometry problems, GeoFormalizer generates formal statements that GeoProver proves in 29 cases; for the remaining 14, it constructs counterexamples verified in Lean and proves all repaired statements after expert correction. Together with IMO 2026 Problem 2, this yields, to the best of our knowledge, the largest reported collection of automated, kernel-checked Lean proofs for IMO geometry problems. On the 14 geometry statements in LEAP's Lean-IMO-Bench, MechGeo proves 12 for the first time, formally refutes the remaining two, and proves both repaired statements. These results establish counterexample guided diagnosis, geometric reasoning, and certified symbolic computation as a practical foundation for trustworthy formal geometry.

AI.tldr: 提出了MechGeo框架，用于欧几里得几何的自动形式化和认证证明构建，在43个历史IMO几何问题中成功证明29个，并在LEAP的Lean-IMO-Bench上首次证明12个问题，建立了目前最大的IMO几何问题的自动化、内核检查的Lean证明集合。
AI.motivation: 几何问题的自动形式化和认证证明构建面临两个主要挑战：1）将非形式化的几何问题准确翻译为形式化语言存在困难，2）构建可信的几何证明需要确保证明过程的正确性。现有方法在处理IMO级别的复杂几何问题时存在准确性和可靠性的不足，需要开发能够同时处理形式化和证明验证的统一框架。
AI.method: 开发了Mathlib原生的代理框架MechGeo，包含两个核心组件：1）GeoFormalizer：将非形式化问题表示为GeoIR，确定性翻译为Lean 4，并通过结构诊断和语义评估迭代修复候选命题；2）GeoProver：构建几何证明计划，推导中间引理，并通过Lean验证的库选择性代数化合适子目标。使用Singular或SymPy生成代数证书，但所有证明和反例都由Lean内核检查。采用反例引导诊断、几何推理和认证符号计算相结合的方法。
AI.result: 在7个LLM骨干模型上展示显著的形式化改进；在43个历史IMO几何问题中，GeoFormalizer生成的形式化命题被GeoProver证明29个，其余14个构建了Lean验证的反例并在专家修正后证明所有修复命题；加上IMO 2026问题2，构成了目前最大的自动化、内核检查的IMO几何问题Lean证明集合；在LEAP的Lean-IMO-Bench的14个几何命题中，首次证明12个，形式化反驳其余2个，并证明2个修复后的命题。
AI.conclusion: 反例引导诊断、几何推理和认证符号计算为可信的形式几何提供了实用的基础，MechGeo框架成功实现了欧几里得几何的自动化形式化和证明构建，显著提升了IMO级别几何问题的自动求解能力，为形式化数学和自动定理证明领域做出了重要贡献。

title: Trajectories That Segment Themselves: Agent-Declared Boundaries as a Training Unit
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Includes appendices with full controls and ablations
summary: Long-horizon coding-agent trajectories are poorly matched to the credit units available to train on: a single action has no stable value, an episode label merges productive exploration with abandoned directions, and a fixed window cuts where the logging mechanics fall. We introduce collection-time semantic self-segmentation, in which a declarative contract has the acting agent expose its own boundaries while the trajectory is generated. Instantiated with falsifiable causal hypotheses, successive adoptions expose variable-length semantic phases, and no milestone vocabulary, gold patch, environment replay, teacher logits, or retrospective segmenter places a boundary. Because the agent names its conjecture, a reviewer can negate it by name, which lets our protocol manufacture wrong-cause-then-correction transitions that recorded work rarely contains; one collection then yields four supervised targets, including audit supervision from exactly the failed regions an episode label discards. We then ask what survives deleting the declaration. Given the cut points but not the hypothesis, a model attributes action blocks to their governing hypothesis at over twice chance, beating equal-length blocks over the same trajectories (paired sign test $p = 0.0002$), surviving a lexical control and collapsing under label permutation. Asked instead to place boundaries, a code-blind annotator matches 24 of 40 where random placement matches 11.5, while a mechanical test-event rule beats chance at neither end of a strict-to-permissive sweep. The segments are therefore coherent and not cheaply reproducible. Downstream, DPO on 2,551 phase-boundary pairs changes no decision on 91 adversarial held-out items, while four of 60 change on matched-construction items, all wrong to right, where two controls change none: with 1,825 pairs from one generator, the variable to vary next is corpus diversity, not the boundary.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种收集时语义自分割方法，让智能体在轨迹生成时自主暴露边界，通过可证伪因果假设创建语义片段。实验证明这些片段具有连贯性且难以廉价复制，下游DPO训练在匹配构造样本上表现良好。
AI.motivation: 现有长视野编码智能体轨迹与训练信用分配单位不匹配：单个动作无稳定价值、回合标签混淆探索与放弃方向、固定窗口切割导致日志机制丢失。需要一种更合理的轨迹分割方法来提供有意义的训练单元。
AI.method: 引入收集时语义自分割方法：在轨迹生成过程中，通过声明性契约让智能体暴露自己的边界。使用可证伪因果假设实例化，连续采纳暴露可变长度语义阶段。智能体命名其猜想后，审查者可以按名称否定，从而制造错误的因-然后-纠正转换。一次收集产生四个监督目标，包括来自回合标签丢弃的失败区域的审计监督。
AI.result: 模型在没有假设的情况下将动作块归因于其主导假设的准确率超过随机两倍（配对符号检验p=0.0002），通过词汇控制并在标签置换下失效；代码盲注释者在40个位置匹配24个（随机仅11.5）；DPO在2551个相位边界对上训练后，91个对抗测试项无变化，60个匹配构造项中4个从错误变为正确（两个控制均为零变化）。
AI.conclusion: 通过声明性契约获得的语义片段具有连贯性，不能廉价复制；下游任务验证了边界分割的有效性；当前需要关注的是语料库多样性而非边界问题本身。该方法为轨迹分割和信用分配提供了新思路。

title: Hard Constraints, Smooth Gradients: Learning Feasible Inventory Policies via Differentiable Projection
summary: Many operational problems are constrained sequential decision processes with large, combinatorial action spaces and interdependent feasibility constraints. Mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs) handle such constraints flexibly but scale poorly in stochastic environments. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) promises scalable decision rules, but existing methods either penalize constraints rather than enforce them, or rely on feasibility mechanisms that break down once constraints interact. We bridge this gap by embedding a differentiable convex optimization module inside the policy: a neural network proposes continuous action targets, a quadratic program projects them onto the relaxed feasible set, and a dual-informed integer mapping restores integrality while preserving feasibility. Given a differentiable simulator, the policy trains end to end from sampled trajectories using pathwise gradients, while handling hard constraints with similar flexibility to MILPs. We show that our feasibility enforcement has bounded error relative to an exact integer projection and ensures the entire feasible action space is reachable. We apply the method to multi-echelon production-inventory planning under shared resource and material constraints. Our policy attains an average optimality gap below 1% on small instances. It further outperforms state-of-the-art echelon base-stock policies by up to 9.75% and a rolling-horizon multi-stage stochastic program by at least 7.7% in larger networks. On an industry-scale case study from ASML, it reduces average cost by up to 3.22% relative to the best-known benchmark policy. The savings are largest where planning is hardest: in tightly capacitated systems with high demand variability. More broadly, our work shows that DRL can deliver economically significant savings in sequential decision problems with interdependent hard constraints, which are widespread in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将可微分凸优化模块嵌入深度强化学习策略的方法，解决了具有组合行动空间和相互依赖可行性约束的序列决策问题，在多级生产库存规划中实现了低于1%的最优性差距，并在ASML工业案例中降低了3.22%的成本。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理具有大规模组合行动空间和相互依赖可行性约束的序列决策问题时存在根本性矛盾：混合整数线性规划(MILP)能够灵活处理约束但在随机环境中扩展性差；深度强化学习(DRL)具有可扩展性优势，但现有方法要么对约束进行惩罚而非强制执行，要么依赖的可行性机制在约束相互作用时失效。这种差距促使研究者开发能够同时具备MILP的约束处理灵活性和DRL的可扩展性的新方法。
AI.method: 提出将可微分凸优化模块嵌入策略网络的端到端学习框架：1) 神经网络提出连续行动目标；2) 二次规划将目标投影到松弛可行集；3) 双重信息引导的整数映射恢复积分性同时保持可行性。在可微分模拟器支持下，策略通过路径梯度从采样轨迹进行端到端训练，同时以类似MILP的灵活性处理硬约束。该方法的可行性执行相对于精确整数投影具有有界误差，并确保整个可行行动空间可达。
AI.result: 在多级生产库存规划问题上的实验表明：1) 小规模实例上平均最优性差距低于1%；2) 在更大规模网络中，比最先进的级联基库存策略高出9.75%，比滚动视界多阶段随机规划高出至少7.7%；3) 在ASML工业规模案例研究中，相比最佳已知基准策略平均成本降低3.22%，在规划最困难的容量紧张且需求波动大的系统中节省效果最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功证明了深度强化学习能够在具有相互依赖硬约束的序列决策问题中实现经济上显著的节省，这类问题在实践中广泛存在。该方法填补了MILP灵活处理约束能力与DRL可扩展性之间的关键空白，为运营管理中复杂的约束序列决策问题提供了新的解决方案，具有重要的理论价值和实际应用意义。

title: Mamba with Hierarchical Memory: Solving Representation Bottleneck in Long Sequence Modeling
summary: Recurrent linear attention models (RLAs) such as Mamba offer efficient linear-time sequence modeling as an alternative to Transformers, yet their fixed-capacity recurrent states limit long-sequence modeling. Drawing inspiration from hierarchical human memory, we propose Hierarchical Memory Mamba (HMM) to address this limitation. Building upon a pre-trained Mamba backbone, HMM integrates a lightweight working memory that extracts slow paragraph-level semantics (PLS) from the fast sensory memory embedded in the backbone's hidden states. The PLS is subsequently compressed into persistent long-term memory for task-relevant retrieval. The hierarchical processing of semantic information overcomes the representation bottleneck of RLAs and endows HMM cross-task generalization through parametric learning, which is not observed in other long-context enhanced Mamba variants. Evaluations on Passkey Retrieval and LongBench-E tasks demonstrate that HMM improves retrieval success by 34.3--37.1% and reasoning accuracy by 1.6--14.2% over strong Mamba-based models, while adding only 2% extra parameters and with minimal training overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层记忆Mamba(HMM)，通过模仿人类分层记忆机制，解决了递归线性注意力模型(RLAs)固定容量状态限制的问题，在仅增加2%参数的情况下显著提升了长序列建模性能。
AI.motivation: 递归线性注意力模型(如Mamba)虽然提供高效的线性时间序列建模，但其固定容量的递归状态限制了长序列建模能力。为了突破这一表示瓶颈，作者从人类分层记忆系统中获得灵感，试图设计一种能够处理更长上下文的记忆架构。
AI.method: 基于预训练的Mamba骨干网络，HMM集成了一个轻量级工作记忆模块：1)从骨干网络隐藏状态的快速感知记忆中提取慢速段落级语义(PLS)；2)将PLS压缩为持久长期记忆以供任务相关检索。这种分层语义信息处理克服了RLAs的表示瓶颈，并通过参数化学习赋予模型跨任务泛化能力。
AI.result: 在Passkey Retrieval任务上检索成功率提升34.3-37.1%，在LongBench-E任务上推理准确率提升1.6-14.2%，同时仅增加2%的额外参数，训练开销极小。相比其他长上下文增强的Mamba变体，HMM展现出通过参数化学习获得的跨任务泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: HMM成功地将人类分层记忆机制融入递归线性注意力模型，通过工作记忆和长期记忆的分层处理突破了固定容量状态的限制，在保持参数高效性的同时显著提升了长序列建模性能，为构建更强大的序列模型提供了新思路。

title: KC-Agent: A Dual-Process Cognitive Architecture for Efficient ML Model Improvement
summary: Data drift poses significant challenges for machine learning systems in production, requiring continuous model updates to maintain performance. We present KC-Agent, a dual-process cognitive architecture for automated ML model improvement that combines fast pattern recognition (System 1) with deliberate incremental updates (System 2). Our approach implements structured memory systems enabling System 1 to leverage successful solutions previously discovered by System 2, achieving efficient pattern-based responses without costly re-computation. KC-Agent incorporates atomic change principles and rollback capabilities to ensure reliable, verifiable updates in production environments. We evaluate our method on five datasets including real-world NASA turbofan data with authentic temporal degradation and synthetic datasets with controlled drift scenarios. KC-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance (76.8% accuracy) while maintaining optimal efficiency (13.2s execution time), outperforming established cognitive architectures: CodeAct (+2.4%), Tree of Thoughts (+3.6%), ReAct (+8.0%), and Reflexion (+8.9%). Consensus evaluation by a panel of state-of-the-art LLMs confirms superior strategic efficacy (8.33/10 Smartness score), significantly outperforming baseline agents. The knowledge consolidation mechanism delivers 91% speedup over the slow variant while maintaining higher accuracy. Our approach demonstrates both theoretical foundations and practical viability for cognitive-inspired automated ML improvement systems capable of handling complex real-world data drift scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了KC-Agent，一种用于自动化机器学习模型改进的双过程认知架构，通过结合快速模式识别（System 1）和审慎的增量更新（System 2）来应对生产环境中的数据漂移问题，在多个数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的机器学习系统面临数据漂移的严峻挑战，需要持续更新模型以维持性能，而传统方法成本高昂且效率低下，亟需一种能够自动化处理数据漂移并高效更新模型的系统。
AI.method: 提出KC-Agent双过程认知架构，结合System 1（快速模式识别）和System 2（审慎增量更新）；实现结构化记忆系统使System 1能够利用System 2先前发现的成功解决方案；引入原子变更原则和回滚能力以确保生产环境中的可靠性和可验证性更新。
AI.result: 在包含NASA涡扇数据等五个数据集上的评估显示：达到最先进性能（76.8%准确率）和最优效率（13.2秒执行时间）；优于CodeAct（+2.4%）、Tree of Thoughts（+3.6%）、ReAct（+8.0%）和Reflexion（+8.9%）等认知架构；LLM共识评估显示卓越策略效果（8.33/10智能评分）；知识整合机制实现91%加速同时保持更高准确率。
AI.conclusion: KC-Agent证明了认知启发的自动化机器学习改进系统在处理复杂现实世界数据漂移场景方面的理论基础和实用可行性，为生产环境中的模型持续优化提供了有效解决方案。

title: SkillTrace: Traversing a Query-Skill Graph for Composable LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents increasingly solve complex tasks by composing reusable skills from a library. To address this, the key challenge is not merely to retrieve individually relevant skills, but to identify a complete and executable skill composition. In this paper, we argue that this problem can be solved in a graph with three levels: compositional relations among skill queries, similarity between queries and candidates in the skill library, and the dependencies among the selected candidates. We introduce SkillTrace, which organizes the user query into a semantic hierarchy, matches skill queries and candidates, and propagates over the skill dependencies. Experiments on SkillsBench and ALFWorld demonstrate that SkillTrace achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching a success rate of 53.17% on SkillsBench and 91.43% on ALFWorld. SkillTrace also delivers consistent improvements across different backbone language models, demonstrating the generality and robustness of graph-based skill retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出了SkillTrace，一种基于三层次图的技能检索与组合方法，在SkillsBench和ALFWorld上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型代理在解决复杂任务时需要从技能库中组合可复用的技能，现有方法的关键挑战在于如何识别完整且可执行的技能组合，而不仅仅是检索单独相关的技能。
AI.method: 提出SkillTrace方法，构建三层次图结构：技能查询之间的组合关系、查询与技能库候选者之间的相似性、所选候选者之间的依赖关系；将用户查询组织成语义层次，匹配技能查询与候选者，并在技能依赖关系上进行传播。
AI.result: 在SkillsBench上成功率达到53.17%，在ALFWorld上成功率达到91.43%，均达到state-of-the-art性能；在不同的骨干语言模型上均有一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于图的技能检索方法具有良好的通用性和鲁棒性，能够有效解决复杂任务中的技能组合问题。

title: Faster-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Deep Action Modules?
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple robot action prediction with video world models. Existing WAMs with shared-backbone and Mixture-of-Transformers designs generally tie the depth of the action module to that of the video backbone, resulting in substantial computational overhead and high inference latency. To address this limitation, we introduce Dock of Transformer (DoT), a video-centric design principle that treats a pretrained video Transformer as a representation hub and connects lightweight output-heads through docking interfaces. This enables flexible output-head design while providing direct access to representations from all layers of the backbone. We then introduce \textbf{Faster-WAM}, an instantiation of DoT for WAMs, which docks a single-layer action head onto a 30-layer video backbone. The docking interface fuses keys and values from all video layers and applies RoPE realignment. Without additional embodied pretraining, Faster-WAM achieves competitive performance on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 while demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization on LIBERO-Plus. Faster-WAM also achieves the lowest end-to-end latency in our controlled comparison, requiring only 66.5 ms per inference --- a \(3.2\times\) speedup over Fast-WAM. Overall, these results demonstrate that the video-centric DoT architecture supports flexible task-specific head design while delivering low inference latency, strong action-prediction performance, and robust generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出Dock of Transformer (DoT)设计原则及其实现Faster-WAM，通过将轻量级动作头对接到视频骨干网络，在保持性能的同时实现3.2倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）采用共享骨干网络或混合Transformer设计，导致动作模块的深度与视频骨干网络深度绑定，产生大量计算开销和高推理延迟。
AI.method: 提出Dock of Transformer (DoT)设计原则，将预训练视频Transformer作为表示中心，通过对接接口连接轻量级输出头；实现Faster-WAM，将单层动作头对接到30层视频骨干网络，对接接口融合所有视频层的键值并应用RoPE重对齐。
AI.result: 在LIBERO和RoboTWin 2.0上达到竞争性能，在LIBERO-Plus上展现出强大的分布外泛化能力；推理延迟仅66.5毫秒，相比Fast-WAM实现3.2倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 视频中心的DoT架构支持灵活的任务特定头部设计，同时实现低推理延迟、强动作预测性能和鲁棒泛化能力。

title: Chess on Ice: Curling Tactical Decision-Making via Backward Induction and Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Curling is often referred to as "Chess on Ice", owing to the tactical complexity of its decision-making process. Yet unlike chess, curling remains largely underexplored from a machine learning perspective, with prior work confined mainly to statistical approaches. We propose a reinforcement learning framework capable of quantitatively evaluating and comparing tactical options in curling. The game poses several modeling challenges: continuous state and action spaces, stochastic action outcomes reflecting player skill variability, and state transitions that are highly sensitive to small perturbations in the executed action. To address them, we employ the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient actor-critic algorithm, adapted to exploit the finite-horizon structure of the game. Our experiments show that effective curling strategies can be acquired in a fully self-supervised manner, without any human-annotated data: on a reduced four-rock variant, the learned agent matches a hand-crafted expert heuristic in a regime where that heuristic is close to optimal, a parity we quantify against the intrinsic hammer advantage of the variant. Beyond the resulting policy, the learned critic provides a dense value estimate over the entire continuous action space, enabling the quantitative comparison of tactical alternatives for applications such as post-game performance analysis and decision support during athlete preparation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个基于强化学习的冰壶战术评估框架，采用改进的DDPG算法，在无需人类标注数据的情况下达到了专家级水平，并提供了对连续动作空间的密集价值估计以支持战术分析。
AI.motivation: 冰壶被称为"冰上国际象棋"，具有高度的战术复杂性，但现有研究主要局限于统计方法，缺乏从机器学习角度的深入探索。冰壶游戏具有连续的状态和动作空间、随机性的动作结果（反映选手技能差异）、以及对微小扰动高度敏感的状态转换，这些都为建模带来了巨大挑战。
AI.method: 采用深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）actor-critic算法，并针对冰壶游戏的有限时间范围结构进行了改进适配。该方法能够在完全自监督的方式下学习，无需任何人类标注数据。实验在四岩石变体上进行验证。
AI.result: 在四岩石变体上，学习到的智能体在接近最优的条件下达到了与手工设计的专家启发式策略相匹配的表现。研究者还量化了该变体中固有的"hammer advantage"（最后一投优势）。学习到的critic网络能够提供整个连续动作空间上的密集价值估计。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功实现了冰壶策略的有效学习，不仅产生了有效的策略网络，还提供了对整个连续动作空间的密集价值估计，可用于赛后表现分析和运动员训练期间的决策支持等应用，为冰壶这项运动引入了定量评估和比较战术选项的新方法。

title: Cooperative Coevolution for Resource-Constrained Agentic LLM Post-Training
summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents produce long, multi-turn trajectories, making gradient-based post-training memory-intensive. Evolution strategies (ES) enable memory-efficient full-parameter post-training without backpropagation and can eventually match the performance of gradient-based reinforcement learning (RL). However, resource-constrained settings typically offer only a few GPUs, so the high GPU-hour requirements of ES translate into prohibitively long training times. To address this, we introduce Cooperative Parameter-subspace Evolution Strategy (CoPES), a cooperative coevolutionary method that decomposes the full parameter space into lower-dimensional subspaces and searches over them cooperatively to improve optimization efficiency. We post-train a Qwen3.5-4B tool-using agent for the math task and evaluate it on five benchmarks of varying difficulty. Under the GPU-hour budget of full-parameter GRPO's best validation checkpoint, CoPES recovers 92% of GRPO's validation-accuracy gain, versus 67% for standard ES, while its theoretical GPU memory requirement is less than one-eighth that of full-parameter GRPO. It consistently outperforms standard ES and LoRA-based GRPO on all evaluated pass@k metrics across the five benchmarks. Additional experiments further show the advantage of CoPES on the question-answering task. These results demonstrate an improved trade-off between memory requirements and training time for agentic LLM post-training under resource constraints. The code is open-sourced in https://github.com/MetaronWang/CoPES

AI.tldr: 提出CoPES方法，通过合作协同进化策略分解参数空间，在资源受限环境下实现高效的工具使用LLM智能体后训练。
AI.motivation: 工具使用的大语言模型智能体产生长轨迹、多轮交互，导致基于梯度的后训练内存消耗大。进化策略(ES)虽能实现内存高效的全参数训练且无需反向传播，但在资源受限的少量GPU环境下，ES的高GPU小时需求转化为过长的训练时间。
AI.method: 提出合作参数子空间进化策略(CoPES)，这是一种合作协同进化方法，将全参数空间分解为低维子空间，并在子空间上进行合作搜索以提高优化效率。在全参数GRPO的最佳验证检查点的GPU小时预算下进行实验。
AI.result: 在数学任务的五个不同难度基准上评估，CoPES恢复了GRPO验证准确率增益的92%（标准ES为67%），理论GPU内存需求不到全参数GRPO的八分之一。在所有五个基准的pass@k指标上持续优于标准ES和基于LoRA的GRPO。问答任务实验也显示了CoPES的优势。
AI.conclusion: CoPES在资源受限条件下实现了智能体LLM后训练中内存需求与训练时间之间的改进权衡，为资源受限环境下的模型训练提供了有效解决方案。

title: MonitrLLM: A Community-Centered Evaluation Infrastructure for Large Language Models
summary:
Benchmark suites assess model capability on controlled tasks; large-scale conversation corpora capture naturalistic use without user feedback; and in-interface feedback mechanisms record satisfaction without task purpose. Together, they leave a critical gap in LLM evaluation: no existing infrastructure routinely links interaction trajectories to user-defined outcomes. We introduce MonitrLLM, open-source infrastructure for community-centered LLM evaluations that links full conversation transcripts to user-reported task intent and outcome assessments, treating all three as primary evaluative signals rather than optional metadata.
  To demonstrate the value of this approach, we conducted a two-week feasibility pilot with 26 college students using ChatGPT, collecting 206 evaluation reports with full conversation transcripts. The findings from our pilot demonstrate the value of connecting conversation trajectories with user-reported outcomes. For instance, despite reporting high average satisfaction (4.19/5) with their LLM interactions, participants also experience a substantial 23.1% failure rate on their goal tasks. We also find that multi-turn conversations are reported as failing at 2.5 times the rate of single-turn exchanges, a pattern that reframes extended interaction as a signal of difficulty rather than engagement. We conclude by discussing the value of incorporating direct user feedback with observational data for robust LLM evaluations, and the possibilities for infrastructure that enables this goal.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了MonitrLLM基础设施，将对话轨迹与用户任务意图及结果评估关联，填补了LLM评估的空白；试点研究显示用户高满意度（4.19/5）下实际任务失败率达23.1%，多轮对话失败率是单轮的2.5倍。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估方法存在关键缺口：基准测试仅评估受控任务，大规模对话语料库缺乏用户反馈，界面反馈机制缺少任务目的。没有现有基础设施能够常规性地将交互轨迹与用户定义的结果关联起来。
AI.method: 引入MonitrLLM开源基础设施，将完整对话转录与用户报告的任务意图和结果评估进行关联，将三者都作为主要评估信号而非可选元数据。通过26名大学生使用ChatGPT进行两周可行性试点，收集了206份包含完整对话转录的评估报告。
AI.result: 试点研究显示：用户对LLM交互报告高平均满意度（4.19/5），但目标任务失败率达23.1%；多轮对话的失败率是单轮对话的2.5倍，这一模式将扩展交互重新定义为困难信号而非参与度信号。
AI.conclusion: 将直接用户反馈与观察数据结合具有重要价值，能够实现更稳健的LLM评估；讨论了支持这一目标的基础设施的可能性。

title: xPress: Parallel Refinement for Diffusion Drafters in Speculative Decoding
summary: Block-diffusion drafters like dFlash generate an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, drastically reducing the overhead of multiple-token drafting in speculative decoding. The crucial final step of the single-pass discrete denoising process involves using the logit distribution at each position to sample conditionally independent tokens. The resulting draft is thus a set of per-position marginals, rather than a joint distribution: no draft token is guaranteed to depend on its predecessors. Such independently sampled marginals tend to produce sequences with tokens that are individually likely, but jointly improbable under the target model's distribution, which verifies each token conditionally. This can cause early rejection and limits acceptance length. To address this, we propose xPress as a means to restore the missing causality in diffusion drafters. xPress is a lightweight causal refiner that reconciles the whole diffusion block at once through parallel refinement, restoring and propagating causal dependencies across the draft without a token-by-token loop. On Qwen3-8B, across seven math, code, and chat benchmarks, xPress raises acceptance length by about 30% on average (up to +56%) and its end-to-end decoding throughput by about 1.3 on average (up to 1.7) compared to the original dFlash diffusion drafter.

AI.tldr: 提出了xPress，一种轻量级因果修正器，通过并行细化恢复扩散推演中的因果依赖，显著提升接受长度和解码吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的块扩散推演方法（如dFlash）在单次前向传递中生成整个块的推演token，通过在每个位置采样条件独立token来生成推演。这导致生成的推演是边缘分布而非联合分布，draft token之间缺乏因果依赖关系。这种独立采样的边缘分布往往产生在目标模型分布下"单独看似合理但联合概率很低"的token序列，容易导致早期拒绝，限制了接受长度。
AI.method: 提出xPress作为轻量级因果修正器，通过并行细化一次性修正整个扩散块，恢复并在推演中传播因果依赖关系，无需逐token的循环处理。该方法旨在为缺失因果性的扩散推演器补充必要的因果依赖。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B模型上，跨越七个数学、代码和对话基准测试，xPress将接受长度平均提高约30%（最高+56%），端到端解码吞吐量平均提升约1.3倍（最高1.7倍），相较于原始dFlash扩散推演器。
AI.conclusion: xPress有效解决了扩散推演中因果依赖缺失的问题，通过轻量级的并行因果修正显著提升了推演质量和系统吞吐量，为推测解码中的多token推演提供了有效解决方案。

title: Agentic Commerce World: An Auditable and Verifiable Environment for Vibe Commerce
summary: In vibe coding, people describe software in natural language and delegate implementation to AI agents. By analogy, vibe commerce allows people to express buying or selling goals in natural language and delegate the corresponding tasks to agents. Commerce, however, requires independently controlled Buyer and Merchant agents to interact in a shared market while preserving their private objectives and distinct authority. We introduce Agentic Commerce World (ACWorld), an environment for evaluating such agents across ongoing transactions. Through its Vibe Commerce Protocol (VCP), ACWorld validates agent actions before updating shared transaction state and records the resulting interactions, making agent behavior auditable and evaluation reproducible. The ACWorld Benchmark contains a 200-task capability-coverage track and a 60-task large-catalog track that searches 785,022 transactable listings. Across ten models, mean scores range from 65.9% to 85.6% and from 56.1% to 91.4%, respectively. Our analysis shows that process-level evidence is necessary: final state alone can miss evaluated errors, incomplete trajectories still retain useful process signals, and large-catalog tasks expose bottlenecks across stages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Agentic Commerce World (ACWorld)环境，用于评估Vibe Commerce场景下买家和商家智能体之间的交互，并通过200任务能力覆盖轨道和60任务大目录轨道的基准测试，分析了不同模型的性能表现。
AI.motivation: 受Vibe Coding启发，作者提出Vibe Commerce概念，即用户用自然语言描述买卖目标并委托给AI智能体执行。与传统软件不同，商业交易需要独立控制的买家和商家智能体在共享市场中交互，同时需保持各自的私有目标和权限边界，因此需要专门的评估环境。
AI.method: 引入Agentic Commerce World (ACWorld)评估环境，通过Vibe Commerce Protocol (VCP)验证智能体行为、更新共享交易状态并记录交互过程。基准测试包含两个轨道：(1) 200任务的能力覆盖轨道；(2) 60任务的大目录轨道，涵盖785,022个可交易商品。对10个模型进行了系统评估。
AI.result: 在能力覆盖轨道上，10个模型的平均得分范围为65.9%至85.6%；在大目录轨道上为56.1%至91.4%。分析表明：仅依赖最终状态会遗漏已评估错误，不完整轨迹仍保留有价值的流程信号，大目录任务揭示了跨阶段瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: ACWorld为Vibe Commerce提供了可审计、可复现的智能体评估框架，证明了流程级证据对于准确评估智能体行为的必要性，并揭示了大规模商品目录场景下的系统性挑战。

title: Right Answer, Wrong Method: Shortcut Hacking Misleads the Evaluation of LLM Reasoning on Frontier Science Benchmarks
summary: Scientific reasoning benchmarks typically evaluate large language models (LLMs) using final-answer accuracy. However, a correct answer does not necessarily demonstrate the reasoning capability targeted by the problem. We identify Solution Hacking, a failure mode in which an LLM reaches the correct answer through invalid shortcuts, such as numerical search, enumeration, guessing, or answer-first verification, without providing a valid task-targeted derivation. We systematically analyze this phenomenon across difficulty levels, scientific domains, and frontier models. Solution hacking increases sharply with benchmark difficulty, from 2.2\% on common problems to 28.3\% on Olympiad-level problems and 37.4\% on HLE. Moreover, 8.2\%-44.1\% of answers credited as correct across frontier models are identified as hacked solutions. We further develop expert-inspired anti-hacking strategies, including an automatic judge and a test-time instruction. The results show that suppressing shortcut behavior substantially reduces reported accuracy while having a smaller effect on correct and non-hacked accuracy. These findings reveal that answer-only evaluation can overestimate the scientific reasoning capabilities of frontier LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现了大语言模型在科学推理基准测试中的“解法破解”现象，即通过无效捷径（如数值搜索、枚举、猜测等）获取正确答案而非真正的推理能力。研究表明这种现象在高难度题目中更为普遍，并提出反破解策略以更准确评估模型的真实推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有科学推理基准测试通常仅通过最终答案的准确性来评估大语言模型，但正确答案并不一定能证明模型具备问题所针对的推理能力。研究旨在揭示并分析模型通过无效捷径获取正确答案的“解法破解”现象，以避免过度估计模型的科学推理能力。
AI.method:
1. 识别并定义“解法破解”失败模式，即模型通过数值搜索、枚举、猜测或答案优先验证等无效捷径获得正确答案。
2. 系统性分析该现象在不同难度级别、科学领域和前沿模型上的表现。
3. 开发受专家启发的反破解策略，包括自动评判器和测试时指令。
4. 评估反破解策略对模型准确性的影响。
AI.result:
1. 解法破解现象随基准难度显著增加：常见问题中为2.2%，奥赛级别问题中为28.3%，HLE中高达37.4%。
2. 在前沿模型中，被认定为正确的答案中有8.2%-44.1%实为破解方案。
3. 抑制捷径行为后，报告的准确性显著下降，但对正确且非破解方案的准确性影响较小。
4. 仅靠答案评估会过度估计前沿LLMs的科学推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，仅依赖最终答案准确性评估LLMs的科学推理能力存在显著缺陷，可能严重高估模型能力。通过识别解法破解现象并采用反破解策略，可以更准确地评估模型的实际推理水平。该发现对科学推理基准测试的设计和LLMs能力评估具有重要意义，呼吁采用更严格的评估方法。

title: ParEvalLayer: When Partial LLM-Agent Evaluations Support a Decision
comment: Accepted at the 2026 ACM International Conference on AI-ML Systems (AIMLSystems)
summary: LLM-agent evaluations often produce task outcomes long before the full benchmark run is complete. A partial score is tempting to report, but it does not show whether the observed tasks support the same conclusion as the completed evaluation. Early tasks can omit important parts of a benchmark, running cheaper tasks first can distort the observed sample, and a rule that decides only easy pairs can appear accurate while leaving many comparisons unresolved. We introduce ParEvalLayer, a decision layer that reads paired outcomes for two agent systems and a comparison policy chosen in advance. For each partial run, it records whether the tested agent system is better by the required amount, is not better by that amount, needs more evidence, or should abstain. We evaluate ParEvalLayer by replaying completed public benchmark data as if each evaluation had stopped earlier. At each point, ParEvalLayer applies the policy using only the outcomes observed so far; if it reaches one of the two comparison judgments, we check whether that judgment matches the completed data for the same system pair. With the main comparison rule, three of the public benchmarks reach the same decision as the completed evaluation after observing only 15% to 25% of task outcomes. Other benchmarks require more task outcomes. This variation shows why a partial score alone is not enough: reports should also state the decision rule and how many comparisons remain without a decision.

AI.tldr: 提出了ParEvalLayer，一种用于LLM代理评估的决策层，能够在部分评估结果上做出可靠的比较判断，而非仅报告不完整的分数。
AI.motivation: LLM代理评估通常在完整基准测试运行完成之前就产生任务结果，研究者往往倾向于报告部分分数。然而，部分分数可能无法支持与完整评估相同的结论：早期任务可能遗漏基准测试的重要部分、优先运行廉价任务会导致样本偏差、仅解决简单对的规则可能看起来准确但留下大量未解决的比较。
AI.method: 引入ParEvalLayer决策层，读取两个代理系统的配对结果和预先选择的比较策略。对于每次部分运行，记录测试的代理系统是否达到要求的优越程度、未达到该程度、需要更多证据或应弃权。通过重放已完成的公共基准测试数据来评估，模拟每次评估提前停止的情况，在每一点应用策略并检查判断是否与完整数据匹配。
AI.result: 在主要比较规则下，三个公共基准测试在仅观察到15%至25%的任务结果后就达到了与完整评估相同的决策。其他基准测试需要更多任务结果。这种差异表明部分分数本身不足够。
AI.conclusion: 部分分数不足以支持可靠结论，报告应同时陈述决策规则以及有多少比较仍未做出决策。这突显了在LLM代理评估中需要透明和标准化的部分评估报告方法。

title: Infinite Trace Objectives with Finite Trace Techniques: Translating LTL to LTLf+
summary: Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) is one of the most widely adopted languages for specifying temporal extended objectives in AI, with applications ranging from reactive synthesis to stochastic planning in Markov decision processes and reinforcement learning. Traditionally, solving any of these problems requires translating the LTL specification to a nondeterministic automata on infinite words and then determinizing it, a step that is notoriously difficult in theory and in practice. Recent work has introduced LTLf+, which lifts the finite-trace logic LTLf to infinite traces. LTLf+ has the same expressive power as LTL, yet it retains most of the crucial advantages of its base logic LTLf. Most reasoning in LTLf+ rests on finite automata on finite words, for which we have not only a canonical minimal representation but also an efficient determinization procedure. In this work we present the first translation from LTL to LTLf+. We first normalize an LTL formula into the syntactic reactivity fragment of the Manna-Pnueli hierarchy, to create the general fragment-based shape of LTLf+. We then present linear translations for each individual component of that fragment. As a consequence of this translation, the expanding body of techniques developed for LTLf+ now becomes available to many AI problems currently formulated in LTL. We further show that this comes at no asymptotic cost, as the pipeline from LTL to automaton via LTLf+ remains doubly exponential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了从LTL到LTLf+的首个转换方法，使得LTLf+的技术可用于LTL问题，且保持双倍指数复杂度。
AI.motivation: 传统LTL问题求解需要将LTL转换为非确定性无限词自动机再确定化，这一步骤在理论和实践上都极其困难。虽然LTLf+具有与LTL相同的表达能力，却保留了LTLf的优势（基于有限词有限自动机，有规范最小表示和高效确定化过程），但缺乏从LTL到LTLf+的转换方法。
AI.method: 提出首个从LTL到LTLf+的转换方法：首先将LTL公式归一化为Manna-Pnueli层次结构中的语法反应性片段，创建LTLf+的通用片段形式；然后对每个片段组件给出线性转换。
AI.result: 成功实现了从LTL到LTLf+的转换，使得为LTLf+开发的技术现在可用于当前用LTL表述的许多AI问题；该转换过程保持双倍指数复杂度，无额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过建立LTL到LTLf+的转换桥梁，使得LTLf+的高效推理技术（基于有限自动机）可广泛应用于反应式合成、马尔可夫决策过程随机规划和强化学习等AI问题，避免了传统方法中困难的自动机确定化步骤。

title: Real-Time Detection and Repair of LLM Agent Failures
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures. Code, data and demo: github.com/sunnydubey1111/agent-trajectory-sentinel Walkthrough: youtu.be/a05n_000klE
summary:
LLM agents fail mid-episode -- they loop, cascade tool errors, drift off goal, fabricate results, or silently absorb corrupted content -- and the standard remedy, judging every step with a second LLM, costs more than the agent itself. We ask how much detection is achievable from observable step telemetry alone, using monitors costing microseconds per step and trained only on healthy runs.
  On 2,823 committed agent episodes across three frameworks, three local models (qwen2.5 7b/3b, llama3.1 8b) and a commercial API (gemini-2.5-flash), a one-class echo-state-network ensemble with CUSUM alarms detects 0.71 of failures at a 5% false-alarm budget (AUROC 0.872). Its advantage over a memoryless baseline is a monotone function of post-onset horizon (+0.09 at <=3 steps, +0.40 at >=9), predicting its own failure region out of sample on AFTraj-2K. Ranking transfers with no retraining to two corpora from other groups (AFTraj-2K 0.745, ATBench 0.779).
  Monitors carry two burdens: a per-deployment healthy null (they do not transfer -- AUROC 0.527 cold against 0.885 recalibrated) and a residual false-alarm rate. We add a layer carrying neither: deterministic verification, which recomputes a run's stated total from the tool results it actually received and confirms every required call was made. Head-to-head it catches 60% of failures (96% with the coverage check) at 0 of 63 false positives against the monitor's 54% at 17%, transfers unchanged to llama3.1:8b (110 of 110 at 0 of 10), and trips on 0 of 1825 healthy episodes.
  Detection is then closed into repair: each flagged run is rolled back and re-run live, recovering 45% of failures against a 16% resampling control (p=0.0005) and lifting task success from 52% to 73% for about one extra model call per run. The system runs at ~200 microseconds per step, three orders of magnitude below a judge call. Code, traces and results are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种低成本LLM智能体故障检测与修复系统。通过回声状态网络ensemble和CUSUM警报，仅利用可观测的步骤遥测数据，在5%误报率下检测到71%的故障（AUROC 0.872）。确定性验证层可零误报捕获60%故障。结合回滚重运行修复，将任务成功率从52%提升至73%，每步仅需约200微秒，比LLM评判快三个数量级。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在执行过程中会出现循环、工具错误级联、目标漂移、结果捏造或静默吸收被污染内容等故障。现有解决方案——用另一个LLM评判每一步——成本甚至超过智能体本身。本文探索仅从可观测的步骤遥测数据中能实现多少故障检测能力，使用每步仅消耗微秒级成本且仅在健康运行数据上训练的监控器。
AI.method:
1. **单类回声状态网络ensemble + CUSUM警报**：仅在健康运行数据上训练，利用步骤遥测数据进行故障检测，每步成本约200微秒。

2. **确定性验证层**：重新计算运行所声明的总数（基于实际接收的工具结果），并确认所有必需调用已执行。

3. **修复机制**：对标记的运行回滚并实时重新执行。

实验涵盖2,823个智能体episode，涉及三个框架、三个本地模型（qwen2.5 7b/3b, llama3.1 8b）和一个商业API（gemini-2.5-flash）。
AI.result:
**监控器性能**：
- 在5%误报预算下检测到71%故障，AUROC达0.872
- 相比无记忆基线，优势随故障后视野单调增长（<=3步时+0.09，>=9步时+0.40）
- 跨数据集迁移良好：AFTraj-2K AUROC 0.745，ATBench 0.779

**确定性验证层**：
- 捕获60%故障（含覆盖检查时96%），零误报（0/63）
- 迁移至llama3.1:8b时保持110/110正确，零误报（0/10）
- 对1825个健康episode零触发

**修复效果**：
- 恢复45%故障（对照重采样仅16%，p=0.0005）
- 任务成功率从52%提升至73%
- 每次运行仅需约一次额外模型调用

**效率**：每步约200微秒，比LLM评判调用快三个数量级。

**局限性**：监控器需要针对每个部署的健康基准（不迁移时AUROC从0.885降至0.527），且存在残余误报率。
AI.conclusion: 从可观测步骤遥测数据的轻量级监控可高效检测LLM智能体故障，配合确定性验证层可实现零误报的高精度检测。故障检测可闭环至修复：通过回滚重运行，显著提升任务成功率。系统运行成本极低（每步200微秒），为LLM智能体可靠性提供了经济高效的解决方案。代码、轨迹和结果已公开发布。

title: Long-term Measurements: Towards a Longitudinal Understanding of Human-AI Interactions
summary: Language models have taken on the role of a very new type of technology, by virtue of their "human-ness" and rapid integration into users' daily lives. This combination of features can introduce longitudinal risks---cognitive, developmental and socio-affective changes in humans---that might not surface in short-term interactions, but can have lasting long-term effects on users. This forms the basis of a critical new mission for NLP: to pivot from static, short-term evaluations of text generations to long-term measurements of behavioral changes, towards a diachronic understanding of human-model interactions. In this work, we draw from measurements used in social science fields that are crucial to understand emergent phenomena in longitudinal data. We discuss how computational methods in the field of NLP need to be combined with such measurements, not only to understand long-term safety risks of human-model interactions, but to help steer model development towards positive rather than negative outcomes for users. This ability to model human behavioral shifts as a function of model interactions can facilitate online rather than post-hoc detection of problematic behaviors, and should be leveraged in alignment frameworks to mitigate long-term risks in users.

AI.tldr: 本文主张NLP研究需要从静态短期评估转向长期行为变化测量，借鉴社会科学方法来理解和引导人机交互的长期影响。
AI.motivation: 语言模型因其"人性化"特征被快速整合到用户日常生活中，可能引入认知、发展和社会情感变化等长期风险，这些风险在短期交互中不会显现，但会对用户产生持久影响。当前NLP领域缺乏对这些纵向风险的理解和应对机制。
AI.method: 借鉴社会科学领域中用于理解纵向数据中涌现现象的测量方法，探讨如何将NLP领域的计算方法与这些测量手段相结合，建立能够建模人类行为变化的框架，从而实现在线检测问题行为而非事后检测。
AI.result: 提出了将长期行为测量整合到NLP评估体系中的方法论，建立了能够建模人类行为随模型交互变化的能力，并将该能力应用于对齐框架中以缓解用户面临的长期风险。
AI.conclusion: NLP领域需要转向历时性理解人机交互，通过结合社会科学测量方法来检测和引导模型发展，确保对用户产生积极而非消极的长期影响，这应成为模型对齐框架的重要组成部分。
